### [1] [Counting Events, Not Seeing Them: Diagnosing and Repairing the Readout Failure in Video LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09949)
*Dongwu Qian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究发现，LLM在处理事件计数任务时，尤其是涉及对象重复出现的情况，虽然存在一定的表示信息，但在解码输出时存在缺陷。通过两种特定的读取导向修复方法，可以显著提高计数准确性。同时，研究揭示了一些数据完整性问题，并通过视频审计验证了研究发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在对象计数任务中存在显著失败，这主要归因于缺乏对象持久性。然而，进一步研究发现这一归因可能并不完全准确。

Method: 研究使用基于构造的合成测试平台和独立验证的标签，通过多种实验方法和技术，如监督学习、符号辅助信道、迁移学习等，验证对象计数模型的表现。

Result: 研究结果显示，虽然存在计数信号，但在解码输出时存在缺陷。通过两种读取导向修复方法，可以显著提高模型的计数准确性。不过，符号转移在零样本情况下的表现不佳。此外，研究揭示了测量装置中的四个数据完整性问题，并通过实时视频审计验证了研究结论。

Conclusion: 研究结论表明，LLM在对象事件计数任务中的不足主要在于对信号的解读问题，而非获取能力本身。通过适当的改进和训练方法，可以在一定程度上修复这个问题。

Abstract: Video LLMs fail conspicuously at counting how many times an object crosses the screen, a failure attributed to missing object permanence. Using construction-grounded synthetic testbeds with independently validated labels, we show this attribution is incomplete: the count signal is present but unread - linear probes decode per-window presence at 93% while global count decoding collapses to a duration confound. Concurrent work reports the same representation-output dissociation for repetition counting; we show that in exit-and-reappear event counting it is repairable: two readout-directed repairs (episode-localization supervision and a discrete event-symbol side channel) raise same-object counting from 46.7% to 65.0% (oracle 66.7%) on a chance-33% benchmark across 7B-30B systems. Transfer to an independent factory costs nothing, and an audit of the measurement apparatus exposes four data-integrity failures that had obscured the boundary. A real-video audit (REALCOUNT, n=18, blind-audited) shows the boundary persists - best 55.6% at chance 33.3% - and symbol transfer fails zero-shot. A 1-epoch in-domain adaptation bench is negative (six levers at 28-50%), but a 3-epoch schedule shows this is budget-limited for the symbol channel: with a 3-epoch schedule and sequence-disjoint oracle timelines the reader reaches 94.4% on REALCOUNT, and with the deployed detector's timelines a 2-epoch run reaches 72.2%. The residual gap is detector evidence and the reader's match to detector noise, not reader capacity: a frozen-feature boundary probe finds the signal weak (AUC 0.62 over a 0.51 permutation control) and non-transferring across clips (0.77 within-clip vs. 0.62 across windows).

</details>


### [2] [Video-DCI: How Far Are VLM Agents from Human Viewers in Direct Video Corpus Interaction?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09951)
*Garry Yang,Yuqiao Liu,Hao Lin,Luohao Pan,Xinru Chen,Wanqi Ren,Zhikang Xu,Yizhan Huang,Huaixiao Tou,James Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 现有视频基准往往忽视多轮视觉证据搜索的探索，因此作者提出了Video-DCI，这是一个用于直接视频库交互的诊断基准和功能匹配的人机协议。它包括DCI-Loc用于时间证据定位和DCI-QA用于端到端的证据发现、保留和跨视频组合。实验表明，在多轮搜索中，迭代搜索优于一次检索，但尚不足以达到人类的精确度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视频基准往往只关注视频最终答案或孤立的定位，或允许文本捷径，导致了多轮视觉证据搜索的忽视。

Method: 提出了Video-DCI，包括了用于时间证据定位的DCI-Loc和用于端到端证据发现的DCI-QA。在DCI-QA中，给定问题和视频池，参与者需要逐步检查局部窗口，保留支持证据，并用引用的时间跨度答题。

Result: 实验结果显示了检索到定位之间的差距。在DCI-Loc上，前沿的视觉语言模型能检索到并暴露参考时刻，但只有少数能够将这些暴露转化为精确的最终引用。在DCI-QA上，差距更早出现并随着视频的增加而积累。

Conclusion: 迭代搜索在目前更为有效，但仍不足以达到人类的准确性。这表明多轮搜索虽然必要但不足够，当前的代理更容易聚集候选证据和观察，但却难以提供精确且综合性的证据。

Abstract: Humans answer complex visual questions by inspecting short moments, updating what they know, and redirecting attention toward missing evidence. Existing video benchmarks, however, often provide the relevant video, evaluate only final answers or isolated localization, or permit textual shortcuts, leaving multi-round visual evidence seeking underexplored. We introduce Video-DCI, a diagnostic benchmark and functionally matched human-agent protocol for Direct Video-Corpus Interaction. It comprises DCI-Loc for temporal evidence localization and DCI-QA for end-to-end discovery, retention, and composition of cross-video evidence. In DCI-QA, videos within each pool are topically related, yet every answer requires hidden temporal evidence from multiple videos. Given only the question and video pool, humans and agents iteratively inspect bounded local windows, retain supporting evidence, and answer with cited temporal spans. Human trajectories provide reference curves for evidence acquisition and use across rounds. Experiments reveal a consistent retrieval-to-grounding gap. On DCI-Loc, frontier VLMs often retrieve and expose the reference moment, yet convert far less of this exposure into precise final citations than the human reference. On DCI-QA, the loss begins earlier and compounds across videos. Ablation studies further confirm that iterative search outperforms one-shot retrieval. Multi-round search is therefore necessary but insufficient: current agents accumulate candidates and observations more readily than precise, jointly sufficient evidence.

</details>


### [3] [Confusion-Adaptive Margin Learning for Handwritten Letter Recognition: A Controlled Study on EMNIST Letters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09953)
*Azam Nouri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Introduction of CAML improved accuracy slightly but did not globally outperform the baseline, as new errors also appeared.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为解决基于几何的手写字符识别系统中视觉相似类别之间的残留字母混淆问题，介绍了CAML方法。

Method: CAML通过从试点训练中排除的发现分区构建稀疏加权混淆图，并在最终训练中应用特定对的余弦分割约束来训练目标。

Result: 在EMNIST Letters数据集上，CAML方法提高了精度和宏F1分数。在不同条件下的平均精度有所增加，但未见显著提升。在干净数据上，CAML减少了某些对的对称错误，但在带噪数据上的优势不显著。

Conclusion: CAML方法虽然解决了部分错误，但在全局上并未超越基线，并且也引入了新的错误，显示了其改进的局限性。

Abstract: Handwritten character recognition systems can achieve high accuracy while retaining concentrated errors among visually similar classes. Motivated by residual letter confusions in earlier geometry-based recognition work, we investigate whether these errors can be addressed through the training objective. We introduce Confusion-Adaptive Margin Learning (CAML), which constructs a sparse weighted confusion graph from a discovery partition held out from pilot training and applies pair-specific cosine-separation constraints during final training. CAML adds no classifier, routing rule, or inference-time parameters.
  We evaluate CAML on EMNIST Letters against a strictly matched cross-entropy CNN baseline, using the same architecture, final training data, deterministic augmentation, optimizer, and checkpoint selection. Eight confusion pairs are targeted: I/L, G/Q, U/V, R/V, D/O, C/E, I/J, and H/N. On the official clean test set, accuracy changes from 95.6346% to 95.6731%, and macro-F1 from 0.956326 to 0.956724. Mean accuracy across ten predefined corrupted conditions increases from approximately 95.3812% to 95.4303%; symmetric errors within targeted pairs decrease from 614 to 605 (1.47%).
  The global differences are small and not statistically reliable. CAML fixes 124 baseline errors but introduces 116 new errors on clean data (exact McNemar p=0.6515), and no corruption-specific difference remains significant after Holm correction. Thus, CAML does not establish global superiority, but shows that a leakage-controlled, pair-specific margin objective can alter targeted error structure with limited overall benefit for an already strong classifier.

</details>


### [4] [PTC-IoU: CPU-Friendly Detection Quality Estimation for Edge Video Analytics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12405)
*Wei Geng,Hyerin Kim,Chang Lu,Zhenghao Lu,Joerg Ott*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PTC-IoU通过紧凑化检测框历史记录，将质量估算工作从GPU迁移至CPU，实现了较低的每帧估算延迟、提升了流水线吞吐量和降低了能量消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于缺乏运行时的地面真实标签，边缘视频分析系统需要一个质量估计器来确定哪些帧可能有检测失败，进而需要被更强大的云模型处理。现有的神经网络方法尽管有效，但也增加了GPU的工作负载。因此，提出了一种新的方法PTC-IoU，以降低对GPU的依赖并提高效率。

Method: PTC-IoU将检测框的历史记录进行紧凑化处理，支持确定性的结果评分。该方法主要通过分析检测框的时空一致性来估算检测质量，这种方法减少了对神经网络的依赖，并且可以在不牺牲最终检测质量的前提下，改进了边缘硬件上的处理速度和能耗。

Result: 实验证明，PTC-IoU在Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano等代表性边缘硬件上表现出色：每帧估算延迟从神经网络方法的10.3毫秒降低到2.2毫秒（加快4.7倍），流水线吞吐量提升了13.6%，且估能量消耗降低了高达95%，同时维护了多种数据集上的竞争性最终检测质量。

Conclusion: PTC-IoU为边缘视频分析系统提供了一种有效的质量估计方法，能够减少对GPU的依赖，提升系统性能。未来的工作可能包括进一步完善估算法，以适应更加复杂和动态的视频场景。

Abstract: An edge video analytics system must estimate the quality of local detections since there are no ground-truth labels available during runtime. Detectors usually provide confidence scores for their results, but these scores can not reveal every missed object or misplaced bounding box. So a quality estimator is necessary to provide a decision signal indicating which frame has potential detection failures that need to be escalated to a more powerful model in the cloud. Neural network based estimators add workload to the GPU already running detection, while CPU capacity may remain available. We present Predictive Temporal Consistency IoU (PTC-IoU), which moves this workload to CPU by compacting detection boxes histories to support deterministic result scoring. Comparing to neural counterparts, experiments on representative edge hardware, Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano, show that our method reduced per-frame estimator latency from 10.3 ms for neural counterparts to 2.2 ms (4.7x faster), increased pipelined throughput by 13.6%, and cuts estimator energy consumption by up to 95%, while maintaining competitive final detection quality verified on multiple datasets.

</details>


### [5] [DiffusedSplitFed: Latent Diffusion-based Obfuscation for Reconstruction-Resilient Split Federated Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09954)
*Chamani Shiranthika,Parvaneh Saeedi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为DiffusedSplitFed的新框架，通过在分割联邦学习中的客户端-服务器点集成潜噪扩散模型（LDDM），以模糊传输的表示同时保持分割性能，从而提高对重建攻击的抵抗力。实验表明，在保持竞争力的分割性能的同时，增强了对评估重建攻击的抵抗力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在联邦学习和分割联邦学习中，训练过程中交换的中间特征和梯度可能会通过重建攻击暴露出敏感信息。因此，为了解决这一漏洞，提出了DiffusedSplitFed框架。

Method: DiffusedSplitFed框架通过在客户端-服务器分割点集成LDDM来模糊传输的表示，同时保持分割性能。研究开发了三种不同的架构变体来研究重建抵抗力、分割精度和计算复杂度之间的权衡。

Result: 在三个医学成像数据集（HAM10K，Blastocysts和FHPsAOPMSB）上进行的实验表明，DiffusedSplitFed相对于基本的分割联邦学习框架提供了增强的攻击抵抗力，同时保持竞争力的分割性能。与其他基于扩散的分割方法的比较也显示了在评估设置下的竞争力。

Conclusion: 研究表明，潜噪扩散基表示混淆具有提高重建抵抗力的潜力，这对于合作的医学图像分割至关重要。该工作已在https://github.com/ChamaniS/DiffusedSplitFed上实现。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL), Split Learning (SL), and Split Federated Learning (SplitFed) enable collaborative medical image analysis without sharing raw patient data. However, intermediate features and gradients exchanged during SplitFed training may reveal sensitive information through reconstruction attacks. To address this vulnerability, we propose \textbf{DiffusedSplitFed}, a SplitFed framework that integrates Latent Denoising Diffusion Models (LDDMs) at client--server split points to obfuscate transmitted representations while preserving segmentation performance. Three architectural variants (V1--V3) are developed using different combinations of dual conditioning and global feature fusion to investigate trade-offs among reconstruction resistance, segmentation accuracy, and computational complexity. Experiments on three medical imaging datasets (HAM10K, Blastocysts, and FHPsAOPMSB), supported by multiple independent runs and paired statistical analyses, demonstrate improved resistance to the evaluated image reconstruction attacks compared with Baseline SplitFed, while maintaining competitive segmentation performance. Comparisons with existing diffusion-based segmentation methods further demonstrate competitive segmentation accuracy under the evaluated settings. A conditional convergence analysis is also provided to characterize the effects of LDDM-induced gradient perturbations and local optimization on training. These findings highlight the potential of latent diffusion-based representation obfuscation for reconstruction-resilient collaborative medical image segmentation. The implementation is available at https://github.com/ChamaniS/DiffusedSplitFed.

</details>


### [6] [RadAI: Gaze-Intention Fusion Pipeline for Attention-Guided Educational Videos in Chest X-Ray Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09955)
*Kavish Mehta,Yuvan Siddharth Katamaneni,Akash Awasthi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RadAI 是一种端到端框架，能够仅通过一张胸部X光片及诊断报告预测专家的注视顺序，并生成带有语音解说的EMME风格视频，以指导初学者，且无需额外收集眼动追踪数据，提高了培训内容的可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 培训放射科医生成为技术熟练的专业医生，通过利用现有的专家眼动信息，提升其在图像识别中的表现。

Method: RadAI 采用了预测专家注视顺序的方法，结合图像分割和语音合成技术，生成具有语音解说的指导视频。

Result: 该方法在97个病例上测试，结果显示约70%的高亮区域与标注的异常区域一致。

Conclusion: RadAI 提供了一种新的途径，用于生成针对放射科医务人员的教育内容，有助于提高医疗培训的效率和效果。

Abstract: Chest radiograph interpretation errors often arise from failures in visual search: although trainees may correctly identify an abnormality once pointed out, they frequently fail to fixate on the relevant region, while expert search strategies (where radiologists look, in what sequence, and for how long) remain largely implicit. Eye movement modeling examples (EMME), which replay a recorded expert's gaze over the image, have been shown to improve novice detection of findings on chest radiographs, but producing one requires an eye-tracking session on that specific case, so teaching sets are limited to recorded sessions by experts. In this work, RadAI is presented, the first end-to-end framework for transforming predicted radiologist gaze into narrated instructional videos, enabling scalable gaze-guided training without collecting new eye-tracking data. Given only a chest X-ray and its report, RadAI predicts an expert fixation sequence, associates each interval of that sequence with the diagnostic finding it pursues, extracts the corresponding image region, and renders the result as an EMME-style video in which each highlighted finding is narrated with synthesized speech. RadAI is evaluated on 97 cases from the EGD-CXR dataset, assessing whether the highlighted regions correspond to annotated abnormality locations. We position this work as a framework for scalable generation of educational content for residents and medical students in the field of radiology.

</details>


### [7] [MAPA: Mode-Aware Prototype Allocation for Latent Dataset Distillation in 3D Medical Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09956)
*Weiqi Zhang,Hiroyuki Kubo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MAPA（模式感知原型分配）是一种在潜在空间中精简3D医疗分类数据集的方法，通过在类内模式之间均匀分布原型，改进了潜在基线，提高了平衡准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对数据集精简（DD）在处理3D医学分类任务时因全卷积采样占用大量存储和优化成本的问题，提出了MAPA方法，在保证类分布匹配的同时解决了原型过度集中于密集区域的问题。

Method: MAPA方法通过聚类方法估计固定锚点，并通过软分配将原型均匀分配到这些锚点上。同时，还引入了一个轻量级的抗塌陷正则化项和渐进加权策略来稳定优化。

Result: 在五个3D医学分类任务中，MAPA方法与潜在空间中最好的基线相比，在相同的原型数量下，提高了约4.2个百分点的加权平衡准确性。此外，探索性严重性分析显示，该方法提升了最差类别召回率，且未降低正常情况的特异性。

Conclusion: MAPA方法通过在类内模式之间分配原型解决了原型集中的问题，提高了3D医学分类任务中的分类性能。

Abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) synthesizes a small training set from a large one, but applying it to 3D medical classification is constrained by the memory and optimization costs of synthesizing full volumetric samples. Under a storage-equivalent budget, distilling in the latent space of a frozen autoencoder reduces this cost and fits more synthetic samples (prototypes) than in voxel space. However, class-level matching, such as distribution matching, causes prototypes to concentrate in dense latent regions while underrepresenting sparser intra-class regions, a consistent imbalance that we term prototype concentration. To address this, we propose MAPA (Mode-Aware Prototype Allocation), a latent distillation method that spreads prototypes across intra-class modes while preserving class-level matching. MAPA marks these modes with fixed anchors estimated by clustering the real latents and distributes prototypes over them through a soft assignment, together with a lightweight anti-collapse regularizer and curriculum weighting that stabilize the optimization. Across five 3D medical classification tasks, MAPA improves the aggregate balanced accuracy by +4.2 points over the strongest latent baseline while using the same number of prototypes. An exploratory severity analysis on MosMedData suggests improved worst-stratum recall without loss of normal-case specificity.

</details>


### [8] [HALMES: Knowing When to Intervene in LVLM Hallucination Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09957)
*Ruining Hu,Jiaqi Lu,Xiao Liu,Ying Shen,Yu Wang,Lin Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HALMES 是一种轻量级的插件模块，在生成过程中从注意力特征中识别出可能产生幻觉的前身片段，并选择性触发对比性解码。该方法可与各种全面阶段对比性解码方法结合，从而减少对正常输出的负面影响，进一步提高幻觉抑制性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLMs 在处理视觉语言任务时存在幻觉问题，而传统的对比解码方式在每一解码步骤中进行干预，可能导致原本正确的生成被破坏并引发新的幻觉。HALMES 的提出旨在解决这一问题。

Method: HALMES 在生成过程中从注意力特征中识别出可能导致幻觉的前身片段，并有针对性地触发对比性解码。这种方法可以与多种全面阶段的对比性解码方式结合。

Result: 在不同 LVLM 架构和多个基准测试中进行的广泛实验表明，HALMES 不仅进一步提升了现有对比性解码方法的幻觉抑制性能，还减少了整体干预对正常输出的负面影响。

Conclusion: HALMES 通过有针对性的干预，改进了 LVLMs 在幻觉抑制方面的表现。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in multimodal tasks. Nevertheless, their outputs remain prone to object hallucinations that are inconsistent with visual content. Contrastive decoding, as a training-free inference-time mitigation approach, typically intervenes in the output distribution at every decoding step. However, such indiscriminate full-stage intervention may disrupt originally correct generations and even induce new hallucinations. To address this issue, we first analyze the relationship between internal attention features and hallucinated token segments in LVLMs, revealing that hallucination-related abnormalities already emerge progressively in preceding token segments. Based on this observation, we propose HALMES, a lightweight plug-and-play module that identifies hallucination precursor segments from attention features during generation and selectively triggers contrastive decoding. HALMES can be integrated with various full-stage contrastive decoding methods, transforming indiscriminate intervention into on-demand targeted correction. Extensive experiments across different LVLM architectures and multiple benchmarks show that HALMES further improves the hallucination mitigation performance of existing contrastive decoding methods while reducing the negative impact of full-stage intervention on normal outputs, validating the importance of modeling and selectively intervening on hallucination-prone segments.

</details>


### [9] [HippoMamba: A Mamba-augmented network for hippocampal segmentation and serial volumetry in Alzheimers disease](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09958)
*Dawa Chyophel Lepcha,Sophie A. Martin,Pierrick Coupe,Shabbir Syed-Abdul*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HippoMamba表现出色的分割表现，并且能够持续提供与FreeSurfer相近的体积变化率，但绝对体积略有偏小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 早期磁共振影像中海马结构的变化是阿尔茨海默病的标记物之一，因此需要一个可靠的分割网络来量度这种结构的变化。

Method: HippoMamba采用了一个3D卷积编码器和解码器，结合了Mamba选择性状态空间块的瓶颈部分，设计用于处理一名或多名受试者的MRI检查。

Result: HippoMamba在Medical Segmentation Decathlon的海马体数据集中（260个受试者，五折交叉验证）取得了0.8861 ± 0.0094的平均Dice相似系数，这是六种经过相同折和补丁大小训练的卷积和变压器方法中最高的；单个受试者的Dice值显著高于其他方法，并且其95th百分位数Hausdorff距离和平均表面距离都是最低的，尽管这些指标并未显著优于Attention U-Net，在某些方面甚至与SegResNet相似。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前音频驱动的人机动画在多场景时间控制方面存在不足，该论文旨在提升动画在背景转换和前景主题一致性方面的表现。

Method: 提出了一种名为 SceneShifter 的框架，通过抑制背景令牌之间的跨场景注意，同时保留前景令牌之间的跨场景注意，指导时空自注意力。

Abstract: Although audio-driven human animation has achieved impressive realism, it still lacks effective Multi-Scene Temporal Control: orchestrating background transitions at precise timestamps while preserving a coherent foreground subject. We show that this challenge stems from the diffusion transformer's self-attention mechanism, and addressing it requires two capabilities: (1) Semantic-Aware Temporal Decoupling, which isolates background attention across scenes while retaining cross-scene foreground attention for subject consistency; and (2) Foreground Motion Localization, which accurately tracks the foreground subject across latent frames, especially under large motion. To address these challenges, we introduce SceneShifter, a training-free framework for precise multi-scene control in audio-driven human animation. SceneShifter guides spatio-temporal self-attention by suppressing cross-scene attention among background tokens while preserving cross-scene attention among foreground tokens. To support this guidance under large motion, SceneShifter extracts dynamic foreground masks from the self-attention layers and heads that best capture subject trajectories. We further introduce SceneShifterBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate scene-timing accuracy, foreground preservation, and visual quality under large motion, multiple subjects.   <summary>Details</summary>

This reveals differences hidden by full-data fine-tuning: models within two points on the full LIBERO-Spatial dataset differ by up to $3\times$ in success with 50 demonstrations. $π_{0.5}$ needs $2$--$5\times$ fewer demonstrations than $π_{0}$ and is the most sample-efficient model at every budget, with the largest gap on the long-horizon suite. Within GR00T, N1.5 adapts more efficiently than N1.6 and N1.7 on three of four suites, despite their stronger zero-shot performance. We study one pretraining factor behind these differences by freezing the VLM during finetuning: this severely degrades the $π$ models, whose VLM is jointly trained with the action expert during pretraining, but barely affects GR00T models. Finally, validation loss on held-out demonstrations tracks closed-loop success within a suite, but understates how much more sample-efficient $π_{0.5}$ is than $π_{0}$.

Abstract: Objective: It is not known whether the input representation governs the quality of explanations of deep learning models for electrocardiogram analysis. ### [14] [ReelCache: An Efficient KV Cache Compression and Management System for Multi-Round Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09973)
*Tianyu Wang,Daiyang Yu,Zhiwei Ren,Junbo Li,Jitian Zhang,Longfei Shangguan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReelCache是一个用于多轮长时间视频生成的KV缓存压缩系统，通过结合基于块的压缩器和跨块缓存管理器，有效减少KV存储并加速视频块生成，同时不影响视频质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成过程中产生大量KV缓存，这些缓存占用大量内存，重建丢弃的缓存会显著延迟视频块生成。

Method: ReelCache使用低秩分解和视频编码对缓存块进行压缩，并通过共享连续块的基础方向和组织块状态树，在保持历史状态的同时支持恢复、回放和分支。

Result: 在五个视频生成模型上进行的实验表明，与基线相比，ReelCache将KV存储减少了14.46-21.13倍，并将下一个块的生成加速了1.25-3.36倍，同时六个代表性VBench度量标准的下降率不到1%。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models produce large KV caches during multi-round video generation. Keeping all these KV chunks would consume substantial memory, while rebuilding discarded caches would significantly delay video chunk generation. This paper presents ReelCache, a KV cache compression system for efficient multi-round, long video generation. ReelCache combines an intra-chunk compressor with an inter-chunk cache manager. The compressor applies low-rank decomposition across channels and video coding to the resulting coefficients, predicting the decomposition rank per transformer layer online to meet retained-energy targets. The cache manager shares basis directions across consecutive chunks and organizes chunk states in a tree, allowing generation branches to share historical state while supporting restoration for resume, rewind, and fork. Experiments across five video generation models show that ReelCache reduces KV storage by 14.46-21.13x relative to baselines and accelerates next-chunk generation by 1.25-3.36x, with less than 1% drop in six representative VBench metrics. GitHub: https://github.com/Tianyu9748/ReelCache

</details>

Abstract: Language models are widely used as synthetic respondents in surveys, behavioral experiments, and market research. Most of these respondents read text, whereas shoppers in a store choose by looking at shelves, which makes vision-language models (VLMs) natural synthetic shoppers. We test whether VLM shoppers follow real consumers at two levels. At the purchase level, VLM shoppers built from household records plan their trips from a store directory and select products from shelf images, and we compare their purchases with six public datasets from three countries. The synthetic baskets hit held-out purchases as often as the households' own past trips, and synthetic group differences correlate with real ones twice as strongly as those of a trained regression. Without fitting, VLM shoppers reproduce alcohol purchases by gender and age in Russia and trip sizes by store distance in Taiwan, and respond to situations, prices, and displays within measured ranges. At the level of a single shelf choice, a model's answer confounds the product with its position and letter label. We therefore introduce ShelfSight, shelf renderings that vary products, positions, labels, viewpoints, and prices independently, together with a factor model that separates product preferences from the effects of label and position, which we call answer effects. On ShelfSight, hosted VLMs read the shelf, follow stated needs, keep their product preferences across views, and respond to price as budget shoppers. These answer effects, a preference for the letter A and for positions in the image, are estimated once per image type and removed. VLMs are thus good synthetic shoppers whose corrected shelf choices reflect product preferences.

</details>


### [16] [Preconditioned Implicit Midpoint Langevin Sampling for Non-Smooth Bayesian Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09980)
*Sichen Wang,Zhipeng Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: P-IMLA是针对高维对数凸目标（带有非光滑正则化）的一种预条件隐中点拉格朗日采样器，它通过Cayley变换身份克服了预条件欧拉-马亚鲁方案在大步长时产生的稳定方差增加问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统采样器在处理高维非光滑优化问题时存在效率和准确度上的挑战，因此需要一种新的方法来改善采样效果。

Method: P-IMLA采用预条件的隐中点方法，并通过Cayley变换克服了大步长时的稳定方差问题，引入了非光滑正则化变体并通过控制误差预算来保证采样精度。

Abstract: We introduce P-IMLA, a preconditioned implicit-midpoint Langevin sampler for high-dimensional log-concave targets with non-smooth regularization. The obstruction is that the large steps enabled by matrix preconditioning are precisely where preconditioned Euler-Maruyama inflates stationary variance. Implicit midpoint removes this surplus via a Cayley-transform identity, making P-IMLA Gaussian-exact at any step size. Beyond Gaussians, whitening transfers the sharp IMLA contraction rate to $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$, and backward-error analysis gives drift-only rather than Euler-type diffusion bias under explicit smoothness assumptions. An $M$-norm Moreau envelope yields a proximal non-smooth variant with a three-term error budget. Controlled Gaussian and TV-regularized imaging experiments confirm the predicted separation: the unpreconditioned midpoint scheme retains long transients as $κ_f$ grows, whereas P-IMLA remains $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$-governed and near variance-exact.

</details>


### [17] [QCVS: Question-Contrastive Visual Steering for Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09982)
*Tong Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: QCVS 提出了一种新的方法来减轻视觉语言模型中查询相关推理动态与低级感知噪声之间的纠缠，从而提高准确率和干预精准度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型在推理时容易受到低级感知噪声的影响，导致预测错误。为了提高准确性和精确性，作者提出了QCVS方法。

Method: QCVS 通过双差激活探测对比目标查询下的空间布局扰动与通用描述参考，从而隔离任务特定的干预方向。使用双阈值门控机制评估相对交互强度和信号振幅，仅在必要时进行单一有界隐藏状态更新。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5 (2B 到 9B) 和 DeepSeek-VL2 上的 DynaMath 和 We-Math 上的实证评估表明，QCVS 在稀疏覆盖下取得了最先进的准确率增长（约 22%-30%）。同时，其修复率为 13.98%，消减了约 0.41% 的副损害。

Conclusion: QCVS 证明了高干预精度和计算效率，是一种有效的减轻低级感知噪声影响的方法。

Abstract: Inference-time steering in vision-language models often entangles query-relevant reasoning dynamics with low-level perceptual noise, causing collateral degradation on correct predictions. We propose Question-Contrastive Visual Steering (QCVS) to isolate task-specific intervention directions via double-differential activation probing. By contrasting spatial layout perturbations under the target query against a generic description reference, QCVS cancels task-agnostic visual artifacts without ground-truth supervision. A dual-threshold gating mechanism then evaluates relative interaction strength and signal amplitude, selectively applying a single bounded hidden-state update only when necessary. Empirical evaluations across multiple scales of Qwen3.5 (2B to 9B) and DeepSeek-VL2 on DynaMath and We-Math demonstrate that QCVS achieves state-of-the-art accuracy gains under sparse coverage (approximately 22%-30%). Crucially, QCVS yields repair rates up to 13.98% while suppressing collateral damage down to 0.41%, proving high intervention precision and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [18] [Stochastic Deep Supervision for Gallery-Consistent Early-Exit Face Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09987)
*Guray Ozgur,Tahar Chettaoui,Eduarda Caldeira,Naser Damer,Fadi Boutros*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SD-ViT 提出了一种训练框架，能够在每一层深度生成区分性嵌入，从而实现预算选择的固定深度退出。通过添加一个随机辅助信号，使中间层通过共享的分类器与最终层嵌入空间对齐，实现了在保持部分性能的同时大幅度降低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Vision Transformers (ViTs) 在人脸识别 (FR) 中表现出色，但由于固定的深度推断限制了其在资源受限环境中的部署。SD-ViT 的提出旨在解决这一问题。

Method: SD-ViT 通过在每次迭代中随机选择一个中间层，将其与最终层相同的嵌入头一起训练，并使用加权边际惩罚 softmax 损失进行训练，从而引入了随机辅助信号。这种机制通过共享分类器的概率采样深层监督，使得中间层嵌入在相同嵌入空间内进行训练。

Result: 在标准基准上，SD-ViT 的性能与全深度训练的同一骨干网相差0.4 IJB-C 点以内，与此同时，其早期退出探测器在计算成本降低50%的情况下，恢复了超过96%的全深度性能，无需修改参考库。并且，一个在全深度下校准的验证阈值从四分之一深度开始仍适用。

Conclusion: SD-ViT 通过引入随机辅助信号，实现了在保持人脸识别性能的同时减少计算成本的目标。这一方法对未来低资源环境下的应用具有重要意义。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) perform strongly in face recognition (FR), yet their fixed-depth inference limits deployment in resource-constrained settings. We propose SD-ViT, a training framework that gives a usable exit at every block depth by making every depth produce discriminative embeddings, for budget-selected fixed-depth exits. Standard ViTs supervise intermediate layers only through backpropagation, so their intermediate representations are not directly optimized to form usable identity embeddings. SD-ViT adds a stochastic auxiliary signal: at each iteration a randomly selected intermediate block is passed through the same embedding head as the final layer and trained with a weighted margin-penalty softmax loss. The objective is thus stochastically sampled deep supervision through a shared classifier. Because both loss terms share that head and classifier, intermediate tokens are trained to map into the same embedding space as final-layer tokens. This matters for FR, where matching is by similarity: a probe processed at an early exit can be compared directly against full-depth gallery embeddings, with no gallery recomputation or adaptation layers. On established benchmarks, SD-ViT stays within 0.4 IJB-C points of the same backbone trained conventionally at full depth, while its early-exit probes recover over 96% of their own full-depth performance at 50% of the computational cost without modifying the reference gallery. A single verification threshold calibrated at full depth remains usable from quarter depth onward.

</details>


### [19] [Retrieval-Grounded Multi-View Reasoning for Clinically Reliable Radiology Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09993)
*Wanshu Fan,Zeyu Wang,Zheng Tong,Qi Ai,Wencai Weng,Haifan Gong,Congyu Liao,Guoliang You,Xiaofeng Liu,Dongsheng Zhou,Cong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RG-MVR框架在数据集MIMIC-CXR上表现尚可，但对于外部数据集的性能下降显著，需进一步外部验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决胸部X光报告生成中因检索到的报告与当前影像临床不一致及诊断标签失衡的问题。

Method: 提出了一种基于检索的框架RG-MVR，包含记忆密集型摘要、视觉筛选稀疏检索证据、针对每个病例加权图像、记忆和检索证据、以及临床提示学习器。

Result: 在MIMIC-CXR数据集上，RG-MVR的临床标签F1得分为0.483，BLEU-4得分为0.118（IU X-ray: 0.202和0.110）；在外部数据集中，临床标签一致性显著下降（F1: 0.071），未支持声明仍然常见，但在一些类目上减少了不支持的比较和设备相关陈述。

Conclusion: 证据感知的检索和结构化的诊断提示可以降低特定报告错误，但需要更广泛的外部验证来进一步验证其实用性。

Abstract: Chest radiograph report generation is hampered by retrieved reports that resemble the current image but are clinically inconsistent with it, and by diagnostic-label imbalance. We present RG-MVR, a retrieval-grounded framework comprising Retrieval-Augmented Evidence Grounding, which combines dense memory summaries with visually gated sparse retrieved evidence; Adaptive Multi-view Evidential Reasoning, which weights image, memory, and retrieved evidence per case; and a Clinical Prompt Learner, which models finding mention separately from positive, negative, or uncertain status. On MIMIC-CXR, RG-MVR achieved a clinical-label F1 of 0.483 and a BLEU-4 of 0.118 (IU X-ray: 0.202 and 0.110). In an exploratory external cohort of 22 examinations, clinical-label agreement declined markedly (F1, 0.071) and unsupported statements remained common, although physicians found fewer unsupported temporal comparisons (9 vs. 20 cases) and device-related statements (7 vs. 15) than with the baseline. Evidence-aware retrieval and structured diagnostic prompting may reduce specific reporting errors, but broader external validation is required.

</details>


### [20] [SurvAD: How Anomalies Survive Diffusion Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09997)
*Lexing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究展示了扩散模型中的异常检测过程中的‘泄漏’现象，并提出了SurvAD方法以提高多类像素平均精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于扩散模型的异常检测方法对异常泄漏的性质缺乏深入理解，这影响了其性能。为了解决这一问题，研究者引入了SurvAD方法来更好地处理泄漏问题。

Method: 研究者通过分析扩散模型中的一阶确定性采样器对异常的递归影响，揭示了泄漏率与噪声水平的关系，并提出了SurvAD方法以优化异常检测效果。

Result: SurvAD方法在DeCo-Diff和VisA基准上的多类像素平均精度分别提高了3.9%和5.5%，并且比CostFilter-AD方法具有更少的参数。

Conclusion: 研究证明，泄漏率可以通过采样器的参数来有效控制，并且通过优化异常检测过程可以显著提高模型的性能。SurvAD方法提供了一种新的视角来理解扩散模型中的异常泄漏现象，并展示了其在实际应用中的有效性。

Abstract: Diffusion-based anomaly detectors reconstruct a test image towards normality, yet how much of an anomaly survives, its leak, remains uncharacterized. We show that a first-order deterministic sampler obeys an exact recursion along the anomaly, whose continuous limit is a survival law. The anomaly decays exponentially as the noise falls, at a rate set by the retention $r$, the share the model keeps on the states it visits. Because $r$ depends on the noise level and not on the step count, one measured path predicts the leak of other step counts, samplers and schedules from a nearby start to within a few hundredths, on four diffusion models and real defects. The law also shows that the leak's growth over steps is exposure bias and that normal details obey the same law, so changing the path or the training trades leak for detail error. We introduce SurvAD, which fine-tunes the reconstructor on inference-like starts and fits a comparator that adds evidence to the residual map without suppressing its ranking elsewhere. For under $2\%$ more inference time, SurvAD raises the multi-class pixel average precision (P-AP) of DeCo-Diff from $76.8$ to $80.7$ on MVTec AD and from $57.5$ to $60.0$ on VisA. It matches CostFilter-AD on the same reconstructor with $9\times$ fewer trainable parameters and, under Dinomaly's protocol, exceeds its reported P-AP on Dinomaly on both benchmarks.

</details>


### [21] [Quality-Governed Deep Learning Network for Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09998)
*Asifiqbal Saiyed,Nitesh Chilakala,Jimmy Joseph,Praneetha Goli,Rohini Maskar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: QGDL-Net 使用 FLAIR MRI 切片实现了二值肿瘤分割，通过预测切片质量和调整编码特征显著提升了 Dice、IoU、精度、召回率、F1 值和准确率，优于 U-Net 和 Attention U-Net。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑肿瘤从 MRI 图像中进行分割对于计算机辅助神经肿瘤学、治疗规划及随访极为重要，但传统方法如 U-Net 和 Attention U-Net 在处理肿瘤边界复杂性时可能产生弱对比或噪声响应。

Method: QGDL-Net 通过预测切片质量（基于对比度和 SNR 统计）并在解码前通过可学习的质量门调整编码特征来改进分割性能。

Result: QGDL-Net 在 BraTS 2021 数据集上的实验结果显示了显著的性能提升，包括 Dice 0.9747、IoU 0.9506、精度 0.9755、召回率 0.9739、F1 值 0.9747 和准确率 0.9982，优于 U-Net 和 Attention U-Net。

Conclusion: QGDL-Net 有效地预测了 FLAIR MRI 切片质量，并通过学习质量门调整编码器特征，实现了对脑肿瘤的精确分割，为该领域的研究提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: The segmentation of brain tumors from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is an essential step for computer-aided neuro-oncology, treatment planning and follow-up. While effective encoder-decoder representations are achieved by U-Net and Attention U-Net, the skip sections of the network can generate weak-contrast or noisy responses in the case of heterogeneous boundaries of the tumor. In this paper, we introduce a Quality-Governed Deep Learning Network (QGDL-Net) that can be used for binary tumor segmentation from FLAIR MRI slices. The proposed model is able to predict the slice quality based on contrast and SNR statistics and to fine-tune the encoder features prior to decoding by learnable quality gates. We used the 80:20 train-validation split for experiments with BraTS 2021. QGDL-Net achieved a Dice of 0.9747, IoU of 0.9506, precision of 0.9755, recall of 0.9739, F1 of 0.9747 and accuracy of 0.9982, outperforming U-Net and Attention U-Net. The EigenCAM maps and segmentation overlays provide better tumor localization and interpretable activation around the lesion regions.

</details>


### [22] [Optimized Car Damage Detection Using CNN and Object Detection Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10001)
*Sania Ejaz,Jaison Shajan Thomas,Zaheeruddin Ahmed,Sushma Hans*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种结合卷积神经网络(CNN)和对象检测的双层模型架构，用于汽车损伤检测。通过迁移学习技术提高了模型性能，适用于多种应用场景，CNN层的准确率为98%，对象检测层mAP为0.5，但也存在问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前汽车损伤检测系统在保险索赔过程、事故报告系统或车库车辆进出记录中至关重要。传统的基于单一模型的方法在处理多种场景时存在局限性，而本文通过迁移学习技术，提出了一种统一的模型架构，旨在提高性能和适应多个用例。

Method: 该模型采用了卷积神经网络和对象检测两层结构。首先使用CNN对输入样本进行分类，识别出损坏和未损坏的图像。然后将样本传递给对象检测层，进一步对损伤进行分类，包括刮痕、凹痕、玻璃破裂和碰撞。模型采用了迁移学习技术，从而提高了性能。

Result: 该模型在CNN层实现了98%的准确率，对象检测层达到了0.5 mAP。但文章指出，对象检测层的性能可能被低估，因为其AP值受多种因素影响。尽管如此，整体模型达到了较高的检测精度。

Conclusion: 论文展示了统一模型架构在汽车损伤检测中的应用，并通过迁移学习技术优化了模型性能。模型在多个检测类别上的准确性为98%和0.5 mAP，但仍然需要进一步的改进以克服存在的问题。

Abstract: Car damage detection systems play a vital role in scenarios, like the insurance claims process, accident reporting systems, or a documented write-up of the various damages a vehicle in a car garage exhibits upon entry and exit. This paper presents a two-fold model architecture encompassing a convolutional neural network used to classify the collected input samples as clear or damaged, thereby filtering out the undamaged images, before the input is passed on to the object detection layer for further localization and classification of defects into Scratch, Dent, Glass Shatter, and Smash. A deviation from the focus of related work, this paper poses the use of unified models while applying transfer learning techniques to augment performance that caters to multiple use cases. The design of this model has been made to optimize performance by incorporating the two models to streamline the processing of input samples. The model boasts significant performance with accuracies of 98% for the CNN layer and 0.5 mAP for the object detection layer. However, the metric for the object detection layer seems to understate its performance due to reasons discussed within the paper.

</details>


### [23] [Reliability-Aware Benchmarking of Self-Supervised Learning in Histopathology Under 1-10% Label Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10003)
*Alicem Koyun,Pranjali Changadeo Pingale,Sachin Mote,Gianluca Pizzuti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究评估了SimCLR、BYOL和MAE启发的掩码重建基线在PatchCamelyon (PCam)和PANDA前列腺癌数据集下的表现，特别关注标签效率、校准和鲁棒性。即使在有限标签的情况下，自监督学习也表现出一定优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字病理学中的专家注释昂贵且低标签环境普遍存在。本研究旨在评估自监督学习方法在有限标签情况下的性能，特别是校准和鲁棒性。

Method: 使用冻结编码器线性探查方法，在两种数据集（96x96的PCam和PANDA前列腺癌）下进行了一系列的自监督学习模型评估，包括SimCLR、BYOL和掩码重建基线。反复多次运行以确保结果的可重复性。

Result: 自监督学习方法在PCam任务上提高了标签效率，但在PANDA数据集上的表现存在较高方差，接近随机猜测。此外，报告了超出AUROC、准确率和F1分数的期望校准错误和布里尔分数，以及跨数据集和联邦学习的对比结果。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，数字病理学中的自监督学习应不仅评估排名性能，还应评估校准、鲁棒性和透明的可重复性诊断，以供临床解释。

Abstract: Expert annotation in digital pathology is expensive, and low-label regimes remain common in realistic histopathology workflows. Self-supervised learning (SSL) offers a practical way to learn transferable representations from unlabeled pathology images, but performance-only evaluation can hide unreliable confidence behavior under domain shift. We present a reliability-aware benchmark of SimCLR, BYOL, and an MAE-inspired masked-reconstruction baseline on PatchCamelyon (PCam; 96x96) and PANDA (prostate cancer) under 1%, 5%, and 10% labeled regimes with frozen-encoder linear probing. To address common single-run concerns, ResNet-18 results are repeated over 3 splits x 3 seeds (n=9) and ViT-B/16 over 1 split x 3 seeds (n=3) under practical compute constraints, with mean+/-std reporting and per-run logs. Beyond AUROC, accuracy, and F1-score, we report Expected Calibration Error and Brier score, OOD confidence diagnostics for cross-dataset PCam<->PANDA scoring, federated-vs-centralized SimCLR comparisons on PCam, and cross-dataset transfer to colorectal histology tiles. SSL improves label efficiency on the more controlled PCam task, while PANDA's noisier patch-level proxy can remain near coin-flip with higher variance. The study highlights that histopathology SSL should be assessed not only by ranking performance but also by calibration, robustness, and transparent reproducibility diagnostics before clinical interpretation.

</details>


### [24] [MATA: Motion-aligned Temporal Adapter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10004)
*Ashish Kumar Singh,Prakash Chandra Chhipa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种参数高效的MATA模型，专门针对细粒度视频动作识别中的少样本问题，通过可学习的时间位置嵌入和局部运动过渡操作专门化CLIP特征，从而在多个基准上实现了最佳性能，且对视觉扰动和时间中断具有鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于视觉相似动作共同具有背景、姿势、物体等先验知识，但动作顺序和时间的不同导致难以识别。研究旨在在此问题下，提出一个参数量少、计算成本低的模型，仅使用视频模态，突破目前的限制。

Method: 将冻结的CLIP骨干网络作为一种固定的背骨，引入参数高效的时间对齐临时适配器MATA，包含可学习的时间位置嵌入和局部运动过渡操作的深度卷积，以专门化CLIP特征沿时间维度。

Result: MATA模型使用约3.6M可调参数，在多个细粒度基准上取得了最先进的性能，且对视频中的视觉干扰和因丢帧引起的时序中断保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 研究表明，MATA可以通过对CLIP特征进行高效的时间专门化处理，有效识别少样本的细粒度视频动作，适用于视频动作识别中的实践约束。

Abstract: Few-shot fine-grained video action recognition requires recognizing novel action classes from only a few labeled examples. The difficulty is that visually similar actions often share actors, scenes, poses, and objects, differing only in the order, timing, and short duration of motion changes. We study this problem under three practical constraints: few tunable parameters, low compute cost, and use of the video modality alone. We propose Motion-aligned Temporal Adapter (MATA), a parameter-efficient adapter on top of a frozen CLIP backbone. MATA specializes CLIP features along the temporal dimension using two components: temporal phase alignment through learnable temporal positional embeddings, and a local motion transition operator through depth-wise convolution. With only ~3.6M tunable parameters, MATA achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple fine-grained benchmarks while remaining robust to both visual corruptions and temporal disruptions induced by frame dropping. Code is available at https://github.com/prakashchhipa/MATA-Motion-aligned-Temporal-Adapter

</details>


### [25] [EarthJev: Efficient Visual Evidence Acquisition and Decision for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10005)
*Pengyu Dai,Yao Zhang,Jian Song,Junjue Wang,Yafei Ou,Yuzeng Chen,Junshi Xia,Hongruixuan Chen,Naoto Yokoya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EarthJev 提出了一种用于 UHR 远程感知 VQA 的框架，通过将区域评分与答案生成分离，并使用特定目标的决策信号，提高了查询回答的准确性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在超高清远程感知 VQA 中，难以高效利用有限的视觉输入对大型场景中的细粒度证据进行选择性探索。EarthJev 通过特定目标的决策信号分离区域评分与答案生成，以改进查询回答的性能。

Method: EarthJev 框架将区域评分与答案生成分离。引入了空间指针验证器（利用视觉和几何线索引导探索或跳过搜索）和证据感知决策机制（通过轻量级头部在冻结表示上批量评分，而不生成文本区域判断）。此外，使用格式特定的信心校准指导从记忆中的候选答案和获取的证据概览中选择。

Result: 在五个基准测试上，EarthJev 使用 Qwen3.5-9B 达到了 53.06% 的平均准确率，超过基于相同模型的 ZoomSearch 2.33 至 14.73 个百分点。与基线相比，四个额外的冻结回答模型实现了 3.41 至 6.53 个百分点的平均准确率提升，同时降低了每问题平均延迟。

Conclusion: EarthJev 显示了改进 UHR 远程感知 VQA 性能的潜力，尤其是在使用冻结回答模型时，通过更高效的决策机制显著提高了查询回答的准确性和响应速度。

Abstract: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing visual question answering (VQA) requires locating fine-grained evidence in large scenes under limited visual input budgets. Active observation addresses this challenge through selective exploration, but repeated generative judgments can make region search costly. Its decisions also concern distinct prediction targets: spatial pointer validity, evidence presence, and reasoning correctness. We propose EarthJev, a framework that separates region scoring from answer generation and uses target-specific decision signals while keeping the answering model frozen. A spatial pointer verifier uses visual and geometric cues to guide exploration or bypass search. An evidence-aware decision mechanism scores compact candidate views in batches using a lightweight head on frozen representations, without generating textual region judgments. Format-specific confidence calibration then guides selection between candidate answers generated from memory and overview presentations of the acquired evidence. Across five benchmarks, EarthJev achieves a mean accuracy of 53.06% with Qwen3.5-9B, outperforming ZoomSearch with the same answering model by 2.33 to 14.73 percentage points per benchmark while reducing mean latency from 11.30 - 1.67 seconds per question. With four additional frozen answering models, model-specific fitting of the decision modules and calibration mappings yields mean accuracy gains of 3.41 - 6.53 percentage points over the corresponding single-pass baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/Da1daidaidai/EarthJev

</details>


### [26] [Representation Learning for 3D Brain Imaging: A Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10007)
*Pierre Falconnier,Robin Trombetta,Nicolas Duchateau,Carole Lartizien*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究对比了不同预训练的视觉编码器在3D脑MRI的应用效果，发现基于自然图像预训练的2D编码器表现最优，强调了适用于3D医学影像的更好更稳健表示学习方法的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前深度学习模型在医学影像中的直接应用受限于与自然图像在域上的差异，研究旨在探索更适合3D医学影像的预训练策略。

Method: 研究使用了8种完全和自我监督预训练的模型（如ResNet、DINO、CLIP）和10种基于医学影像训练的骨干网络架构（监督或自我监督任务），评估了它们在年龄、性别预测和疾病分类（ADNI和PPMI数据集）等下游任务中的表现。

Result: 基于自然图像预训练的2D编码器在各个下游任务中表现最佳，即使与预先训练于超过100,000份脑MRI数据的模型相比也是如此。

Conclusion: 研究指出了针对3D医学影像更适配的预训练方法的重要性，并提供了公开源代码供进一步研究使用。

Abstract: Many deep learning architectures for computer vision tasks rely on features extracted by a pre-trained encoder on large databases of natural 2D RGB images. However, the wide domain gap with medical images hampers the direct transfer of optimized deep learning models from computer vision to clinical applications. Recently, self-supervised pre-training and foundation models emerged as promising alternatives to mitigate these limitations. Yet, constructing such models for medical imaging faces critical challenges, including designing and adapting training strategies for large 3D volume datasets, and the need for standardized benchmarks to evaluate feature extraction performance. Abstract: Generative world models and 3D Gaussian Splatting promise to turn ordinary video into explorable 3D scenes, but little is reported on how they behave on uncurated, in-the-wild footage. We also describe the corrections needed to turn world-model output into a valid, metric Universal Scene Description (OpenUSD) asset with its native splat schema, which serves as the only interface to a data layer, a browser viewer, Blender and NVIDIA Omniverse. Abstract: We introduce nanopath, an open-source framework and benchmark for rapidly training and evaluating small-scale pathology foundation models. Using a single H100 GPU, a typical nanopath model trains in a little over an hour on up to one million TCGA pathology tile presentations and evaluates within 25 minutes on a broad suite of tile-level and slide-level tasks. Nanopath enables rapid exploration of research ideas at small scale, so promising training recipes can subsequently be tested with more data and compute. To enable fair comparisons between ideas, we constrain submissions to fixed data and compute budgets while keeping the downstream evaluation protocol fixed. Anyone may clone the codebase, automatically download the data, reproduce or modify existing models, and submit a run to Labless, our public experiment ledger where researchers and AI agents can search through prior attempts. Here, we detail its design and assess how well its rapid evaluation tracks standardized THUNDER, HEST, and PathoBench (CPTAC) benchmarks across six nanopath and 14 reference foundation models. Conclusion: 论文建议，为了有效检测儿童性虐待材料，需要综合使用基于AI的方法和传统的基于哈希的技术。同时，需要了解并遵守相关的欧盟法规框架，以确保技术应用的合法性和透明度。

Abstract: The detection of previously unidentified Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) remains a significant challenge for law enforcement authorities, online service providers, and child protection organizations, as traditional hash-matching technologies are primarily designed to identify previously verified material. This paper reviews and classifies existing AI-based technologies that could complement hash-based approaches and support the detection, analysis, and prioritization of potentially harmful content. The reviewed approaches are organized into three categories: real-time image and video analysis, image and video classification and tagging, and AI-based behavioral monitoring. A comparative analysis examines the capabilities, limitations, and potential integration of general-purpose computer vision platforms, content moderation services, and specialized CSAM detection tools within existing detection workflows. An experimental evaluation was conducted using Google Cloud Vision AI and Sightengine to investigate sexual-content classification and child-adult age estimation. The results highlight differences in classification taxonomies and outputs across providers, as well as significant limitations in age classification, particularly for adolescents. These findings highlight the importance of using AI-based assessments as complementary tools for analysis and prioritization, rather than as definitive determination of CSAM. Finally, the paper examines the relevant European Union regulatory framework, with particular attention to the EU AI Act, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), fundamental rights, transparency, accountability, and human oversight. The legal analysis highlights how regulatory obligations and safeguards may differ depending on the deployment context, potentially creating inconsistencies across interconnected detection and reporting workflows.

</details>

*Rahim Ullah,Hasan Abbas,Hazrat Ali,Syed Waqar Nabi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种轻量级的Mamba网络，名为GMD Mamba，通过组多方向扫描减少了参数量，但保持了良好的分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对现有方法中使用的Mamba模型参数量大、FLOPs高，提出了GMD Mamba网络，以减轻计算负担并提高模型的适应性和实用性。

Abstract: Mamba has the capability to capture global context in linear time for 3D medical image segmentation. However, existing methods employ Mamba with full-width directional scans at every resolution, keeping the model large (64-138M parameters and high FLOPs). We propose Grouped Multi-Directional (GMD) Mamba, a lightweight network based on the GMD scan that divides input channels $C$ into groups $G$ and flattens each group in different directions in one pass. This gives multi-directional context at $O(C^2/G)$ instead of $O(K \cdot C^2)$, where $K$ is the number of scan directions. Additionally, we employ Mamba only at the deepest encoder stages, resulting in 19.2M parameters. On BraTS2023, it achieves the best average Dice of 92.0% and the lowest HD95 of 2.7 at $\sim$1/7 the parameters of SegMamba-V2. For model validation, we also ran experiments on the MSD Spleen dataset, achieving competitive performance. The implementation details and code are publicly available at https://github.com/2802990u/GMD-Mamba.

</details>

Abstract: Mamba is a neural network architecture that reduces computational complexity, and has been shown to be effective for 3D medical image segmentation. Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究引入了REFORM-3D框架，旨在评估3D医学图像基础模型在不同场景下的表现。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的基于下游任务表现的评估方式将影像表示质量和适应性决策相混淆，特别是在体积成像领域影响显著。

Abstract: Evaluation of 3D medical foundation models is typically dominated by downstream task scores, which entangle representation quality with adaptation choices. This is especially critical in volumetric imaging, where spacing and anisotropy can substantially alter image statistics while the anatomy itself remains unchanged. We therefore introduce \textbf{REFORM-3D}, a \textbf{R}epresentation-centric \textbf{E}valuation \textbf{F}ramew\textbf{OR}k for benchmarking frozen 3D medical vision foundation \textbf{M}odels across three questions: Acquisition Robustness, asking whether features remain stable when spacing varies while anatomy is fixed; Cross-Modal Anatomical Alignment, asking whether labeled anatomical structures remain recoverable across modalities under balanced bidirectional retrieval; and Anatomical Transfer, asking whether organ identity remains recoverable from limited labeled support under case-disjoint evaluation. These are also pretraining questions, because what a 3D encoder learns depends on how volumes are geometrically presented during self-supervised pretraining. We further introduce Med3DINO encoder family, pretrained on $62.6$K unlabeled MR, CT, PET, CTA, and CBCT volumes under three explicit geometric assumptions: isotropic normalization, voxel-relative sampling, and spacing-aware resampling. Across Med3DINO and heterogeneous external encoders, REFORM-3D reveals module-specific strengths rather than a single model ordering. Within the controlled Med3DINO comparison, voxel-relative sampling yields lower embedding drift, whereas spacing-aware resampling favors anatomical transfer; semantic-transfer advantages depend on the dataset and feature type. Project link: \href{https://endarzboy.github.io/reform3d-website/}{\highlightLR{REFORM-3D}}.

</details>


### [33] [VLM as an Editing Pilot: VLM-Steered Velocity Control for Flow-Based Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10066)
*Kuan-Shen Chiu,Jia-Wei Liao,Yu-Chieh Chao,Li-Xuan Peng,Wei-Yun Ma,Cheng-Fu Chou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: V2C-Edit 提出了一种无需训练的 VLM 控制的张量场框架，通过动态选择耦合控制的运动量并利用指令级相似性来提升编辑指令的对齐性，同时保持结构保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FlowEdit由于源锚定的耦合限制，易导致输出接近源图像而不进行请求的编辑。因此，V2C-Edit旨在解决这一问题，提出了一种无需训练的方法来控制编辑过程。

Method: V2C-Edit 方法包括构建互补的耦合控制速度，并使用指令级相似性在它们之间进行动态选择，以评估预测变换是否遵循编辑指令。此外，适应的时空掩码进一步保留了无关区域。

Result: 实验表明，与 FlowEdit 相比，V2C-Edit 在 MagicBrush 和 PIE-Bench 中保持了竞争力的结构保真度，同时在指令对齐方面表现出色。同时，指令级相似性比目标描述图 CLIP 相似性更能反映编辑效果。

Conclusion: V2C-Edit 提供了一种有效的解决方案，能够更好地实现图像的语义变化，同时将不相关的内容保持原样。代码可在 https://github.com/Kuanshen77/V2C-Edit 获得。

Abstract: Text-guided image editing requires realizing the requested semantic change while preserving content unrelated to the instruction. FlowEdit provides an efficient inversion-free solution, but its source-anchored coupling can become overly restrictive, causing zero-edit, where the output remains close to the source and the requested change fails to emerge. We find that source coupling directly governs the preservation--editing trade-off, while a fixed coupling schedule cannot adapt to timestep-specific editing needs. Motivated by this observation, we propose V2C-Edit, a training-free VLM-steered velocity control framework. V2C-Edit constructs complementary coupling-controlled velocities and dynamically selects among them using Instruction-Level Similarity (ILS), which evaluates whether the predicted transformation follows the editing instruction. Adaptive spatial masking further preserves regions unrelated to the edit. Experiments on MagicBrush and PIE-Bench with FLUX and Stable Diffusion 3 show that V2C-Edit consistently improves instruction alignment over FlowEdit while maintaining competitive structural preservation, and that ILS better reflects editing effectiveness than target-caption CLIP similarity. Our code is available at https://github.com/Kuanshen77/V2C-Edit.

</details>

*Boheng Zhu,Zehua Wang,Wei Chen,Ming-Hao Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文引入了Pass@k指标来评估文档编辑过程中选择对象的效率，通过多种诊断测试文档属性，包括结构敏感性、实际相关性和参考依赖性。研究发现，编辑任务中包含多个形状的部分比单一形状的部分表现更差，且高保真度并不意味着更高的Pass@1得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的渲染保真度评估方法无法区分在渲染上相同但编辑支持不同的文档。编辑测试虽然存在缺点，作者提出了Pass@k指标来直接测试指定编辑是否能在k次点击内完成。

Method: 研究引入了八个文档诊断来表征编辑之外的相关属性，并通过控制扰动、设计师操作和参考依赖性三种方式来评估文档的方法。研究评估了12种开源和商用方法在211个参考文档上共计635项编辑任务的表现。

Result: 研究结果表明，在包含多个形状的部分中，64%-88%的Oracle通过的任务在Pass@1测试中失败，而单一形状的部分仅有6%-40%的失败率。此外，虽然更高的保真度并不总是对应更高的Pass@1得分，但研究中选定的诊断指标与设计师的努力程度有显著关联。

Abstract: Image vectorization is often evaluated by rendering fidelity, which cannot distinguish documents that render identically but support different edits. Edit-based evaluation tests outcomes, but an oracle that gathers a part's fragments can conceal the cost of selecting them. We introduce Pass@k, which tests whether a prescribed edit can succeed using objects selectable within k clicks under a specified interaction model. Eight document diagnostics characterize properties relevant to editing beyond these tasks. We assess structural sensitivity through controlled perturbations, practical relevance through designer operations, and reference dependence through alternative drawings. We evaluate twelve open and commercial methods on 211 references, with 635 edit tasks on 93 of them. In each of four reference sets, including two drawn by designers, 64-88% of oracle-passed tasks on parts composed of multiple shapes fail at Pass@1, against 6-40% for single shapes, pooling counts over configurations. Higher fidelity does not guarantee higher Pass@1, while selected diagnostics are associated with designers' effort in our study.

</details>

*Khayrul Islam,Christopher Frederic Miller*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SNAP管道通过学习注释者绘制的标签边界，改进了SAM家族的实例分割模型，在多个微镜项目的多个数据集上，提高了类别识别和分割的准确性。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的SAM家族模型依赖固定的基础特征集，无法识别特定项目的类别边界，SNAP管道通过学习用户的标注，解决这一问题。

Abstract: Histopathology foundation models achieve strong performance across diverse downstream tasks, yet their representations have been shown to encode scanner- and site-specific biases, creating generalization gaps and potentially limiting real-world utility. Abstract: Facial Expression Recognition (FER) traditionally relies on raw RGB images, introducing privacy risks, sensitivity to illumination variations, and susceptibility to identity-confounding visual shortcuts. As an alternative, this work proposes a lightweight, privacy-aware pipeline using exclusively geometric representations-facial landmarks (478 points) and blendshapes (52 coefficients, ARKit standard)-eliminating persistent raw video storage. Six neural architectures trained from scratch on fused CREMA-D and RAVDESS datasets were benchmarked against an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 baseline under a 5-fold subject-independent cross-validation protocol. Geometric models consistently outperformed the pixel baseline on unseen subjects with 12-124 times fewer parameters, while demonstrating superior robustness on subtle emotional expressions such as sadness. *Guanhe Huang,Songqiao Han,Tangzheng Lian,Oya Celiktutan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为DiMoT的新扩散模型，通过改善分词器的可扩散性，而非增加扩散主干的规模，以提高基于文本的人体动作生成的质量。此外，该模型还引入了Critic Spectral Adaptation (CSA) 和 Alpha-Flow Motion Decoder (AMD)，分别用于提高基于文本的优化效果和保护动动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于现有的基于VAE分词器的扩散模型在生成和重建之间存在性能上的权衡，简单的增加分词器容量仅能改善重建效果，而无法相应地提升基于文本的生成质量。为此，该研究提出了DiMoT，旨在解决该问题。

Method: 该方法提出了Critic Spectral Adaptation (CSA) 和 Alpha-Flow Motion Decoder (AMD)。CSA利用预训练的扩散模型作为批评家来抑制高频分词器能量，从而提高文本条件优化效果；AMD则通过平均速度预测进行生成解码，以保持动作的动态性。

Result: 此方法在多个具有挑战性的文本到动作基准测试中均取得了最先进的性能，显示出更高的动作准确性和文本-动作对齐度。

Conclusion: 总的来说，提出的DiMoT方法能够有效地提高基于文本的人体动作生成的质量，具有重要的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Latent diffusion models paired with a variational auto-encoder (VAE) tokenizer have shown promising performance for efficient text-driven human motion generation. However, motion latent diffusion suffers from a generation-reconstruction trade-off: simply increasing tokenizer capacity enhances reconstruction but fails to proportionally improve text-conditioned generation quality. We assume this trade-off stems from a spectral mismatch inside the VAE tokenizer: the encoder yields a latent space biased toward high frequencies, and the decoder introduces temporal artifacts. In this paper, we propose the Diffusable Motion Tokenizer (DiMoT) to improve the diffusability of the tokenizer, rather than scaling up the diffusion backbone. To improve text-conditioned optimization, Critic Spectral Adaptation (CSA) leverages a pretrained diffusion model as the critic to suppress high-frequency latent energy. To preserve motion dynamics, the Alpha-Flow Motion Decoder (AMD) performs generative decoding via average-velocity prediction, enabling efficient one-step decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiMoT achieves state-of-the-art performance across various challenging text-to-motion benchmarks, yielding superior motion fidelity and text-motion alignment. Project page: https://githubhgh.github.io/dimot/.

</details>

Method: 本文提出了一种轻量级的跨模态特征聚合网络CXR-CMFA。它利用EfficientNet-B0和DenseNet-121对图像进行编码，同时使用TF-IDF-MLP对报告文本进行编码。CXR-CMFA通过两个融合模块来整合视听模态：Dual-Modal Spatial Attention Module通过报告嵌入门控全局和局部视觉特征，而Cross-Modal Gated Feature Fusion模块则学习每实例的视觉和文本贡献权重。

Result: CXR-CMFA在MIMIC-CXR基准测试集上的表现卓越，准确率为93.45%，精确率为99.88%，召回率为91.8%，F1分数为95.7%，AUC值为99.19%。与纯全局图像模型相比，AUC提高了22.47个百分点，验证了跨模态融合的必要性与优越性。

Conclusion: CXR-CMFA通过轻量级跨模态融合，不仅提高了病理分类的准确性和效率，而且展示了在无依赖大型预训练语言模型的情况下，可以提供优异的判别性能。

Abstract: Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation remains challenging because subtle pathology can be obscured by overlapping anatomy, image-quality variation, and limited visual evidence in isolated radiographs. Although image-only deep learning models provide useful baselines, they discard the complementary diagnostic context available in radiology reports, while large vision-language models can be computationally expensive for practical deployment. This paper presents CXR-CMFA, a lightweight cross-modal feature aggregation network for binary CXR pathology classification. The proposed framework combines a dual-stream visual encoder, using EfficientNet-B0 for global anatomical representation and DenseNet-121 for local pathological detail, with a TF-IDF-MLP report encoder. Two fusion modules integrate these modalities: the Dual-Modal Spatial Attention Module (DMSAM) uses the report embedding to gate global and local visual features, and the Cross-Modal Gated Feature Fusion (CGFF) module learns per-instance weights for visual and textual contributions. Experiments on the MIMIC-CXR benchmark, using the provided train, validation, and test splits, show that CXR-CMFA achieves 93.45% accuracy, 99.88% precision, 91.8% recall, 95.7% F1-score, and 99.19% AUC on the held-out test set. The model produces only four false positives among 984 normal test cases, supporting its suitability for high-specificity screening workflows. An ablation study further demonstrates a 22.47 percentage-point AUC improvement over the global-image-only variant, confirming the value of adaptive cross-modal fusion. These results indicate that compact report-conditioned fusion can provide strong discriminative performance without relying on large pretrained language models.

</details>

Abstract: Recognizing anatomical structures during minimally invasive surgery (MIS) could support intraoperative navigation and improve patient safety, but progress is limited by small, single-procedure datasets and by segmentation methods developed for natural scenes. This work addresses both limitations through a new dataset and model. First, we introduce ATLAS-120k, a clip-level semantic segmentation dataset of 121,018 annotated frames from 100 surgical videos, covering 14 laparoscopic and robot-assisted procedures and 41 classes. Annotations were created with a pipeline that combines manual labeling, tracker-based propagation, and review by surgeons. Second, we propose ATLAS (Anatomy Recognition with Context Learning using Foundation Representations), a video semantic segmentation model for surgical anatomy recognition. ATLAS builds on in-domain foundation-model embeddings and adds context queries for the procedure and surgical phase, together with query propagation between frames for short-term memory. ATLAS outperforms state-of-the-art natural-image and in-domain foundation models in both segmentation accuracy and temporal consistency, achieving a Dice score of 0.70 with ViT-L while running in real time at 76.2 FPS. Ablations show that the context queries improve accuracy and that query propagation improves temporal consistency. ATLAS also generalizes well, matching a dedicated model zero-shot on CholecSeg8k and improving phase recognition on AutoLaparo over SurgeNet initialization. The model weights, dataset annotations, and annotation tool are publicly available at https://github.com/TimJaspers0801/ATLAS.

</details>

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RigidGS通过一个端到端的管道解耦几何学习和对象身份，引入了一种深度和时间感知的掩模精炼模块，提高了竞品方法的分割和边界IoU，并能在Meta Quest 2上实现实时的刚体操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了解决3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）中的噪声基础模型掩码和标签-几何耦合问题，提出了RigidGS方法，以实现更高质量的交互式VR/MR应用。

Method: RigidGS提出了一种深度和时间感知的掩模精炼模块，以及一种完全独立于几何优化的、基于COLMAP投影投票的对象身份确定方法。

Abstract: Interactive VR/MR applications demand photorealistic 3D representations that support real-time rendering and object-level manipulation. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves high rendering quality, it represents scenes as unstructured, monolithic primitives. Existing object-aware 3DGS methods jointly optimize geometry and semantic states but suffer from two key failure modes: noisy foundation-model masks on complex geometry, and label-geometry coupling, in which co-optimized identity gradients mislabel boundary Gaussians. We introduce RigidGS, an end-to-end pipeline that decouples geometric learning from object identity. We propose a depth- and temporally-aware mask refinement module that addresses two complementary SAM2 failures: over-inclusion on thin structures and under-inclusion on multimodal-depth objects. We then determine object identities entirely upstream via COLMAP projection voting and freeze them during training, directing mask supervision solely toward geometric optimization. Refined masks alone substantially improve competing methods, yet a residual gap in label-geometry coupling persists that our fixed-identity design eliminates. RigidGS outperforms prior object-aware 3DGS methods on LLFF/NVOS, Mip-NeRF~360, and iNeRF360, improving segmentation and boundary IoU by 7.7 and 14.5 points on LLFF/NVOS. Finally, RigidGS enables real-time rigid-body manipulation on Meta Quest~2 without mesh extraction. Our code and project page are available at https://gyreyirisansah.github.io/rigidgs.

</details>

*Zhilin Zou,Hieu Le,Saumya Gupta,Jingyi Xu,Prateek Prasanna,Chao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种两阶段框架，通过分离结构捕捉和生成，提高无配对医学图像翻译的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的无配对医学图像到图像翻译方法虽然能直接学习源到目标的映射，但也存在结构和外观特征纠缠导致的临床解剖结构失真问题。因此提出了一个新的框架，以提高解剖结构保持和生成性能。

Method: 该方法分为两个阶段，第一阶段通过结构编码器-解码器训练学习共享结构空间，并利用掩码重建将潜在空间锚定到模态无关的解剖结构；第二阶段使用条件流模型学习在固定结构条件下生成目标领域的外观。

Conclusion: 该两阶段框架显著提高了无配对医学图像到图像翻译的性能，并有效分离了结构捕捉和外观生成过程，验证了其在实际医学图像应用中的有效性。

Abstract: Unpaired medical image-to-image translation requires synthesizing target-modality images from source-modality images without aligned supervision. Existing methods learn a direct source-to-target mapping that entangles structure preservation and appearance generation within a single model, often distorting clinically meaningful anatomy in the translated output. We argue that these two objectives should be decoupled entirely: anatomical structure should be captured independently of generation, and the generator should operate only on a frozen structural representation. To this end, we propose a two-stage framework for unpaired medical image translation. In the first stage, we learn a shared structure space by training a structure encoder-decoder on source images, target images, and structural masks jointly, using mask reconstruction to anchor the latent space to modality-agnostic anatomy. For source images without mask annotations, a target-domain memory bank provides soft structural supervision via prototype retrieval. In the second stage, a conditional flow model learns to render target-domain appearance under fixed structural conditions. This ensures the generator inherits target appearance statistics and can focus entirely on structural conditioning rather than learning appearance from scratch. We validate our framework on OCT-to-OCTA synthesis and brain MR-to-CT translation. Our method outperforms all unpaired baselines on both tasks and, despite requiring no paired supervision, also surpasses paired baselines, improving PSNR by up to 11.2% and SSIM by up to 26.4% on OCT-to-OCTA, and achieving consistent gains across whole-image, soft-tissue, and bone regions on MR-to-CT. The project repository is available on GitHub.

</details>

Abstract: Domain generalization (DG) for object detection aims to improve model performance on unseen target domains. For data preparation, we leverage off-the-shelf diffusion models to expand the source datasets into 20 distinct styles, with all generated images manually verified to ensure that object instances and annotations remain consistent across style variants. During training, we impose Origin-anchored consistency constraints at scene and object levels to reinforce the learning of domain-stable features while suppressing the influence of style-sensitive cues. We present DAC-MACE, which conditions soft expert routing on recalibrated and contextualized features. A residual context adapter (RCA) reweights the channels and locations of frozen encoder features, a global context encoder (GCE) mixes them with multi-scale self-attention, and an image-level pooled descriptor is added to the router input. A dual-threshold RANSAC--Levenberg--Marquardt estimator recovers the pose. In a cumulative study, the MoE head, GCE, RCA, and the dual-threshold estimator lower the mean error from 17.0 cm to 14.4, 14.0, 13.6, and 13.0 cm. Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) in medical retrieval-augmented generation must be able to say when a retrieved report contradicts the X-ray, so understanding whether they can detect such conflicts is important for safe deployment. We introduce a three-part diagnostic that separates concealment from uncertainty: representation probing, activation steering, and two-way forced choice. Steering the learned conflict direction never elicits contradiction, and forcing a binary choice does not recover one; instead, cross-modal attention to the image drops on mismatched pairs. Abstract: Due to supply constraints, replacing damaged automotive components can be expensive and time-consuming, while replacing the entire component can be wasteful when much of it remains usable. This paper presents a pipeline to investigate whether missing geometry can be reconstructed as a repair patch using paired observations of the intact models and synthetically damaged components. Noise-free color, depth, and silhouette images were produced using the camera viewpoints. Depth differences were then used to identify the potential missing regions, while multi-view voxel reconstruction was used to estimate the missing portion. A pretrained DINOv2 model was also added to validate missing candidates and determine whether pretrained visual features could improve reconstruction. We tested the pipeline on 20 automotive CAD models, each with a synthetically removed portion. Each model was tested under four different conditions using two reconstruction methods for a total of 160 trials. The predictions were compared with the missing geometry of the unchanged ground-truth using predefined thresholds of the voxel intersection-over-union over 0.85 and the absolute relative volume error less than 15%. Of the 160 experimental trials, 109 of them satisfied both thresholds. Geometry-only reconstruction passed 16 of 20 components with eight views but only 10 of 20 with four adjacent views. Further analysis showed that 24 out of the 37 failed reconstructions could be categorized as unsuccessful because extra material was incorrectly added to areas that should have been empty. The implementation of DINOv2 into the pipeline did not improve the overall reconstruction accuracy and made prediction generation slower. For 13 verified tests, printing only the repaired sections instead of the entire parts reduced filament use by 93.08% and printing time by 89.39% based on the median results.

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LoCo 提出了一种新的 Local Competition 框架来处理开放词汇多标签识别中的局部预测问题，通过减少局部特征纠缠和特定类别间的竞争机制，与现有方法相比在多个基准上取得了更好的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的开放词汇多标签识别方法主要提升了全局图像-文本匹配或文本表示的能力，而局部预测部分则被忽视。这项工作尝试重新审视局部预测，并揭示了其作为强辨别分支的潜力。

Method: LoCo 采用了一种空间上一致的视觉编码器来减少局部特征纠缠，并引入 Selective Softmax 机制来仅在局部不兼容类别之间施加竞争，同时保留兼容响应。此外，多尺度推理提高了不同尺度下的局部预测性能。

Result: 在四个多标签基准测试上的实验结果显示，LoCo 单独使用时将其平均 F1 分数和 mAP 分别提高了 3.4% 和 3.8%，与 DualPrompt 结合使用时，其平均值分别是对照组的最高，提高了 4.8% 和 5.2%。

Conclusion: 我们的研究结果表明，局部语义稀疏性为开发更具辨别性的开放词汇多标签识别方法提供了有用的依据。

Abstract: Open-Vocabulary Multi-Label Recognition (OV-MLR) aims to identify all queried semantic concepts present in an image. Existing methods mainly improve global image-text matching or text-side representations, leaving local prediction largely under-explored. In this paper, we revisit local prediction and reveal that it can serve as a strong discriminative branch once two properties are properly handled: spatial consistency of local visual features and compatibility-aware local competition. This perspective is motivated by local semantic sparsity: each image region is related to only a small subset of queried concepts, while compatible concepts of different granularities or types may still coexist locally. We instantiate this perspective with LoCo, a selective Local Competition framework for OV-MLR. LoCo adopts a spatially consistent visual encoder to reduce local feature entanglement, and introduces Selective Softmax to impose competition only among locally incompatible categories while preserving compatible responses. Multi-scale inference further improves local prediction at different scales. LoCo can also be ensembled with an existing global predictor to provide complementary image-level context. Experiments on four multi-label benchmarks show that standalone LoCo improves average F1-score and mAP over TagCLIP by 3.4% and 3.8%, respectively. LoCo + DualPrompt achieves the highest averages among the compared methods, with gains of 4.8% and 5.2% over TagCLIP. Our results suggest that local semantic sparsity offers a useful basis for developing more discriminative open-vocabulary multi-label recognition methods. The code is available at https://github.com/lee-plus-plus/LoCo.

</details>

*Minkuk Kim,Junho Kim,Seong Tae Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TimeTraveler 是一种流视频问答框架，通过时间字典存储每个时刻的结构化描述，并根据不同查询的需求决定调用过去的证据、当前的上下文还是等待未来的观察，从而提升流视频问答的效果。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前流视频系统的视觉记忆或固定的证据访问方案可能丢失细节，并且无法适应每个查询的时空意图。因此，提出了TimeTraveler框架以解决这个问题。

Method: TimeTraveler框架使用时间字典存储每一个观察到的时刻作为时间戳索引的结构化描述，根据查询需求动态地调用特定的时间策略来获取证据。

Result: 实验结果显示，TimeTraveler能够保留更丰富的时序证据，并为每个查询选择恰当的时间策略，从而提高了流视频问答的性能。

Conclusion: TimeTraveler是一种创新的流视频问答框架，通过有效的证据管理和时间策略规划，显著提升了流视频问答的质量。

Abstract: Streaming video understanding (SVU) requires models to answer user queries over continuously evolving video streams. Unlike offline video QA, SVU must handle queries whose evidence may lie in the past, appear in the current scene, or emerge only after future observations. Existing streaming video systems often rely on compact visual memories or fixed evidence-access schemes, which can lose fine-grained details and fail to adapt the answering process to the temporal intent of each query. In this paper, we propose TimeTraveler, a streaming VQA framework that performs temporal strategy planning with a Time Dictionary. Inspired by the need to search across different temporal regions of a stream, TimeTraveler stores each observed moment as a timestamp-indexed structured caption and uses this dictionary as an explicit source of queryable evidence. Given a query, TimeTraveler determines whether to recall past evidence, read the present context, or wait for future observations, and then applies a strategy-specific evidence acquisition process. Comparative experiments on streaming video QA benchmarks show that TimeTraveler improves streaming question answering by preserving fine-grained temporal evidence and selecting the appropriate temporal strategy for each query. The project page is available at https://geppa.github.io/TimeTraveler.

</details>


### [52] [MaRiO: Multi-agent Collaborative Reasoning via Shared Observations in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10344)
*Nathaniel Redmond,Fidel Omar Tito Cruz,Devansh Sharma,Shehreen Azad,Sirshapan Mitra,Shruti Vyas,Yogesh S. Rawat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个名为MaRiO的基准，用于评估多智能体协作推理能力。研究发现现有的多模态大语言模型在跨智能体对应关系、几何线索利用等方面存在困难，并提出了一种几何引导的合成视图增强方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型主要集中在单视图或多视图且共享摄像参数的场景，缺乏对多智能体协作场景的研究。为了探讨多智能体在独立视角下共享环境的协作推理，作者提出了MaRiO基准。

Method: 该研究提出了一个名为MaRiO的新基准，评估了23个最先进的多模态大语言模型在多个任务上的表现。结果通过实证分析来揭示模型在跨智能体对应、几何线索利用等方面的能力差异。

Result: 研究发现，在静态感知任务上模型表现较好，但在需要变换事件序列的任务上则较弱。大多数模型在跨智能体对应关系上存在困难，误差随场景复杂性增加而增加，模型也无法充分利用场景中的几何线索。

Conclusion: 研究结论指出，多智能体协作推理仍是一个开放的挑战，需要进一步研究与解决。几何引导的合成视图增强方法被视为一种潜在的解决方案。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show strong visual perception capabilities, but existing evaluations largely focus on single-view or multi-view settings with shared camera parameters, leaving the challenge of multi-agent collaborative scenarios underexplored. In such settings, multiple agents observe a shared environment from independent viewpoints, and reliable decisions require reasoning across these independent observations of the same environment. To study this problem, we introduce MaRiO, a benchmark for evaluating multi-agent collaborative reasoning, and evaluate 23 state-of-the-art MLLMs on it. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (1) tasks governed by static perception are generally easier than tasks that require transformational event sequences; (2) most models struggle to resolve cross-agent correspondences, with errors increasing with scene complexity; and (3) models show limited ability to leverage geometric cues present in the scene. As an initial step toward addressing these challenges, we explore geometry-guided synthetic view augmentation that generates intermediate transition frames between agent observations, providing auxiliary spatial context that improves performance in certain categories. Overall, our results highlight that multi-agent collaborative reasoning remains an open challenge and an important direction for multimodal embodied systems. The code is available on the project page: https://omarftt.github.io/MaRiO-page/.

</details>


### [53] [PoseBench: Probing Pose Awareness in Visual Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10347)
*Most Nilufa Yeasmin,Draix Wyatt,Ruyi Lian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PoseBench是一个用于探测预训练视觉特征中姿态感知能力的基准测试，研究发现2D视觉基础模型在大规模预训练后具备一定的姿态感知能力，但这种能力是隐含且非均匀的，姿态图优化表明特征空间保留了与姿态流形兼容的结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于2D视觉基础模型通常缺乏显式3D或姿态监督，研究者想要了解这类模型在大规模预训练后是否具备姿态感知能力。

Method: 研究者构建了一个名为PoseBench的基准测试，包括两种类型的测试：一种是使用合成渲染图像测试模型在受控条件下的内在姿态感知特征，另一种是使用真实图像测试这种结构在现实世界中的鲁棒性。

Result: 研究发现，2D视觉基础模型在大规模预训练后具备一定的姿态感知能力，但这种能力在不同模型和条件下有所不同。姿态图优化展示了特征空间保留了与姿态流形兼容的结构。

Conclusion: PoseBench为理解并选择用于姿态敏感3D视觉任务的预训练特征提供了一个系统的基础。

Abstract: Pose awareness characterizes the extent to which a learned feature space aligns with the underlying object-pose manifold, such that observations with similar poses exhibit greater feature similarity than those with increasingly different poses. While such structure is desirable for pose-sensitive 3D vision tasks, visual foundation models pre-trained on individual 2D images typically lack explicit 3D or pose supervision. This raises a fundamental question: Do 2D visual foundation models exhibit pose awareness after large-scale pretraining? To answer this question, we introduce PoseBench, a systematic benchmark to probe pose awareness in pretrained visual features.
