Our evaluation follows a progressive design: held-out rendered views probe intrinsic pose-aware structure under controlled conditions, while real-image queries evaluate how robustly this structure remains accessible under real-world variations. We further introduce pose-graph-based refinement as a complementary probe of compatibility between feature neighborhoods and the underlying pose manifold. Across 31 publicly available checkpoints from 10 pretraining families, PoseBench reveals that pose awareness is an implicit but non-uniform property of 2D visual foundation models, and consistent gains from pose-graph refinement suggest that feature spaces retain structure compatible with the underlying pose manifold. PoseBench therefore provides a systematic basis for understanding and selecting pretrained features for pose-sensitive 3D vision tasks.

</details>


### [54] [Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating for Multimodal Medical Data Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10348)
*Muntaqim Ahmed Raju,Priyanka Siddappa,Md Shifat Haider Al Amin,Ruizhe Ma,Md Ripon Ahammed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出了Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating框架，通过双向跨注意力，样本特定融合以及令牌级引导构建方向性表示，实现了在胸部X光片和放射报告二分类任务中最高性能的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多模态融合需要在不同模态间交换信息，并确定哪部分表示应该参与交互，以及如何将互补的跨模态视角进行组合。

Method: 引入Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating，包括双向跨注意力，样本特定融合以及令牌级引导，构造了图像条件下的文本表示和文本条件下的图像表示。

Result: 在胸部X光片和放射报告的二分类任务中，该模型达到了96.05%的准确性，96.10%的F1分数，98.37%的AUC，95.60%的95敏感性下的特异性，和96.51%的95特异性下的敏感性，显示出双向交互、自适应门控和令牌级引导的互补益处。

Conclusion: 研究表明，在构建多模态表示时，明确建模交互方向、令牌相关性和样本依赖性融合是关键。

Abstract: Multimodal fusion requires not only exchanging information across modalities but also determining which representations should participate in the interaction and how complementary cross-modal views should be combined. We introduce Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating, a fusion framework that integrates token-wise guidance, bidirectional cross-attention, and sample-specific fusion. The proposed method constructs two directional representations: an image-conditioned text representation, obtained by allowing textual tokens to query visual features, and a text-conditioned image representation formed in the reverse direction. Token-wise guidance modulates the representations before cross-attention, while an adaptive gate learns the relative contribution of the two resulting directional representations for each sample. We evaluate the approach using paired chest radiographs and radiology reports as an image-text test bed for binary (normal vs. abnormal) classification. The two cross-attention directions exhibit distinct performance characteristics, demonstrating that reversing the query and source modalities does not produce interchangeable representations. Ablation experiments further show that bidirectional interaction, adaptive gating, and token guidance provide complementary benefits. The proposed model achieves 96.05% accuracy, 96.10% F1-score, 98.37% AUC, 95.60% Sens@95Spec, and 96.51% Spec@95Sens, yielding the highest mean performance across all evaluated metrics. These findings support explicitly modeling interaction direction, token relevance, and sample-dependent integration when constructing multimodal representations.

</details>


### [55] [DAPointRWKV: Domain Adaptive Vision RWKV for Point Cloud Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10353)
*Yinghui Li,Qianyu Zhou,Hao Yang,Richard Dazeley,Ye Zhu,Xuequan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DAPointRWKV 提出了一种基于 RWKV 的框架来解决域适应点云完成任务中的挑战，通过引入几何感知的 RWKV 主干网络、基于 RWKV 的渐进解码器以及双结构正则化，实现了在合成和现实世界基准上的顶级性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 CNN、Transformer 和 Mamba 像序列模型在处理域适应点云完成任务时仍面临诸多挑战，因此需要一个更具适应性的解决方案。

Method: DAPointRWKV 采用 GA-RWKV 主干网络捕捉几何先验，结合 RWKV-PD 渐进解码器实现从粗到细的重建，并通过 DSR 稳定目标域适应。

Result: 在合成和现实世界基准上的实验证明，DAPointRWKV 在域适应点云完成任务上表现优于现有最先进的方法。

Conclusion: DAPointRWKV 提出了一种成功解决域适应点云完成任务挑战的方法，显著提高了点云完成的准确性。

Abstract: Domain adaptive point cloud completion (DA PCC) aims to bridge the geometric discrepancy between labeled source domains and unlabeled target domains for accurate 3D shape completion. Existing methods based on CNNs, Transformers, and Mamba-like sequence models still face challenges from limited receptive fields, high computational complexity, insufficient geometric bias, and serialization sensitivity. Recently, Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) provides a linear-complexity alternative for long-range sequence modeling. However, adapting RWKV to DA PCC remains challenging due to the lack of explicit geometric priors, the mismatch between recurrent modeling and coarse-to-fine generation, and unstable target-domain adaptation. To address these challenges, we propose DAPointRWKV, a novel RWKV-based framework for DA PCC. DAPointRWKV consists of three components: Geometry-Aware RWKV (GA-RWKV) Backbone, RWKV-Oriented Progressive Decoder (RWKV-PD), and Dual Structural Regularization (DSR). Specifically, GA-RWKV introduces geometry-aware recurrent representation learning, RWKV-PD bridges RWKV token representations with coarse-to-fine reconstruction through local token-guided refinement, and DSR stabilizes target-domain transfer through visible-structure anchoring and complete-shape hypothesis stabilization. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that DAPointRWKV consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [56] [ClearForm: Shared-Surface Gaussian Splatting for Transparent and Opaque Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10370)
*Hajeong Lee,Jong-Il Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ClearForm 提出了共享平面高斯方法联合重构透明界面和透过它们的外观。该方法解决了透明度依赖的alpha同时管理颜色和几何造成的几何重建问题，并在3D-FRONT-T和TransLab数据集上取得了优于其他方法的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在透明界面上恢复几何结构时，观察到的颜色可能来自场景的后方，这会导致透明度依赖的alpha同时影响颜色和几何，从而削弱透明界面在几何重建中的贡献。ClearForm通过开发几何保留的双透明度表面重建方法，解决了这一冲突。

Method: ClearForm 使用共享平面高斯模型，在几何复合成像时保留透明界面的贡献，同时模拟在RGB中传输和稀疏反射，并通过透明度意识的几何约束来支持表面建模。引入了双证据生命周期（DEL），以保留多视角几何或RGB重建证据支持的高斯模型。

Result: 在3D-FRONT-T 数据集上，ClearForm 达到了27.05 mm 的步线距离和0.928 的F1，这比PGSR 方法的59.18 mm 更好。在TransLab 数据集上，ClearForm 达到1.65 mm 的步线距离、0.963 的F1 和40.14 dB 的PSNR。

Conclusion: ClearForm 方法有效地解决了透明界面重建中的几何和颜色冲突问题，并通过实验验证了其在不同数据集上的优越性能。

Abstract: Transparent-interface reconstruction must recover glass surfaces even when most observed color comes from the scene behind them. We present ClearForm, a shared-planar-Gaussian method for jointly reconstructing transparent interfaces and the appearance seen through them. We identify and analyze the Geometry-Appearance Compositing Dilemma (GACD): when the same transparency-dependent alpha controls both color and geometry, revealing the background can weaken a transparent surface's contribution to geometric reconstruction. We derive its effect on plane-based depth estimation, identify a mechanism that can weaken geometric learning, and quantify the loss of interface support through controlled comparisons. To address this conflict, we develop geometry-preserving dual-opacity surface reconstruction. Shared planar Gaussians retain interface contributions in geometry compositing while modeling transmission and sparse reflection in RGB, supported by transparency-aware geometric constraints. To manage the different primitive-visibility requirements of these compositors, we introduce Dual-Evidence Lifecycle (DEL), which retains Gaussians supported by multi-view geometry or RGB reconstruction evidence. On 3D-FRONT-T, ClearForm achieves 27.05 mm Chamfer distance (CD) and 0.928 F1, compared with 59.18 mm CD for our PGSR reproduction and the reported 34 mm CD and 0.836 F1 for GLINT. On TransLab, it achieves 1.65 mm CD, 0.963 F1, and 40.14 dB PSNR. In matched ablations, dual-opacity compositing reduces CD from 59.25 to 27.09 mm, while DEL improves PSNR by 2.06 dB. Our project page is available at https://hajeongx.github.io/clearform/.

</details>


### [57] [PhysDNet: Physics-Driven Gradient Amplification for Real-Time Image Dehazing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10376)
*Rayen Dhahri,Lei Sun,Victor Javier Kartsch Morinigo,Alice Pagnoux,Luca Benini,Danda Pani Paudel,Luc Van Gool*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysDNet 是一种轻量级的多模态架构，结合了NIR图像和稀疏LiDAR深度，采用基于物理约束的双头目标进行训练。该网络在计算效率、恢复质量和泛化能力上取得了显著改进，特别适合边缘设备的实时部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代去雾网络常常计算复杂且容易过拟合到合成的雾，限制了实时部署。因此，迫切需要一种高效、高保真的去雾方法，可以在资源受限的边缘设备上实时运行。

Method: PhysDNet 架构利用NIR成像和稀疏LiDAR深度数据，通过物理约束的双头目标进行训练，引入固定Koschmieder反演通过梯度放大提供动态密度感知的资源分配机制。

Result: PhysDNet 相较于竞争对手在Seeing Through Fog基准上表现出色，性能提升了1.67 dB，同时计算成本降低了5.2倍，恢复了54.9%的由雾引起的检测损失。消融实验和跨域评估表明，物理引导的训练提高了泛化能力，特别是在非均匀的非Koschmieder假定条件下.

Conclusion: PhysDNet 证明了其在边缘设备上的实时部署兼容性和高效性，不同的硬件版本在小于4瓦的功耗下分别达到了29/45/99 FPS。

Abstract: Modern dehazing networks are often computationally expensive and overfit to synthetic haze, limiting real-time deployment. This underscores an urgent demand for efficient, high-fidelity restoration methods that can operate on resource-constrained edge devices in practical, dynamic environments. We introduce PhysDNet, a lightweight multimodal architecture that fuses NIR imagery with sparse LiDAR depth and is trained with a physics-constrained dual-head objective. Differentiating through a fixed Koschmieder inversion induces density-adaptive gradient amplification, acting as an implicit resource allocation mechanism that concentrates learning on heavily degraded regions without increasing inference cost. PhysDNet delivers superior restoration with minimal capacity and enhanced training efficiency, facilitating real-time deployment on edge devices without increasing inference overhead. On the Seeing Through Fog benchmark, PhysDNet outperforms competitors by 1.67 dB at 5.2 times lower compute while recovering 54.9% of fog-induced detection loss. Ablations and cross-domain evaluations show that physics-guided training improves generalization, including under non-homogeneous haze that violates the Koschmieder assumption. PhysDNet further demonstrates compatibility with fixed-function NPUs, running at 29/45/99 FPS at <4 W across L/M/S variants. Code, deployment scripts and pre-trained checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Heatdh/PhysDnet.

</details>


### [58] [Vision Language Models for Primary Structure Threat Identification in Wildland Urban Interface Fires](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10377)
*Zhangding Liu,Neda Mohammadi,John E. Taylor*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究评估了Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct模型在野火现象下的即时识别表现，通过虚拟场景和实验室火灾实验两种测试方法，并在模型泛化能力和误差分析上提供了参考。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于野火对社区和基础设施构成越来越大的威胁，因此需要快速的视觉评估工具。此前的研究主要集中在火源检测和事后损伤评估上，但对活动中的野火决策支持的认知及识别仍旧不足，因此本研究聚焦于活动野火场景下的识别问题。

Method: 这项研究使用了Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct模型，通过合成图片和实验室火灾实验两种方法进行双轨检测。合成图片来自于491个设计的野火场景，共有1824幅；实验室火灾实验有45个帧。研究采用零样本提示对模型进行测试。

Result: 模型在合成场景中的有效性为1808张图片，达到94.0%的准确率，并且在较为复杂的实验场景帧中有69.2%的准确率，这对于与随机选择对比是一个显著的优势。合成场景数据显示，当关联的火势传播提示清晰可见时，模型通常能够识别预期的目标。而实验帧中的成功率虽然高于随机选择，但模型在处理复杂场景时存在难以解读空间关系的缺点。

Conclusion: 双轨测试为模型的行为提供了一个标尺，在设计场景中进行模型后训练和评估，对于未来的大规模多样化实地野火数据集上的应用提供了可能。

Abstract: Wildland urban interface (WUI) fires increasingly threaten communities and infrastructure, motivating the need for rapid visual assessment. Recent research has focused primarily on detecting fire and assessing post-event damage. However, structure-level fire threat identification during active WUI fire events remains underexplored. This study evaluates Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct for this active-fire decision using two separately scored tracks: 1,824 synthetic images from 491 designed WUI scenarios and 45 frames from a controlled-burn experiment conducted in collaboration with Columbus Fire & EMS Department. Under zero-shot prompting, the model returned valid target fields for 1,808 synthetic images and 39 controlled-burn frames. Accuracy among valid outputs was 94.0% for the synthetic track and 69.2% for the controlled-burn track, compared with a 16.0% random-selection baseline for the latter. On the synthetic track, the model generally identified the intended target across varied designed WUI scenarios when the relevant fire-spread cues were visually distinct. Controlled-burn performance was well above random selection, but errors showed difficulty interpreting spatial relations in complex scenes. The dual-track protocol provides scalable stress testing in designed scenarios and a controlled-burn reference for assessing model behavior under physical fire conditions. Future work can use the synthetic data for VLM post-training and then evaluate the adapted models on larger and more diverse real WUI fire datasets.

</details>


### [59] [RefineSplat: Reconstruction-Guided Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Querying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10379)
*Yiren Lu,Disheng Liu,Sreya Srinidhi,Yunlai Zhou,Yiran Qiao,Chaoda Song,Tuo Liang,Jing Ma,Huan Wang,Yu Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RefineSplat通过改进的重建导向方法，在复杂场景中提高了基于自然语言的3D场景理解的准确性，实现了一致的分割和物体检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于splat-then-segment方法在处理复杂静态和动态场景时存在视点不一致、边界模糊和弱的物体级对应问题，RefineSplat通过重建导向的方法解决了这些缺陷。

Method: RefineSplat首先在2D中跟踪物体，然后为每个物体使用独立的3D高斯重建，保持物体-3D高斯的显式对应关系，采用重建导向反馈机制优化2D跟踪，并引入视点感知的嵌入分配策略，提高语义信息的捕获。

Result: 在静态和动态基准数据集上，RefineSplat表现出更高的渲染视图分割准确性和更低的物体级对准距离，具有竞争力的场景重建质量。

Conclusion: RefineSplat通过重建导向的方法改进了物体识别和检索，在复杂场景的自然语言查询场景理解中表现出色。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding aims to segment and retrieve arbitrary objects in 3D scenes using natural language queries. Most existing methods typically follow a splat-then-segment paradigm, where 3D Gaussian Splatting is first reconstructed and then augmented with labels or language features for subsequent segmentation. However, this pipeline often suffers from view inconsistency, ambiguous object boundaries, and weak object-level correspondence, especially in complex static and dynamic scenes. Building on our prior Segment-then-Splat framework, we present RefineSplat, a reconstruction-guided extension that retains its object-centric paradigm: it first tracks objects in 2D and then reconstructs each object with a dedicated set of 3D Gaussians, preserving explicit object-Gaussian correspondence for unified open-vocabulary segmentation and retrieval. To improve robustness, we further close the loop between 2D tracking and 3D reconstruction. Since off-the-shelf video trackers can produce unreliable masks that propagate errors into object reconstruction, we introduce a reconstruction-guided feedback mechanism that refines object tracking using rendered masks and multi-view consistency. Moreover, instead of assigning each object a single language embedding, we propose a viewpoint-aware embedding assignment strategy, where each object maintains multiple view-clustered embeddings to capture view-dependent semantic cues. We also introduce Blender-OVS, a synthetic benchmark of static and dynamic sequences with exact object meshes and point clouds, enabling direct evaluation of extracted geometry. Experiments on static and dynamic benchmarks show improved rendered-view segmentation and lower object-level Chamfer distances, with competitive scene reconstruction quality.

</details>


### [60] [From Reflection to Co-Evolution: Self-Evolving Agents with Locally Verified Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10382)
*Xinxiang Yin,Xinglang Zhang,Haodong Chen,Zhiqing Cui,Weidong Tang,Yuxuan Wang,Junrui Wang,Jingyi Zhang,Jianfeng Zhang,Jian Qian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 文章提出了一种名为Anchor的方法，通过测试候选记忆对目标分布的影响及其来源角色一致性来决定是否保留记忆。Anchor在ALFWorld和WebShop任务中显著提高了成功率和评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理在编码和数学推理方面取得了显著进展，激发了对长时间交互学习的兴趣。当前记忆机制存在冗余或强化不当行为的风险，因此需要一种有效的方法来评估记忆的有效性。

Method: 该方法首先定位关键步骤，提取候选记忆，并且在相同的情境下分别两次执行每个源决策，一次包含候选记忆，另一次不包含。之后，Anchor根据候选记忆对目标分布的影响和来源角色一致性来决定是否保留记忆。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop任务中，Anchor分别比最强 baseline 提高了19.9%和17.2%的成功率和平均得分。使用Qwen3.5-27B时，它减少了41%的ALFWorld卡片，并且在WebShop任务中使用更少的token却优于所有四种成本对比baseline。

Conclusion: Anchor提供了一种新颖的方法来优化记忆保留策略，从而在保持或改进决策性能的同时减少资源消耗。

Abstract: LLM agents have made impressive progress in coding and mathematical reasoning, motivating growing interest in learning from long-horizon interaction. Memory supports this process, but plausible lessons can be redundant or reinforce inappropriate actions. Can a memory's source decision provide a practical test for whether to retain it? We localize consequential trajectory steps, extract candidate memories, and replay each source decision with and without its candidate under the same context. This reveals two properties: most candidates barely shift the probed distribution, and both successful and failed source actions can be reinforced or suppressed. These observations motivate Anchor, which tests shift magnitude and source-role alignment before retention. Admitted memories guide later trajectories, enabling experience-driven improvement under a frozen policy. On held-out ALFWorld and WebShop tasks, Anchor improves success rate and mean score by up to 19.9% and 17.2%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline for each backbone. With Qwen3.5-27B, it retains 41% fewer ALFWorld cards than unfiltered retention and outperforms all four WebShop cost-comparison baselines while using fewer tokens.

</details>


### [61] [Tiresias: Towards Language-Conditioned World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10392)
*Fengyi Wu,Yifei Dong,Yetong Sha,Lingdong Kong,Qiyu Hu,Bohan Xiong,Qi Dai,Alexander G. Hauptmann,Zhi-Qi Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了LCWM任务和LCWM-Bench基准，旨在通过语言理解和世界模型实现跨领域的导航、机器人、3D游戏和驾驶任务的指令执行。为此，还设计了Tiresias代理，利用语言调节的扩散策略生成候选轨迹，通过轨迹排名和视觉预训练世界模型想象视觉后果，最终选择最佳计划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前，语言调节的世界模型在不同领域中存在数据集、行动空间和评估协议不统一的问题，因此引入LCWM和LCWM-Bench旨在提供一个共同的框架，以促进相关研究的交流和发展。

Method: 研究提出了一个名为Tiresias的代理，该代理基于语言条件下的扩散策略生成候选轨迹，运用轨迹排名和视觉预训练世界模型来想象这些轨迹的视觉后果，并通过视觉排名来评估和选择最终计划。

Result: Tiresias代理在LCWM-Bench基准测试中展示了与竞争性性能相当的计划和想象能力。消融实验表明轨迹排名和视觉验证的互补优势，实验还说明训练后的排名器在扩散策略之外的替代提案方法上仍然有效。

Conclusion: LCWM-Bench和Tiresias共同提供了一个统一的评估环境，并为通过世界模型引导的语言规划提供了一个有效的起点。

Abstract: World models enable planning through internal simulation, while natural language provides intuitive task specification. Yet, language-conditioned world modeling remains fragmented across domains with disparate action spaces, datasets, and evaluation protocols. We introduce LCWM, a shared task that maps an initial agent-view observation and a language instruction to an action sequence that fulfills the instruction. Its accompanying benchmark, LCWM-Bench, integrates 15 datasets across navigation, robotics, 3D gaming, and driving under a shared action interface and evaluation protocol, pairing 142,987 episodes with 428,961 instructions in three styles. We further propose Tiresias, an agent that plans via selective imagination: a language-conditioned diffusion policy generates candidate trajectories, a trajectory ranker shortlists them, and a video-pretrained world model imagines their visual consequences. A visual ranker evaluates these rollouts, complementing trajectory scores to select the final plan. Tiresias achieves competitive planning and imagination performance on LCWM-Bench. Ablations demonstrate the complementary benefits of trajectory ranking and visual verification, while experiments with alternative proposal methods show that the trained rankers remain effective beyond our diffusion policy. Together, LCWM-Bench and Tiresias provide a unified evaluation setting and an effective starting point for studying language-guided planning through world models.

</details>


### [62] [Frequency-Structure Complementary Modeling for Hyperspectral Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10413)
*Song Qiya,Tian Siyu,Li Shutao,Dian Renwei,Sun Long,Liu Jinyang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FSCM-Net通过结合频域意识的依赖学习和结构自适应局部精炼，解决了常规特征域注意力机制无法明确表征空间-光谱变化模式以及空间共享局部操作员缺乏灵活适应不同结构聚合的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法主要依赖于卷积聚合或基于注意力的空间光谱互作。但常规特征域注意力没有明确表征沿空间-令牌和学习的潜在通道坐标的变化模式，而空间共享的局部操作缺乏适应异构结构的灵活性。

Method: 提出了一个频域结构互补建模网络（FSCM-Net），包括频域意识空间-光谱频率校准注意力（SSFCA）模块和结构一致动态特征融合（SC-DFF）模块。

Result: 实验结果显示，FSCM-Net在空间细节重建和光谱保真方面优于代表性的融合方法。

Conclusion: 结合频域意识的依赖学习和结构自适应局部精炼，FSCM-Net能够在保持光谱保真度的同时，有效地提升空间细节的重建性能。

Abstract: Existing methods mainly rely on convolutional aggregation or attention-based spatial-spectral interaction. However, conventional feature-domain attention does not explicitly characterize variation patterns along spatial-token and learned latent-channel coordinates, while spatially shared local operators lack the flexibility to adapt neighborhood aggregation to heterogeneous structures. To address these limitations, we propose a Frequency-Structure Complementary Modeling Network (FSCM-Net), which couples frequency-aware dependency learning with structure-adaptive local refinement. Specifically, a Spatial-Spectral Frequency Calibration Attention (SSFCA) module constructs spatial-token affinities from Fourier-interacted query-key representations and builds latent-channel affinities after input-conditioned frequency filtering along learned channel coordinates. The latent-channel response is then calibrated by a learned shared gain and combined with the spatial-token response. Complementarily, a Structure-Coherent Dynamic Feature Fusion (SC-DFF) module combines regularized structure-tensor cues from MSI features with context-modulated HSI detail representations to generate channel- and position-dependent aggregation kernels. This design makes local HSI refinement responsive to smooth regions, edges, and textures while maintaining spectral fidelity. The two modules are progressively integrated within a multiscale encoder-decoder to coordinate representation-level interaction and structure-adaptive reconstruction. Experiments on two simulated benchmarks and one real remote-sensing dataset demonstrate favorable performance against representative fusion methods in spatial detail reconstruction and spectral preservation.

</details>


### [63] [S2HAND: Accuracy-Preservation Trade-Offs for Hand Specialization in Whole-Body Pose Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10416)
*Singyu Muk,Xuanren Song,Kalin Stefanov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: S2HAND 通过引入一种专用的手部模块，提高了在小、模糊或遮挡的手部上的人体姿态估计精度，适用于多个手部和全身姿态的评估基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用模型在处理小、模糊或遮挡的手部时表现较差，常规方法如附加独立手部专家模块会增加检测开销并产生肩部缝合伪影。

Method: S2HAND 提出了一种专门的手部体系结构，在保留原有 308 个关键点输出接口的同时，将一个轻量级的 0.87M 参数肢体支路适配以分配 40 个手指热图，同时保留共享Transformer 和其他组成部分。S2HAND-Pose进一步微调了三个Fisher选定的Transformer块（267.13M 参数），在不完全保留的前提下提升手部恢复效果。

Result: S2HAND-Pose 在多个评估基准上取得了显著提升，手部AUC从57.83%提升至65.73%，在COCO数据集上手部精度提升了12.89点，身体加脚部精度提升了0.19点。此外，还降低了S2HAND-MT在特定环境下的失败率。

Conclusion: S2HAND 成功解决了全身姿态估计中手部表现的瓶颈问题，提供了精确无手部保留（MT)或经过实证审核的权衡（Pose)的选择。

Abstract: Unified whole-body pose estimators jointly predict body, face, and hand landmarks, but often degrade on small, blurred, or occluded hands. Attaching a standalone hand specialist introduces extra detection overhead, coordinate alignment, and wrist-stitching artifacts. We introduce S2HAND, a hand-specialized Sapiens2-5B framework that preserves the native 308-keypoint output interface. Specifically, S2HAND-MT adapts a lightweight 0.87M-parameter pose branch to route 40 finger heatmaps while strictly preserving the shared Transformer, auxiliary task heads, and the other 268 body, foot, and face heatmaps. S2HAND-Pose further fine-tunes three Fisher-selected Transformer blocks (267.13M parameters), trading exact preservation for stronger hand recovery: it lifts macro AUC from 57.83% to 65.73% across HInt TEST, COCO WholeBody VAL, and FreiHAND EVAL, and surpasses HInt-adapted Hand5/HRNet and stitched Hand5 systems on all five Native Pipeline benchmarks. On COCO, S2HAND-Pose improves hand AP by 12.89 points and body-plus-foot AP by 0.19 points. Across a 512-image multi-task audit, it maintains 99.60% foreground segmentation agreement with the public checkpoint, with quantified normal and pointmap drift. Its 2D coordinates also lower 3D mesh error in frozen Pose2Mesh transfer, while our optional TailGuard re-cropping module cuts S2HAND-MT's severe failure rate on NewDays from 13.45% to 10.43%. S2HAND thus resolves the whole-body hand bottleneck with either exact non-hand preservation (MT) or empirically audited trade-offs (Pose).

</details>


### [64] [Mental Imagery That Matters: Curing Latent Collapse in Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10423)
*Mi Luo,Rohan Dugad,Zihui Xue,Alex Dimakis,Kristen Grauman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究发现，现有的潜态多模态推理模型在执行视觉推理时，往往依赖文本路径而非潜态视觉路径，这被称为Mental Simulation Collapse (MSC)。研究引入了一种新的框架AnchorSim来增强模型对潜态视觉路径的依赖。实验表明，AnchorSim能够显著提升模型在多个视觉推理基准上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态大型语言模型在进行视觉推理时，对于潜态多模态推理的支持不足，导致模型过度依赖文本推理路径而忽视了潜态视觉路径的作用，这阻碍了模型认知灵活性的提升。

Method: 研究通过直接扰动分析，评估潜态视觉状态的重要性，并发现潜态视觉路径对模型预测影响微乎其微。进一步通过潜态多模态推理模型的训练目标分析，识别出导致现象的原因。引入AnchorSim框架，通过对比蒸馏训练模型在潜态视觉路径生成方面的能力，以提升模型对于潜态视觉路径的依赖。

Result: 实验结果表明，与原始模型相比，应用AnchorSim后的模型在多个视觉推理基准上的表现得到了显著提升，同时通过对模型行为进行诊断重评估，证明潜态视觉路径对预测的作用具有实际意义。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了潜态多模态推理模型中深层次的认知问题，并提出了一种解决方案，展示了锚定潜态视觉路径对于提升模型认知能力的重要性。

Abstract: Mental simulation, the ability to reason by constructing and updating internal visual states, is central to flexible human cognition, but remains elusive in current multimodal large language models. Latent multimodal reasoning offers a promising route toward this capability by interleaving text with continuous visual latent blocks, allowing models to maintain internal visual workspaces without decoding them into pixels. In this paper, we ask whether these latent visual states actually matter. Through a direct perturbation analysis across representative latent-reasoning MLLMs, we find that they often do not: dropping, replacing, or shuffling generated visual latents has only minor effects on the model's own final-answer probability, while equivalent perturbations to the linguistic reasoning trace are substantially more damaging. We call this failure mode Mental Simulation Collapse (MSC): the model appears to perform interleaved visual reasoning, but routes most answer-relevant computation through text. We further diagnose that MSC follows naturally from existing training objectives: visual alignment can make generated latents resemble helper-image embeddings, but it does not require the decoder to rely on them; subsequent text-only supervision further leaves the semantic role of the latent pathway unidentifiable. To address this, we introduce AnchorSim (Anchored Mental Simulation), a contrastive distillation framework that trains models to make their generated visual latents consequential. Across multiple visual reasoning benchmarks, AnchorSim improves performance, while diagnostic re-evaluation shows that visual perturbations now meaningfully affect predictions. Our results expose a fundamental failure mode of latent multimodal reasoning and demonstrate that mental simulation must be anchored to model behavior in order to matter.

</details>


### [65] [Split and Bridge: Multimodal Generation via Diffusion Bridging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10441)
*Ahmad Arrabi,Xiaohan Zhang,Xingyu Li,Safwan Wshah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SnB 提出了一种新的自下而上框架，通过在采样时结合预训练的单模态扩散模型来生成多模态样本，而不需要从头开始的联合训练，从而提高了可扩展性和适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大多数多模态方法采用自上而下的策略，通过从头开始的联合训练来学习共享的潜在空间，这限制了其可扩展性。而SnB通过在采样阶段结合预训练的模态模型，以自下而上的方式生成多模态样本，提高了模型的可重用性和适应性。

Method: SnB 提出了一种新的多模态生成方法，通过在采样时间将不同的单模态扩散模型耦合起来，共享扩散轨迹直至分岔点，然后分叉进入特定模态的路径，通过桥梁模块的引导，生成具有高度一致性的多模态样本。

Result: 在标准基准（PolyMNIST，CelebAMask-HQ）以及更复杂的场景（PIE-Bench++，ROCO）上，SnB实现了在样本质量和一致性之间的良好平衡。此外，SnB能够自然地扩展到零样本下游任务，如交错共生成、图像编辑以及风格耦合/解耦。

Conclusion: SnB 证明了自下而上生成框架相较于传统的自上而下方法，提供了更具实用性的替代方案，适用于多模态生成任务。

Abstract: Visual data are often expressed through multiple complementary modalities (e.g., images and segmentation masks), each capturing different aspects of the same underlying structure. Most existing multimodal methods adopt a top-down paradigm, learning a shared latent variable through joint training from scratch, which limits scalability. We propose Split and Bridge (SnB), a bottom-up framework for multimodal generation that couples pretrained unimodal diffusion models at sampling time. Rather than learning a unified latent space, SnB generates coherent multimodal samples by following a shared diffusion trajectory up to a split point and then branching into modality-specific trajectories guided by a bridge module. This design enables plug-and-play reuse of powerful pretrained models without joint training, making it scalable and easily adaptable. Across standard benchmarks (PolyMNIST, CelebAMask-HQ) and more complex settings (PIE-Bench++, ROCO), SnB achieves a strong balance between sample quality and coherence. We show that SnB naturally extends to downstream zero-shot tasks such as interleaved co-generation, image editing, and style coupling/decoupling. Our results demonstrate that bottom-up generation provides a practical framework that complements existing top-down multimodal approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/AhmadArrabi/SnB

</details>


### [66] [ESTRA: Enabling Extreme Attention Sparsity for Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10448)
*Enhuai Liu,Yunke Wang,Yutong Wang,Changming Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ESTRA 是一种无需训练的加速方法，即使在极高的稀疏度下也能保持视频生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视频生成方法由于处理长时间序列表现缓慢， Sparse attention 和其改进方法虽然提高了速度但质量下降明显。

Method: ESTRA 方法通过集中精确计算少数重要键值对的注意力，并用簇代表来近似剩余部分，利用相似查询分组和代表打分法，且引入方差修正进一步优化近似权重。

Result: 在 Wan2.1-14B 和 HunyuanVideo-13B 上的实验表明，ESTRA 在 5% 的注意密度下实现了 3.26 倍和 4.71 倍的端到端速度提升，同时超过 Sol-Attn 和 SVG-EAR 的生成保真度。

Conclusion: ESTRA 成为了无需训练的稀疏注意力新的质量与效率前沿。

Abstract: Video diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos, but attention over long spatiotemporal sequences makes inference computationally expensive. Sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only a subset of query-key interactions exactly, and recent training-free methods further approximate the remaining interactions. These methods, however, degrade quickly at high sparsity, which limits the achievable speedup. We present ESTRA (Extreme Sparsity Through Refined Attention), a training-free acceleration method that preserves generation quality even at extreme sparsity. ESTRA concentrates exact attention computation on a small set of important key-value tokens and approximates the remaining contributions with cluster representatives. To identify these tokens efficiently, it groups similar queries and uses their representatives to score individual keys. A variance-based correction further refines the attention weights of the cluster representatives, improving the accuracy of the approximation. Experiments on Wan2.1-14B and HunyuanVideo-13B show that ESTRA establishes a new quality-efficiency frontier for training-free sparse attention, achieving $3.26\times$ and $4.71\times$ end-to-end speedups at 5% attention density while surpassing Sol-Attn and SVG-EAR in fidelity to dense generation and on most VBench dimensions. Even at 1% density, ESTRA remains more faithful to dense generation than Sol-Attn at 12.5%, while reaching up to $5.39\times$ speedup.

</details>


### [67] [WordEval: Evaluating Word-Native Operation Fidelity in Document Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10475)
*Jinyoung Park,Yupan Huang,Shimin Zhang,Jiayu Ding,Yilin Jia,Yuzhong Zhao,Tengchao Lv,Wenshan Wu,Shaohan Huang,Nan Yang,Xiangyang Zhou,Dongdong Zhang,Li Dong,Lei Cui,Sun Mao,Xun Wang,Tao Ge,Huitian Jiao,Si-Qing Chen,Changick Kim,Furu Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 介绍了WordEval，这是一个专门评估Microsoft Word编辑操作准确性的基准测试。它包含642个案例，涵盖15个Word功能区域，并通过分析不同系统的表现来诊断编辑失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的评估方法主要关注办公工作流或桌面自动化，并采用关键字匹配、任务属性检查或屏幕截图比较。WordEval 的目的是提供一个更精确的方法来评估Word编辑操作。

Method: WordEval 包含642个案例，分为546个原子案例和96个组合案例。每个案例都基于编辑单元规格构建，具有控制输入文档、参考文档和对齐的验证。系统性能通过不同的任务区域进行评估。

Result: 八个代理系统在原子任务轨道上的表现不佳，不同功能区域的表现有所差异。所有系统在组合案例中的表现都低于原子案例，具体差距因系统而异。

Conclusion: WordEval 为评估Word编辑操作的准确性和系统的性能提供了新的标准。它揭示了系统在不同功能区域表现的差异，并提供了原子意图链接和记录的失败诊断，有助于更详细地了解编辑失败的原因。

Abstract: Microsoft Word is a central environment for office automation, and the faithful execution of its editing operations is an important capability for document agents. Unlike plain-text editing, editing in Word modifies a structured object model, where the requested effect is realized in object properties. Existing benchmarks, however, evaluate office workflows or desktop automation, treating word-processor documents as one task domain among many and verifying outcomes with keyword matching, per-task property checks, or screenshot comparison. We introduce WordEval, an operation-fidelity benchmark that instead centers evaluation on Word editing operations, testing whether each requested edit is realized as intended changes to Word objects and properties. It contains 642 cases across 15 Word feature areas, ranging from text and lists to charts, shape geometry, and SmartArt. 546 atomic cases cover 231 commands, 96 compositional cases combine multiple edits in a single document, and a Word-native oracle checks task-specific object properties and preservation conditions. Cases are constructed from editing-unit specifications, yielding controlled input documents, reference documents, and aligned oracle checks. Each compositional case is linked to corresponding atomic cases, supporting fine-grained diagnosis of editing failures. We evaluate eight agent systems and find that many struggle on the Atomic track, with performance varying across feature areas. Moreover, every system scores lower on Compositional than on Atomic, with gaps that vary substantially by system. Exact atomic-intent links and recorded failure diagnoses provide complementary views of this variation.

</details>


### [68] [They Can See It but Not Say It: Iterative Self Knowledge Re-expression in Visual Reasoning Relative Pose Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10483)
*Mengyu Wang,Ken Deng,Yftah Ziser,Shay B. Cohen,Tiejun Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究分析了现代视觉-语言模型在视觉相对位姿识别任务中的表现，发现了模型固有的偏差，并提出了一种无需标注的自知识重表达与迭代去偏算法（SKR-ID），显著减少了系统的偏差，提高了开源模型的Macro-F1分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代视觉-语言模型在视觉相对位姿识别任务中存在固有的偏差，影响了其在3D空间推理能力上的表现。

Method: SKR-ID算法包含两个阶段：第一阶段使用去偏置的中央对象提示进行冷启动初始化，将运动推断锚定在2D视觉证据上；第二阶段采用递归逻辑排名机制，通过使用中间逻辑值作为动态阈值来强制执行统计公正。

Result: 实验表明，SKR-ID显著减少了系统的偏差，提高了开源视觉-语言模型的Macro-F1分数，从35.0-45.4%提升到了53.7-58.0%，且无需使用任何标注数据。

Conclusion: SKR-ID能够有效改善严重退化的基础3D推理性能。

Abstract: The task of visual reasoning relative pose identification (VRRPI) has exposed critical weaknesses in the multi-view 3D spatial reasoning capabilities of modern vision-language models (VLMs). We present a systematic analysis of VLMs' behavior in VRRPI, uncovering stable output biases where VLMs disproportionately predict specific motion patterns regardless of visual evidence. To mitigate these inherent biases, we propose self knowledge re-expression with iterative debiasing (SKR-ID), an annotation-free pipeline that adapts VLMs for VRRPI using only randomly extracted unannotated image pairs. SKR-ID transitions VLMs' output mechanism from generic next-token prediction to task-optimized classification heads. The pipeline proceeds in two stages: (1) a cold-start initialization using debiasing object-centric prompts to anchor motion inference in 2D visual evidence; and (2) a recursive logit-ranking mechanism that enforces statistical parity by using the median logit value as a dynamic threshold. Experimental evaluation across frontier VLMs on standard benchmarks demonstrates that SKR-ID significantly mitigates systematic biases. Our method improves open-source VLMs' Macro-F1 scores from 35.0-45.4% to 53.7-58.0%, without using any annotated data. These results show that SKR-ID can effectively improve 3D reasoning performance from a severely collapsed baseline. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/astudentuser/Codes_of_SKR-ID.

</details>


### [69] [Can General-Purpose Generative AI Supply Training Data for Medical Vision Models? A Multimodal Retrospective Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10484)
*Jiachuan Peng,Kyle Lam,Jierui Qu,Lin Li,Haining Zheng,Bang Zheng,Aniruddha Agarwal,Zaki Almallah,Min Chen,Vicente Grau,Hagai Rossman,Eran Segal,Jianing Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究评估了Nano Banana模型生成的合成医学图像在训练模型、群体增补及模型审计中的应用效果，结果显示合成数据在某些疾病上的AUC值与真实数据相当，但临床价值需通过校准、决策曲线分析和临床审查进一步评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前缺乏高质量且多样化的医疗影像数据，限制了视觉医学AI的发展。研究人员希望通过研究一个通用的图像生成和编辑模型（Nano Banana），探索合成图像在医学影像领域中的潜在用途。

Method: 研究在四个影像模态下进行了回顾性分析：胸片、眼底照相、CT和颈动脉超声。团队训练模型仅使用合成图像或结合真实数据进行训练，并通过真实世界数据对外部验证模型性能。通过AUROC、AUPR、校准和决策曲线分析进行评估。

Result: 仅使用合成数据训练的模型在肺炎、视网膜脱离和肾结石上的AUC值分别达到0.877（95%CI 0.843~0.910）、0.963（0.948~0.975）和0.711（0.600~0.823），与真实数据训练的模型相近。但在血管超声模型中，混合使用合成和真实数据训练能更好地反映个体的BMI和血糖状况。同时，研究还展示了高级编辑技术能显著提升图像真实性和模型性能。

Conclusion: 合成数据在医学影像模型训练、群体代表性和模型测试方面具有潜在价值，但在评估其临床价值时，应综合考虑模型校准、决策曲线分析及其是否得到临床医生的认可，而不仅仅依赖于区分性能提高来判断。

Abstract: Background: Well-annotated, diverse medical imaging datasets remain a major constraint for vision-based medical AI. We evaluated Nano Banana, a general-purpose image generation and editing model, as a source of synthetic medical images for model training, subgroup augmentation, and model auditing. Methods: In this retrospective study across four imaging modalities, chest radiography, fundus photography, and CT models were trained only on synthetic images and externally validated on real-world data against real-data-trained models. Carotid ultrasound models were trained on a private Human Phenotype Project cohort (aged 40-75 years) with and without synthetic augmentation. Clinicians rated image plausibility. Evaluation used AUROC, AUPR, calibration, and decision curve analysis. Findings: Synthetic-only models achieved AUROCs of 0.877 (95% CI 0.843-0.910) for pneumonia (n=14863), 0.963 (0.948-0.975) for retinal detachment (n=1149), and 0.711 (0.600-0.823) for renal calculus (n=4122), comparable to real-data-trained models, but their calibration and net benefit were not consistently more favorable. With mixed synthetic-real training, a carotid ultrasound model produced an ordinal vascular age index that stratified 633 external subjects into subgroups differing in BMI and glucose (both p<0.01), linking vascular aging to cardiometabolic health. To stress-test shortcut learning, editing a moderate tessellated pattern into fundus photographs reduced the true-class probability for central serous chorioretinopathy from 0.996 to 0.822. Clinician-guided editing raised low-quality CT plausibility from 3.10/5 to 4.30/5. Interpretation: Synthetic data can complement real data in model training, subgroup representation, and model testing via controlled editing, but its clinical value should be assessed with calibration, decision curve analysis, and clinician review, not discrimination alone.

</details>


### [70] [Decoupling Direction and Magnitude: Language-Steered Flow Matching for Super-Resolution in the Dark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10485)
*Jiaxin Gao,Ziyu Yue,Yaohua Liu,Danchen Cui,Zhihui Zhao,Zhixun Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DeLang-SR 提出了一种新的自适应超分辨率框架，通过使用结构化的退化语言和自适应更新强度场来指导重构过程，适用于暗光环境下的超分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在处理暗光图像的极端空间不均匀退化时表现不佳，因为它们依赖于全局均匀的积分轨迹。

Method: DeLang-SR 在一个流匹配框架中引入了退化语言和自适应更新强度场的概念。它将可测量的物理统计信息转化为结构化的退化语言，并利用预训练文本到图像模型的语义先验来引导重构方向。

Result: 实验结果表明，DeLang-SR 可以有效地处理暗光环境下的超分辨率，并且提供了一种解析的单步路径。

Conclusion: DeLang-SR 架构提供了一种理解并解决暗光环境超分辨率问题的有效方法，并且适用于多种场景。

Abstract: Image super-resolution in the dark is fundamentally challenged by extreme spatial heterogeneity: severely underexposed and noisy regions demand aggressive generative enhancement to reconstruct missing details, while relatively well-exposed areas require conservative updates to prevent hallucinated textures. Standard diffusion and flow-matching models, however, rely on globally uniform integration trajectories, making them sub-optimal for such spatially varying degradations. In this paper, we propose DeLang-SR (Degradation-Language steered Super-Resolution), a one-step flow-matching framework that explicitly decouples the restoration direction and magnitude. Rather than treating low-light corruption as arbitrary latent features, DeLang-SR translates measurable physical statistics into structured degradation language, harnessing the semantic prior of pretrained text-to-image models. The degradation-language intent, complemented by image-specific visual tokens, steers the velocity field (direction) toward restoration-relevant manifolds. Simultaneously, a continuous spatial update-strength field acts as a locally varying Euler step-size field (magnitude), applying stronger integration steps in heavily degraded shadows while enforcing conservative updates in reliable regions. Experiments on paired and real dark images, together with ablations and diagnostic analyses, show that DeLang-SR provides an effective and interpretable one-step route to super-resolution in the dark. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/moriyaya/DeLang-SR.

</details>


### [71] [Disentangling Channel Semantics in Vision Transformers via Token Decorrelation and Composition-Aware Modulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10497)
*Daeun Kim,Hyesong Choi,Hyejin Park,Dongbo Min*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MuCa-ViT 提出了一种结合两机制的多通道卷积感知视网膜转换器框架，解决了在高通道冗余度下记忆标记集中于少数主导通道的问题，从而避免了冗余表示和有偏的全局摘要。MuCa-ViT 在三种基准测试中的表现优于之前的多通道 ViT，并且性能改进与各数据集的通道冗余度相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文章提出，大多数多通道卷积视网膜转换器在高通道冗余度下无法有效捕捉全局共享语义和通道特定变化，导致生成冗余表示和有偏的全局摘要，影响了模型的解释能力。

Method: MuCa-ViT 结合了 Factorial Token Learning (FTL) 和 Channel Composition-Aware Modulation (CAM) 两种机制。FTL 通过标签级别解耦记忆标记，鼓励 [CLS] 标记捕捉全局共享语义，而记忆标记保留互补的通道特定线索。CAM 使用 FTL 提炼的 [CLS] 作为语义锚，生成样本级别的调控信号，使得在统一结构中能够进行有选择的通道解释，而不是依赖静态的通道嵌入。

Result: 实验证明，MuCa-ViT 在 JUMP-CP、CHAMMI 和 So2Sat 三个基准测试中均优于现有的多通道视网膜转换器，并且改进程度与数据集的通道冗余度呈相关关系，验证了设计的诊断分析。

Conclusion: MuCa-ViT 提出的两机制框架显著提升了多通道图像的处理效果，并通过实验证明了针对高通道冗余度的处理能力。

Abstract: Multi-channel images encode heterogeneous channel semantics aligned over a shared spatial structure, which requires models to jointly capture globally shared structure and channel-specific variations. Recent multi-channel Vision Transformers attempt to address this challenge by augmenting the [CLS] token with memory tokens to organize multi-channel representations under varying channel compositions. However, we find that these context tokens collapse onto a few dominant channels under high inter-channel redundancy, producing redundant representations and a biased global summary that fails to reliably support composition-aware channel interpretation. We propose MuCa-ViT (Multi-Channel Composition-Aware Vision Transformer), a unified framework that addresses these limitations through two coupled mechanisms. Factorial Token Learning (FTL) enforces token-level decorrelation among context tokens, encouraging the [CLS] token to capture globally shared semantics while memory tokens preserve complementary channel-specific cues. Channel Composition-Aware Modulation (CAM) uses the FTL-refined [CLS] as a semantic anchor to generate sample-wise modulation signals, which enable composition-aware interpretation of channels within a unified backbone rather than relying on static channel embeddings. Experiments on JUMP-CP, CHAMMI, and So2Sat show that MuCa-ViT outperforms prior multi-channel ViTs across all three benchmarks, and the magnitude of improvement aligns with the inter-channel redundancy of each dataset ($ρ\in [0.19, 0.77]$), validating the diagnostic analysis that motivates our design. Our code is available at https://github.com/kimdanni/MuCa-ViT .

</details>


### [72] [SRA: Spatial Reasoning Adapter via Evolving Social Interaction Graphs for Trajectory Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10506)
*Jaewoo Jeong,Seonkyu Song,Hyeonwoo Park,Jegyeong Cho,Yujin Bae,Giwon Lee,Daehee Park,Kuk-Jin Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SRA（基于空间推理的适配器）在三种不同的预测器上，通过构建稀疏的欧几里得相互作用图，并返回对预测路径的残差矫正，持续更新未来预测，显著提升了位置预测准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的预测方法在一个生成过程中查看了多智能体的交互历史，并在此过程中保持不变，无法重新评估随着联合未来越来越清晰而出现的互相几何约束。SRA解决了这一问题，通过不断更新多智能体的未来预测来实现更好的位置预测。

Method: SRA包含三个核心组件：基于学习查询-键评分和几何偏置的空间稀疏邻域检索，基于未来条件的交互特征重新计算，以及基于不确定性加权的消息传递，其中自信的智能体作为不确定智能体的锚点。

Result: SRA在三种不同的预测器上（LED, MID, MoFlow）对四个多智能体基准测试（SDD, NBA, 足球, 足球）的表现进行了提升，平均在平均绝对位移（ADE）上提升了5.8%，在最终位移误差（FDE）上提升了7.0%。

Conclusion: SRA通过直接处理预测器的未来输出，并在推理过程中利用空间上的相互作用，对多种不同的预测器架构实现了改进，表明这种方法具有普遍适用性，特别是在提高位置预测准确性方面。

Abstract: Predicting where multiple agents will move next is fundamental to autonomous driving, robotics, and any system that must share space with people safely. Modern stochastic predictors read off inter-agent interactions once from the observed past and keep that view fixed throughout the generative rollout, so the reciprocal geometric constraints that emerge as the joint future sharpens are not re-examined. We address this gap with SRA (Spatial Reasoning Adapter), a modular graph denoiser that is integrated into existing diffusion and flow-matching predictors without redesigning their generative cores. At every reverse step, SRA reads the host's current future estimate, builds a sparse Euclidean interaction graph on the predicted trajectories, and returns a residual correction to the host's decoding path. Our adapter consists of three core components: a sparse neighborhood retrieved with a learned query-key score and a geometric bias, a future-conditioned relational feature recomputed on the evolving prediction, and uncertainty-weighted message passing where confident agents act as anchors for uncertain ones. We instantiate SRA on three structurally different hosts (LED, MID, and MoFlow) across four multi-agent benchmarks: SDD, NBA, Soccer, and Football. SRA improves ADE for every host on every dataset, with average gains of 5.8% in ADE and 7.0% in FDE. A cumulative ablation shows that the three components act as one mechanism: only together do they improve every host on every sports dataset, indicating that spatial reasoning over the model's own evolving future, weighted by how far that future can be trusted, is broadly useful across denoising architectures. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaewoo97/SRA.

</details>


### [73] [Scaling Optimization-Oriented Hypernetworks for Implicit Neural Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10509)
*Lulu Cai,Hanxiang Ren,Siyan Dong,Li Sun,Jiefeng Wu,Youyi Zheng,Yi Ma,Yanchao Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种生成神经表示参数的超网络，它在单次前向传播中工作，而不需要在测试时进行优化。该方法通过用注意机制替换MLP主体来解决参数计数成本问题，并在多个2D和3D隐式神经表示生成基准测试中，相对于基于MLP的优化导向方法，该方法在性能上更佳，且能处理更宽的神经网络而不消耗大量存储。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的超网络方法要么忽略了测试时优化隐式神经表示的链式规则结构，要么保留了该结构但需要大量的参数。本文旨在提供一种新的解决方案，避免了参数效率问题，并在神经网络宽度大的情况下仍能有效工作。

Method: 本文的方法创新地采用了注意力机制替代MLP，解决了参数计数成本问题。此外，还设计了输出神经元为中心的标记化、信息流一致性规则和标记空间迭代展开策略，确保每个标记的作用明确，并有效计算五个优化步骤。

Result: 在五项2D和3D隐式神经表示生成基准测试中，该方法在性能上超越了现有的单次通过和优化导向方法。同时，对于神经网络宽度较大的情况，本文提出的方法能够使用有限GPU内存来实现。

Conclusion: 证明了通过引入注意力机制和特定设计策略的超网络方法在生成高精度隐式神经表示的同时，解决了参数效率问题，为构建大型隐式神经表示模型提供了可能。

Abstract: We present a hypernetwork that generates the parameters of an implicit neural representation (INR) for a given signal in a single forward pass, without test-time optimization. Existing hypernetworks for this problem either ignore the chain-rule structure of the test-time optimization that produces an INR or, when they preserve it, instantiate the structure with MLPs whose parameter count grows quartically in target-network width. Our central contribution is to show that this parameter-count cost is structural to the MLP instantiation, not to the optimization-oriented principle of preserving chain-rule structure, and to resolve it by replacing the MLP body with attention. The resulting hypernetwork combines three design choices: an output-neuron-centric tokenization that aligns the token axis with each layer's output-neuron axis; an information-flow consistency rule that fixes the role of every cross-attention module from the representation its output should occupy; and a token-space iterative rollout that realizes the five quantities one optimization step on the target INR computes as five cross-attention modules with parameter count independent of target-network width. Across five 2D and 3D INR generation benchmarks, our method outperforms the state-of-the-art single-pass and optimization-oriented baselines; scales to target-network widths at which the MLP-based optimization-oriented paradigm exhausts GPU memory; and produces the highest result on NeRF generation without ground-truth INR weights supervision.

</details>


### [74] [Beyond Row Alignment: Virtual-Camera-Aware Online Stereo Rectification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10518)
*Yizhao Peng,Rui Gong,Zaiwang Gu,Xudong Jiang,Jun Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR:  Stereo matchers typically rely on accurate calibration, but physical shifts can degrade depth estimation. VirtualRect is introduced as a method to online rectify images by estimating a rectified virtual stereo camera, ensuring consistent geometry for reliable stereo depth estimation.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的立体匹配算法依赖于精确的相机校准，但在实际部署中，由于相机移动、机械漂移、振动或安装变化导致的小的物理位移，会破坏这一假设，导致深度估计下降。为了解决这个问题，引入了VirtualRect进行在线立体校正，以确保图像几何的一致性，从而提高深度估计的可靠性。

Method: VirtualRect通过估计一个矫正的虚拟立体相机，并利用整个图像的监督来估计图像变形行为，从而确保矫正后的图像和相机参数来自同一几何结构。这样，用于匹配和用于深度计算的模型保持一致。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，与之前的最佳在线校正器相比，VirtualRect在不同下游立体匹配器上的垂直流误差降低了17%（Carla-Flowguided数据集），降低了7%（Semi-Truck Highway数据集），并且在Carla-Flowguided数据集上降低了30-41%的深度MAE。

Conclusion: VirtualRect通过改进在线立体校正方法，适用于实际部署的可靠立体深度估计。

Abstract: Stereo matchers estimate depth by comparing the left and right images from a stereo camera pair, but they assume that the two cameras are accurately calibrated and rectified. In real deployments, small physical shifts after calibration, caused by camera motion, mechanical drift, vibration, or installation changes, can break this assumption and degrade depth estimation. Online stereo rectification is therefore needed to correct the image pair during operation and recover a stereo geometry where standard stereo matching can work reliably. Recent online rectification methods mainly optimize row alignment, making the left and right views of the same scene point fall on the same image row. We show that this target, while necessary, is insufficient for deployable stereo depth estimation. A rectifier may make a small set of matched points look well row-aligned, but still distort the full images in ways that hurt stereo matching: useful image regions may be cut off, large blank areas may appear, objects may be stretched or squeezed, or image scale may change unevenly across the view. We propose VirtualRect, an online stereo rectification method designed for reliable real-world deployment. Rather than treating rectification as simply making the left and right image rows line up, this method estimates a rectified virtual stereo camera and combines image-wide supervision of image warp behavior. This makes the rectified images and the camera parameters come from the same geometry, so the images used for matching and the model used for depth computation remain consistent. Experiments on multiple datasets show that, compared with the prior state-of-the-art online rectifier, VirtualRect reduces vertical flow error by 17% on Carla-Flowguided and 7% on Semi-Truck Highway, and lowers depth MAE by 30-41% on Carla-Flowguided across three downstream stereo matchers.

</details>


### [75] [Action Transfer Across Character Body Plans in Latent-Action World Models: An Empirical Study of Animated Characters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10523)
*Amarnath R*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了通过学习一种角色的动作是否能使具有不同身体结构的角色执行相同的动作，并提出了一种新的评估转移分数的方法，以改进动作转移的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在不同角色间的动作转移性上表现欠佳，特别是当角色具有不同的身体结构时。本研究旨在克服这一挑战。

Method: 研究提出了一种新的评估方法，以便更准确地评估动作转移的性能；使用一个跟随角色身体的相机进行训练，评估模型在未见动物家族和人类动画上的表现。

Result: 在新的合成数据集和标准数据集上进行的实验表明，仅复制源的角色屏幕运动的基线模型的表现接近大多数学习模型。而使用跟随角色身体的相机训练的最优模型，对于未见过的动物家族和人类，得分分别为0.46和0.20。同时，使用线性探针能够识别未见过的动物家族的动作类别，准确率在66%到86%之间。

Conclusion: 虽然研究发现学习的动作保留了一定的信息，但在新角色上的预测误差仍然较大，表明仍有改进空间。

Abstract: Latent-action world models learn actions from video without labels, and recent methods aim to share these actions across bodies. Transfer between 2D characters with different body structures remains underexplored. In this paper, we study whether an action learned from one character can make a character with a different body perform the same action. A cat, a blob and a human can all jump, but each moves its body in its own way. The usual transfer gain mixes body motion with screen movement and can assign a perfect score to a model that ignores its action. To address this, we introduce a transfer score that compares the correct action with wrong ones from the same source. We test five training objectives on a new synthetic benchmark of 2D cartoon characters with six body plans, the standard Sprites benchmark, and 431 selected animal and human animations from DeformingThings4D. With a fixed camera, a baseline that only copies the source's screen movement scores 0.71, as high as most learned models. In contrast, with a camera that follows the body, the best model reaches only 0.46 for an unseen animal family and 0.20 for humans. With this camera, a linear probe identifies the action class of unseen animal families with 66% to 86% balanced accuracy (chance 17%). The learned actions therefore retain information about which action is performed, but the correct action closes only part of the prediction error gap for a new character.

</details>


### [76] [PrivMark: Pixel-Space Steering against Privacy Leakage in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10528)
*Ruofan Xing,Arman Akbari,Weikai Lin,Yuhao Zhu,Xuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PrivMark通过分析VLM的激活状态，在不触及模型内部的情况下，对图像进行单一像素级的扰动以抑制生物识别泄露，同时在多个VLM上表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的隐私防御手段无法有效解决VLM泄露软生物特征的问题，因此需要一个新的框架来在图像级别抑制这种泄露。

Method: 通过分析VLM的激活状态，确定了两个在潜在状态空间中弱对齐的向量方向，将这两个方向编码到单一的像素级扰动中，从而保护图像隐私。

Result: PrivMark在三种白盒模型中实现了高达85.9%的生物特征抑制，同时保持了75%的清晰OK-VQA实用性，优于最强的像素基线方法，且对七个未见的VLM表现稳定。

Conclusion: PrivMark提供了一种有效的方法来在不侵入模型内部的情况下保护生物识别隐私，具有广泛的适用性。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) routinely disclose soft-biometric attributes such as age, gender, and race in their text outputs, exposing demographic information from uploaded images to any downstream API user. Existing privacy defenses do not fit this setting: face de-identification leaves distributed soft-biometric cues intact, classifier-targeted adversarial perturbations do not transfer to open-ended generation, and stronger VLM-specific methods require retraining or runtime activation access unavailable to downstream APIs. We propose PrivMark, a framework that suppresses biometric leakage at the image level. By analyzing VLM activations, we identify two weakly aligned steering vector directions in hidden-state space, each tied to a distinct leakage behavior --- one corresponding to incidental attribute disclosure under open-ended descriptions, the other to compliance with direct biometric probes instead of refusal --- and encode both directions into a single bounded pixel perturbation, so the protected image alone enforces privacy with no invasive access to model internals at deployment. To support evaluation, we assemble BioleakBench, $1{,}600$ VQA pairs covering biometric privacy attributes under both free-form description and direct-probe protocols. Across three white-box source models, PrivMark achieves up to $85.9\%$ biometric suppression while retaining $75\%$ of clean OK-VQA utility, up to $1.4\times$ the privacy-utility tradeoff of the strongest pixel-only baseline. The same one-shot perturbations transfer consistently to seven unseen VLMs including closed-source APIs.

</details>


### [77] [CompositionEvidence: Controlling Geometric Evidence for Cinematic Composition Reasoning with Frozen Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10559)
*Yichen He,Xin Huang,Yuxi Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过引入Geometry信息提高了视觉-语言模型在电影构图理解任务上的表现，尤其是在可靠测量和模型整合几何信息能力较强的模型上效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型在处理电影构图问题时表现出不一致的性能，尤其依赖于帧内几何学这一因素，因此本研究旨在探索如何有效地引入几何信息以提升模型性能。

Method: 研究人员开发了一个名为CompositionEvidence的工具，可以从冻结的检测、深度和线性专家中提取九个可重复的特征，并将它们以24维共用表示形式通过两个接口提供给模型。进一步地，研究还设计了两种不同的方法来利用这些几何信息：一种是无训练的通道方法，在问题后添加门控中性证据；另一种是有少量训练的通道方法，将相同表示映射到四个软标记。

Result: 研究表明，采用几何信息可以显著提高视觉-语言模型在电影构图问题上的准确率。其中，无训练的通道方法将准确率提升了6.7%，达到56.2%；有少量训练的通道方法则实现了11.5%的提升，达到61.0%。这表明不同模型对几何信息的利用程度不同，且几何信息的有效性依赖于测量的可靠性。

Conclusion: 研究结论指出，引入可靠测量的几何信息能够有效提升视觉-语言模型在电影构图理解任务中的表现，特别是在那些更能利用这种信息的模型上效果显著。

Abstract: Cinematic composition questions depend on in-frame geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) use inconsistently. External perception tools can expose this geometry, but naive prompt injection can overwrite useful visual predictions. On ShotBench composition, pre-question geometry reduces Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 49.5% to 46.3%; corrupted measurements lower it to 33.6%. CompositionEvidence derives nine reproducible features from frozen detection, depth, and line experts and supplies their shared 24-dimensional representation through two interfaces. A training-free channel appends gated neutral evidence after the question, reaching 56.2% (+6.7, exact McNemar p=0.0018) and 48.4% under corrupted evidence. A minimal-training channel maps the same representation to four soft tokens with a 7.37M-parameter projector while leaving the VLM frozen; it reaches 61.0% (+11.5). Across nine VLMs, including five commercial models queried through official provider APIs, zero-shot accuracy ranges from 43.8% to 63.0%, and the text channel changes it by +6.7 to -6.9 points; the highest baseline is among the regressions. The effect of explicit geometry depends on measurement reliability and on how the receiving model integrates it.

</details>


### [78] [ZARA: Zero-shot Animatable and Relightable 3D Avatar reconstruction from a single image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10562)
*Yixiao Chen,Dongdong Weng,Chengfeng Zhao,Tao Gong,Zhihe Zhao,Zhe Zhu,Yue Liu,Yuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ZARA 提供了一个零样本前向框架，能够在不依赖于具体人物优化或后期处理的情况下，从单张图像中重建出可动画化且可重新照明的人体3D高斯avatar，并且能够继承几何先验学习材料感知的高斯表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了解决现有大尺寸人类重建模型虽然生成的3D avatar非常逼真且可动画化，但无法与照明分离的问题，以及现有3D relightable-avatar重建方法通常需要针对特定个人进行优化的问题。

Method: ZARA 使用了一个预训练的大规模人类重建模型与材料变换器相结合，来继承几何先验并学习材料感知的高斯表示。通过引入高斯对齐的材料特征融合策略，在保留局部细节的同时，将多尺度材料特征注入个体高斯中，并与几何标记相结合。同时，ZARA 通过伪材料标签作为训练过程中的条件输入和监督目标，以及引入MatFace正则化来保证在不稳定的面部伪材料监督下的材质结构和颜色预测。

Result: ZARA 的实验结果表明，它可以在数十秒内无须特定人物优化或后期处理，从单张图像中重建出可动画化且可重新照明的人体3D avatar，相较于现有基线，ZARA 在重新照明质量和材质泛化能力上表现出优越性，同时 ZARA 还能恢复人体基于物理渲染的属性，使 avatar 的外观可以直接进行材质编辑。

Conclusion: ZARA 提供了一种创新的方法来解决三维人体重建中的重新照明问题，通过结合预训练模型和新的材料处理策略，实现了更快、更准确的人体3D avatar 重建。

Abstract: Recent large human reconstruction models create remarkable animatable 3D avatars from a single image, but their appearance remains entangled with the illumination and cannot be relighted. In contrast, existing 3D relightable-avatar reconstruction methods typically require person-specific optimization. We present ZARA, a zero-shot feed-forward framework that reconstructs an animatable 3D Gaussian avatar together with its intrinsic attributes from a single image. ZARA couples a pretrained large-scale human reconstruction model with a Material Transformer to inherit geometry priors while learning material-aware Gaussian representations. To preserve localized details, we introduce Gaussian-aligned material feature fusion strategy, which injects multi-scale material features onto individual Gaussians and combines them with geometry tokens. As most human-avatar datasets lack ground-truth material maps, we use pseudo-material labels as conditioning inputs and supervision targets during training. We further introduce MatFace regularization to preserve facial structure and color in albedo prediction under unreliable facial pseudo-material supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ZARA reconstructs animatable and relightable humans within tens of seconds without person-specific optimization or post-processing, outperforming existing baselines in both relighting quality and materials generalization ability. As the ability of recovering the physically-based-rendering attributes of the human, ZARA also enables direct material editing of the avatar's appearance.

</details>


### [79] [Understanding the Effect of Visual Attention in CNNs: A Decision-Space Alignment Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10571)
*Niladri B. Puhan,K. Kamala Priya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种决策空间框架来量化视觉注意力对目标与竞争对手分类边距的影响，并引入了一种决策一致性得分（DAS）来衡量扰动与局部边距梯度的方向一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对视觉注意力如何影响CNN的下游决策理解不足。因此，研究旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 研究构建了一个决策空间框架，将注意力模型为中间特征扰动，并推导出对其对目标与竞争对手分类边距的影响的一阶预测。此外，引入了决策一致性得分（DAS）来衡量扰动与局部边距梯度的方向一致性。

Result: 该框架在CIFAR-100数据集上使用SimAM和CBAM，以及五种流行的CNN骨干网络进行评估。结果显示，预测的和实际的边距变化具有良好的一致性。DAS与实际边距变化呈正相关。单注意力实验进一步显示，预测一致性与DAS边际相关的注意力放置具有依赖性，且在后期阶段关联更强。

Conclusion: 本研究提出了一种综合框架，提供了对视觉注意力如何影响CNN的决策过程的全新理解。

Abstract: Visual Attention enhances convolutional neural networks (CNNs) by modulating intermediate features, yet their effects on downstream decisions remain less understood. We present a decision-space framework that models multiplicative attention as an intermediate feature perturbation and derives a first-order prediction of its effect on the target-versus-competitor classification margin. We further introduce the Decision Alignment Score (DAS) to quantify the directional alignment between the perturbation and the local margin gradient. We evaluate the framework on CIFAR-100 using SimAM and CBAM across five popular CNN backbones, ResNet-18, ResNet-20, ResNet-50, ResNet-56, and MobileNetV2. The analysis examines prediction agreement, DAS margin correlations, and downstream activation-state changes. Across most final-attention configurations, predicted and actual margin changes show good agreement, while DAS exhibits positive correlations with actual margin changes. Single-attention experiments further show that prediction agreement and DAS margin correlations depend on attention placement, with stronger associations at later stages.

</details>


### [80] [ROLECUE: Diagnosing Cross-Lingual Role-Binding Failures in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10575)
*Niaz Mohaiman Abtahi,Evan Maksud*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ROLECUE展示了视觉和语言组件在多语言情境下的联合表现存在差距，并揭示了单一组件表现较好的模型在联合推理时表现不佳的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了解决现有视觉语言模型在多语言语境下无法有效绑定视觉和语言角色的问题，需要设计一种控制性的诊断测试来评估这些模型的组成部分。

Method: 通过使用ROLECUE测试集，该测试集包含不同语序和语种的配对图片和句子，评估不同组件的表现，并通过分离不同的任务来揭示模型的特定弱点。

Result: 在192个图片和句子配对的数据上，八种最近的公开权重VLM模型在图像和文本角色识别方面存在差距，部分模型在单独测试中表现良好，但在联合推理中表现较差。

Conclusion: 这些结果表明需要在研究联合多模态错误之前，先进行单个组件的诊断分析以揭示隐藏的多语言组件联合表现差距和接受偏差。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can recognize events in images and parse sentences, but it remains unclear when they bind visual Agent-Patient structure to linguistic semantic roles across languages whose role cues depend on morphology, word order or construction. We introduce ROLECUE, a controlled diagnostic that pairs 192 validated two-person action images with German, Turkish, Japanese, English, Korean and Bangla sentences in canonical and patient-first orders. The evaluation separates image-only role recognition, text-only role parsing, direct image-sentence matching, response-compliance behavior and an external modular composition of the model's own component predictions. Across eight recent open-weight VLMs, ROLECUE reveals a structured spectrum: some models fail visual or linguistic component tests, some largely solve the diagnostic, some collapse to constant semantic assent and several show component-joint gaps in which reliable image-only and text-only role predictions do not survive direct joint inference. The largest non-degenerate gaps reach 44.9 percentage points, with final bootstrap intervals confirming that the effect is not a point-estimate artifact. These results reveal multilingual component-joint performance gaps and acceptance biases hidden by aggregate VLM benchmarks and show why component diagnostics are necessary before interpreting joint multimodal errors.

</details>


### [81] [MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10592)
*Jiaju Ma,Ashvini Kumar Jindal,Chuhua Wang,Sumithra Bhakthavatsalam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究发布了MotionGraphicsBench，这是一个由100个实例组成的基准，旨在评估大型语言模型生成运动图形的能力，从实时Lottie运动设计中提取，覆盖多样化的时空动画行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前，大型语言模型能从静态图片和自然语言请求中生成运动图形，但尚难评价其组合空间、外观和时间要求的能力。MotionGraphicsBench 提供了一个新的挑战，以真实世界的Lottie运动设计为基础，揭示现有模型生成运动图形的技术局限。

Method: 研究者开发了一个专家标注的数据集，并通过一个由多智能体管道生成的人类可读的验证程序来评估模型表现。验证程序基于人类判断标准，并能接受不同有效的实现方式来报告完成或未完成要求。

Result: 研究结果表明，人类编写的验证程序在180个动画的平衡测试集中与人类判断的共识达到93.3%，比基线高出10%。在47种不同的配置下，通过增加尝试次数，效果提升显著，尽管最高成功率仍然在38.0%到95.0%之间。此外，验证程序分析显示生成的动画经常未能匹配参考姿势、遵循要求的运动轨迹或协调相关事件。

Conclusion: 该研究通过MotionGraphicsBench为评估大型语言模型生成运动图形的能力提供了一个新的基准工具，并揭示了该领域现有的不足之处，有助于后续改进研究。

Abstract: Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models can follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. We introduce MotionGraphicsBench, an expert-curated benchmark of 100 instances for animating an input static SVG with a motion edit prompt. By supplying all required visual elements, our editing task reflects a designer-like workflow and isolates motion generation from graphic generation. Derived from real-world Lottie motion designs, our benchmark contains diverse combinations of spatio-temporal animation behaviors. Each benchmark instance pairs its model input with a deterministic, human-readable verification program that accepts different valid implementations and reports which prompt requirements pass or fail, rather than comparing against a reference animation or using a VLM judge. We construct these programs with a multi-agent pipeline using human-labeled animations and synthesized test cases. On a balanced test set of 180 animations, our programs achieve 93.3% raw agreement with human judgments, compared with 83.3% for a GPT-6 Astra VLM baseline, and outperform the baseline in both approval and rejection recall. Across 47 configurations from 32 LLMs and 12 providers, pass@1 ranges from 6.0% to 67.7%. Across 15 models evaluated at their highest available reasoning effort with 32 attempts per instance, additional attempts improve every model, but pass@32 still ranges from 38.0% to 95.0%. Our analysis of verification programs reveals that generated animations often fail to match reference poses, follow requested motion trajectories, or coordinate related events. We release our benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/figma-ai/motion-graphics-bench.

</details>


### [82] [The RenAIssance: Caption-Guided Diffusion Models for Historical-Art Visual Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10599)
*Zhanyu Tuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了The RenAIssance，一种将历史欧洲艺术品转化为可重复文本-图像资源的可扩展管道，通过此管道生成场景级说明，并使用生成的15,000个图像-文本对训练Stable Diffusion v1.5的LoRA适配器，该适配器可以生成符合历史艺术分布且保留基本模型呈现新颖概念能力的图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于历史艺术品缺少与之配对的描述，阻碍了现代图像生成器的应用，研究者旨在通过创建一个可扩展的管道，将历史欧洲艺术品转化为可重复的文本-图像资源，解决这一问题。

Method: 研究者利用BLIP生成场景级说明，并从DEArt中获得大约15,000个图像-文本对来训练Stable Diffusion v1.5的LoRA适配器，通过这种方式，生成的图像符合历史艺术品的分布，同时保留了基本模型呈现新颖概念的能力。

Result: 当面对历史和当代内容的不同长度提示时，该方法在其所有设置中都提高了FID，同时只稍微降低了CLIP文本-图像相似度。使用相同适配器，可以生成符合历史时期主题和当代概念的连贯历史视觉语言。

Conclusion: 通过分离可重复使用的历史艺术风格表示与基础生成器，该方法为可控历史艺术媒体创作、互动作者创作和丰富的媒体体验提供了实用的构建块。

Abstract: Generative AI can expand cultural collections into prompt-responsive visual media, but historical artworks rarely provide the paired descriptions needed to adapt modern image generators. We present The RenAIssance, a scalable pipeline that turns a collection of historical European artworks into a reusable text-to-image media resource. The pipeline generates scene-level captions with BLIP and uses the resulting approximately 15,000 image--text pairs from DEArt to train a compact LoRA adapter for Stable Diffusion v1.5. The adapter shifts generated images toward the historical-art distribution while retaining the base model's ability to render novel concepts. On historical and contemporary prompts of different lengths, it improves FID to the DEArt reference distribution in every setting with only a modest decrease in CLIP text--image similarity. Qualitative results show that the same adapter can render both period-appropriate subjects and contemporary concepts in a coherent historical visual language. By decoupling a reusable style representation from the base generator, the approach offers a practical building block for controllable historical-art media creation, interactive authoring, and rich-media experiences.

</details>


### [83] [Reason First, Retrieve What Matters: Hypothesis-Guided Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10609)
*Yisong Hu,Junbo Wang,Yuke Li,Jiangbin Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HypoKFS 是一个无需训练且即插即用的框架，将关键帧选择与多模态大语言模型的迭代推理耦合，通过稀疏抽样的帧进行初步假设空间构建，基于生成的答案分布判断是否需要额外的帧选择，并指导更具区分性的帧选择，从而提高长视频理解的准确性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关键帧选择方法通常依赖于全局图像-文本匹配，这可能导致不必要的计算；单独的查询相关性选择可能忽略辨别不同答案的证据；而一次性选择则无法纠正早期错误。

Method: HypoKFS框架首先通过稀疏抽样的帧进行初步假设空间构建，然后依据生成的答案分布判断是否需要额外的帧选择。如果需要，保留的假设将指导更具区分性的帧选择，再进行重新推理和假设精炼。这种迭代过程能够将额外的视觉计算集中在未解决的假设上，从而避免不必要的全球帧匹配。

Result: HypoKFS相比现有方法在多个多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）骨干网络上表现出一致的性能提升。它在Video-MME、LongVideoBench和MLVU测试集上分别提高了6.7个百分点的准确性，并以参考帧-假设匹配成本的1.3%实现了72.9%的准确率。

Conclusion: HypoKFS框架通过将关键帧选择与迭代的多模态大语言模型推理耦合，显著提高了长视频理解任务的准确性和效率，为这一领域的未来研究提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Long video understanding requires models to identify and reason over sparse, temporally distributed evidence within limited frame budgets. Existing keyframe selection methods typically retrieve query-relevant frames from a densely sampled candidate set before inference. However, global image-text matching incurs unnecessary computation when a small set of uniformly sampled frames already provides sufficient evidence. Query relevance alone may also overlook evidence that distinguishes competing answers, while one-shot selection offers no opportunity to correct earlier selection errors. We propose HypoKFS, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that couples keyframe selection with iterative inference by multimodal large language models (MLLMs). HypoKFS first reasons over sparsely sampled frames to construct an initial hypothesis space. The resulting answer distribution determines whether additional frame selection is needed. When needed, the retained hypotheses guide the selection of discriminative frames, followed by renewed inference and hypothesis refinement. This iterative process directs additional visual computation toward unresolved hypotheses while avoiding unnecessary global frame matching. Experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple MLLM backbones. HypoKFS improves accuracy by up to 6.7 percentage points and achieves 72.9% accuracy on Video-MME at only 1.3% of the reference frame-hypothesis matching cost.

</details>


### [84] [EndoSCOP-V: A Multi-Turn Video Understanding Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Models in Endoscopy Reporting and Clinical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10626)
*Abhishek Tyagi,Tanmay Jain,Vilas Biradar,Krithi Krishna Koduri,Misba Hul Bashir Masoodi,Swetha Rapolu,Hardik Rughwani,Rachana Kotha,Anjan Kumar Kaipa,Anudeep Katrevula,Rakesh Garlapati,Aniruddha Pratap Singh,Rajendra Patel,Abhay Tyagi,Sundeep Lakhtakia,Mohan Ramchandani,Rakesh Kalapala,D. Nageshwar Reddy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EndoSCOP-V 是一个用于结构化内镜报告和临床推理的多轮视频评价框架，包含1307段真实内镜和结肠镜视频，以及20,274个问题-答案回合。与现有基准测试相比，它更好地模拟了临床场景中的时间和临床推理需求。评估表明大型语言模型在某些方面仍落后于专业医生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的内镜多模态基准测试专注于静态图像或单一疾病视频，忽视了临床推理，这对实际应用中有严格要求。因此，为了更贴近现实应用需要，建立了EndoSCOP-V框架。

Method: 框架运用Markovian上下文修剪或acles-forcing协议，每个回合注入金标准答案，确保逐轮推理独立于对话错误。由一名病理检查中审阅的模板生成问题-答案回合，确保其真实性和准确性。

Result: 在14个高水平LM中，27B级模型达到59.8%准确率，去除格式性疾病的题目后下降到53.4%。在临床医生团队的表现上，最前沿的3个专有模型以23分的差距落后。

Conclusion: EndoSCOP-V展示了现有大型模型在处理复杂临床场景时的局限性，特别在量化评估、多变量评分和长期视频间的操作推理方面留下了改进空间。

Abstract: Endoscopic diagnosis unfolds over native video, where a single positive finding during traversal of the gastrointestinal tract sets off a multi-minute chain of reasoning over location, morphology, severity and intervention. Existing endoscopy multimodal benchmarks test only static images or single-disease videos, which miss the temporal and clinical reasoning that real-world reporting demands. We introduce EndoSCOP-V, a video-grounded multi-turn evaluation framework for structured endoscopy reporting and clinical reasoning. It contains 1,307 real-world endoscopy and colonoscopy videos (63.2 h; 97% 1080p) averaging about 174 s. Its 20,274 question-answer turns are instantiated deterministically from clinician-filled structured endoscopy-reporting EHRs, so no per-case annotation is synthetic or LLM-rephrased. They come from 1,033 clinician-reviewed templates, about 18 per disease, that span a clinically aligned 9-task x 30-sub-task reporting taxonomy over 54 World Endoscopy Organization (WEO) MST 3.0 diseases. 22% of procedures carry co-existing pathologies, up to six per case. A Markovian context-pruned oracle-forcing protocol evaluates the dialogue turn by turn, injecting the gold answer before each subsequent turn so that per-turn reasoning is isolated from cascading dialogue errors. A panel of 15 board-certified endoscopists sets a 78% strict-accuracy baseline on 1,500 questions. Across 14 open-weight LMMs, the best 27B-class model reaches 59.8% strict accuracy, falling to 53.4% once format-trivial disease-rejection items are excluded. On a between-subjects spot-check, the best of 3 frontier proprietary models trails the clinician panel by 23 pp on strict NDR accuracy. Sub-task analysis reveals consistent gaps in quantitative measurement, multi-variable grading and intervention reasoning on long-horizon video. Data: Hugging Face (EndoSCOP-V). Code: GitHub (abhi25t/EndoSCOP-V).

</details>


### [85] [Latent-WAM++: Shaping World and Action Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10632)
*Yichen Zhang,Yupeng Zheng,Linbo Wang,Pengxuan Yang,Zebin Xing,Junli Wang,Shiwei Li,Kangwei Liu,Fan Ren,Qichao Zhang,Yifeng Pan,Ji Tao,Dongbin Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Latent-WAM++ 提出了一种新颖的 World Action Model (WAM) 的变体，它通过直接监督每种表示的作用于规划来改进 WAM。该模型包括世界表示构建，轨迹均值流规划器和视觉-动作表示对齐，实现了 NAVSIM v2 和 HUGSIM 数据集上的新基准性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 WAM 主要集中在预测未来状态或最终动作，而忽略了连接预测与规划的中间世界和动作表示。Latent-WAM++ 旨在通过直接监督每种表示在规划中的作用来改进 WAM。

Method: Latent-WAM++ 通过结合场景-自我未来预测、SIGReg 基础的分布稳定化以及冻结几何先验来学习一个具有时间和几何意识的非退化世界表示。该模型还包括直接预测多模态轨迹提案的轨迹均值流规划器，以及视觉-动作表示对齐，确保输出的动作特征与当前视觉语义对齐。

Result: Latent-WAM++ 在 NAVSIM v2 上达到了最新的 EPDMS 性能 90.1，以及 HUGSIM 数据集上的平均 RC 和 HD-Score 分别为 47.0 和 30.1。

Conclusion: 与 Latent-WAM 相比，Latent-WAM++ 的端到端训练成本降低了 88.1%，由 1,600 个 GPU 小时减少到 190 个 GPU 小时。这表明 Latent-WAM++ 在自动驾驶中的性能得到显著提升，并且训练效率也有很大提高。

Abstract: We introduce Latent-WAM++, a representation-centered World Action Model (WAM) for end-to-end autonomous driving. Existing WAMs are primarily trained to predict future states or final actions, leaving the intermediate world and action representations that connect prediction to planning only indirectly constrained. Latent-WAM++ matches the supervision of each representation to its role in planning. World Representation Construction combines scene-ego future prediction, SIGReg-based distribution stabilization, and frozen geometric priors to learn a temporally predictive, non-degenerate, and geometry-aware world representation without an EMA target encoder. Trajectory MeanFlow Planner directly predicts multimodal trajectory proposals while being optimized with an Improved MeanFlow velocity-space objective, enabling one-step sampling. Visual-Action Representation Alignment further aligns the resulting pre-output action features with a stop-gradient target derived from current visual semantics. Latent-WAM++ achieves state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM v2 and under zero-shot evaluation on HUGSIM, reaching 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and 47.0 average RC and 30.1 average HD-Score on HUGSIM. Training the planner end to end costs 190 GPU-hours for Latent-WAM++ versus 1,600 for Latent-WAM, a reduction of 88.1%.

</details>


### [86] [VAComp: View-Aware Full Projector Compensation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10637)
*Kai Zhou,Qingyue Deng,Bingyao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VAComp是一种新颖的方法，能够为移动观众提供全投影补偿，使观察者能够感知到虚拟对象，或对现实对象的外观和材质属性进行视图一致的修改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于视角的方法需要重新训练或重新校准模型以适应新的视角，而基于NeRF/GS的方法则使用结构从运动（SfM）进行投影仪-相机系统的校准，这引入了额外的校准挑战。

Method: VAComp采用非迭代混合方法VAComp-SD和VAComp-SI，结合2D高斯视图条件几何校正和学习的光度补偿，通过单向前传播预测每个补偿图像，而不采用逐帧迭代优化。

Result: 实验表明，这两种方法都能达到竞争性的补偿质量，其中VAComp-SD能够实现实时更新，VAComp-SI则能够在交互速率下运行。

Conclusion: VAComp提供了一个全新的视角感知校准框架，为裸眼场景下的移动观众提供了全投影补偿，同时保证了补偿质量和运行效率的平衡。

Abstract: Full projector compensation adjusts a projector's input image to compensate for both geometric and photometric distortions introduced by the projection surface. Existing methods generally treat the viewing condition as a static camera viewpoint. When applied to a moving viewer, existing methods face two key challenges: (1) view-dependent methods require model retraining or recalibration to compensate for novel viewpoints; and (2) NeRF/GS-based view-agnostic methods use structure from motion (SfM) to calibrate the projector-camera systems (ProCams) with an unknown global scale, while view-aware tracking requires calibrating a camera oriented opposite to the projector, which introduces an additional calibration challenge. To address these challenges, we introduce VAComp, the first view-aware framework for full projector compensation for a moving viewer in a naked-eye setting. Using a projector, VAComp enables the viewer to perceive a virtual object that visually replaces the real object or to observe view-consistent modifications of the real object's appearance and material properties. To resolve the SfM scale ambiguity, we use metric calibration as a reference to recover the global scale; to calibrate the oppositely facing camera, we use two checkerboards, one facing the RGB camera and the other facing the depth camera. To balance compensation quality and runtime efficiency, we develop two non-iterative hybrid methods, VAComp-SD and VAComp-SI. Both combine 2D Gaussian-based view-conditioned geometric correction with learned photometric compensation, predicting each compensation image through a single forward pass without per-frame iterative optimization. Real-world experiments show that both methods achieve competitive compensation quality, with VAComp-SD enabling real-time updates and VAComp-SI operating at interactive rates. Project page: https://realkaizhou.github.io/VAComp/.

</details>


### [87] [VisProve: Learning Typed Visual Provenance for Scientific Document Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10642)
*Jingxuan Wei,Zhengyang Wang,Zheng Guo,Xiaoming Wu,Fuqiang Wang,Xin Wang,Bihui Yu,Yining Wang,Junnan Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了ReViE数据集和VisProve方法，旨在从视觉证明中生成答案及其来源，提出了一种结合空间证据阅读和证据-答案关系反馈的可微分方法，显著提高了细粒度来源标注的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
