Motivation: 当前的视觉引用仅表明答案的支持来源，但不解释这些来源如何与答案相关。本文旨在弥合从视觉中准确归因答案证据的差距，通过生成带有明确支持关系的来源区域来改进科学文档问题回答任务。

Method: 本文提出了ReViE数据集，包含完整的科学文档以及标注的引用、压缩或推理来源区域。在此基础上，设计了VisProve方法，结合空间证据阅读和证据-答案关系反馈，以不同iable的方式对证据进行加权，条件性预测序列预测，并通过门控规范化残差进行信息传递。

Result: 与其他方法相比，使用VisProve方法在不同类型来源上的改进显著，特别是Inference（推理）类别的改进最为显著。这些结果表明，将视觉锚定与支持关系建模结合主要提高了细粒度来源标注的精度。

Conclusion: 本文的工作促进了科学文档问题回答任务中细粒度来源标注的精确度，尽管在绝对的Typed-F1上仍然较低，这表明在问题回答和视觉证据归因之间仍存在差距。

Abstract: Visual citations show where an answer is supported, but not how the cited content contributes to it. In scientific document question answering, a model may read a value directly, compress several observations, or combine evidence to infer a conclusion. We study typed visual provenance, where a system generates an answer together with source regions and explicit support relations. We introduce ReViE, a dataset of 3,941 questions over complete scientific documents, with page, section, and region annotations labeled as Quotation, Compression, or Inference. We further propose VisProve, which augments joint answer and provenance generation with differentiable Spatial Evidence Reading and Evidence-Answer Relation Feedback. VisProve conditions next-token prediction on localized visual evidence and its estimated support relation through a gated norm-bounded residual. On the document-disjoint ReViE test set, VisProve improves Typed-F1 from 3.52 to 5.48 and Section-F1 from 45.99 to 53.24 over joint supervised fine-tuning with the same backbone, while Page-F1 changes only marginally. These results suggest that coupling visual grounding with support relation modeling mainly improves fine-grained provenance, while the low absolute Typed-F1 reveals a substantial gap between answer generation and precise visual evidence attribution.

</details>


### [88] [Agent2BIM: A Systematic Evaluation of Reality-Capture Configurations and Prior Models for As-Built Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10644)
*Boyu Wang,Borja García de Soto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究介绍了基于代理的扫描到BIM框架Agent2BIM，并通过实验室和室内机电设备场景评估了七种捕获配置，分别使用全景图、智能手机视频、智能手机LiDAR、地面激光扫描等输入。结果显示，视觉与测量证据在基于代理的Scan-to-BIM过程中具有互补作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究指出在从现实数据自动构建BIM的过程中，需要什么样的证据才能实现高精度的重建，通过对比不同捕获配置的效果，强调了视觉和测量证据在这一过程中的重要性。

Method: 该研究采用了多种现实捕获技术，包括全景图、智能手机视频、智能手机LiDAR、地面激光扫描、地面激光扫描结合全景图以及图像补充之前的IFC模型。通过与经过地面激光扫描验证的参考模型进行比较，评估了不同配置下的组件检测、几何精度和机电连接情况。

Result: 在实验室环境中，组件召回率达到了84%到100%之间，但仅全景图重建的组件中有9%位于参考位置20厘米以内；相比之下，智能手机LiDAR重建的组件中有86%在参考位置20厘米以内。在机电设备场景中，非比例输入重建组件比例为11-43%，而比例输入为75-93%。使用之前的IFC模型可以提高机电重建质量，但可能会传播不准确的信息。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，视觉和测量证据是代理Scan-to-BIM过程中相辅相成的。合理配置不同技术可以提高BIM的重建精度。

Abstract: AI agents can generate as-built Building Information Models (BIMs) from reality-capture data, but the evidence required for accurate reconstruction remains unclear. This paper presents Agent2BIM, an agent-based Scan-to-BIM framework, and evaluates seven capture configurations in a research laboratory and a mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) scene. Inputs include 360° panoramas, smartphone video, smartphone LiDAR, terrestrial laser scanning (TLS), TLS with posed panoramas, and imagery supplemented by prior IFC models. Outputs are compared against TLS-verified reference models for component detection, geometric accuracy, and MEP connectivity. In the laboratory, component recall ranged from 84% to 100%, but only 9% of components reconstructed from panoramas were within 20 cm of their reference positions, compared with 86% using smartphone LiDAR. In the MEP scene, scale-free inputs recovered 11 - 43% of components, versus 75 - 93% for metric inputs. Prior IFC models improved MEP reconstruction but could propagate inaccuracies. The results highlight the complementary roles of visual and metric evidence in agent-based Scan-to-BIM.

</details>


### [89] [SHIN: Scalable Hierarchy for INcremental 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10652)
*Reagan Koo,Yeong-Gyu Kim,Eun-Seok Ryu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SHIN（Spherical Harmonic-based Interventional Network）通过构建多层次的3D高斯点阵（Gaussian Splatting）层次结构，实现了可扩展的多分辨率视图合成，能够在不同预算下渐进提升合成质量，同时保持高PSNR/大小效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS方法虽然能够提供高质量的实时新视图合成，但设备和网络条件下的部署成本各异。大多数紧凑型方法专注于单一的操作点，因此不同的预算要求单独的表示形式。

Method: SHIN通过提出一种可扩展的3DGS层次结构，在基础层（Base）上添加可叠加的增强层。每一层在预算中分配用于添加高斯体素和保留球面谐波（SH）带的数量，通过多尺度位置和尺度敏感性的得分来决定每个阶段添加哪些高斯体素以及保留多少SH带。

Result: 在三个基准测试中，SHIN逐层改进单一表示形式，并且在与多速率和渐进基线的重叠比较中，以每个像素最好的PSNR/大小效率取得了最优表现。

Conclusion: SHIN通过优化高斯体素的添加和SH带的保留策略，成功实现了一种灵活性高的3DGS方法，能够在不同的预算下提供渐进提升的视图合成质量。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides high-quality real-time novel-view synthesis, but deployment budgets vary across devices and network conditions. Most compact methods target one operating point, so another budget requires a separate representation. SHIN is a scalable 3DGS hierarchy with a reusable Base and additive enhancement layers, so each higher-quality operating point extends rather than replaces the decoded representation. Constructing this hierarchy requires deciding which Gaussians each stage adds and how much spherical-harmonic (SH) appearance each retains, because these choices remain fixed in later prefixes. SHIN derives one shared Gaussian order from multi-scale position-scale sensitivity and divides each stage budget between adding Gaussians and retaining SH bands using calibrated gradient-based scores per byte. Lightweight opacity updates adjust compositing while transmitted geometry and SH coefficients remain unchanged. Across three benchmarks, SHIN progressively improves one cumulative representation and achieves the best PSNR-size efficiency in every overlapping comparison with the multi-rate and progressive baselines.

</details>


### [90] [FG-DSA: Frequency-Guided Depthwise Separable Attention for Efficient Dense Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10653)
*Yiyao Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的频率引导的深度可分离注意机制（FG-DSA），用于在资源受限的场景下进行高效密集预测。FG-DSA通过在空间注意力机制中显式插入频域先验信息，使轻量级网络能以线性复杂度恢复清晰的边界过渡。实验证明，FG-DSA在语义分割任务中能有效恢复细粒度对象边界，并显著提高由扩散模型生成的图像细节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在资源有限的场景中，深层多尺度预测存在显著的细节损失问题，尤其是在语义分割任务中。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新的频率引导的注意力机制，以提高模型性能同时保持高效。

Method: 本文方法的核心是一个两维快速傅里叶变换（2D FFT）高通滤波模块，用于在空间注意力机制中加入频域先验信息，提高模型恢复尖锐边界的能力，同时保持线性复杂度。

Result: 实验结果显示，FG-DSA在语义分割任务中能有效恢复细粒度对象边界，且在扩散模型生成的图像质量上表现出显著的提升。此外，该模块的参数和计算量非常小，几乎不会增加额外的计算负担。

Conclusion: FG-DSA为资源受限场景下的高效密集预测提供了一种新颖的解决方案。通过实验证明，这种方法不仅在语义分割方面有效，还能显著提高由扩散模型生成图像的细节。

Abstract: Dense prediction and generative modeling in resource-constrained scenarios remain challenging, as repeated downsampling substantially reduces spatial detail and degrades boundaries. Although recent attention mechanisms have alleviated the problem of semantic ambiguity, they often fail to preserve high-frequency features or do so at the expense of a very high computational cost. In this paper, we propose the Frequency Guided Depthwise Separable Attention for Efficient Dense Prediction (FG-DSA), a novel framework for efficient dense visual understanding and generation. FG-DSA employs a 2D FFT high-pass filtering module to explicitly inject frequency domain priors into the spatial attention mechanism, allowing lightweight networks to recover sharp boundary transitions with linear complexity. A range of experiments show that FG-DSA is effective at recovering fine object boundaries and leads to a consistent performance gain in the task of semantic segmentation. Importantly, we show that FGA-DSA can be used as a module in diffusion-based generative U-Nets, leading to a significant improvement in the detail of the generated images with very little additional parameter and Floating Point Operation (FLOP) cost.

</details>


### [91] [Dynamics-Informed Action Learning for Goal-Conditioned Latent Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10660)
*Yinuo Jiang,Guangzhi Wang,Yiran Wang,Junfu Pu,Cheng Cheng,Honghao Chen,Cheng Cheng,Ying Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DIAL通过优化动态信息和动作学习，提高了视觉控制任务中的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的潜在世界模型虽然能提供视觉控制，但在学习动态和用于规划之间存在差距。

Method: DIAL方法通过两次监督来提高动态预测和逆向推理，同时在测试时结合了自回归逆向动力学和前向动力学。

Result: DIAL在四个视觉控制基准测试中表现优于现有的潜在世界模型和规划基准。

Conclusion: DIAL在视觉控制领域中提供了更有效的动作序列生成方法。

Abstract: Latent world models enable visual control by planning action sequences in compact representation spaces, but a gap remains between how latent dynamics are learned and how they are used for planning. First, teacher-forced training does not expose the dynamics model to the recursively predicted latent states encountered during planning. Second, sampling-based planners typically initialize action search from goal-agnostic proposals, without exploiting the action-conditioned dynamics learned by the world model. We introduce Dynamics-Informed Action Learning (DIAL) to bridge these two gaps. During training, rollout alignment exposes the forward model to its own autoregressive latent predictions, while multi-step inverse supervision trains a lightweight inverse dynamics head to infer actions from latent-state transitions. We further apply the inverse head to model-generated transitions with its parameters held fixed, encouraging predicted rollouts to retain action-relevant information. At test time, DIAL autoregressively couples the inverse and forward dynamics to construct a dynamics-informed action sequence toward the goal, which initializes the mean of the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) proposal distribution. The subsequent CEM search then refines this initialization using the standard sampling and updating procedure. Experiments across four visual control benchmarks demonstrate that DIAL outperforms existing latent world models and planning baselines in both standard and long-horizon scenarios.

</details>


### [92] [Physically Guided TeX Generation for Low-Light Visual Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10665)
*Daoheng Li,Jianjun Qian,Mengkai Yan,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了TeX-Gen框架，融合可见光和红外图像以提升低光环境下视觉任务的表现。TeX-Gen通过构建互补的多视角特征，并使用分支特定门控机制将线索导向温度、发射率和纹理图。TeXMetric对生成的地图进行评估，无需像素级物理标签。TeX Tune改进了结果，通过任务导向调整同步优化调整模块和任务网络。实验表明TeX-Gen在FLIR、LLVIP、M3FD和MSRS数据集上的低光环境任务表现具有竞争力，HADAR实验还检查了TeXMetric分数与下游检测性能的相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光条件下，可见光图像对比度降低，细节模糊，而红外图像缺乏颜色和纹理信息。因此，需要一种融合两者的框架以提高低光环境下的视觉任务表现。

Method: TeX-Gen框架包含TeX生成、TeXMetric评估和TeX Tune优化三个部分。其中TeX生成通过构建多视角特征和使用分支特定门控机制从配对的可见光和红外图像中提取信息，构建温度、发射率和纹理图。TeXMetric构建了辐射重建、通道结构和材料一致性三方面的评估指标。TeX Tune则在任务导向的前提下调整模块，优化整个网络。

Result: TeX-Gen在低光环境下的多个数据集（FLIR、LLVIP、M3FD和MSRS）上取得了与现有方法相当的任务性能。HADAR实验还展示了TeXMetric分数与下游检测性能的相关性。

Conclusion: TeX-Gen是一个有效的物理引导框架，它能够通过融合可见光和红外图像生成互补信息，为低光环境下的视觉任务提供支持，并减少对物理标注的依赖。

Abstract: Low-light conditions reduce visible contrast and obscure details, while infrared images lack color and texture, motivating the fusion of infrared and visible information for visual tasks. Existing fusion methods primarily optimize image appearance or task-specific features without explicitly disentangling the coupled factors underlying thermal observations, limiting their physical interpretation under thermal degeneracy. Hyperspectral thermal measurements enable physical decomposition, but they require specialized imaging hardware, while pixel-level physical annotations for supervision or evaluation incur additional costs. We propose TeX-Gen, a physically guided framework for TeX generation from paired visible and infrared images in low-light visual tasks. TeX Generation constructs complementary multi-view features and employs independent branch-specific gates to route cues into the Temperature, Emissivity, and Texture maps. TeXMetric integrates radiometric reconstruction, channel structure, and material consistency to assess the generated maps without requiring pixel-level physical labels. TeX Tune improves performance through task-guided adjustments, jointly optimizing the adjustment modules and task network while keeping the generator frozen. Experiments show that TeX-Gen achieves competitive task performance in low-light environments on the FLIR, LLVIP, M3FD, and MSRS datasets. Experiments on HADAR also examine the association between TeXMetric scores and downstream detection performance.

</details>


### [93] [Heterogeneous Asymmetric Contrastive Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10672)
*Qi Wang,Jinjia Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出了HACD（Heterogeneous Asymmetric Contrastive Distillation）方法，通过将教师和学生网络的logits映射到共享的单位超球体上，去除了架构依赖的偏移，并通过控制温度来影响输出的尖峰程度，从而实现知识迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规的知识蒸馏方法会匹配教师和学生网络预测值的样本特征，但这种方法在异构教师与学生之间表现不佳，因为不同架构之间的预测组织方式和非目标类别的语义结构存在差异。

Method: HACD方法首先将教师和学生的logits映射到共享的单位超球体上，消除了架构依赖的偏移和温度控制输出的尖峰程度。每个学生输出需要在其批次内识别自己的教师目标，并在轻微和强烈增强的不同视图中计算目标，进行对比。

Result: HACD方法在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1K上的11到12对和14对异构双胞胎上表现优异，达到了最佳或第二高的准确率，平均提高了0.882和0.133个百分点，且无需_ground-truth_labels。此外，HACD添加的可学习参数为零，且每处理一个样本仅需一次教师推理。

Conclusion: HACD方法为异构架构的知识蒸馏提供了一种高效可行的方式，验证了通过预测关系结构而非具体预测值来进行知识转移的有效性。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) between architectural families, e.g., from a Transformer teacher to a CNN student, is difficult because the two networks learn different representations. Logits share a label space, but heterogeneous teachers differ in logit offset, scale, and sharpness, and their non-target classes are less semantically organized. Conventional logit distillation matches these values sample by sample, asking the student to imitate how another architecture expresses its predictions. We argue that a heterogeneous teacher should pass on the relational structure of its predictions, i.e., how it arranges samples relative to one another, and propose Heterogeneous Asymmetric Contrastive Distillation (HACD) to transfer this structure. HACD maps teacher and student logits to centered, temperature-softened probability directions on a shared unit hypersphere, which removes architecture-dependent offsets and lets the temperature control how sharply peaked outputs enter the representation while keeping informative non-target classes. Each student output must then identify its own teacher target within the batch. Because every teacher target also acts as a negative for the others, HACD computes the targets on a moderately augmented view and contrasts both a moderate and a strong student view against them. HACD adds no learnable parameters and needs one teacher pass per sample. It achieves the best or second-best accuracy on 11 of 12 heterogeneous pairs on CIFAR-100, without ground-truth labels, and on 14 of 15 pairs on ImageNet-1K, improving over the reported vanilla KD results by 8.82 and 1.33 percentage points on average. Checkpoints are available at https://github.com/BTAEYANG/HACD-Heterogeneous-Asymmetric-Contrastive-Distillation; the code will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [94] [MGE: A Membership Guided Data Extraction Attack against Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10678)
*Yuchang Mei,Longqiang Wang,Haoyang Jiang,Mingyang Yi,Shaolei Zhang,Keman Huang,Wuqiong Pan,Ju Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出了一种新的数据提取框架MGE，通过条件生成方式从预训练的扩散模型中提取训练数据，通过对抗梯度和并行分支解码提高提取成功率和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在图像生成方面取得了显著成果，但其潜在的安全风险包括训练数据泄露的问题。

Method: 提出了一种名为MGE的框架，将数据提取问题形式化为条件生成问题，条件信号来自于成员推理分类器，并通过对抗梯度和并行分支解码提升提取效果。

Result: 实验表明MGE框架能够从预训练的扩散模型中成功提取数百张图像。

Conclusion: 实验结果强调了扩散模型隐私保护的重要性。

Abstract: Recently, diffusion models have achieved remarkable performance in image generation. However, their inherent memory properties introduce a potential safety risk of training data leakage, i.e., data extraction attack. To illustrate such risk, we propose a membership guided extraction (MGE) framework to effectively extract training data from a pre-trained diffusion model. Our core idea is to formulate the data extraction as a conditional generation, where the condition signal is from a membership inference classifier. To improve the success rate and efficiency of MGE, we propose adversarial gradient and parallel branch decoding. Our experiments on image generation benchmarks demonstrate that our MGE can extract hundreds of images, which shows that more attention should be paid to privacy-preserving of diffusion model.

</details>


### [95] [JoVox: Joint Hierarchical Flow Matching for Lightweight Voxel Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10690)
*Xiangjun Tang,Jianqi Chen,Peter Wonka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JoVox 提出了一种新的框架，通过联合学习多层体素层次结构的概率分布，使细网格的预测依赖于已生成的粗网格，从而提高体素质量并降低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前的生成方法难以在保持体素轻量化的同时提高其高保真度，而Hiearchical方法虽然保持了轻量化但粗尺度预测不准确。

Method: JoVox 设计了一种离散流匹配框架，学习所有层次的体素概率分布，而不是单独学习每个层次的分布。通过这种框架，引入了双层预测机制，一次性生成更细一层的体素，减少网络处理的层级，提高质量同时降低计算量。

Result: JoVox 框架在无条件和图像条件下的体素生成中优于基线，并与当前最先进的TRELLIS.2相比，实现了8倍的训练吞吐量、每向前传递1/15的FLOPs、在4块GPU上训练而不需要32块，且体素质量更高，Chamfer距离减少了11%。

Conclusion: JoVox 通过新的多级预测策略和联合分布学习显著提高了体素生成的高保真度，并大幅降低了计算成本。

Abstract: Generating high-fidelity voxels while keeping their lightweight nature remains an open problem in computer vision. Current generators are either high-fidelity but computationally heavy, or lightweight but of lower fidelity. Hierarchical methods keep the lightweight nature of voxels. However, their coarse levels, which decide where all finer cells can appear, are generated with the least information about the shape and are never revisited, so they are often plausible but wrong. Our key insight is to let finer cells take part in deciding coarse cells. To this end, we propose JoVox, a discrete flow matching framework that learns the joint distribution of all levels of the voxel hierarchy, instead of a separate distribution for each level, so that coarse cells can be predicted with finer cells already generated nearby. Within this framework, we further introduce a two-level prediction, which outputs the cells two levels finer at once instead of one level finer, halving the number of levels that the network processes and yielding voxels of higher fidelity. We also introduce an unmasking strategy that revisits early decisions once finer cells are generated and corrects inconsistencies in masked diffusion models. Our framework outperforms the baselines on both unconditional and image-conditioned voxel generation. Compared with the current state-of-the-art TRELLIS.2, we achieve 8x higher training throughput, 1/15 of the FLOPs in a forward pass, train on 4 vs. 32 GPUs, and obtain higher quality with an 11% lower Chamfer distance.

</details>


### [96] [Perception, Not Reasoning, Limits Visual Theory of Mind](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10694)
*Mohamed Rayan Barhdadi,Syed Talal Wasim,Juergen Gall,Erchin Serpedin,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过提出一个名为'感知贡献比'的五条件分离协议，探讨视觉情景理解中的瓶颈，并发现感知问题是主要限制因素，而非推理问题。具体地，研究测试了多种视觉语言模型在处理抽象2D图像和自然3D游戏场景中的表现，发现人工构建的脚手架能够显著改善视觉推理错误，但基于自动解析的脚手架效果不佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在面对纯视觉问题时表现不如人类，因此研究团队认为感知能力是主要瓶颈，并设计了一种新的实验方法来评估模型的感知能力。

Method: 该研究采用了五种不同的视觉清晰度条件，从纯视觉到纯文本，并通过Perceptual Contribution Ratio来量化不同条件对视觉-文本差距的补偿程度。同时，对视觉模拟认知的过程进行了细致的分类分析。

Result: 研究结果显示，人工构建的脚手架在多数情况下能够显著提升模型的视觉推理准确性，尤其是在处理抽象2D图像和自然3D游戏场景中表现突出。而基于自动解析的脚手架则表现不佳。在视觉仅有条件下，最常见的错误是现实偏差。

Conclusion: 研究结论指出，感知问题而非推理问题在视觉情景理解中是一个主要的瓶颈。有效的视觉场景提取结构化状态而非信念推理是提高现有视觉-语言模型在视觉情景理解上的关键。

Abstract: Vision-language models pass text-based false-belief probes at near-human levels but drop by over twenty percentage points on abstract panels the moment the same problem is conveyed visually. The consensus diagnosis is conceptual, prescribing new belief-reasoning modules. We argue the dominant bottleneck is perceptual: not what the model cannot reason about, but what it cannot see. We propose a five-condition dissociation protocol that holds the reasoning task constant while varying perceptual fidelity from visual only to text only, and quantify the result with the Perceptual Contribution Ratio, the share of the visual-to-text gap a given fidelity closes. We test this on two kinds of scenes: abstract 2D panels in the Heider--Simmel tradition, and naturalistic 3D game scenes from MuMA-ToM and MindPower. The evaluation covers seven VLMs and roughly 159,000 API calls. Ground-truth scaffolds substantially close the gap in every setting, and on the abstract panels and MuMA-ToM they match or exceed the text-only reasoning. Whereas scaffolds built by automatic parsers, including frontier VLMs, fail. The most common error in the visual-only condition is \emph{reality bias}, which accounts for 60\% of false-belief failures. Models report where an object actually is, not where an absent agent believes it is. This points to a perceptual front-end that fails to track which agents were present at each moment. Under the evaluated protocol, structured visual scene-state extraction, rather than belief inference, is the dominant bottleneck for visual ToM.

</details>


### [97] [PLS-GS: Probabilistic Lidar Scaffolds for Compact, Surface-Aligned Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10699)
*Krishnan Harikumar,Alejandro Fontan,Thierry Peynot,Emili Hernández,Niko Sünderhauf*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PLS-GS利用LiDAR和相机数据的互补性，通过层次高斯混合模型优化3D Gaussian Splatting表示，实现了更紧凑和更快的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前3DGS通常只利用图像数据进行优化，但同时提供高精度LiDAR数据的机器人和制图应用能够结合视觉和几何结构信息，通过PLS-GS更好地利用这些数据。

Method: PLS-GS采用层次高斯混合模型同时优化位置和颜色，形成连续且自适应的支撑结构，不需要传统的体素格子或八叉树进行场景分区。每个渲染高斯归一化到通过该分量诱导的局部表面框架中，并通过马氏距离支撑损失限制渲染高斯与LIDAR导出的表面的偏差。

Result: 在五个大型户外场景中，PLS-GS在更少的示例下使几何体更接近LiDAR测量值，生成更紧凑的模型并加快了渲染速度。在匹配容量的情况下，尽管具有类似的渲染质量，PLS-GS的几何体仍然更接近LiDAR测量值。

Conclusion: PLS-GS作为一种新的3D GS方法，在保持渲染质量的前提下，通过优化几何结构与LiDAR测量的匹配程度，实现了更好的表示效果。

Abstract: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is typically optimized from images only, many robotics and mapping applications provide both camera and high-definition LiDAR data, combining rich visual appearance with accurate geometric structure. We introduce PLS-GS, a probabilistic LiDAR scaffold for Gaussian Splatting that exploits this complementary sensing setting to construct a compact 3DGS representation aligned to the measured surface. PLS-GS fits a Hierarchical Gaussian Mixture Model jointly over position and color, yielding a continuous and adaptive scaffold that eliminates the need for discrete scene partitioning such as voxel grids or octrees. The fitted mixture then guides the renderable 3DGS Gaussians: each rendering Gaussian is associated with a GMM component and constrained in the local surface frame induced by that component's covariance. A Mahalanobis support loss bounds the deviation of the rendering Gaussians from the corresponding LiDAR-derived surface. Across five large outdoor scenes, PLS-GS places primitives markedly closer to the LiDAR measurements than both image- and LiDAR-initialized baselines, while employing substantially fewer primitives, yielding a considerably more compact model and faster rendering. At matched capacity, PLS-GS places primitives closer to the LiDAR measurements, with comparable rendering quality. Code is available at https://github.com/k-harikumar/PLS-GS.

</details>


### [98] [Quadratic Bezier Splatting with Structural Initialization for Efficient Painting Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10713)
*Jinfan Liu,Xuhan Zhan,Mengqin Zhao,Guangyi Deng,Wuze Zhang,Bingbing Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种基于模型的框架，通过引入Quadratic Bezier Splatting 算法和一种新的单线审计机制，实现了更高质量的画笔痕迹渲染。与现有方法相比，该方法在布局一致性、峰值信噪比、表示的紧凑性以及计算效率方面均有显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于像素级重构的画笔痕迹渲染方法过于注重全局误差的减少，导致画笔痕迹变碎片化，局部缺陷被遮掩，因此需要一种新的模型指导框架来提高画笔痕迹渲染的质量。

Method: 该研究采用Quadratic Bezier Splatting 算法进行连续弯曲画笔痕迹的分析建模，并通过前馈多尺度画笔痕迹解码器提供结构初始化。同时，在测试时进行画笔痕迹优化，提高高保真度的重构能力。还引入了一种单线审计机制，能够明确评估局部画笔质量，防止缺陷通过逐层补偿而生存下来。

Result: 在现有方法的基础上，该框架实现了更加一致的布局，PSNR提高了5.46 dB，表示更加紧凑（节省16%的空间），并在联合渲染器的前向和后向计算中提高了220.3倍的计算效率。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的模型导向框架显著改善了画笔痕迹渲染质量，通过模型建模、结构初始化、测试时间优化和单线审计机制在多个方面都展现出优势。

Abstract: Stroke-based rendering is often optimized as a pixel-level reconstruction task. This over-reliance on global error reduction not only degrades strokes into fragmented curves due to a lack of structured planning, but also allows locally defective primitives to be concealed by overlapping layers. To address these issues, we introduce a model-guided framework for stroke-audited rendering. Our framework uses Quadratic Bezier Splatting to analytically model continuous curved strokes with efficient differentiable alpha compositing. Built on this renderer, a feedforward multi-scale stroke decoder provides a structural initialization with learned stroke-scale allocation, while test-time stroke optimization supplies the reconstruction capacity needed for high-fidelity refinement. We further propose a single-stroke audit mechanism that explicitly evaluates local stroke quality, preventing defective primitives from surviving optimization through layer-wise compensation. Compared with existing methods, our approach achieves coherent layouts, improves PSNR by up to 5.46 dB, yields a 16% more compact representation, and accelerates combined renderer forward and backward computation by a factor of 220.3.

</details>


### [99] [Permute-then-Adapt: Weak-to-Strong Contrastive Image-Text Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10714)
*Jinhao Li,Sarah Erfani,Lei Feng,Guangrui Li,James Bailey,Feng Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了Permute-then-Adapt (PTA)框架，通过使用弱模型估计随机配对的参考分布，并选择其上尾作为辅助正样本，从而减轻了图像-文本对齐模型在对比学习中的误判问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的图像-文本对齐模型，如CLIP，通常使用对比学习以相反样本作为严格负例进行训练。然而这种二分假设导致了去噪问题，现有一些解决方案依赖于没有统计依据的手法阈值，导致噪声处理不当。

Method: PTA框架通过利用高效的弱模型识别未识别的正样本，同时控制一类错误，相比条件排列参考，使用随机配对的上尾来选择辅助正样本。

Result: 实验表明，PTA在目标识别、跨模态检索以及数据效率方面优于基于启发式的软标签方法。

Conclusion: PTA框架可有效提高图像-文本对齐模型在对比学习中的性能。

Abstract: Image-text alignment models such as CLIP are typically trained with contrastive learning, where unpaired examples are treated as strict negatives. While this assumption introduces noise by penalising semantically related pairs, existing solutions often rely on heuristic similarity thresholds that lack statistical grounding and sensitivity to dataset-specific noise distributions. In this paper, we propose Permute-then-Adapt (PTA), a framework that leverages efficient weak models to identify missed positives while controlling Type-I error relative to a conditional permutation reference, up to calibration approximation error. Unlike standard distillation or arbitrary thresholding, PTA estimates a random-pairing reference distribution from the weak teacher's similarity scores and uses its upper tail, determined by $α$, to select auxiliary positives. The calibrated positive set is then trained against by a single multi-positive contrastive objective: each anchor maximises the total probability mass it assigns to its positive set. Offline calibration with the weak model adds negligible training overhead. Experiments show gains over heuristic soft-label approaches in object recognition, cross-modal retrieval, and data efficiency. Project repository: https://github.com/JinhaoLee/Permute-then-Adapt.

</details>


### [100] [Disentangled Stylized Image Generation via IP-Cross-Attention Rearrangement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10717)
*Beibei Dong,Yueming Lyu,Yue Jiang,Jing Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于IP-cross-attention重排的方法，实现解耦的风格化图像生成，并引入了负内容指导以减少风格化图像生成中的内容泄露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了提升基于扩散模型的风格化图像生成的质量和效率，解决现有方法中存在的迭代生成成本高、风格与内容解耦困难以及通过文本提示捕获风格效率低下等问题。

Method: 通过引入IP-cross-注意力重塑机制实现风格与内容的解耦；借鉴无分类引导思想，提出负内容指导机制以降低风格化图像生成中的内容泄露问题。

Result: 该方法提升了风格化图像的质量和生成效率，有效降低了内容泄露现象。

Conclusion: 该工作的贡献在于提出了有效的解耦风格化图像生成方法，并通过实验证明了其实效性。

Abstract: With a solid theoretical foundation and pretraining on large-scale datasets, diffusion-based methods have achieved controllable generation leveraging text and image conditions, and generating excellent stylized images is possible using diffusion models. However, previous methods face significant challenges. First, because diffusion generation is iterative, the common approach of learning implicit style representations via cycle-consistency strategies is too costly and not well-suited to diffusion, even for LoRA-based methods. Second, decoupling style is difficult in the latent space of diffusion models. Representations of attributes are coupled in the latent space of diffusion models; thus, extracting style attributes with diffusion models usually suffers from the issue of content leakage. Furthermore, because style is hard to represent in natural language, capturing style using text prompts or textual inversion is deficient. In this paper, we propose a method for achieving disentangled stylized image generation through IP-cross-attention rearrangement, based on our experimental observations. We also propose negative content guidance, inspired by classifier-free guidance, to reduce content leakage in stylized image generation.

</details>


### [101] [Locating and Repairing Domain Shift in VLM Trajectory Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10720)
*Zhihong Cui,Hengyu Liu,Michael Alexander Riegler,Guandong Xu,Amir Taherkordi,Tor Skeie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了MoLaRx框架，针对VLM跨城市域移针对模态和层两个维度进行了定位修复，展示了其在多个VLM和基准上的优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法统一处理域移，未能充分考虑模态和层之间的差异，该研究挑战了这一观点，并提出了一种结构化定位修复的方法。

Method: 首先通过激活补丁分析域移，揭示了模态轴和层轴上的规律。随后，基于这些发现，提出了一种CIS-Guided Selective Repair机制，它使用因果重要性得分将层划分为功能区，并针对这些区域应用匹配操作来修复。

Result: MoLaRx在三个不同架构的VLM和两个跨城市基准测试中表现出色，实现了最低的跨城市轨迹误差差距，同时减少训练参数和降低推理延迟。

Conclusion: 结构化定位修复方法在处理VLM的域移问题上优于统一目标方法。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly adopted as end-to-end driving planners, yet they suffer from cross-city domain shift. Existing methods treat this shift as a single quantity addressed by uniform alignment or single-site editing. We challenge this view on two counts: (i) domain shift in VLM trajectory planners is inherently structured across modality and layer, and (ii) a locate-then-repair recipe matched to this structure outperforms every uniform-objective baseline. We analyse domain shift via activation patching and uncover two regularities. (F1) Modality axis. Image and text tokens exhibit distinct shift patterns in each VLM. (F2) Layer axis. The layer-wise shift partition is architecture-dependent and dataset-stable. These findings recast domain shift as a two-dimensional tensor indexed by modality (image vs. text tokens) and layer, motivating a simple principle: locate where shift occurs, and repair only there. We instantiate this principle in MoLaRx (Modality-Layer Repair), a locate-then-repair framework. The Causal Importance Score (CIS) estimates the domain shift as a modality-layer tensor and partitions the layers into functional zones. CIS-Guided Selective Repair (CISR) then applies a matched operator (Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) / low-rank adaptation (LoRA) / freezing) to repair each zone, with the composition adapting automatically to each architecture. We evaluate MoLaRx on three architecturally distinct VLMs (LFM2-VL-1.6B, Qwen2-VL-2B, and PaliGemma2-3B) across two cross-city benchmarks (nuScenes and Argoverse 2). MoLaRx attains the lowest cross-city trajectory-error gap among adaptation methods in all six main-table settings, while using 50-60% fewer trainable parameters and 8.4-10.9 ms lower inference latency. In contrast, uniform MMD-only adaptation collapses in all six settings, highlighting the importance of structure-guided repair.

</details>


### [102] [3D Segmentation in the Clinic: A Grand Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10728)
*Bram van Ginneken,Tobias Heimann,Martin Styner*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了在2007年医学图像计算与辅助介入会议上的分割竞赛，竞赛涵盖了从CT扫描自动/半自动分割肝脏和从脑MRI数据分割壳状核的任务，详细描述了竞赛的数据集和评估标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织分割竞赛的目的是提高自动和半自动分割医学图像的能力，特别是在肝脏和壳状核的分割上，以促进医学图像处理技术的发展。

Method: 比赛围绕两个分割任务展开，分别是肝脏从CT图像和壳状核从脑MRI图像的自动和半自动分割。竞赛提供了训练集和测试集，并使用特定的评分系统来进行分割效果的评估。

Result: 未在摘要中直接提及具体结果，但强调了比赛的设计和评估标准的建立为相关领域的技术进步奠定了基础。

Conclusion: 本文总结了分割竞赛的设计和实施过程，以及它在促进医学图像处理领域技术发展方面的作用和重要意义。

Abstract: This paper describes the set-up of a segmentation competition for automatic and semi-automatic extraction of the liver from computed tomography scans and the caudate nucleus from brain MRI data. This competition was held in the form of a workshop at the 2007 Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention conference. The rationale for organizing the competition is discussed, the training and test data sets for both segmentation tasks are described and the scoring system used to evaluate the segmentation is presented.

</details>


### [103] [LIFT: Local Metric Alignment and Foundation-guided Propagation for Few-shot Depth Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10729)
*Xiang Li,Xiaojin Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LIFT框架利用预训练的单目深度估计模型的深度和特征先验，实现了Sparse to Dense的深度补全，通过多尺度深度传播和特征引导逐步细化初始化，达到了业内领先的few-shot深度补全效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了在少量标注的情况下，以较低的注释成本获得密集的度量深度，特别在目标领域利用少量标注数据，提出LIFT框架。

Method: LIFT框架首先在粗网格上估计局部尺度和位移参数，然后进行平滑插值，形成空间自适应的度量深度初始化。接下来，通过多尺度深度传播和预训练模型特征引导，逐步细化初始化结果。最后，轻量级的残差解码器结合多尺度预训练特征与传播校正，进一步优化度量深度。

Result: 实验结果显示，LIFT方法在NYUv2和KITTI-DC数据集上实现了业内领先的few-shot深度补全性能。

Conclusion: LIFT框架通过共享预训练模型的先验知识来优化未见数据的深度补全，展示了强大的few-shot学习能力。

Abstract: Few-shot depth completion aims to recover dense metric depth from sparse measurements using only a small number of target-domain annotations, offering a favorable balance between annotation cost and model adaptation. We propose LIFT, a framework that harnesses both depth and feature priors from a frozen pretrained monocular depth estimation (MDE) foundation model for few-shot depth completion. Specifically, LIFT first estimates local scale and shift parameters on a coarse grid and interpolates them into smooth, dense parameter fields, providing a spatially adaptive metric depth initialization. It then progressively refines this initialization through multi-scale depth propagation guided by foundation features. Finally, a lightweight residual decoder combines multi-level foundation features with propagation correction to refine the metric depth. Extensive experiments on NYUv2 and KITTI-DC demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art few-shot performance. The source code will soon be released.

</details>


### [104] [Tiny Evidence Region Localization with Selective Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10734)
*Yujuan Pang,Wenhao Xu,Yinglei Teng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPN-OPSD 提出了既考虑证据区域也考虑背景区域的选择性正负面现场自蒸馏方法，显著提高了模型在细粒度视觉任务中的干扰抵抗能力和对证据区域的关注度，从而在多个基准测试上获得了显著的准确性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在细粒度视觉任务中主要依赖于与证据相关的区域进行训练，忽视了广泛背景区域的影响，导致模型对于无关干扰的抵抗能力有限。

Method: SPN-OPSD 使用来自两个视角的监督，包括考虑到证据和背景区域，同时进行选择性令牌级蒸馏，提供更具信息量的监督，以提高模型对证据区域的关注。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-2B 模型上，SPN-OPSD 提高了 V* 鉴别基准、ZoomBench 和 MME-RealWorld-Lite 的准确率，分别从 76.44%、45.92% 和 57.43% 提高到 84.82%、54.56% 和 59.56%。类似增益也在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 也观察到了。

Conclusion: SPN-OPSD 方法通过双重监督和选择性蒸馏机制提高了模型在细粒度视觉任务中的表现。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models have made progress in general visual tasks. However, limitations remain in fine-grained visual tasks requiring evidence from minute image regions. Existing methods primarily train models using evidence-related regions while overlooking the influence of extensive background regions, resulting in a limited ability to resist interference from irrelevant regions. We propose selective positive-negative on-policy self-distillation (SPN-OPSD), which considers both evidence and background regions. Supervision from both views improves the model's ability to resist interference from irrelevant regions. Furthermore, selective token-level distillation provides more informative supervision, improving the model's ability to attend to evidence regions in Fine-Grained Visual Tasks. On Qwen3.5-2B, SPN-OPSD improves accuracy on V* Bench, ZoomBench, and MME-RealWorld-Lite from 76.44%, 45.92%, and 57.43% to 84.82%, 54.56%, and 59.56%, respectively. Similar gains are also observed on Qwen3.5-0.8B.

</details>


### [105] [Writer-independent handedness identification from offline Bangla handwriting under controlled acquisition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10744)
*Tanzim Hasan Prappo,Sayeed Hassan,Sayem Ali,Sukhendra Nath Dhar,M. Shahidur Rahman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究使用BanglaHand数据集评估了通过离线孟加拉手写识别左右手的能力，尽管存在光照变化等因素影响，但仍能够取得一定的识别准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于报告的手写字迹识别准确率往往忽略了书写者、文本内容和图像获取条件之间的区别，该研究旨在通过控制收集和摄影条件来评估离线孟加拉手写左右手识别的可能性，以检测这种软生物特征是否可以有效应用于孟加拉语书写。

Method: 研究使用了一个包含42名书写者（21名左撇子和21名右撇子）的手写数据集，每位书写者在规定条件下书写六个共同的提示语和两篇自选文本。研究通过使用不同的方法（如使用带有图像梯度描边的手写体识别方法），并进行了全书写者随机置换测试以及光照控制措施，来评估和识别左右手的可能性。

Result: 研究结果表明，通过使用图像梯度描边的方法能够对未知书写者进行左右手识别，准确率为77.4%（95%书写者置信区间67.7-86.5%），这一数字高于使用冻结的ImageNet嵌入方法的结果（69.5-72.0%）。进一步分析还发现，右撇子书写者的笔迹更靠近笔尖处，这可能是由于更高的书写压力而产生的，并且即使排除了墨水密度和亮度的影响，该识别方法仍然有效，达到了64.5%的准确率。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，通过控制采集和图像获取条件，离线孟加拉手写左右手是可以被识别出来的，而光照控制对于理解和解释这些生物特征信号是至关重要的。

Abstract: Handedness is a soft-biometric cue for forensic document examination and writer profiling, yet reported accuracies from offline handwriting rarely keep writers, texts and image acquisition apart, so models may recognise the writer or capture conditions rather than the writing hand. Such controlled evidence is missing for Bangla. Using our BanglaHand dataset of 42 writers (21 left- and 21 right-handed), who each wrote six shared prompts and two own texts under controlled collection and photography, we evaluate handedness identification with all images of each test writer held out, whole-writer permutation tests and photometric controls. An ink-gradient descriptor identified the handedness of unseen writers with 77.4% balanced accuracy (95% writer-bootstrap interval 67.7-86.5%; p=0.001) and frozen ImageNet embeddings with 69.5-72.0%. Part of this signal is stroke darkness: in a post hoc analysis, right-handed writers' strokes were darker at their centres for equal stroke width, consistent with higher pen pressure and not explained by lighting drift. With ink density and brightness regressed out, the descriptor still reached 64.5% (p=0.027), whereas writing-only shape features were weaker (60.8%; p=0.090). Handedness is thus identifiable from offline Bangla handwriting under controlled acquisition, and photometric controls are essential to interpret such cues.

</details>


### [106] [RoadState: A Domain-Prior-Enhanced Vision-Language System for Industrial-Grade Lane-Level Map Updating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10746)
*Deguo Xia,Zihan Li,Jiaqi Wang,Dong Xie,Xiyan Liu,Liuhui Zhang,Jizhou Huang,Mengmeng Yang,Diange Yang,Chen Zhu,Liwei Qian,Xin Pei,Shuanglong Li,Hanmeng Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RoadState 是百度地图更新流程中部署的视觉语言系统，其核心模型 RoadState-VLM 能够在复杂场景下准确理解道路状况并提高推理准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车道级地图更新需要保持时间一致性和物理可行性，以及能够处理视线变化、模糊的车道标记和临时障碍物等问题。为此，研究提出了一种增强推理能力的视觉语言模型 RoadState 车道级地图更新系统。

Method: RoadState-VLM 将道路场景理解视为自回归状态估计，通过先前观察和符号状态与当前观察的结合进行预测。此外，还引入了几何链式思考（Geo-CoT），利用语义依赖性的有向无环图作为领域先验，以改善跨依赖维度的语义一致性和推理准确性。

Result: 在实际数据集上的广泛实验表明，RoadState-VLM 在六个车道级道路状态下实现了 94.33% 的平均准确率，优于最佳微调视觉语言模型基线。消融研究进一步证明了几何链式思考和时间过渡上下文的互补效果。此外，该系统还支持了超过 360 个城市中的车道级地图更新，并降低了生产成本。

Conclusion: 该系统通过增强推理能力、结构化状态接口、选择性路由以及人工质量控制，改善了视觉语言模型的道路场景理解在大型车道级地图更新任务中的适用性。

Abstract: Lane-level map updating requires temporally consistent, physically valid, and auditable road-scene semantics despite occlusions, ambiguous lane markings, temporary obstacles, and viewpoint changes. We present RoadState, a production-deployed vision-language system that transforms sequential road-scene observations into structured lane-level semantics for Baidu Maps' map-updating pipeline. Its core model, RoadState-VLM, formulates road-scene understanding as autoregressive state estimation, predicting the current structured road state from the previous observation and symbolic state together with the current observation. We introduce Geometric Chain-of-Thought (Geo-CoT), which uses a directed acyclic graph of semantic dependencies as a domain prior to improve semantic consistency and reasoning fidelity across interdependent road-state dimensions. Extensive experiments on a real-world dataset show that RoadState-VLM achieves 94.33% mean accuracy across six road-state dimensions, outperforming the strongest fine-tuned VLM baseline. Ablation studies further demonstrate the complementary effectiveness of Geo-CoT and temporal transition context. A cascaded routing pipeline directs routine cases to lightweight models while reserving complex cases for RoadState-VLM. Since its deployment in March 2025, RoadState has supported lane-level map updating across more than 360 cities and reduced overall production costs by 30%. Together with human-in-the-loop auditing, the system maintains robust performance under stress-test conditions. These results demonstrate how domain-prior-enhanced reasoning, structured state interfaces, selective routing, and human quality control can bridge the gap between VLM-based road-scene understanding and large-scale lane-level map updating.

</details>


### [107] [Unified Framework with Convex-Concave Decomposition and Sparse Topological Learning for Skeleton-Based Clinical Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10758)
*Quang-Anh N. D.,Duc Pham Minh,Minh-Anh Nguyen,Hien Quang Kha,Manh Hung Ha,Minhhuy Le,Oscal Tzyh-Chiang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种多流模型CC2-STG，结合了几何分解、稀疏特征学习和自适应拓扑，通过凸凹距离函数分解关节关系，捕获局部和全局运动特征，同时使用稀疏正则化和近端优化选择临床相关的几何特征，并通过多尺度拓扑分析捕捉病理性运动中的非解剖学关节依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对基于骨架的康复评估中存在的固定拓扑问题，统一关节处理忽略临床重要偏差及缺乏几何理解的问题，提出了一种新的方法CC2-STG以改进现有的评估方法。

Method: 该方法通过使用几何分解将关节关系分解为互补的凸凹距离函数，以捕捉局部和全局的运动特征。通过稀疏正则化和近端优化选择与临床相关的几何特征。多尺度拓扑分析用于捕捉病理运动中的非解剖学关节依赖。

Result: 在KiMoRe和UIPRMD数据集上的实验验证了该方法的有效性，能够实现临床病理运动评估的最佳性能。

Conclusion: CC2-STG在缓解基于骨架的康复评估中的固定拓扑局限性和促进临床病理运动评估方面取得了显著成果，为相关研究提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Skeleton-based rehabilitation assessment faces fundamental limitations of fixed topologies which cannot model compensatory patterns, uniform joint treatments overlook clinically important deviations, and lack of geometric understand- ing. We propose Concave-Convex Decomposition Sparse Topological Graph Convolutional Network (CC2-STG), a multi-stream model that combines geo- metric decomposition, sparse feature learning, and adaptive topology. Our framework decomposes joint relationships into complementary convex-concave distance functions to model both local and global movement characteristics, with sparse regularization with proximal optimization selecting clinically relevant geo- metric features, while multi-scale topological analysis captures non-anatomical joint dependencies in pathological movements. Experiments on the KiMoRe and UIPRMD datasets validate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving state-of-the-art performance on clinical pathological movement assessment.

</details>


### [108] [BAPLe++: Cross-Model Transferability and Prompt-Level Defense of Backdoors in Medical Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10764)
*Ufaq Khan,Umair Nawaz,Satyajit Tourani,Awais Rauf,Fahad Shamshad,Asif Hanif,Rao Muhammad Anwer,Muhammad Haris Khan,Mohammad Yaqub*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究了基于提示的后门在不同医疗基础模型之间的传输性，并提出了一种名为DePLe的防御方法，以提高模型的干净性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示学习在医疗基础模型中带来效率，但同时也暴露了后门攻击的风险。研究者旨在探索后门是否可以在不同的医疗基础模型之间传递，以及如何有效防御这些问题。

Method: 引入了Clean Accuracy Difference (CAD)和Backdoor Accuracy Difference (BAD)两个新指标来量化不同医疗基础模型间基于提示的后门传输性。还提出了DePLe方法，该方法利用受感染的提示作为固定锚点，并在干净的样本集上学习一个新提示，以保留其干净任务性能并偏离受损的特征区域。

Result: 实验表明，基于提示的后门可以在不同医疗基础模型之间传递，但传输效果具有不对称性，并且依赖于数据集。与四种无监督输入变换相比，DePLe方法在各实验情况下均能更一致地降低后门准确性，同时保持或提高干净任务的准确性。

Conclusion: 提示学习可能传递受感染的提示，但可通过DePLe方法减轻这种威胁。研究强调了解决医疗基础模型中后门攻击的必要性，并提供了评估和防御这些威胁的实际方法。

Abstract: Medical foundation models (Med-FMs) are increasingly adapted to clinical tasks through prompt learning, which tunes a small set of prompt tokens while the backbone remains frozen. Recent work has shown that this efficiency introduces a vulnerability: jointly optimizing learnable prompts and an imperceptible noise trigger during few-shot adaptation implants a backdoor that leaves clean performance intact but steers triggered inputs to an attacker-chosen class. Since prompts are compact and readily shared, this raises two questions: whether a backdoored prompt remains effective on a different Med-FM, and whether it can be repaired without retraining the backbone. We address both in BAPLe++. First, we present the first study of cross-model transferability of prompt-based backdoors, quantified by two proposed metrics, Clean Accuracy Difference (CAD) and Backdoor Accuracy Difference (BAD). Second, we propose DePLe (Defense via Prompt Learning), which uses the infected prompt as a fixed anchor and learns a new prompt on a small clean set that preserves the clean task while diverging from the compromised embedding region. Experiments on four Med-FMs and six chest X-ray and histopathology datasets show that backdoors transfer across models, but asymmetrically and in a dataset-dependent manner. Compared with four training-free input transformations, DePLe reduces backdoor accuracy more consistently while preserving, and in several settings improving, clean accuracy. Our code can be accessed on https://github.com/Ufaqkhan/Baple-Plus-Plus

</details>


### [109] [How reliable is an embedding of the seabed? Repeat-look measurement of frozen encoders on synthetic aperture sonar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10770)
*Harold Horsley,Oscar Pizarro,Hayat Rajani,Morten Omholt Alver*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究使用合成孔径声纳（SAS）调查，评估了预训练编码器在海底声纳图像中的重复观察可靠性。研究发现单次视角和探针的表现是稳定的，但整个嵌入的重复可靠性较差，表明对于需要特定区域身份的应用（如跨航次比较和检索），现有的度量标准未能检测到重复可靠性的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管现有的自监督表示学习预训练编码器在海底声纳图像中表现出色，但缺乏重复观测的可靠性评估方法，这可能影响对海底环境的理解和应用。

Method: 通过合成孔径声纳（SAS）调查，研究团队使用了一个冻结的自然图像编码器（DINOv3 ViT-S/16）来测量嵌入的重复观察可靠性。此外，研究还使用了BenthicDINO声纳编码器和传统的SAS纹理描述符进行对比实验。

Result: 标准单视角度量（有效秩、聚类和用于珊瑚的线性探针）是稳定的，而基于嵌入的整体重复可靠性较低。探针学习到一个稳定的向量方向，具有较好的重复可靠性，表明方向比整体嵌入更为鲁棒。通过广义可加性理论计算的方差成分显示，约10%的单元内散度归因于视角获取几何，其余则归因于单元固有特性。这表明，具有特定区域身份的应用任务在不同的视角下表现不佳，而针对栖息地类型的任务则可以正常工作。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，在海底声纳图像的情况下，任何嵌入表示的评估都应包括重复观测的可靠性检查，以确保在实际应用中的稳健性。

Abstract: Pretrained encoders from self-supervised representation learning are increasingly applied to sonar imagery of the seafloor, where they are evaluated with protocols that take one embedding per target. A target patch of seabed, by contrast, is re-imaged from an alternate look on overlapping survey passes, so each embedding is one measurement of that target. Standard protocols cannot say how consistent those measurements are, or how much of their spread belongs to the patch and how much to the acquisition geometry. We treat this as a measurement-reliability problem. Using a synthetic-aperture sonar (SAS) survey, we measure the repeat-look reliability of embeddings from a frozen natural-image encoder (DINOv3 ViT-S/16). Standard single-look metrics, effective rank, clustering and a linear probe for coral, are all stable to the look, and the probe performs well (AUC 0.93). Yet the repeat-look reliability of the same embeddings is poor, with a distance-based intraclass correlation (dbICC) of 0.20 and nearest neighbours and clusters that barely agree across looks. This contradiction resolves as we find the probe learns a stable direction, whose ICC of 0.60 is 3.0 times that of the full embedding. Variance components, calculated from generalizability theory, attribute under a tenth of the within-cell spread to look acquisition geometry. The rest is cell-specific and cannot be separated without repeat passes at matched geometry. A sonar-pretrained encoder (BenthicDINO) and a classical SAS texture descriptor show the same pattern. For this dataset and the tested representations, uses that depend on patch identity fail, such as cross-pass comparison and retrieval, while uses at the level of habitat type (e.g. coral classification) do not. Because the standard metrics did not detect this, we argue that repeat-look reliability should accompany any evaluation of representations of the seafloor.

</details>


### [110] [WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10771)
*Juanxi Tian,Jiadong Hou,Baiang Li,Xin Lin,Zhengbo Jiao,Weijia Zhang,Yeying Jin,Truong Nguyen,Haitian Zheng,Zhifei Zhang,Jianfei Yang,Ming-Hsuan Yang,Felix Heide,Wei Xiong,Enze Xie,Wanhua Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WorldFoundry 提供了一种新的生成世界模型，并定义了理想的世界模型的核心能力，同时开发了一个开源框架来支持这些系统的研究和评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的视觉生成模型更多关注于生成看似真实的观察，但并不足以构建良好的世界模型，因此需要更全面的框架来指导世界建模研究。

Method: 作者制定了一个包含感知定位、持久状态建模、可控变换、动力学预测和闭环互动五个方面的智能框架，并且开发了WorldFoundry开源平台来支持这些研究和评估。

Result: WorldFoundry 提供了集模型和基准发现、运行时和资产准备、执行编排、制品管理和交互可视化于一体的基础设施，并支持多模态适应器保持原始输入和执行语义。

Conclusion: 该开源平台促进了在不同系统之间比较持久且可控的动力学的能力，推动了从感知生成向可衡量的全球智能的进步。

Abstract: Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions. We define a generative world model as a predictive dynamical system that maintains a persistent, history-conditioned representation of an environment, updates that representation in response to actions or interventions, and generates temporally coherent trajectories that reflect outcomes under observed and counterfactual interventions. From this definition, we derive an intelligence-oriented framework spanning perceptual grounding, persistent state modeling, controllable transformation, dynamics-aware prediction, and closed-loop interaction. We present WorldFoundry, open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation across video, 3D and 4D, embodied action, and interactive world systems. WorldFoundry unifies model and benchmark discovery, runtime and asset preparation, execution orchestration, artifact management, and interactive visualization, while modality-specific adapters preserve native inputs, execution semantics, output representations, and evaluation protocols. Explicit manifests, durable artifact contracts, and evidence-aware scorecards separate execution readiness from evaluative claims, making each claim traceable to its supporting artifacts. The catalog contains 270 model entries, 74 benchmarks, and 62 registered metric entries, with readiness and execution evidence recorded separately. WorldFoundry enables reproducible comparison of persistent, controllable dynamics across heterogeneous systems, advancing the field from perceptual synthesis toward measurable world intelligence.

</details>


### [111] [Same Measurements, Different Velocity Risk: Complementary Rolling-Shutter Readouts under Clock Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10774)
*Lunshuo Tian,Dongheng Liu,Mingwei Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文探讨了在曝光时间不确定的情况下，具有相同测量预算的摄像机框架在滚动快门重建时的不同速度估计率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究了在曝光时间不确定的情况下，多摄像机系统中速度估计的性能差异。

Method: 分析了包含两个校准移动锚点、未知场景点和未知辅助姿态和时钟的滚动快门重建问题。通过理论分析区分了重复读取和互补读取的最坏情况速度风险，并提供了物理补偿路径和非线性速度反演以证明互补稳定性。

Result: 结果显示在固定物理类区域，重复读取的最坏情况速度平方风险至少是噪声标准偏差σ的σρeff次方级，而互补读取的最小最大风险是σ^2的次方级，其中ρeff 表示可接受的时钟偏移。物理补偿路径给出了下界，而非线性速度反演证明了互补稳定性。

Conclusion: 研究识别了可以实现两种设计正常化的安装配置，并量化了由于度量不确定性引起的风险下界。此外，研究了独立6毫秒时钟的完整参数域下的配对噪声和深度偏移干预下的重建情况，并进行了光栅研究以检查图像形成和校准灵敏度。

Abstract: Camera rigs with identical measurement budgets can have different velocity estimation rates when exposure timing is uncertain. We establish this distinction for rolling-shutter reconstruction with two calibrated moving anchors, unknown scene points, and independently unknown auxiliary poses and clocks. On the same fixed local physical class near a separated lateral rig, repeated readouts have worst-case squared velocity risk at least of order $σρ_{\mathrm{eff}}$, whereas complementary readouts have minimax risk of order $σ^2$, for a fixed admissible clock displacement $ρ_{\mathrm{eff}}>0$ as the noise standard deviation $σ$ tends to zero. A finite physical compensation path gives the lower bound; a nonlinear velocity inverse proves complementary stability. All motion, structure, pose, and clock nuisances remain unknown. We identify mounting configurations in which both designs become regular and quantify the risk floor induced by metric uncertainty. We quantify full-parameter domains with independent 6-ms clocks and test in-domain reconstruction under paired noise and a depth-offset intervention. Raster studies examine image formation and calibration sensitivity.

</details>


### [112] [STAR-VF: Spatio-Temporal Aware Representation Condensation for Data-Efficient Video Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10811)
*Yuchen Xian,Yunqiu Xu,Guosheng Lin,Yang He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为STAR-VF的新框架，以实现高效的数据视频融合。通过从dataset condensation的角度重新思考视频融合，STAR-VF将原始训练集凝缩成一组可学习的时空表示，这些表示随后被解码为合成视频片段，并通过由冻结的代理模型提供的特征级监督进行优化。STAR-VF还配备了无流的帧间时空建模和查询驱动的帧内聚合，以实现直接的时空交互和在表示空间中的融合相关信息的自适应选择。实验结果表明，使用原始数据集的约1/16，STAR-VF在多种视频融合基准上的融合质量与使用完整数据集训练的方法相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视频融合方法依赖于大规模、高质量的数据集，这会带来存储和计算上的高成本。为了减轻这个问题，作者提出了一个新的框架，STAR-VF，该框架通过数据凝缩可以更高效地执行视频融合。

Method: STAR-VF框架从数据凝缩的角度出发，将原始的训练集凝缩成少量可学习的时空表示，并通过特征级监督进行优化。通过这种方式，它能够在较少数据集的情况下保持融合所需的空间和时间线索。此外，该框架还包括帧间无流时空建模和查询驱动的帧内聚合，以增强融合过程中的直接时空交互和相关信息的自适应选择。

Result: 通过在多种视频融合基准上进行实验，证明STAR-VF使用原始数据集约1/16的量，其融合质量可与使用完整数据集训练的方法相媲美。

Conclusion: STAR-VF框架在促进视频融合过程中数据效率方面取得了显著进展，展示了在不同视频融合任务上使用其凝缩数据进行训练的有效性，并验证了其组件的有效性。

Abstract: Video fusion aims to integrate complementary cues from heterogeneous sources, producing visually informative videos with coherent spatio-temporal structures. Jointly learning cross-modal complementarity and temporal dependencies typically relies on large-scale, high-quality video datasets, whose storage and repeated use during optimization incur substantial costs, making data-efficient learning highly desirable. To address this challenge, we rethink video fusion from the perspective of dataset condensation and propose STAR-VF, the first framework that condenses spatio-temporal representations for data-efficient video fusion. STAR-VF condenses the original training set into a compact set of learnable spatio-temporal representations, which are decoded into synthetic video clips and optimized using feature-level supervision provided by a frozen proxy model. The resulting condensed data preserves fusion-relevant spatial and temporal cues without requiring ground-truth fused videos as supervision. To adapt fusion learning to condensed representations, we equip the final fusion model with flow-free inter-frame temporal modeling and query-driven intra-frame aggregation, enabling direct temporal interaction and adaptive selection of fusion-relevant information in representation space. Extensive experiments on infrared-visible, multi-exposure, multi-focus, and medical video fusion benchmarks demonstrate that STAR-VF, trained with only approximately 1/16 of the original temporal training set, achieves fusion quality comparable to methods trained on the full data. Further analyses validate the contributions of learned condensation and flow-free temporal modeling, and demonstrate the robustness of the condensed supervision across different proxy encoders and downstream fusion models. Project page: https://zju-xyc.github.io/STAR-VF-Project-Page/.

</details>


### [113] [AmodalBox: Automated 3D Bounding Box Annotation under Partial Visibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10821)
*In-Jae Lee,Namtae Kim,Robert Exley,Kwonyoung Ryu,Jaesik Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 文章提出了一种自动注释框架，利用图像生成的3D资产作为不完全观测对象的无边界几何先验，通过建立输入图像与3D资产渲染视图之间的对应关系，实现与部分观测世界空间点云的稳健对齐。该方法通过一次性生成实例资产、在单帧估计其度量尺度并在动态实例中跨帧传播，在静态实例中则聚合多帧观测，提高了3D物体检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于激光点云和图像联合的自动化开放词汇3D边界框注释方法在稀疏驾驶场景中受限于部分观测，导致生成的边界框定位不准确或物体未被注释。

Method: 文章提出了一种自动注释框架\textbf{\Ours{}}，使用图像生成的3D资产作为无界几何先验，通过图像-渲染视图配对对齐部分观测的世界空间点云，同时通过一次性生成资产、单帧估计度量尺度并跨帧传播，以及多帧观测聚合来提高时空一致性并减少计算开销。

Result: 在nuScenes数据集上，基于\Ours{}注释的3D物体检测器相比强壮基线提高了14.1 mAP；在Waymo开放数据集中，对于车辆类别，3D物体检测器的性能在IoU 0.5时相较于基线提高了12.45 AP。

Conclusion: 该方法通过引入图像生成的3D资产作为几何先验，成功解决了部分观测挑战，显著提高了3D物体检测的性能和准确性。

Abstract: Recent progress in vision foundation models (VFMs) has made automated open-vocabulary 3D bounding box annotation increasingly feasible by jointly leveraging LiDAR point clouds and images. However, partial observations remain a major challenge in sparse driving scenes, where visible LiDAR points often cover only a small fraction of the object's surface and provide insufficient cues for estimating its full spatial extent. As a result, existing methods often produce mislocalized boxes or leave objects unlabeled. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{\Ours{}}, an automated annotation framework that leverages image-generated 3D assets as amodal geometric priors for partially observed objects. By establishing correspondences between input images and rendered views of 3D assets, \Ours{} robustly aligns canonical amodal geometry with partially observed world-space LiDAR point clouds. To improve temporal consistency and reduce computational cost, \Ours{} generates a single asset per instance, estimates its metric scale once at a single frame and propagates it across frames for dynamic instances, and aggregates multi-frame observations for static instances. 3D object detectors trained on annotations from \Ours{} improve performance over strong baselines by 14.1 mAP on the nuScenes dataset and by 12.45 AP at IoU 0.5 for the vehicle class on the Waymo Open Dataset (WOD). Our project page is available at: \href{https://oliver0922.github.io/AmodalBox/}{https://oliver0922.github.io/AmodalBox/}

</details>


### [114] [Fine-resolution land-use segmentation and synthetic image-label augmentation in the Kathmandu Valley](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10847)
*Pranil Parajuli,Sugam Dahal,Kiran Chandra Dahal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究构建了一个涵盖加德满都谷地202平方公里、包含408个高分辨率RGB场景的六类土地利用手注语料库，面对高RGB光谱相似度、类别极度不平衡和关键结构特征小等问题，采用严格序列块分割的方法评估了五种现有架构，并进一步修改了SegFormer模型，实现了对稀有薄结构类别的性能提升，但增加了合成数据的使用反而损害了模型的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的土地利用分割架构主要依赖多光谱图像和计划布局来获取城市数据，但在全球迅速城市化的南方城市中，这些数据存在明显缺失。为解决这一问题，该研究搜集了一个涵盖加德满都谷地大规模区域的六类土地利用语料库，并发现了在数据分割、架构选择和模型改进方法等方面面临的挑战。

Method: 研究团队采用了严格序列块分割法评估了若干现有土地利用分割架构，并根据模型表现对SegFormer进行了改进，包括添加了一半分辨率的细节路径、边界可靠性重权、拓扑有意识损失和存在平衡采样器等。

Result: 改进后的模型在各个实验折中的平均IoU均有所提升，特别是对稀有和薄结构类别有明显改进，并且在外部LoveDA基准测试中与原模型得到了相同的结果。同时，研究指出合成数据的盲目集成可能严重损害性能，需谨慎评估和筛选生成样本。

Conclusion: 该研究构建了一个对现有框架极具挑战性的数据集，并深入探讨了模型改进的空间，但同时也指出在实际应用中集成合成数据时需要谨慎选择和评估。

Abstract: Parcel-scale land-use data is missing for most rapidly urbanizing Global South cities, as current segmentation architectures rely on multispectral imagery and planned layouts. We introduce a hand-annotated six-class land-use corpus covering 202 km$^2$ of Kathmandu Valley across 408 fine-resolution RGB scenes. The dataset is uniquely challenging: RGB spectral similarity is high, class imbalance approaches 100:1, and key structural features like rivers measure just two to three pixels wide at a standard hierarchical decoder's prediction stride. Evaluating five architectures reveals that standard random data splitting conceals massive spatial leakage. Switching to a strict sequence-block split drops performance by up to 0.095 mIoU. This penalty exceeds the performance gap between the architectures themselves. We modified the SegFormer baseline by integrating a half-resolution residual detail path, boundary-reliability reweighting, a topology-aware loss, and a presence-balanced sampler. Adding only 1.9% more parameters, the enhanced architecture improves mean IoU across every test fold, with gains concentrated in rare, thin-structure classes. However, both models achieve identical results on the external LoveDA benchmark. Finally, augmenting with diffusion-generated pairs at matched compute degraded accuracy across all architectures, especially harming rare classes it aimed to improve. This demonstrates that blindly incorporating synthetic data can severely damage performance, highlighting a critical need to rigorously evaluate and filter generated samples before training.

</details>


### [115] [Beyond Bit Matching: Orthogonal Watermarks for Collusion-Resistant Image Fingerprinting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10858)
*Zhakshylyk Nurlanov,Tobias Weißberg,Florian Bernard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VectorMark 通过将用户密钥映射到近正交的高维单位向量并使用余弦相似度来识别合谋者，具有在理想条件下保持按根号K缩放的余弦信号以识别所有合谋者的能力，同时对无关密钥的处理结果呈现出零中心的特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 致力于解决图像指纹技术中因平均合谋攻击导致的离散位字符串水印特别脆弱的问题，VectorMark 通过引入用户密钥映射到近正交的高维单位向量的方法，旨在提供一种更稳健的水印方案。

Method: VectorMark 通过神经网络实现水印的编码和提取，采用基于 JND 的掩蔽以及逐步学习课程，增强了对光照、几何变形和合谋攻击的鲁棒性。

Result: 实验结果表明，VectorMark 在保持高视觉质量的同时，能够稳健地抵抗光照和几何变形的干扰，并且在测试的评估方法中，实现了对所有合谋者的最佳检测。

Conclusion: 综合实验结果，VectorMark 提出了一种有效的方法，能够在多种条件下实现对水印的稳健识别，并且其代码已公开，展示其实用性和透明性。

Abstract: Image fingerprinting assigns each distributed copy a user-specific watermark for source tracing. Averaging collusion is a central threat: several recipients can average their differently marked copies to suppress each individual mark. Discrete bit-string watermarks are especially vulnerable because averaging drives bit evidence toward ambiguous decisions. We introduce \textbf{VectorMark}, which maps user keys to near-orthogonal high-dimensional unit vectors and identifies colluders by cosine similarity to the extracted watermark direction. Under ideal averaging of $K$ vector keys, the normalized average preserves a cosine signal of order $1/\sqrt{K}$ for each colluder, while unrelated keys remain concentrated near zero. The spherical geometry of random directions gives a shifted-Beta null distribution for cosine similarities, enabling analytic per-key false-positive-rate control after validation on unwatermarked images. VectorMark uses a neural watermark encoder and centered extractor trained with JND masking and a progressive curriculum for photometric, geometric, and collusion robustness. Experiments on MS-COCO, OpenImages, and AI-generated images show that VectorMark maintains robust watermark attribution under photometric and geometric distortions, and achieves the best strict all-colluder detection among evaluated methods, while preserving high visual quality. Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/nurlanov-zh/VectorMark

</details>


### [116] [Interactive Person Retrieval with On-the-Fly Visual Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10869)
*Lyucheng Qian,John Yuehan Zhang,Pingyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一个新颖的互动人物检索框架VFI-ReID，并通过视觉反馈增强检索过程，该框架在交互过程中能够根据实时证据调整检索和提问策略，从而提高了人物检索的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的互动人物检索方法主要通过离线学习问题顺序，忽视了可视反馈循环。因此，需要一个能利用视觉反馈来优化检索过程的新框架。

Method: VFI-ReID框架采用了一种动态积累证据检索者（DAR）和检索感知问题优化技术，能够根据逐步积累的证据调整检索策略和提问内容。

Result: 实验结果显示，VFI-ReID在不同交互阶段都能提升人物检索性能，证明了视觉反馈对互动人物检索的有效性。

Conclusion: VFI-ReID框架展示了利用视觉反馈提高互动人物检索性能的可行性，并优于现有的互动人物检索基线。

Abstract: Traditional text-based person retrieval (TPR) assumes that a witness provides a complete description at once, whereas interactive person retrieval (Inter-PR) refines a partial description through question-answer exchanges. In this setting, the questioner inspects retrieved candidates to decide what evidence to request next, while the answerer sees only the witness-side memory and cannot report candidate-specific visual differences. Existing methods mainly learn offline question orderings, leaving this visual-feedback loop underexplored. To address this limitation, we introduce visual-feedback interactive person retrieval (VFI-PR), a new interactive retrieval paradigm in which retrieved candidates produce visual feedback that becomes evidence for subsequent questioning and re-ranking. To support training and evaluation in this setting, we construct VFI-PEDES, a dataset and evaluation protocol for visual-feedback interaction, and propose VFI-ReID, a framework that learns to use visual feedback during interactive person retrieval. Through the Dynamic Accumulated-evidence Retriever (DAR) and retrieval-aware question optimization, VFI-ReID adapts retrieval and question generation to evolving evidence states, turning visual feedback into complementary evidence for subsequent retrieval. Experiments show that VFI-ReID consistently improves retrieval across VFI-PR interaction stages, demonstrating the utility of visual feedback for interactive person retrieval and outperforming existing Inter-PR baselines.

</details>


### [117] [REDiff-AD: No Training and No Target Masks for Industrial Anomaly Image Generation via Diversity-Driven In-Context MMDiT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10875)
*Chih-Yu Tsai,Chih-Heng Chang,Jian-Jiun Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: REDiff-AD 提出了一种无需模型训练和目标掩码且能够高效生成真实且多样的工业缺陷的框架，通过在上下文学习中转移缺陷外观，并利用内部注意力信号进行缺陷定位以生成像素级伪掩码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业领域中的真实异常样本稀缺且多样，现有的异常生成方法往往需要针对特定产品进行微调、目标掩码标注或成本高昂的流程，REDiff-AD 模型旨在解决这一问题。

Method: REDiff-AD 引入了 Rectified Flow MMDiT，用于在较少生成步骤的情况下高效采样。通过在一个正常产品图像和单个掩码参照异常上使用上下文学习，将缺陷外观转移到正常图像中。生成过程中产生的内部注意力信号进一步用于精确定位合成的异常。此外，还提出了两个轻量级模块：适应性参考条件增强缺陷保真度，多样性引导促进多样缺陷模式，无需额外训练。

Result: 实验表明，REDiff-AD 能够在异常模式生成中实现真实性和多样性的良好权衡，并且在异常分类、检测和定位方面取得了竞争力的表现。该模型适用于大规模异常数据扩充和像素级数据构建。

Conclusion: REDiff-AD 是一个简单、高效且有效的解决方案，不仅无需微调和目标掩码标注，而且能够生成真实且多样的异常样本，适用于工业领域的异常检测和数据扩充应用场景。

Abstract: Industrial anomaly detection is challenged by the scarcity and diversity of real defects, leaving insufficient anomalous data to effectively train downstream models. Existing anomaly generation methods often require product-specific fine-tuning, target mask annotation, or costly procedures to achieve realistic and diverse defects. We propose REDiff-AD, a framework that requires neither model training nor target masks and introduces Rectified Flow MMDiT into industrial anomaly generation for efficient sampling with fewer generation steps. Given a normal product image and a single masked reference anomaly, REDiff-AD employs in-context learning to transfer the defect appearance from the reference into the normal image. Internal attention signals generated during this process are further reused to localize the synthesized anomaly, while edge and color cues refine the localization into pixel-level pseudo-masks. Two lightweight modules further improve generation quality: adaptive reference conditioning enhances defect fidelity, while diversity guidance promotes varied defect patterns without additional training. Experiments demonstrate that REDiff-AD can well address the tradeoff between realism and diversity for anomaly pattern generation and achieve competitive downstream anomaly classification, detection, and localization performance. These results show that REDiff-AD is a simple, efficient, and effective solution for large-scale anomaly data augmentation and pixel-level data construction. Github code: https://github.com/efdefe4-droid/REDiff-AD

</details>


### [118] [Beyond Real or Fake: A Dual-Channel Authenticity and Reasoning Protocol for Photographic Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10908)
*Xiaoxiao Li,Ruinan Jin,Lili Meng,Miaosen Wang,Athula Balachandran,Pei Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 2CAP 提出了一种新颖的两通道框架来区分真实与合成图像，利用对比训练的摄像头编码器和冻结的语义编码器生成图像的通道级对齐分数和斑点级显著性图，从而增强解释的质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的图像验证方法通常采用二元的‘真实 vs. 伪造’标签，混淆了全合成、篡改和AI修饰图像的不同影响。因此，需要一种方法能够区分不同类型的图像操纵以减少歧义。

Method: 2CAP 通过对比训练的摄像头编码器和冻结的语义编码器来进行图像真实性的分类和证据生成，其中图像的真实性和篡改特征分别是通过两通道的对齐分数来评估的。

Result: 2CAP 在多源基准测试中实现了最佳分类性能，包括现有的方法在篡改检测方面的失败之地表现良好，并提高了解释的质量。

Conclusion: 2CAP 通过引入两通道真实性协议，提供了一种有效区分真实和合成图像的方法，能够增强解释的准确性和可视化。

Abstract: Forensic verification has converged on a binary "real vs. fake" label that confates fully synthetic, tampered, and AI-retouched images despite their very different consequences. We argue that GenAI manipulations decompose along two complementary channels: a camera channel of sensor fingerprints (destroyed by neural processing), and a semantic channel of scene-level coherence (disrupted by content edits). Each manipulation type leaves a distinctive two-channel signature. We instantiate this taxonomy in 2CAP (2-Channel Authenticity Protocol), pairing a contrastively-trained camera encoder with a frozen semantic encoder to serve two applications on a shared backbone: (i) four-class authenticity classification via cross-attention fusion with learnable reliability weights; and (ii) evidence generation, where an authentic image serves as a reference for a query and the two encoders produce per-channel alignment scores together with a patch-level saliency map. These signals are supplied as privileged context to a frozen Vision-Language Model (VLM) through an Observe-Generate-Refine loop, yielding explanations with localization without forensic fine-tuning. On a multi-source benchmark, 2CAP attains the best classification performance, including strong retouching detection where existing methods fail, and improves explanation quality.

</details>


### [119] [Remembering to Reason: Structured Memory for Scene and Workflow Understanding in Robot-Assisted Surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10917)
*Zhiran Zhang,Hu Wang,Yichen Wu,Yutong Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MemSurg 是一种能够记住手术观察的框架，通过结构化记忆图和适时检索支持手术视频理解，提高了手术视频理解性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的帧中心提示方法无法访问早期观察历史，不利于理解具有相似视角但反映不同手术动作或阶段的视图。MemSurg 引入了一种新的方法，通过结构化记忆图和线索关联链接，以及任务自适应检索，增强了手术视频的理解能力。

Method: MemSurg 框架包括一个结构化记忆图，该图存储了按时间戳分类的实体类别、位置、运动提示和交互总结。通过时间顺序链接保留了最近的上下文，并通过实体关联链接连接了程序中反复出现的观察，进而进行任务自适应检索，提供证据支持的提示，用于场景和工作流推理。

Result: MemSurg 在机器人辅助前列腺切除术以及两个互补的外科基准测试中显示了与 SurgRAW 和 GPT-4o 的性能提升。与其他模型相比，MemSurg 的评价结果显示了 10.43 个百分点的提升。

Conclusion: MemSurg 支持结构化记忆作为手术视频理解的可重用来源，结构化记忆图和任务自适应检索的技术为智能辅助外科手术提供了解决方案。

Abstract: Surgical video understanding is an important foundation for intelligent assistance in robot-assisted surgery. Similar surgical views can reflect different actions or procedural stages. Interpreting these views requires access to earlier observations, yet frame-centric prompting leaves this history unavailable. We introduce MemSurg, a framework that remembers surgical observations before reasoning over them. Its structured memory graph stores timestamped entity categories, locations, motion cues, and interaction summaries. Chronological links preserve recent context, while entity-associated links connect recurring observations across the procedure. Task-adaptive retrieval then supplies evidence-grounded prompts for scene and workflow reasoning, supporting both frozen inference and memory-conditioned supervised fine-tuning. Evaluation on robot-assisted prostatectomy and two complementary surgical benchmarks shows a 10.43-percentage-point gain over SurgRAW with GPT-4o. Memory conditioning adds 6.52 points under matched Qwen3-VL-8B fine-tuning, and an inference-time plug-in adds 7.04 points to EndoChat. These results support structured memory as a reusable source of procedural evidence for surgical video understanding. Our code will be publicly released.

</details>


### [120] [Semantic Synthesis over Brute-Force Search: LLM-Guided Transformation Design for Efficient Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10940)
*Usha Shrestha,Radu Timofte,Dmitry Ignatov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 利用大型语言模型合成可执行的数据转换程序，可以在预定义增强空间之外高效发现训练分布，优于暴力搜索方法，减少候选评估次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计数据转换管道是一个计算密集型问题，需要探索新型方法以提高效率。因此，研究是否可以用大型语言模型在统一训练协议下生成高效的转换程序。

Method: 研究了九种策略，包括标准数据增强策略、暴力搜索、直接代码生成以及基于性能导向的大型语言模型精细化生成。

Result: 使用大型语言模型生成的转换程序在每个数据集上都表现优异，CIFAR-10上达到了0.8877的准确率，CIFAR-100上为0.5825，SVHN上为0.9588。此外，生成步骤所需的候选评估次数减少了22倍，在现成生成器的情况下减少了600倍。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，使用代码大型语言模型进行语义合成提供了高效的数据转换发现的替代方案，同时强调了在优化数据变换时验证评估准确性的必要性。

Abstract: Data transformation pipelines shape the training distribution in computer vision, but designing them is a computationally expensive problem. We investigate whether large language models can enable efficient discovery by synthesizing executable transformation programs outside predefined augmentation spaces. We compare nine strategies under a unified training protocol, including standard augmentation policies, brute-force search, direct code generation with two LLMs, and performance-guided generation using LLMs fine-tuned on accuracy-ordered transformation pairs. When the best candidates are retrained for 20 epochs, LLM-generated transformation programs lead on every dataset, reaching 0.8877 accuracy on CIFAR-10, 0.5825 on CIFAR-100, and 0.9588 on SVHN, surpassing brute-force search over 6,000 candidates. The best transform on CIFAR-10 and SVHN comes from a fine-tuned generator using 270 candidates, while the best on CIFAR-100 comes from an off-the-shelf generator using only 10. This needs 22x fewer candidate evaluations in the generation step and 600x fewer for off-the-shelf generations, relative to brute-force search. Beyond transformation discovery, we analyze the reliability of the reduced-budget evaluation commonly used for augmentation search. Correlating one-epoch selection scores with 20-epoch outcomes reveals strong, weak, and absent predictive relationships depending on the dataset and architecture, with correlations ranging from 0.756 to near zero. A positive control indicates that range restriction alone is unlikely to explain the low correlations. Our results indicate that semantic synthesis with code LLMs provides an efficient alternative to search-based transformation discovery and highlight the importance of validating evaluation fidelity when optimizing data transformations.

</details>


### [121] [Anatomy-Activated Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Medical Vision-Language Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10960)
*Szymon Płotka,Gizem Mert,Pedro R. A. S. Bassi,Wenxuan Li,Zongwei Zhou,Anna Marcinkiewicz,Wiktoria Romańczyk,Jarosław B. Ćwikła,Łukasz Struski,Ewa Szczurek,Jacek Tabor,Arkadiusz Sitek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种新的混合架构A$^{2}$MoE，通过引入Histogram Representation Router (HRR)和Organ-Query Multi-Scale Projector (OQMSP)，使编码器能够关注特定器官的上下文，并支持无标注推理。A$^{2}$MoE在多个医学影像任务中取得了最先进的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的医学VLP模型在处理医学影像时未能充分利用器官特定的上下文信息，导致了在实际临床诊断应用中的局限性。因此，需要一种能够更好地适应医学图像中器官差异的新架构。

Method: A$^{2}$MoE架构通过引入Histogram Representation Router (HRR)和Organ-Query Multi-Scale Projector (OQMSP)，设计了一个新的混合模型，它能够在模型计算路径中整合解剖学诱导偏置，实现器官级别的特征提取和对齐。

Result: A$^{2}$MoE在预训练后，在多种医学影像分割、分类和检测基准任务中表现出卓越的性能。此外，通过器官定位和查询模块，该模型可以在缺乏标记数据的情况下进行有效的推理。

Conclusion: A$^{2}$MoE在医学影像学习中展示了显著的潜力，同时为医学影像的多层次理解和稳健泛化提供了坚实的基础。

Abstract: Medical Vision-Language Pre-training (VLP) leverages the semantic richness of radiology reports to learn 3D representations, yet current architectures remain fundamentally anatomy-agnostic. While clinical diagnostics rely on organ-specific context, standard encoders apply a uniform, dense parameterization to all volumetric patches, and existing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routers gate on isolated local features without explicit access to the organ composition of the scan or crop. We propose Anatomy-Activated Mixture-of-Experts (A$^{2}$MoE), a framework that incorporates anatomical inductive biases within the model's computational path. A$^{2}$MoE introduces two key components: (1) a Histogram Representation Router (HRR) that conditions expert selection on global visual context and a predicted anatomical composition histogram, encouraging anatomy-dependent expert weighting; and (2) an Organ-Query Multi-Scale Projector (OQMSP) that utilizes learnable queries to extract organ-level embeddings for fine-grained alignment without requiring manual annotations at inference. By routing at the patch level rather than the token level, A$^{2}$MoE reduces routing complexity by orders of magnitude while satisfying load balancing by construction. Pre-trained on over 60,000 multi-phase CT scans, A$^{2}$MoE achieves state-of-the-art performance across segmentation, classification, and detection benchmarks. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our anatomically grounded inductive biases support robust generalization to MRI and ultrasound, establishing a scalable foundation for medical representation learning. The code is available at https://github.com/gmum/A2MoE.

</details>


### [122] [Sensitivity-Gated Accumulator Caching for On-Device Learning of Low-Bit Hand Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10991)
*Soroor Ghandali,Kanika Mamgain,Manjot Kaur,Akanksha Shukla,Shashira Guntuka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究介绍了一种名为SGAC的量化方法，它仅保留一小部分权重组的残差状态，并通过一种新颖的缓存机制将这些组的子步骤更新写入8位累加器中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统量化方法（如量化感知训练）由于需要保留大量的32位原始权重及其优化状态，因此占用大量内存。而直接使用随机选择进行定点训练虽然不需要额外的存储，但引入了每一步的舍入噪声，且去除此噪声的方法又需维持额外的残差缓冲区。

Method: 提出了一种基于敏感性门控累加器缓存（SGAC）的新方法。该方法仅对一小部分具有高敏感性的权重组保留残差状态，并使用一种设定关联的8位累加器缓存来收集这些组的最大Fisher加权平方代码步，并将其作为完整的步骤写入存储中。未命中缓存的组则通过随机选择自动舍入。

Result: 在参数量为383k的手部关键点网络上，SGAC方法只使用每个权重8.1位的状态进行训练，在部署在设备后进行适应时，其在两个模拟摄像机上的平均准确性达到9个低比特网络中的最高水平。在十二种ImageNet-C图像扰动测试中，该方法在干净与损坏图像准确性平均值上超过了四个基线方法，且置信区间不包含零。

Conclusion: SGAC方法展现了显著的内存节省能力，同时保持了与较高比特量化相同的甚至更高的模型性能。这一创新的计算策略能够在限制资源的边设备上实现高效的机器学习推理。

Abstract: Small hand-tracking networks are deployed as 4- and 8-bit codes, and they should keep adapting to a user's camera after deployment, on the device and within roughly the memory of the model itself. Quantization-aware training cannot do this cheaply, because it keeps a 32-bit master copy of every weight together with its optimizer state, about 96 bits per weight. Training the codes directly with stochastic rounding needs no copy but injects rounding noise at every step, and the methods that remove this noise keep a residual buffer for every weight. We introduce sensitivity-gated accumulator caching (SGAC), which keeps residual state for only a small and changing set of weight groups. A set-associative cache of 8-bit accumulators collects the sub-step updates of the groups with the largest Fisher-weighted squared code step and writes them into the codes as whole steps; an evicted line is flushed by stochastic rounding, and a group without a line does not move until it is admitted. We prove that the write-back is unbiased and show, under a local quadratic model, that rounding a sub-step update costs loss of the same order as the update's own gain, so that rounding pays only where the expected gradient is large relative to the curvature. On a 383k-parameter hand-keypoint network, SGAC trains with 8.1 bits of state per weight. Scored on the 4/8-bit network that the device runs after adaptation, it has the highest mean accuracy of nine deployed low-bit networks on two simulated cameras. On twelve ImageNet-C corruptions it has the highest average of corrupted and clean accuracy of seven deployed methods, ahead of the PEQA-style, ECO-style and direct low-bit baselines with confidence intervals that exclude zero, and it matches an 8-bit accumulator kept for every weight with 56% of that state.

</details>


### [123] [Efficient 3D plant segmentation through multiscale graph learning and optimized geometric processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11007)
*Jesus Ivan Ruiz-Martinez,Andres Mendez-Vazquez,Eduardo Rodriguez-Tello*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多尺度边缘的图注意力模型，模型包含局部形状描述符、两种邻域尺度和茎和叶的残差修正，适用于紧凑计算平台的植物器官分割。该模型使用了约78,000个参数，在点云分割精度上超过了多个基线，尤其是对局部玉米数据集进行子集分析，验证了模型的有效性。模型优化后，在多个点云处理任务中的测试中，处理时间显著缩短。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在精准农业应用中，需要对紧凑计算平台进行高精度的植物器官分割以支持点云分割任务。本文致力于开发一种高效并且稳定的分割模型PointNeXt，提高模型的准确性和在紧凑计算设备上的应用可能性。

Method: 本文采用了一种基于多尺度边缘的图注意力模型，该模型结合了局部形状描述符和两种邻域尺度，并实施了残差修正来优化处理结果。首先，模型通过多层次结构来提取特征；其次，通过全局和局部尺度的相邻关系来传递节点信息；最后，在本地修正步骤中进行了茎和叶的具体优化。
