Result: 该模型在点云分割任务上的性能显著优于多个基线模型，特别是在本地玉米数据集上的性能提升，以及在多任务处理上的时间和精度优化。实证研究显示，经过优化的PointNeXt模型在PlantNet和TomatoWUR数据集上的精确分割率分别为86.36%和78.35%，并且具有较低的延迟时间和较高的处理效率。

Conclusion: 本文提出并评估了一种新的点云分割方法PointNeXt，通过在多个精度和时间复杂度条件下的实证研究，表明该方法在紧凑计算平台上具有较高的准确性和实际应用价值。虽然还有一些改进空间可以调整模型组件的贡献，但整体上它提供了一种有效的模型结构来实现精确的植物器官分割。

Abstract: Plant organ segmentation on compact computing platforms requires accurate predictions and affordable geometric preparation. We develop and evaluate a multiscale edge based graph attention model that combines local shape descriptors, two neighborhood scales and a residual stem and leaf correction in approximately 78 thousand parameters. The engineering application is plant point cloud segmentation for precision agriculture, assessed through grouped accuracy experiments and physical Raspberry Pi 5 inference. Broad comparisons with hierarchical, graph and transformer baselines establish PointNeXt as the strongest external accuracy reference among the tested local recipes. A nested four variant ablation on a local maize collection separates geometric information from the combined multiscale configuration across seven outer groups and three seeds. The complete model achieves the highest mean intersection over union, 86.36%, although uncertainty and boundary errors qualify the contribution of each component. We then optimize full cloud principal component analysis, sampling and neighbor queries without changing learned weights or descriptor definitions. All 1,180 paired desktop comparisons on PlantNet and TomatoWUR preserve exact logits and predictions. Multiscale pipeline latency falls from 330.33 to 96.82 milliseconds on PlantNet and from 1,054.52 to 463.10 milliseconds on TomatoWUR. PointNeXt also benefits from optimized sampling and remains faster over the complete pipeline. These results support compact graph learning with reduced geometric overhead, while physical board measurements establish inference feasibility rather than energy efficiency or readiness for autonomous flight.

</details>


### [124] [Virtual Task Prompting for Multi-Task Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11041)
*Zedong Wang,Yucheng Wang,Dan Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VTP 提出了一种用于多任务场景理解的新方法，通过共享虚拟状态中的虚拟任务提示，实现任务适应性的交互，提升了模型在多个数据集上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多任务场景理解模型依赖于修改的视觉编码器或复杂的解码器来实现跨任务交互，这限制了模型的灵活性和与现成视觉基础模型的兼容性。

Method: VTP 方法通过维护一个与主干网络一同的扩展虚拟任务集，在每一层使用可学习的路由矩阵读取任务特定组成作为输入，处理图像令牌并写回处理结果，从而形成捕捉任务间复杂关系的显式路径。

Result: VTP 方法在Pascal-Context 和 NYUD-v2 数据集上达到了最先进的性能，且在 Taskonomy 挑战测试中的 13 个异构任务中也表现出很强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过 VTP，研究人员表明模型性能的提升主要来自于适应性路由机制，而非容量的增加。

Abstract: Multi-task scene understanding models typically rely on modified vision encoders or complex decoders for cross-task interaction, which limits their flexibility and compatibility with off-the-shelf vision foundation models (VFMs). We introduce Virtual Task Prompting (VTP), which frames multi-task prompting as retrieving task-adaptive compositions from a shared virtual state, where both the state and routing process are optimized in an end-to-end manner. Concretely, VTP maintains an expanded set of virtual tasks alongside the backbone. At each layer, learnable routing matrices read task-specific compositions as input to interact with image tokens and write the processed results back, forming explicit pathways that capture the intricacies among tasks outside the encoder. Since VTP keeps the backbone clean, it integrates seamlessly with pretrained VFMs, advancing the state of the art on Pascal-Context and NYUD-v2. Stress test on Taskonomy with 13 heterogeneous tasks further shows VTP's robustness in extreme settings. Ablations and analysis indicate that VTP's gains stem from adaptive routing rather than increased capacity. The project page is available at https://jacky1128.github.io/VTP/.

</details>


### [125] [Differentiable Virtual-Slot Partitioning for Adaptive Tokenization in Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11058)
*Gaoxiang He,Bin Zhu,Bo Xie,Xiaotong Yu,Yi Chen,Hongfei Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种称为Differentiable Virtual-Slot Partitioning (DVSP) 的方法，旨在通过减少不必要的计算，并保留准确度，实现自适应的标记化策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自适应标记化方法存在一些限制，例如固定的评分规则或使用具有噪声梯度的直通估计器。本文作者重新审视了自适应标记化，提出了一种新的方法来平衡计算效率和模型准确性。

Method: DVSP 方法采用一个 2x2 区域内的四个虚拟槽位，通过单个权重 α 融合这些槽位的标记特征和注意力质量，能够在训练过程中端到端地学习。

Result: 在 COCO 检测任务中，DVSP 保留了97.9%的密集 Box AP，同时减少了64.2%的视觉标记，实现了1.61倍的端到端加速。在 Cityscapes 和 DeiT 架构上的实验表明，DVSP 相对于其他自适应标记化方法更具优势。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的方法验证了自适应标记化在保持准确度的同时，可以通过减少计算量来提高模型效率，为自适应标记化的发展提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Adaptive tokenization aims to reduce the compute spent on uninformative image regions while preserving accuracy. Existing work relies on (i) fixed or frozen scoring rules, which cannot be trained toward the task loss, or (ii) discrete masks trained with straight-through estimators, which yield noisy gradients, while fully differentiable alternatives instead leave the pre-trained regular grid. We revisit adaptive tokenization from a regular-grid perspective and ask: can a two-scale quadtree be learned end-to-end without deleting a single token during training? We show that one coarse token and its four fine children can be made the two endpoints of a single continuous interpolation. We introduce Differentiable Virtual-Slot Partitioning (\dvsp{}), which keeps four \emph{virtual slots} per $2{\times}2$ region and blends their token features and attention mass with a single weight $α$, exactly reproducing the discrete grid at $α\in \{0,1\}$. On COCO detection with EVA-02-B, \dvsp{} retains $97.9\%$ of dense Box AP while removing $64.2\%$ of visual tokens, giving a $1.61\times$ end-to-end speedup, and it outperforms entropy-based APT, DART, and uniform lower-resolution dense adaptation at matched budgets; these gains depend on the conserved attention mass, whose removal costs $1.59$ Box AP. On a frozen Segmenter it also improves Cityscapes mIoU, and on frozen DeiT backbones it exceeds entropy selection at identical per-image token counts.

</details>


### [126] [What Does Multiple Choice Actually Measure? Disentangling Video Understanding from Option Exploitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11062)
*Elliott Piercy,Justin Chan,Sepand Dyanatkar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 当前视频理解评估存在多种偏差，研究通过Option-Delayed Replay (ODR)机制来消除这些偏差，提出了一种新的评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视频问答基准存在依赖多选答案指南、语言先验和脆弱评分管道的问题，这使得难以准确评估模型的真实感知能力。研究旨在通过一个新的ODR机制，消除这些偏差，使评估更加客观。

Method: 研究通过对六种不同长度的视频问答基准进行分析，发现无视觉输入时准确率显著高于随机猜测，归因于捷径和选项优先依赖。通过ODR机制，在开放路径中逐步展示选项，进行忠实的无选项推理。

Result: 研究发现，使用ODR机制的评价方法能获得更忠实的评估结果，并且其评估结果与使用选项依赖策略的模型相当。研究还发布了一份修正了20.5%键值的人类重新标注版本LVBench，以减少注释噪声的干扰。

Conclusion: 研究得出结论，引入ODR机制的评估方法能够更好地评估模型的真实视觉感知能力，同时提供了可重复的评估协议。

Abstract: Video understanding evaluations are intended to measure a model's proficiency in video perception and task solving. However, current VideoQA benchmarks struggle to isolate these capabilities due to their reliance on multiple-choice (MC) answer guidance, language priors, and fragile scoring pipelines. Disentangling these confounding factors reveals how much of a model's score is supplied by the evaluation context rather than earned through faithful perception. Across six VideoQA benchmarks of varying length, we find that accuracy is significantly above chance without any visual input. This is caused by shortcutting and option-prior reliance. We express these effects in the language of faithfulness: option-exploitation and answer-conditioned reasoning traces are unfaithful even when they are correct. Together, our results show that a VideoQA score is jointly determined by language priors, option timing, and how outputs and labels are converted into correctness. We produce a novel Option-Delayed Replay (ODR) mechanism that discloses options at controlled stages of an open-ended (OE) trajectory, to obtain objective MC scores from faithful option-free inference. Our work demonstrates that agentic methods with ODR and faithful inference can match option-exploiting performance. Finally, we formalize our diagnostic collection and ODR as a reproducible evaluation protocol, and we release a human-relabelled edition of LVBench (correcting $20.5\%$ of keys) to remove annotation noise as a confounding variable.

</details>


### [127] [NanoNet: Ultra-Lightweight Network for MRI Brain Tumor Classification toward Edge AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11071)
*Tran Nguyen-Le,Huu-Thuan Huynh,Minh-Triet Tran,Trung-Nghia Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NanoNet是一种超轻量级的卷积神经网络，旨在资源受限的MRI分类中应用。它通过深度和通道容量的显著减少以及最终特征维度的减小，仅包含5个倒残差块和8,132个参数，同时保持了良好的分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 介绍NanoNet网络是为了应对边缘AI平台的资源限制，支持MRI影像的自动脑肿瘤分类，为未来边缘AI应用场景提供解决方案。

Method: 受到MobileNetV2的启发，NanoNet通过减少网络深度、通道容量、扩展比和最终特征维度，实现轻量级化。进一步通过依赖感知结构化剪枝、知识蒸馏和INT8量化感知训练进行额外压缩。

Result: NanoNet在BRISC 2025基准上实现了92.80%的准确率和92.97%的宏F1分数，参数数量和计算量分别比70%剪枝的MobileNetV2少60.2%和9.8%。INT8量化后的NanoNet在不同量化训练种子下达到了89.70%的准确率和90.22%的宏F1分数。

Conclusion: NanoNet在保持高精度的同时，极大地减少了参数数量和计算量，为资源受限的边端设备提供了高效的MRI脑肿瘤分类解决方案。

Abstract: Automated brain tumor classification from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) can support accessible medical image analysis, but conventional deep learning models often exceed the resource budgets of highly constrained edge-AI platforms. We present NanoNet, an ultra-lightweight convolutional neural network designed for resourceconstrained MRI classification and motivated by future edge-AI applications. Inspired by MobileNetV2, NanoNet substantially reduces network depth, channel capacity, expansion ratios, and final feature dimensionality, resulting in only five inverted residual blocks and 8,132 parameters. We further investigate dependency-aware structured pruning, knowledge distillation, and INT8 quantization-aware training for additional compression. Experiments on the BRISC 2025 benchmark show that NanoNet achieves 92.80% accuracy and 92.97% macro F1 with 8,132 parameters and 10.498 MFLOPs. Across three compression seeds, it exceeds the mean accuracy of 70%-pruned MobileNetV2 by 5.20 percentage points while using 60.2% fewer parameters and 9.8% less computation. Converted INT8 NanoNet achieves 89.70% accuracy and 90.22% macro F1 across three QAT seeds. Earlier TensorFlow Lite measurements indicate 27.7 KB of baseline model storage, motivating future edge-AI deployment.

</details>


### [128] [ADC-RANet: Improving Resolution Adaptive Neural Networks with Attention, Distillation and Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11076)
*Jeferson Severino de Araujo,Lilian Hollard,Eric Granger,Marco Pedersoli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ADC-RANet 是一种增强的 RANet 网络，通过结合通道注意力、知识蒸馏和 MixUp 过矫正，在不同计算预算下保持和提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对传统动态神经网络RANet在图像分类中的表现，引入一种更高效的改进版本ADC-RANet，旨在提升所有计算预算下的表现。

Method: ADC-RANet 结合了通道注意力机制、多层次的知识蒸馏方法和 MixUp 过矫正策略，来优化计算资源分配并提升网络性能。

Result: 实验结果表明，ADC-RANet 在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 数据集上均取得了稳定改进，同时保持了与原 RANet 相似的高效性。

Conclusion: 作者提出的方法通过结合多种策略有效提升了 RANet 的性能，而无需牺牲其计算效率特性，提供了改进动态神经网络的参考方案。

Abstract: Dynamic neural networks are a class of adaptive models in which the computation assigned to each input sample is determined dynamically, potentially reducing computational cost while maintaining similar performance. For image classification, the Resolution Adaptive Network (RANet) is a strong approach that progressively allocates computational resources across input scales based on sample difficulty. In this work, we introduce RANet with Attention, Distillation and Calibration (ADC-RANet), an enhanced version of RANet that improves performance across all computational budgets. Our approach combines three tightly connected components: bottom-up channel attention, top-down cascaded knowledge distillation, and overconfidence correction using MixUp, in a synergistic design that coordinates both pathways. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet datasets show consistent gains while preserving the efficiency of RANet. Our code is available: https://github.com/jefersonseverino/ADC-RANet

</details>


### [129] [ViCLIP-OT: The First Foundation Vision-Language Model for Vietnamese Image-Text Retrieval with Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22678)
*Quoc-Khang Tran,Minh-Thien Nguyen,Nguyen-Khang Pham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViCLIP-OT 是一种专为越南语设计的图像-文本检索基础模型，通过结合 CLIP 样式的对比学习和带有相似性-图规制最优传输（SIGROT）损失的框架，增强了跨模态一致性和缓解了模态差距问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大多数视觉-语言模型主要针对高资源语言进行优化，在低资源语言如越南语的环境中表现不佳。

Method: ViCLIP-OT 模型使用 CLIP 样式的对比学习，引入了 SIGROT 损失来增强全局跨模态一致性并减少模态差距问题。

Result: 在三个越南语基准数据集（UITOpenViIC、KTVIC 和 Crossmodal-3600）上进行的大量实验表明，ViCLIP-OT 在领域内和零样本设置中均优于 CLIP 和 SigLIP 基准模型。在 UIT-OpenViIC 上，模型的平均 Recall@K 达到 67.34%，比 CLIP 提高了 5.75 个百分点。在 Crossmodal-3600 的零样本评估中，ViCLIP-OT 超过了 CLIP 11.72 个百分点。嵌入空间分析进一步证实了改进的对齐和减少的模态差距。

Conclusion: 引入 SIGROT 可以为跨模态检索提供一种有效且可扩展的策略，尤其适用于如越南语等低资源语言的语言环境，对智能多媒体检索系统具有实际意义。

Abstract: Image-text retrieval has become a fundamental component in intelligent multimedia systems; however, most existing vision-language models are optimized for highresource languages and remain suboptimal for low-resource settings such as Vietnamese. This work introduces ViCLIP-OT, a foundation vision-language model specifically designed for Vietnamese image-text retrieval. The proposed framework integrates CLIP-style contrastive learning with a Similarity-Graph Regularized Optimal Transport (SIGROT) loss to enhance global cross-modal consistency and mitigate modality gap issues. Extensive experiments on three Vietnamese benchmarks (UITOpenViIC, KTVIC, and Crossmodal-3600) demonstrate that ViCLIP-OT consistently outperforms CLIP and SigLIP baselines in both in-domain and zero-shot settings. On UIT-OpenViIC, the model achieves an average Recall@K of 67.34%, improving upon CLIP by 5.75 percentage points. In zero-shot evaluation on Crossmodal-3600, ViCLIPOT surpasses CLIP by 11.72 percentage points. Embedding-space analysis further confirms improved alignment and reduced modality gap. The results indicate that integrating SIGROT provides an effective and scalable strategy for cross-modal retrieval in low-resource languages, offering practical implications for intelligent multimedia retrieval systems in Vietnamese and other underrepresented linguistic contexts.

</details>


### [130] [SoftPAT3D: Physics-Augmented Text-to-3D Scene Generation with Deformables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11087)
*Lei Shu,Alberta Longhini,Leonidas Guibas,Gordon Wetzstein,Jeannette Bohg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SoftPAT3D 是一个针对生成可变形物体（如布料、填充玩具和绳子）的物理增强框架，能够在避免相互交*接触的情况下将这些物体放置在支撑家具上，并与它们相互作用。该系统通过优化变形物体的几何形状，材料参数，以及通过大规模网格搜索进行重新定位来确保场景的物理合理性和操作可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的文本生成3D场景方法主要处理刚体，无法处理可变形物体，这些物体往往几何信息不完整或不准确，缺乏足够的物理模拟所需的初始状态。SoftPAT3D旨在解决这一问题，通过重建物体的支持，优化物体的初始状态，确保生成的可变形物体与场景中其他物体和支撑保持物理合理性。

Method: SoftPAT3D 提取对象的制造信息以确定其静息形状，通过物料库分配初始弹性和其他物理属性。然后自动重构支撑，转换为封闭碰撞网格，从支撑指定高度优化放置点。使用统一的接触模型使整个场景达到静止平衡，通过几何检查和视觉语言模型验证。如果场景失败，系统通过网格搜索多次重新定位物体，优化材料参数。

Result: SoftPAT3D 在所有65个测试提示中完全避免了各种物体之间的相互交*或穿透，而其他类似系统不能保证。这表明了SoftPAT3D在生成物理合理3D可变形场景方面的显著优势。

Conclusion: SoftPAT3D 具有潜力将自然语言指令转化为精确且物理合理的3D场景，在设计和机器人操作中有重要意义。

Abstract: We present SoftPAT3D, a physics-augmented framework for text-to-3D scene generation in which deformable objects, such as cloth, stuffed toys and ropes, are generated as physically valid, simulation-ready bodies and placed in intersection-free contact with the furniture that supports them, with one another and with themselves. Existing physics-augmented pipelines simulate rigid bodies only and cannot accommodate a generated deformable object, which text-to-3D generation returns as a geometrically invalid mesh, sometimes self-intersecting, that has no rest shape, no material model and no admissible initial state. These are the inputs a deformable simulation requires, and we construct each from information already in the pipeline. The rest shape comes from how the object is manufactured rather than from the generated physically inconsistent deformed configuration, and a material library assigns each deformable object its initial elastic parameters, which can then be optimized. The occluded support is regenerated and converted into a watertight collision mesh, each object is released from an optimizable placement above the supporting part that the prompt specifies, and the complete scene is driven to static equilibrium under one unified contact model, with completion verified by geometric checks and a vision-language model. When a scene fails the prompt, a grid search over placements corrects it, and the adjoint of a differentiable simulation of the same contact energy reaches the targets the grid does not, places several bodies jointly and recovers and optimizes material parameters. Multi-body scenes equilibrate in a single simulation, and the pipeline also runs from the text prompt alone. On all sixty-five prompts, SoftPAT3D produces no undesired interpenetration of any kind, whereas every other system does, and its scenes directly support scene editing and robotic manipulation.

</details>


### [131] [Does Pose Encoding Matter? Analyzing Geometric Representations for Discrete Motion Vocabulary Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11093)
*Amir Kimiyaie,Nahal Mafi,Hamed Tabkhi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究了四种骨骼运动的几何空间编码，发现旋转和位置编码能够更有效地将代码词转化为有效词汇表，而完全的骨骼编码在几种编码中仅能提供数百个有效词汇，热图编码则提供更少的词汇。较小的代码维度在三种编码中提供了最高的利用率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索不同几何空间编码的高效压缩和表示方法，以优化运动压缩和生成管道中的运动词汇化过程。

Method: 对四种骨骼运动编码（关节高斯热图、相对于根的位置、局部关节旋转和冗余完整运动链）进行了VQ-VAE（矢量量化变分自编码器）训练，以比较不同编码对运动词汇化的影响。

Result: 旋转和位置编码能够提高代码词的利用率，并提供更多有效词汇。在相同的姿态族编码中，有效词汇量的数量级差异显著，这一点仅通过重构损失无法完全揭示。

Conclusion: 输入几何形状是运动分词的首要设计选择。根据具体的编码方式，可以显著影响到最终的编码效率和词汇数量。

Abstract: Compressing continuous human motion into a finite vocabulary of discrete tokens is now the first stage of many motion understanding and generation pipelines. Vector quantization partitions a latent space into Voronoi cells around a finite codebook, but the geometry of that latent space is inherited from the input pose encoding, and it is unclear which encoding admits an efficient discretization. We study four encodings that place skeletal motion in different geometric spaces: Gaussian joint heatmaps on the pixel lattice, which we show to be a morphological dilation of the joint point set by a quadratic structuring function; root-relative joint positions in Euclidean space; local joint rotations on $\SO$ through a continuous 6D embedding; and a redundant full kinematic encoding. For each, we train VQ-VAE tokenizers whose codebooks lie on the unit hypersphere, varying codebook size, temporal stride, and code dimension. Beyond reconstruction, we measure codebook utilization and the effective vocabulary size, i.e., the number of equiprobable spherical Voronoi cells with the same entropy as the observed token distribution. Rotation and position encodings keep converting additional codewords into effective vocabulary, whereas the full kinematic encoding saturates at a few hundred effective cells and heatmaps at fewer than sixty. The smallest code dimension gives the highest utilization for three of the four encodings, and the effect of temporal stride depends on the encoding. Encodings of the same pose family can thus yield effective vocabularies differing by an order of magnitude, a difference that reconstruction loss alone does not reveal, which points to input geometry as a first-order design choice in motion tokenization.

</details>


### [132] [MySign: A High-Fidelity Motion-Capture Dataset for 3D Sign Generation in Bahasa Isyarat Malaysia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11115)
*Jiayu Shen,Kalin Stefanov,Lay-Ki Soon,Vee Yee Chong,Alpha Agape Gopalai,KokSheik Wong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MySign 是首个针对马来手语（BIM）孤立手语的运动捕捉数据集，包含5000个样本，1000个词汇，并提供了高质量的 SMPL-X 参数序列，有助于提升3D手语生成模型的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的3D手语数据资源匮乏，现有dataset依赖SMPL-X参数获取伪标签，导致深度模糊、手指姿态不准确和时间抖动等问题，MySign提供了高标准的真实数据来改善这些问题。

Method: MySign通过专门用于手语的运动捕捉设置记录了手语表演，确保了高保真的动作捕捉，特别是在细粒度的手指和手掌动作表达。

Result: 实验结果表明，使用真实数据训练优于使用伪标签训练的手语生成模型，在视觉上更接近真实手语，但尤其是在细粒度的手指动作方面仍存在差距。

Conclusion: MySign 成为了3D手语生成的标准测试基准，展示了目前最先进的模型在精细化动作捕捉方面的不足，同时为手语识别提供了可靠的监督学习支持。

Abstract: Progress in 3D sign generation is constrained by the scarcity of high-fidelity 3D sign language datasets, a limitation that is particularly severe for under-resourced languages. We introduce MySign, the first motion-capture dataset for isolated signs in Bahasa Isyarat Malaysia (BIM). Its 5,000 samples cover 1,000 lexical items (glosses) and were produced by five Deaf native signers. Prior datasets that rely on SMPL-X parameters regressed from video provide pseudo-labels, which are often affected by depth ambiguity, inaccurate finger poses, and temporal jitter. MySign instead provides ground-truth SMPL-X sequences retargeted from recordings made with a motion-capture setup tailored for sign language; these sequences offer higher-fidelity motion, particularly in fine-grained hand and finger articulation. A controlled comparison on the same glosses and signers indicates that training on these sequences improves generation over training on such pseudo-labels. We establish MySign as a challenging benchmark for gloss-conditioned 3D sign generation: state-of-the-art models produce visually plausible outputs but fall short of the ground truth, most notably in fine-grained articulation, revealing persistent gaps in modeling articulated sign motion. In contrast, recognition baselines consistently achieve high lexical accuracy, indicating that the dataset reliably supports supervised learning. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mysigner/MySign

</details>


### [133] [Query-Only Prompt-Agnostic Attacks on Visual In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11116)
*Xiao Hu,Muhammad Ibrahim,Hao Wen,Pin-Yu Chen,Jianliang Wu,Antonio Bianchi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了在仅查询访问且不知道部署提示的情况下，针对条件渲染的自提示代理（SPS）的攻击效果，通过Color Hijack（CH）和Task Hijack（TH）两种方法对抗 VICL 模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 Vicl（Visual In-Context Learning）方法虽然可以实现基于视觉示范的条件化的 RGB 预测，提高了自动标注效率，但其在仅查询访问和未知部署提示条件下的鲁棒性尚未得到充分研究。

Method: 本文提出了两种外观空间攻击方法：Color Hijack（CH）和Task Hijack（TH），并使用自提示代理（SPS）实现跨未知部署提示的攻击转移。

Result: 实验结果显示，SPS（自提示代理）比随机提示代理（RPS）更有效，CH方法将前景保留率从0.918降至0.155，TH方法将调色板感知容限距离从0.345降至0.225。CH和TH分别在语义、实例和文本样式的预测结果上抑制前景和合并实例颜色，且TH在下采样的部署提示下也减少了实例计数和掩码保留率，同时增加了实例合并。

Conclusion: CH和TH两种攻击方法在Vicl模型上表现出色，能够有效减少Vicl模型的预测准确性，显示出模型在仅查询访问和未知部署提示下的不稳定性。

Abstract: Visual In-Context Learning (VICL) enables promptable segmentation by conditioning RGB predictions on visual demonstrations, making it attractive for auto-labeling, but its robustness under query-only access and unknown deployment prompts remains underexplored. We study query-only, prompt-agnostic targeted attacks where the attacker observes only returned RGB outputs, without access to model internals or deployment prompts. Treating prompt-conditioned RGB rendering as a distinct attack surface, we introduce two appearance-space attacks: Color Hijack (CH) drives foreground colors toward the background to suppress visibility, while Task Hijack (TH) collapses instance-distinguishing colors toward a shared color assignment. To transfer across unseen prompts, we propose a Self-Prompt Surrogate (SPS) constructed from the clean query and its output. In a paired, matched-budget SegGPT comparison, SPS outperforms the Random-Prompt Surrogate (RPS), reducing CH instance foreground retention from 0.918 to 0.155 and TH palette-aware tolerance distance from 0.345 to 0.225. Across four VICL models on COCO and HierText, CH suppresses foregrounds across semantic-, instance-, and text-style outputs, while TH collapses instance colors under held-out deployment prompts. After palette-based decoding, TH also reduces the decoded instance count and mask retention while increasing instance merges. Finally, at 30% corruption, CH-corrupted annotations from a publicly accessible VICL-based auto-labeling pipeline reduce downstream YOLO-seg mAP50 from 0.761 to 0.281.

</details>


### [134] [What You Show Is Not What You Get: Rethinking Demonstration Following in Visual In-Context Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11122)
*Xiao Hu,Ilia Sucholutsky*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SegGPT通过背景颜色映射偏差和部分-父扩展这两个新的发现，推进了视觉上下文分割领域，引入了SCPS，提高了目标IoU并减少对象其他部分的泄漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SegGPT旨在通过视觉演示来指导新图像的预测，揭示了背景颜色映射偏差和部分-父扩展这两个关键机制，从而改善视觉上下文分割中的演示遵循效果。

Method: 通过分析视觉演示中的背景颜色映射偏差和部分-父扩展，揭示了视觉上下文分割中演示的指导作用。基于此，引入了SCPS，使用特定的语义对比编码来选择具有高质量的演示及其语义对比编码。

Result: SCPS在三个基准数据集上的七种检索方法中，相对于原始二元选择器，性能分别提高了目标IoU 0.054和减少了22.7%的对象其他部分泄漏。

Conclusion: 研究为理解并改进视觉上下文分割中演示的遵循提供了一个新的视角，表明语义对比编码在视觉上下文分割中的潜在价值。

Abstract: Visual in-context segmentation uses visual demonstrations to guide predictions for a new image. In SegGPT, we identify background color mapping deviation, where non-target regions sharing a background label receive different output colors, and part-to-parent expansion, where predictions extend beyond the requested part into its parent object. These deviations can occur even when the relevant regions remain distinguishable in internal features. Controlled changes to demonstration colors and requested targets support an account in which demonstrations guide role and color assignments over familiar semantic regions, influenced by learned semantic and color preferences. Building on these findings, we introduce Semantic Contrast Prompt Selection (SCPS). Its semantic contrast encoding assigns separate colors to the requested part and the rest of its object while keeping the remaining scene black. SCPS combines existing retrieval scores with quality estimates from labeled development images to select demonstrations and their binary or semantic contrast encodings. Averaged across seven retrieval methods on three benchmarks, SCPS improves target IoU by 0.054 and reduces leakage into the rest of the object by 22.7% relative to the original binary selectors. Our findings offer a new perspective on understanding and improving demonstration following in visual in-context segmentation.

</details>


### [135] [CrossLiDAR: Controllable Multi-Sensor LiDAR Sequence Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11131)
*Khanh Nguyen,Thomas Walker,Hichem Telli,Carlos de la Torre-Ortiz,Stefano Fiorini,Salah Eddine Bekhouche,Mohammed-En-Nadhir Zighem,Wassim Swaileh,Tinghuai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CrossLiDAR 提出了一种基于统一_transformer 的框架，能够生成可控制且时空一致的多传感器 LiDAR 序列，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的 LiDAR 模拟器在场景结构、几何控制以及长时段一致性方面存在局限性，CrossLiDAR 框架旨在解决这些问题，以提高自动驾驶系统的开发和验证效率。

Method: CrossLiDAR 使用一个矫正流动目标与 Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT) 后端相结合的方法，在范围图像的紧凑隐空间内工作。通过 Inter-sensor 模块支持多个 LiDAR 传感器之间的交互，并使用一个 ControlNet 风格的分支提供结构条件。为了建立时间一致性，CrossLiDAR 生成短周期的帧序列并通过自回归方式扩展，以增强长期一致性和连贯性。

Result: 实验结果显示，CrossLiDAR 在 nuScenes 和 Waymo 数据集上的 JSD 和 MMD 评价指标上分别比现有最佳基线提高了 29.56% 和 15.36%，表现出更好的长期一致性。

Conclusion: CrossLiDAR 通过提供一个与现代自动驾驶仿真相匹配的框架，实现了多传感器 LiDAR 在长时间尺度上的一致性和控制性，增强了场景基于的测试能力。

Abstract: High-fidelity LiDAR simulation remains a bottleneck for scalable development and validation of autonomous systems. Existing generators can synthesize realistic scans, but they are typically constrained to a single sensor configuration, offer limited control over structure and geometry, and drift in long-horizon 4D generation. We present CrossLiDAR, a unified transformer-based framework capable of generating controllable and spatio-temporally consistent multi-sensor LiDAR sequences. Our approach leverages a rectified flow objective with a Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT) backbone, within a compact latent space of range images. To support multiple LiDAR sensors, an Inter-sensor Module enables interaction across sensors, while a ControlNet-style branch provides structural conditioning (e.g., BEV priors or 3D bounding boxes). For modeling the temporal consistency, CrossLiDAR generates short $N$-frame sequences and extends them autoregressively to improve long-horizon coherence. Our model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average improvement of 29.56\% in JSD and 15.36\% in MMD evaluated on nuScenes and the Waymo Dataset. CrossLiDAR bridges the gap to modern autonomous-driving simulation by enabling calibration-consistent multi-sensor LiDAR rollouts over long horizons for controllable, scenario-based testing.

</details>


### [136] [From Game Generation to Game Playing: Fully Automated Ability Training for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11136)
*Changran Liu,Qi Wu,Wenchao Ma,Sharon X. Huang,Haomiao Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种自动生成游戏环境和专家演示的框架，利用LLM构建游戏环境并使用程序化专家生成对齐的指令、渲染观察数据和键盘鼠标操作。研究者使用合成的Minecraft和Roblox游戏数据进行训练，证明了Script2Play在多个公开游戏基准上的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLA模型训练受限于收集游戏演示的成本，因此，为了降低这一限制，作者提出了一个自动构建游戏环境和生成专家演示的框架，以便能够以合成数据进行模型训练。

Method: 该框架利用LLM构建可执行游戏环境，并使用程序化专家生成对齐的指令、渲染观察数据和键盘鼠标操作，从而生成合成游戏演示数据。然后使用4B大小的vision-language模型进行行为克隆训练。

Result: Script2Play在多个公开游戏基准上的评价表明，它能够有效执行游戏指令，并且能够跨游戏引擎进行泛化。研究结果证明了针对合成监督的有效性。

Conclusion: 该研究成功地利用合成数据训练了一种能够跨游戏泛化的VLA模型，并证明了自动构建游戏环境和生成专家演示方法的有效性。

Abstract: Training vision-language-action (VLA) models to follow gameplay instructions across diverse games is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. We introduce a framework that automatically generates game environments and expert demonstrations. An LLM-powered agent uses game-building tools to construct executable environments and tasks targeting specified skills. Programmatic experts then use privileged simulator state to generate aligned instructions, rendered observations, and keyboard and mouse actions. We train our game policy, Script2Play, by post-training a 4B vision-language model with behavior cloning on 150.3 hours of synthetic Minecraft and Roblox gameplay, without human gameplay demonstrations or reinforcement learning. Evaluation on multiple public game benchmarks demonstrates that Script2Play follows gameplay instructions effectively and generalizes across game engines, highlighting the effectiveness of targeted synthetic supervision.

</details>


### [137] [Graphene: A Lightweight Transformer with Ising Mean-Field Refinement for Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11139)
*Seungki Hong,Taekwang Jang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种名为Graphene的轻量级图像超分辨率架构，通过Ising模型启发的局部特征精炼模块（IRB）和基于阶段历史的特征精炼模块（HistAttn）来改进图像超分辨率。IRB利用注意输出特征和预softmax注意力权重在局部窗口内部构建带符号的成对token耦合，通过未展平的均场更新来精炼特征。HistAttn则通过自适应地混合当前阶段输出和历史加权特征聚合来融合当前输出，而不引入空间成对注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着图像超分辨率技术的发展，研究人员不断寻找更高效、性能更好的方法来提高图像的质量。然而，传统的方法在提升图像细节的同时往往伴随着计算复杂度和资源消耗的增加。因此，发展一种既高效又能保持较高图像质量的算法成为研究焦点。

Method: Graphene架构中，引入了两个互补的特征精炼机制：一个是基于Ising模型的局部特征精炼模块IRB，另一个是基于阶段历史的特征精炼模块HistAttn。IRB通过构建带符号的成对token耦合来进行局部特征精炼，而HistAttn则通过自适应地结合当前阶段输出和历史特征来精炼特征。

Result: 实验结果显示，Graphene 和 Graphene-light 在Urban100 数据集上分别比 IET 和 IET-light 多倍减少参数、FLOPs、延迟和峰值内存消耗，并且在现实世界的数据上表现出对细粒度细节和纹理更好的恢复能力。

Conclusion: 总之，Graphene通过创新的特征精炼机制提供了高效且高质量的图像超分辨率解决方案。

Abstract: This paper proposes Graphene, a lightweight image super-resolution architecture with two complementary feature refinement mechanisms: Ising-model-inspired local feature refinement using an Ising Refinement Block (IRB) and stage-history-based feature refinement using a History Attention (HistAttn) module. The IRB reuses attention output features and pre-softmax attention logits to construct signed pairwise token couplings within each local window, applies unrolled mean-field updates, and refines features through a gated residual correction. These signed couplings allow alignment and opposition between latent spins to modulate local feature refinement. HistAttn attends over the current stage output and earlier representations at the same token position and adaptively blends the current stage output with a history-weighted feature aggregate without adding spatial pairwise attention. On Urban100 at $\times4$, Graphene and Graphene-light improve over IET and IET-light by 0.24 dB and 0.38 dB, respectively, with 34.3%/13.7% fewer parameters, 44.8%/44.4% fewer FLOPs, 78.4%/71.5% lower latency, and 76.0%/85.5% lower peak memory. Real-world SR comparisons further show that Graphene recovers fine details and preserves textures across diverse degradations. Code and reference checkpoints are available at https://github.com/skethz/Graphene

</details>


### [138] [SurgWorld: Learning Surgical Representations Beyond Observation via Latent Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11140)
*Jingkun Yue,Pengxiang Wang,Siqi Zhang,Zinan Jia,Yiyao Zhang,Huihuan Xu,Yichang Hao,Xiaohong Liu,Zongbo Han,Guangyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SurgWorld是一个用于手术表示学习的视频原生自监督框架，通过预测基于相对时空偏移的隐藏手术动态，结合几何视觉相似性目标提高空间几何和局部视觉一致性，使手术过程识别、细微动作理解和密集视觉感知优于现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督学习方法主要依赖当前视野内的视频信息进行学习，无法直接建模看不到的手术动态。SurgWorld通过利用潜在预测世界模型的理念，提出了一种新的自监督框架，并通过预测相对时空偏移条件下的表示来建模隐藏的手术动态。

Method: SurgWorld框架在预训练阶段使用Out-of-Sight Dynamics Modeling (OSDM)目标来预测基于相对时空偏移的表示，并通过Geometric Visual Similarity (GVS)目标来增强空间几何和局部视觉一致性。训练框架使用聚合式训练来整合多个监督信号以学习统一的手术动态和视觉几何的潜在表示。

Result: 在包括17个手术基准的数据集上的广泛迁移学习实验中，SurgWorld在手术工作流程识别、细微动作理解以及密集视觉感知任务上表现优于现有的视觉基础模型。

Conclusion: SurgWorld提高了手术动态的建模能力，推动了对手术过程的理解，尤其是在密集视觉感知方面取得了显著进展。

Abstract: Surgical procedures are inherently partially observable, requiring surgeons to continuously infer evolving anatomical dynamics and future surgical states beyond the current observation. However, existing self-supervised learning methods primarily learn from observed surgical videos through masked reconstruction or predicting representations within the camera's current field of view, lacking the capability to explicitly model the out-of-sight surgical dynamics. Inspired by latent predictive world models, we introduce SurgWorld, a video-native, self-supervised framework for surgical representation learning, which treats a specified spatial or temporal shift as a pseudo-action and learns to predict the target latent representation from a partial observation. Specifically, we propose Out-of-Sight Dynamics Modeling (OSDM) as the pretraining objective for predicting representations conditioned on relative spatio-temporal shifts. We further regularize the learned latent dynamics from OSDM with a Geometric Visual Similarity (GVS) objective by aligning patch-level relational structures between predicted and target representations, preserving spatial geometry and local visual coherence for dense perception. These two objectives are integrated through an agglomerative training framework that consolidates complementary supervisory signals from multiple teachers to learn a unified latent representation of surgical dynamics and visual geometry. Extensive transfer learning experiments on 17 surgical benchmarks show that SurgWorld consistently outperforms existing vision foundation models across surgical workflow recognition, fine-grained action understanding, and dense visual perception. We further conduct tailored qualitative and quantitative analyses, demonstrating that SurgWorld effectively captures surgical dynamics beyond the directly observed context through latent prediction.

</details>


### [139] [Not All Layers Are Equal in Image-to-Video Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11147)
*Thinesh Thiyakesan Ponbagavathi,Constantin Seibold,Alina Roitberg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STRAP通过分析不同模型家族和预训练范式的层间敏感性，提出了一个无训练的适配器放置规则，提高了动作识别的准确率，并减少了参数量和推理时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法假设所有层都需要等量的时间建模，而层间敏感性分析显示，这种假设并不成立，因此需要改进适配器的放置策略。

Method: 通过跨四个视频本源模型家族和两种预训练范式进行层间敏感性分析，总结出一种不需要训练的适配器放置规则（STRAP），该规则根据预训练范式适应地划分空间和时间适配器的位置。

Result: STRAP在四个细粒度的动作识别基准上，比均匀放置提高了最高11.8%的准确率，将可训练参数减少了29%到48%，并在某些标准基准上以更少的参数达到了相同的准确率，同时降低了推理时间。

Conclusion: STRAP提供了在无需训练的情况下优化适配器放置的方法，能够显著提升模型效率和性能。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient image-to-video transfer adapts frozen image foundation models to video via lightweight trainable adapters. Existing methods insert the same adapter at every transformer layer, implicitly assuming all layers require equal temporal modeling. A layer-wise sensitivity analysis across four video-native model families and two pretraining paradigms reveals that this assumption is wrong: temporal sensitivity increases with depth, and the pretraining paradigm determines its growth profile. Vision-only models exhibit a gradual rise, while vision-language models show early suppression followed by late recovery.
  This finding motivates STRAP, a training-free adapter placement rule that derives a spatial-to-temporal transition boundary from a paradigm-matched video model. Spatial adapters are assigned before this boundary and temporal adapters after it, without modifying the adapter architecture itself. On four fine-grained action recognition benchmarks, STRAP improves accuracy by up to 11.8% over uniform placement, reduces trainable parameters by 29 to 48%, and lowers inference time by up to 10%. On standard benchmarks, it matches accuracy with fewer parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/th-nesh/STRAP.

</details>


### [140] [Map2SLAM: From Streaming Map Prediction to Real-Time SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11169)
*Jian Gao,Lin-Zhuo Chen,Yihang Chen,Jiagang Chen,Jiacheng Dong,Xun Cao,Nan Xue,Yinghao Xu,Yao Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Map2SLAM 利用3DFM模型提供持续更新的视觉里程计和密集几何结构，通过冻结现有模型并引入检索头部来进行前端跟踪，而后端则适时重新观察和修正，从而显著提高了系统的准确性和可重用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的3D基础模型（3DFMs）虽然能够实时估计相机姿态和密集几何，但由于预测一旦生成便固定不变，无法通过循环闭合并校正累积偏移，因此无法达到SLAM系统的精确性标准。Map2SLAM的设计目标是利用3DFMs的优势，增加系统的可重用性和可修正性，以增强其在实际环境中的性能。

Method: Map2SLAM 方法主要包括两个阶段：前端和后端。前端使用3DFM模型的因果流式推理跟踪每一帧，决定哪些帧作为关键帧写入持久状态。而后端则异步决定何时及需要重新观察哪些过去的帧，通过刷新上下文重新运行模型的联合推理；认证的循环观察可以在线修正轨迹，分割观察可以细化密集几何结构。所有调用共享一次帧编码过程，其缓存特征亦用于循环检索，因此频繁重调用不会增加额外的编码成本。

Result: Map2SLAM 已在KITTI、VBR和Oxford Spires数据集上实现了最先进的性能，与最优的未标定基准相比，平均ATE降低了超过40%。同时，该方法还能够在NVIDIA RTX 5090D GPU上以超过28 FPS的速度实现实时跟踪，分辨率设定为518×154。

Conclusion: Map2SLAM 提供给SLAM系统一种新颖的方法，将3DFM模型的预测转变为对外部持久状态的观察，通过前端和后端的合作动态调整和优化结果，显著提高了系统性能。

Abstract: Streaming 3D foundation models (3DFMs) estimate camera poses and dense geometry online, but they fall short of SLAM: their predictions are fixed once emitted, so loop closures cannot correct accumulated drift. With such models already providing strong geometric capability, a central question for SLAM becomes how to schedule their inference and how to keep its results as revisable state. We present Map2SLAM, which keeps LingBot-Map frozen, trains only a lightweight retrieval head, and builds SLAM on the model's inference interface, turning its predictions into observations of an external persistent SLAM state. The front-end tracks every incoming frame with the model's causal streaming inference and decides which frames are written to the persistent state as keyframes. The back-end asynchronously decides when and which past frames to re-observe, re-running the model's joint inference over them with fresh context; verified loop observations correct the trajectory online, and segment observations refine dense geometry after the sequence. All invocations share a single frame encoder pass per image, whose cached features also drive loop retrieval, so frequent re-invocation incurs no additional encoding cost. Map2SLAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, VBR, and Oxford Spires, reducing mean ATE by over 40% compared with the best uncalibrated baselines, while maintaining real-time tracking at over 28 FPS at a resolution of $518\times154$ on an NVIDIA RTX 5090D GPU. Please visit our project page at https://robbyant-research.github.io/Map2SLAM/.

</details>


### [141] [Source-Anchored Visual Autoregression for Extreme Image Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11200)
*Bingxin Wang,Yuan Lan,Yang Xiang,Yiqing Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAVAR是一种改进了视觉自回归模型的编码解码器，在极低比特率范围内减少了感知失真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在极低比特率（低于0.01 bpp）下进行图像压缩面临挑战，目标是同时保持与输入图像的接近性和恢复可能缺失的细节。传统的自回归模型在传输早期尺度标记时，可能会导致对象身份和纹理的确定不足，从而造成源不一致的重建结果。

Method: SAVAR引入了一种新的生成型编解码器，结合了早期尺度标记和紧凑的文本说明。这种方法分离了图像布局信息和全球语义的提供，这在VAR风格生成中通常是由共享条件驱动的。

Result: 在Kodak和CLIC2020数据集的极低比特率范围内，SAVAR相较于匹配的ARPC模型减少了8%-9%的LPIPS并减少了高达22%的DISTS。它可以在一台NVIDIA L20X GPU上以约218毫秒的时间重建一个512x512的图像。

Conclusion: SAVAR通过提供特定于图像的布局信息和全球语义，在极低比特率下实现了更优的图像重建质量。

Abstract: In the extreme-low bitrate range below $0.01$ bpp, image compression becomes a constrained generation problem: the reconstruction depends on inferring plausible missing details while staying close to the input image. Autoregressive token models provide an efficient coarse-to-fine prior for this setting, but the transmitted early-scale tokens often leave object identity and texture underdetermined, which can lead to source-inconsistent reconstructions. We introduce Source-Anchored Visual Autoregression (SAVAR), a generative codec built on Visual Autoregressive (VAR) modeling. SAVAR transmits early-scale tokens and a compact caption. The tokens provide image-specific layout information, while the caption supplies global semantics. SAVAR reconstructs a partial VQ-VAE latent from the retained scales, maps it to the start-of-sequence initialization, and uses the same latent to condition the caption embedding before adaptive layer normalization, separating two roles that are typically driven by a shared condition in VAR-style generation. On the Kodak and CLIC2020 datasets in the extreme-low range, SAVAR reduces perceptual distortion relative to matched ARPC retained-scale operating points, lowering LPIPS by about $8$--$9\%$ and DISTS by up to $22\%$ at a lower bpp. It reconstructs a $512 \times 512$ image in about $218$ ms on one NVIDIA L20X GPU, retaining fast autoregressive decoding in the evaluated setting.

</details>


### [142] [Viscot-steer: Disentangling and Transferring Visual Chain-of-Thought via Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11209)
*Ningning Wang,Beier Zhu,Xingyu Zhu,Kaiyun Yang,Xun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Viscot-steer 是一种无需训练的激活引导框架，将来自不同视觉-CoT 模型的视觉推理能力转移到架构各异的 LVLM 中，相比最强的能力转移基线，在主要评估指标上平均提升了 1.86 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的视觉-CoT 能力主要用于特定模型且难以迁移。Viscot-steer 旨在解决这一问题，使视觉-CoT 能力能够更加灵活地在不同模型之间转移。

Method: Viscot-steer 首先将视觉-CoT 分离为语义定位向量和推理向量，从源模型中提取这些向量，并将它们与目标模型的激活空间对齐。在预测边界框和生成推理轨迹时，它分别引导语义定位层和推理层。

Result: Viscot-steer 方法在多种基准测试中显示出优越性，在包含高分辨率视觉理解、通用视觉感知和推理以及数学视觉推理的评估中，相较于最好的能力转移基线，在主要评估指标上提升了 1.86 个百分点。

Conclusion: Viscot-steer 提出了一种创新的方法来实现视觉-CoT 能力的跨模型转移，展示了其在实际应用中的潜力和价值。

Abstract: Visual chain-of-thought (visual-CoT), also known as "thinking with images", equips LVLMs with the ability to locate and use key visual evidence for reasoning. However, acquiring such visual-CoT capabilities requires costly post-training and tightly couples them to a specific backbone, making transfer to other LVLMs difficult. Existing cross-model transfer methods typically treat visual-CoT as a monolithic capability, using a unified representation that ignores the functional distinction between grounding and reasoning and introduces stage-irrelevant interventions. To address this problem, we propose Viscot-steer, a training-free activation steering framework for transferring visual-CoT capabilities across heterogeneous LVLMs. Specifically, Viscot-steer first disentangles visual-CoT into grounding and reasoning vectors and extracts them from the source-model layers associated with the corresponding capabilities. It then aligns the vectors with the activation space of the target model and steers the grounding and reasoning layers during bounding-box prediction and reasoning-trace generation, respectively. Across benchmarks covering high-resolution visual understanding, general visual perception and reasoning, and mathematical visual reasoning, Viscot-steer transfers capabilities from different visual-CoT models to architecturally diverse LVLMs and outperforms the strongest capability-transfer baseline by an average of 1.86 percentage points on the primary evaluation metrics.

</details>


### [143] [DynOLAT: OLAT Video Prediction for Controllable Dynamic Full-Body Relighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11210)
*Taoming Liu,Yinji ShenTu,Guangzhao He,Yudong Jin,Yukang Ye,Siyu Zhang,Fan Jia,Wei Hua,Hujun Bao,Xiaowei Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DynOLAT 是一种针对动态全身人体的可定制光照合成框架，通过预测逐光光照基础视频并线性组合生成目标光照效果，有效解决了现有方法中光照响应不准确的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习驱动的光照合成方法在光照响应方面存在不足，DynOLAT旨在通过预测逐光光照基础视频并线性组合来改善。

Method: DynOLAT方法包括一个动态捕捉管道和大规模的动态全身逐光光照数据集，采用逐光基础视频预测和线性组合生成目标光照效果。

Result: DynOLAT在目标光照方向和相对强度的变化响应上优于测试基准，能够实现可控的视频光照变换，同时保持细节和时间连贯性。

Conclusion: DynOLAT通过数据集和工具的开放，期望推动未来的研究并改善动态光照变换的效果。

Abstract: Accurate lighting response is essential for realistic dynamic human relighting, because shadows, highlights, and color changes should follow the target illumination in both direction and relative strength. Current learning-based relighting methods can generate visually plausible videos, but they often exhibit imprecise lighting responses: shadows and highlights may drift away from the target direction, and the output brightness may not faithfully follow the relative intensities in the target environment, making the result closer to appearance harmonization than controllable relighting. To address this issue, we propose DynOLAT, a generalizable OLAT video prediction framework for dynamic full-body humans. Instead of directly synthesizing a single relit appearance, our method predicts temporally consistent One-Light-At-a-Time (OLAT) basis videos from flat-lit inputs, and then linearly combines the predicted bases according to the target environment map. This OLAT-based formulation makes the directional response explicit in the predicted bases, while the relative lighting strength is determined by the linear weights derived from the environment map. We further introduce a dynamic capture pipeline and the first large-scale dynamic full-body OLAT dataset, comprising over 24 million frames from 224 identity-outfit combinations, where different outfits of the same person define separate combinations. Experiments show that DynOLAT responds more faithfully to variations in target lighting direction and relative intensity than the tested baselines, enabling controllable video relighting while preserving fine appearance details and temporal coherence. The dataset and processing tools will be publicly released to foster future research.

</details>


### [144] [Disentangling Where and When:Factored Spatio-Temporal Explanations for Video Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11214)
*Bhavan Vasu,Giuseppe Raffa,Prasad Tadepalli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种新的扰动框架，将动作识别中的空间外观和时间动力学分离成两个独立的掩码，并通过舍弃协议评估这些分离的掩码，从而实现更精简且有效的解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的后验解释方法将空间外观和时间动态合并为单一的重要性图，而本文通过分离这两种贡献，旨在提供更精确的解释。

Method: 该方法采用扰动架构，通过最邻近帧替换来识别重要时间动态，同时加入分离惩罚和ReLU激活函数的区域约束来优化空间外观掩码和时间运动掩码。

Result: 在EPIC-Kitchens-55、EGTEA Gaze+和Something-Something V2数据集上，该方法在删除AUC上优于领先基准，并且产生的掩码密度约为其他方法的五分之一。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的方法为视频动作识别提供了更好的后验解释，通过分离空间外观和时间动态，实现了更有效的解释。

Abstract: Post-hoc explanation methods for video action recognition typically conflate spatial appearance and temporal dynamics into a single saliency or importance map. We propose a perturbation-based framework that disentangles these contributions into a spatial appearance mask ($M_a$) and a temporal motion mask ($M_m$). The two masks are jointly optimized against a frozen action recognition model through factored perturbation architecture, with nearest frame replacement to identify important temporal dynamics. A separation penalty discourages the appearance mask from spending budget on frames that the motion mask has already discarded. A ReLU-based area constraint penalizes explanations larger than an assigned budget. To evaluate these explanations, we introduce a separation protocol that sweeps spatial pixels and temporal frames independently, backed by proofs characterizing the proposed method. Across EPIC-Kitchens-55, EGTEA Gaze+, and Something-Something V2, our method attains the lowest deletion AUC against leading baselines while producing masks roughly five times sparser.

</details>


### [145] [Auto-GlaKG: Automated Biomarker Reasoning for Explainable Glaucoma Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11258)
*Cheng Huang,Zeyu Han,Yian Hu,Yaopeng Ding,Jingxi Qiu,Yadi Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Auto-GlaKG 是一个自动化的框架，结合了基于图像的生物标志物预测与固定的临床先验规则，通过知识图谱推理将生物标志物的贡献聚集为青光眼评分。这个方法在青光眼检测上表现良好，AUC超过0.95。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前使用的标注生物标志物无法证明仅使用图像时的检测性能，需要开发一个新的框架解决此问题。

Method: Auto-GlaKG 的方法先使用 ResNet50 网络预测杯盘比（CDR）和其他六种形态学标志，然后通过知识图谱推理将这些标志的贡献聚合为青光眼评分。

Result: 在利用分层、组意识的五折交叉验证评估的689张视网膜图像上，Auto-GlaKG实现了0.951的平均受试者操作特征曲线下面积（AUC），灵敏度为0.970，特异性为0.779。此模型的表现超过了仅基于图像的分类器，并且在替换预测的CDR时，AUC达到了0.995。

Conclusion: Auto-GlaKG 提供了基于图像的预测的显式规则层面解释，并指出需要使用独立测量的生物标志物来验证CDR估算的重要性。

Abstract: Interpretable glaucoma detection requires a transparent connection between fundus images, clinically meaningful biomarkers, and diagnostic predictions. Knowledge graph (KG) reasoning provides this structure, but performance measured using annotated biomarkers does not establish performance when only images are available. We present Auto-GlaKG, an automated framework that combines image-based biomarker prediction with fixed clinical-prior rules. A ResNet50 network predicts the cup-to-disc ratio (CDR) and six morphological signs using biomarker supervision, and a KG reasoner aggregates their signed rule contributions into a glaucoma score. On 689 fundus images evaluated using stratified, group-aware five-fold cross-validation, Auto-GlaKG achieves a pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.951 (95\% confidence interval: 0.931--0.969), with sensitivity of 0.970 and specificity of 0.779. The matched image classifier also achieves an AUC of 0.951, while the rule stage adds 0.2~ms per image. Replacing predicted CDR with its annotation increases fold-mean AUC from 0.953 to 0.995. The framework provides an explicit rule-level account of image-based predictions and identifies CDR estimation as a priority for validation using independently measured biomarkers.

</details>


### [146] [DuSS-PET: Self-Supervised Low-Dose PET Reconstruction Using Pseudo-Dual-Domain Consistency Without Paired Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11265)
*Shuijin Lin,Yuzhu He,Yongbo Wang,Jianhua Ma,Fan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DuSS-PET 提出了一种新颖的无监督 PET 重建框架，无需低剂量和全剂量配对数据即可实现高质量的 PET 图像重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PET 重建需要高辐射剂量，而有监督方法依赖于难以获取的低剂量和全剂量扫描配对数据。

Method: DuSS-PET 基于 Noisier2Noise 计算框架，通过贝努里数据腐蚀策略模拟低计数噪声模式，并融合了自适应 Swin 变换器、图像增强插件模块及一致性约束的无监督学习策略。

Result: DuSS-PET 在多中心数据集上表现优异，优于最先进的无监督学习方法并在不同剂量水平上达到或超过全监督方法的性能，尤其在不同扫描供应商上表现出色。

Conclusion: DuSS-PET 是首个强制重建图像与伪 Sino 图像之间一致性的自我监督低剂量 PET 重建框架，通过图像空间生成的伪 Sino 图像提供了一个计算一致性约束，使无全剂量训练扫描的情况下进行增强成像成为可能。

Abstract: Positron emission tomography (PET) is pivotal in medicine and healthcare, but requires high radiation doses for quality imaging. Although deep learning has shown promise for low-dose PET reconstruction/enhancement, existing methods primarily rely on fully supervised learning, which requires paired low- and full-dose scans that are clinically impractical to obtain. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we propose DuSS-PET, a novel self-supervised PET reconstruction framework that operates without any paired low- and full-dose data. Our method is built upon a computational Noisier2Noise (Nr2N) paradigm, featuring a Bernoulli corruption strategy that serves as an image-space approximation to emulate low-count noise patterns in image-derived pseudo-sinogram representations. The DuSS-PET framework integrates three core components: an adaptive Swin transformer for pseudo-sinogram restoration, a plug-and-play module for image enhancement, and a consistency-constrained SSL strategy that enforces agreement between the pseudo-sinogram and image representations. Extensive experiments on multi-center datasets demonstrate that DuSS-PET achieves superior reconstruction performance, outperforming state-of-the-art SSL methods and achieving comparable or even better results than fully supervised approaches across various dose levels. In particular, it exhibits exceptional generalization across different scanner vendors. This work is among the first self-supervised low-dose PET reconstruction framework that enforces consistency between reconstructed images and pseudo-sinograms, where the pseudo-sinogram generated in the image space serves as a solid computational consistency constraint for enhanced imaging without full-dose training scans. The source code will be publicly available at https://github.com/ladderlab-xjtu/DuSS-PET.

</details>


### [147] [BiRefNet-V2: Rethinking Bilateral Reference for High-Resolution Dichotomous Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11272)
*Peng Zheng,Deng-Ping Fan,Binglu Wang,Nicu Sebe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BiRefNet-V2改进了BiRefNet，通过空间到深度转换、重叠块和语义引导门进行局部保留和语义指导的细节注入，采用学习边界流生成全通道残差注意力，结合深度边界卷积和大内核注意力的双分支解码器，使用更新的框架缩短训练周期，并在多个检测任务中表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对二值图像分割中的局部空间结构丢失以及缺乏语义指导的问题，提出BiRefNet-V2以提高分割精度。

Method: BiRefNet-V2通过空间到深度转换和重叠块实现局部保留和语义引导的细节注入，采用学习边界流生成全通道残差注意力，并结合深度边界卷积和大内核注意力的双分支解码器，同时引入局部归一化、GELU激活函数和Lion优化器等现代框架。

Result: BiRefNet-V2在DIS5K，迷彩物体检测和高分辨率显著对象检测等任务上表现出优越性能。缩短了训练周期，减少了训练参数，降低了计算成本。代码已开源。

Conclusion: BiRefNet-V2改善了二值图像分割的精度和效率，为该领域的研究和应用提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Dichotomous image segmentation requires pixel-accurate foreground-background separation while preserving fine structures such as thin filaments, sharp edges, and intricate textures. BiRefNet addressed this challenge through bilateral references, combining image patches and gradient information, but its inward reference loses local spatial structure and lacks semantic guidance, while its outward reference relies on single-channel gradient attention. We recast this paradigm as controlled information recovery - locality determines what spatial information survives, semantic selectivity what information enters, and focused boundary supervision where refinement occurs - and propose BiRefNet-V2 to implement it: (1) locality-preserving and semantically guided detail injection through space-to-depth transformation, overlapping patches, and a Semantically Guided Gate; (2) a learned boundary stream with focused supervision that generates full-channel residual attention without requiring boundary annotations; and (3) a dual-branch decoder integrating depth-wise boundary convolutions with large-kernel attention. A modernized framework - LayerNorm, GELU, the Lion optimizer, and a DINOv3 backbone - cuts training from 600 to 50 epochs. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on DIS5K, camouflaged object detection, and high-resolution salient object detection across all 13 evaluation sets. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet-V2.

</details>


### [148] [HumanSightBench: A Benchmark for Human Visual Perception in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12305)
*Zixin Su,Yangguang Lin,Zegang Peng,Yuntong Sun,Xuanyi Wang,Jiahao Wang,Qiankai Xu,Bing Yuan,Jinze Bai,Youbin Wu,Jingjia Huang,Ruyang Liu,Yanxu Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HumanSightBench 是一个新的人类易解模型难解的数据集，包含2876个视觉问题，涉及7个主要感知类别和21个子类别。它通过五个筛选门限减少了歧义和外部知识的干扰，揭示了模型在数量计数任务上的不足，为未来训练实验提供了参考。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的多模态大语言模型在视觉语言基准数据集中的表现虽强，但在解决人类可以轻松解决的视觉问题上仍然存在困难。因此，有必要构建一个专门设计的评估基准，以更好地衡量模型的性能差距。

Method: HumanSightBench 数据集通过五个筛选门限来确保问题的质量：问题清晰度、答案唯一性、视觉对接、人类解题能力和纯文本捷径过滤。评价标准定义了错误为在人类验证的视觉任务中通过评估界面的不正确答案。

Result: HumanSightBench 包含2876个视觉问题，结果显示多模态大语言模型的最佳通过率@3为65.6%，且无模型在数量计数任务上超过27.5%的性能。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了模型在处理特定类别视觉问题时的能力差距，有助于未来训练实验和验证方法的改进。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on knowledge-intensive and reasoning-based vision-language benchmark datasets, but still struggle to solve the visual questions that people can solve easily. Evaluating the differences between MLLMs and human-level visual perception is challenging due to end-to-end evaluation which combines various skills, or because we are uncertain if individual items are valid. Specifically, observed errors may reflect visual perception, language priors, background knowledge, question ambiguity, and underspecified answers. Our guideline for HumanSightBench is that we construct items that are human-easy by construction and model-hard by evaluation. HumanSightBench contains 2,876 visual questions with short answers across 7 top-level perceptual categories and 21 subcategories. We only include items that pass five inclusion gates: question clarity, answer uniqueness, visual grounding, human solvability, and text-only shortcut filtering. According to the protocol, errors are defined as incorrect answers on human-validated visual tasks with the evaluated interface. The inclusion gates are intended to reduce confounds from ambiguity and external knowledge. The best pass@3 score is 65.6% across eight evaluated MLLMs. No evaluated model exceeds 27.5% on Counting. These results identify capability gaps that are hidden by overall scores and can help future training experiments and held-out evaluation.

</details>


### [149] [TransArt3D: From Two States to Articulated 3D Reconstruction with Video Transition Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11304)
*Chenhao Guan,Liying Yang,Xinxing Yu,Hao Mo,Tianshun Han,Renjun Gao,Yanyan Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TransArt3D 是一种优化框架，利用两幅端图像重建具有可交互部分的 3D 资产，通过过渡耦合的 3D 共识将静态 3D 先验应用于帧之间，稳定制动区域并初始化部分和关节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的优化方法存在数据不足的问题，以及视频扩散模型只能捕捉 2D 模式。因此需要一种新的方法来更好地捕捉 3D 运动。

Method: TransArt3D 通过结合静态 3D 先验和视频过渡先验，提出了一个分步骤的优化框架。首先，过渡耦合的 3D 共识应用于帧之间，稳定未改变区域，初始化部分和关节。然后，矫正流运动约束细化让视频先验指导整个过渡过程的 3D 运动场，限制运动并保持关节连贯性。最终，基于运动的规范图像融合利用恢复的关节信息，将两个端图像映射到规范表面。

Result: 在 PartNet-Mobility 数据集上，与其他给定相同两幅端图像的方法相比，TransArt3D 在几何和关节准确性方面表现更优；与给定六个观测状态的方法相比，在关联状态几何、关节定位和外观方面也表现更佳。

Conclusion: TransArt3D 通过显著改进现有的关节和几何精度，表明了利用视频过渡先验在解决 3D 资产重建中的欠约束问题方面的有效性。

Abstract: Reconstructing interactable articulated assets from a few images is key to robotics and simulation, yet highly underconstrained. Existing optimization-based methods fit an articulated asset under a static 3D prior that scores each state independently, so per-state reconstruction errors leak into the estimated moving part and joint as false motion. Video diffusion models capture how objects move between states, but only implicitly in 2D. To this end, we present TransArt3D, an optimization-based framework that reconstructs an articulated 3D asset from two endpoint images by translating this video transition prior into explicit part structure and joint kinematics. It first lifts frames generated between the endpoints with a transition-coupled 3D consensus that applies the static 3D prior jointly across frames, stabilizing unchanging regions and initializing the parts and joint. A rectified-flow kinematic refinement then lets the video prior supervise a 3D motion field over the whole transition, while part assignment and a shared joint constrain the field throughout optimization, keeping per-state errors out of the articulation. Finally, a motion-aware canonical appearance fusion uses the recovered articulation to map both endpoint images onto one canonical surface, texturing regions that only one state reveals. On PartNet-Mobility, TransArt3D outperforms methods given the same two endpoints in geometry and joint accuracy, and surpasses methods given six observed states in articulated-state geometry, joint localization and appearance.

</details>


### [150] [Evaluating Cross-Signal Coherence in Mammography Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12574)
*Rebeca Nam,Chase M. Fensore,Christian A. Fauria-Robinson,Judy Gichoya,Joyce C. Ho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究评估了四款视图-语言模型（VLMs）在乳腺密度和BI-RADS分类任务上的表现，通过改变问题、选项顺序和图像，发现模型的置信度在图像变化时保持稳定，但答案和解释可能会发生变化，且有时模型的解释与最终答案矛盾，这表明仅依赖准确率不足以评估VLMs的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前，VLMs在医疗图像解释中不仅提供标签，还包含置信度和解释。然而，学术界仍主要依赖准确性来评估VLMs。本文旨在改进这一评估标准，通过不同手段评估VLMs的输出一致性，从而更好地理解模型的真实性能。

Method: 对四个VLMs在乳腺密度和BI-RADS分类任务上的表现进行了评估。通过控制问题、多个选项顺序以及图像的变化，考察答案、置信度和解释的一致性。

Result: 研究表明，模型的置信度在图像变化时保持不变，但答案和解释可能会改变。还有情况下，模型的解释与其最终答案相矛盾。这一发现表明，单纯依赖准确性不能全面评估VLMs。

Conclusion: 本文的研究结果表明，VLMs在提供决策支持时，不仅需要关注准确性，还要考虑置信度和解释的合理性。未来的研究应开发更全面的评估方法来衡量VLMs在医疗图像分析中的表现。这为VLMs在医疗领域的应用提供了新的视角和挑战。

Abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) move toward interpreting medical images directly, their outputs increasingly include not just a label but a stated confidence and a written justification. Yet the field still predominantly evaluates VLMs using just accuracy. We evaluate the coherence between answer, confidence, and explanation across four VLMs on breast density and BI-RADS categorization, using two mammography datasets. We perform controlled perturbations of the question, multiple choice option orders, and the images and assess changes in the three outputs. Our results suggest confidence does not decrease even as the mammography image is changed. Shuffling the options also changes most VLMs' answers. Notably, there are cases where a model's own stated reasoning contradicts its final answer, a distinction accuracy alone cannot capture but one that governs whether an AI-generated answer can be trusted.

</details>


### [151] [Beyond Similarity Entropy: A Rank-Guided Data-Free Quantization Framework for Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11320)
*Runqing Jiang,Ye Zhang,Pengpeng Yu,Zhuo Song,Changjun Li,Longguang Wang,Yulan Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RankQ-ViT 提出了一种基于秩引导的数据无损量化框架，通过增强合成数据生成中的特征多样性，特别是在低比特量化下，展示了在多个数据集和架构上的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据无损量化方法依赖于模拟样本的相似性熵，但这种熵度量不能确保生成样本覆盖所有特征方向，可能导致量化校准效果有限。 RankQ-ViT 通过利用来自高斯噪声的特征矩阵秩通常低于实际图像的特点，提出了一种块感知的自对比目标，促进了合成样本中的特征多样性，而无需在每步优化中显式计算矩阵秩。

Method: RankQ-ViT 框架首先通过高斯噪声生成的特征矩阵秩较低这一观察，提出了块感知的自对比目标，生成具有更高特征多样性的同时避免每次优化时显式计算矩阵秩。进一步，基于样本的秩和语义一致性选择合成样本，用于块式的量化模型重建。

Result: RankQ-ViT 在 ImageNet、COCO、ModelNet40 和 ShapeNet 上的实验表明，该方法在多种架构和任务中都显示出了有效性，尤其在低比特量化时表现出色。

Conclusion: RankQ-ViT 为 ViTs 在移动设备上的优化部署提出了一个新的解决思路，提升了低比特量化下的模型性能。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have demonstrated remarkable performance, yet their computational and memory demands pose significant challenges for deployment on mobile devices. Data-free quantization (DFQ) enables the compression of ViTs without access to their original training data. Existing DFQ methods often synthesize calibration samples by maximizing the entropy of patch similarity. However, similarity entropy describes the dispersion of similarity values without ensuring that the generated samples cover diverse feature directions, potentially limiting their effectiveness for quantization calibration. To address this limitation, we propose RankQ-ViT, a rank-guided DFQ framework for ViTs. We first observe that patch similarity matrices derived from Gaussian noise tend to have lower ranks than those derived from real images. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a block-aware self-contrastive objective that promotes feature diversity during synthetic data generation without explicitly computing matrix rank at each optimization step. We then select calibration samples based on their rank and semantic consistency and use them for block-wise reconstruction of the quantized model. Experiments on ImageNet, COCO, ModelNet40, and ShapeNet demonstrate the effectiveness of RankQ-ViT across multiple architectures and tasks, particularly under low-bit quantization. The code is available at https://github.com/Runqing-forMost/rankq-vit.git

</details>


### [152] [Conditional Diffusion-Based Proxy Representation Recovery for BCVA Prediction with Missing SLO Modality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11326)
*Chuyi He,Hua Zou,Fei Luo,Zixian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种基于条件扩散的方法，用于恢复和融合扫描激光视网膜成像图(SLO)的代理表示，通过融合OCT图像特征和临床文本特征来改善在缺乏SLO图数据的情况下的术后最佳矫正视力预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态方法在实际临床数据中存在SLO图缺失的问题，这会影响手术后的最佳矫正视力预测，因此提出了基于条件扩散的方法来解决这一问题。

Method: 该方法通过首先将OCT图像特征和临床文本特征融合以构建OCT-text条件表示，以此引导扩散模型的逆噪声过程，从而估算样本特定的SLO代理表示。这些恢复的SLO代理表示进一步替代失真的SLO模态，并被整合到下游的多模态融合预测网络中，用于术后最佳矫正视力的预测。

Result: 该方法在包含58.80% SLO缺失样本的2141个术前多模态白内障样本上进行实验，实现了在绝对误差不超过0.1 LogMAR下的准确率为0.9714，均绝对误差为0.0423。相较于其他术后视力预测和缺失模态学习方法，该方法表现出更好的性能。

Conclusion: 研究表明，表示级别的代理恢复可以在一定程度上缓解SLO模态缺失对术后最佳矫正视力预测的影响。

Abstract: Preoperative prediction of postoperative best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) can support prognosis assessment and individualized decision-making in cataract surgery. Multimodal learning can integrate preoperative optical coherence tomography (OCT) images, scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO) images, and clinical text to characterize patient status. However, SLO images are often missing in real-world clinical data due to acquisition or data-management issues, resulting in incomplete multimodal inputs. To address this problem, this paper proposes a conditional diffusion-based method for SLO proxy representation recovery and fusion prediction. Instead of reconstructing raw SLO images, the proposed method formulates SLO missingness as proxy representation recovery in the latent feature space. Specifically, OCT image features and clinical text features are first fused to construct an OCT-text conditional representation, which guides the reverse denoising process of the diffusion model to estimate sample-specific SLO proxy representations. The recovered SLO proxy representation is then used as a substitute for the unavailable SLO modality and incorporated into the downstream multimodal fusion prediction network for postoperative BCVA prediction. Experiments were conducted on 2,141 preoperative multimodal cataract samples, with an SLO missing rate of 58.80%. The proposed method achieved an accuracy of 0.9714 under the criterion of an absolute prediction error within 0.1 LogMAR and a mean absolute error of 0.0423, outperforming representative postoperative visual acuity prediction and missing-modality learning methods. These results indicate that representation-level proxy recovery can alleviate the impact of SLO modality missingness on postoperative BCVA prediction.

</details>


### [153] [MoT3DVG: A Benchmark for Outdoor 3D Visual Grounding with Motion-Aware Descriptions and Temporal Cues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11334)
*Shijia Zhao,Xusheng Guo,Qiming Xia,Xun Huang,Kezheng Xiong,Zhihong Liu,Chenglu Wen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个名为MoT3DVG的新数据集，旨在支持动态感知的3D视觉 grounding，尤其适用于户外场景。同时提出了DynaVG框架，利用时间和动态信息改进了3DVG任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的3D视觉接地研究大多集中在室内静态物体，而户外动态交通工具的需求未得到满足。针对这一问题，本文提出了MoT3DVG数据集和DynaVG框架，旨在提高3D视觉接地在动态户外环境中的表现。

Method: 本研究通过引入一个包含运动描述的大型数据集，以及一个结合短时和长时间窗口编码的新型框架DynaVG，改进了3D视觉接地技术。

Result: DynaVG框架在MoT3DVG数据集上表现出最先进的性能，证明了其在3D视觉接地中的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文的研究结果指出了未来户外3D视觉接地研究中需要关注的关键问题，并提供了进一步发展的潜在方向。

Abstract: 3D visual grounding (3DVG) localizes language-referred objects in 3D scenes, with broad applicability in both indoor and outdoor environments. However, existing 3DVG research focuses on static indoor objects, limiting its use in dynamic outdoor autonomous driving. Motion descriptions, which capture the temporal dynamics of moving objects, offer a promising way to address this challenge. We therefore introduce MoT3DVG, a large-scale dataset for dynamic-aware outdoor 3DVG with temporally evolving motion descriptions. It contains 850 scenarios with 31,128 frames from nuScenes dataset, and provides 144,568 language prompts with motion-aware descriptions for dynamic objects across time. We further propose DynaVG, a novel framework that effectively leverages temporal cues for outdoor 3DVG. In addition to the standard modality-specific encoders, DynaVG introduces a Short-Long Integrated Dynamic Encoding (SLIDE) module before the language-point cloud alignment. SLIDE models both local motion cues and global temporal context via short-term window encoding and long-term window shifting. Extensive experiments demonstrate its state-of-the-art performance on MoT3DVG, validating the effectiveness of motion-aware encoding. Our work reveals open challenges and promising directions for future research in outdoor 3DVG.

</details>


### [154] [NuJEV: Structured Visual Judgments for Consistent Nuclei Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11359)
*Yonghuang Wu,Pengfei Wang,Zhenyang Liang,Yize Ma,Pengfei Song,Guoqing Wu,Jinhua Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NuJEV 通过联合训练视觉 LoRA 和并行头来预测核的存在、中心和类型，实现了优于直接生成的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了解决核数量化需要定位和分类核的问题，并提出了一种基于 Jev 的结构化决策方法，改进了核感知。

Method: 采用了联合训练视觉 LoRA 和并行头的方法，通过一个图像编码器同时为核头和原始语言解码器提供输入，并且解码器能够理解区域和类型请求。

Result: 在 2,732 张测试图像上，NuJEV 达到了总体的五查询平均绝对误差（MAE_5）1.844，稠密图像上的 MAE_5 为 5.268，定位/类型 F1 分别为 0.816 和 0.682。视觉适应的 ablation 实验显示，降低了 41.0% 的稠密误差。语言请求上，NuJEV 相对于直接生成减少了 76.2% 的 MAE。

Conclusion: NuJEV 显示出相较于直接生成更好的性能，在核感知方面具有潜力，且代码将作为开源发布。

Abstract: Nuclear quantification requires locating and typing nuclei, beyond generating a count. Inspired by Jev's structured decisions in place of free-form generation, we introduce NuJEV for nuclear perception in Qwen3-VL-2B. We jointly train visual LoRA and a parallel head to predict nuclear presence, centers, and types. One image encoding feeds both the nuclear head and original language decoder. The decoder interprets region and type requests, with counts computed from the predicted nuclei. On 2,732 PanNuke test images, NuJEV achieves a five-query mean absolute error ($\mathrm{MAE}_5$) of 1.844 overall and 5.268 on dense images, with localization/typed F1 of 0.816/0.682. A matched encoder ablation shows 41.0\% lower dense error with visual adaptation. For language requests, NuJEV reduces request MAE by 76.2\% relative to direct generation. Our code will be released as open source.

</details>


### [155] [SegDis: Foreground Segmentation Followed by Type Discrimination for Salient and Camouflaged Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11378)
*Dingning Luo,Shuo Dou,Tong Jiang,Xianfeng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文通过提出SegDis模型来同时处理凸出目标检测(SOD)和伪装目标检测(COD)任务，该模型将输出分解为显式前景概率和给定前景的条件类型概率。SegDis在USC12K数据集上达到了68.98%的FG-mIoU和78.35%的mIoU，参数量仅为USCNet的八分之一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前联合SOD和COD的方法大多只能输出二值掩码，不能区分两种类型且无法定位前景， USC12K虽能区分两种类型但其基础模型USCNet仍然将前景的存在和类型绑定到单个归一化中，因此无法归咎于失败的根源。因此，需要一种能够明确区分前景和背景，并且可以正确判断类型的新方法。

Method: SegDis模型将输出分解为两个部分，一是显式的前景概率，另一个是在前景背景条件下，类型的条件概率。FLR（Foreground Localization Refinement）用于提供高质量的任务无关支持，RTA（Region Type Assignment）则根据前景背景关系进行SOD/COD的重新分配。

Result: 结果显示，SegDis在USC12K数据集上取得了显著的性能，得到了68.98%的FG-mIoU和78.35%的mIoU，同时参数数量仅为USCNet的八分之一。

Conclusion: SegDis模型通过明确将前景和类型分开处理，对前景恢复和类型分配的错误进行了单独诊断，并在USC12K数据集上取得了优异的性能指标。

Abstract: Salient and camouflaged object detection (SOD and COD) both recover foreground support, yet most joint methods output only a binary mask and therefore cannot distinguish the type. USC12K distinguishes the two types, but its baseline USCNet still binds foreground existence to the type within a single normalization, so the failure source cannot be attributed. Our cross-task study shows that foreground localization transfers between SOD and COD, whereas type discrimination does not: a COD-only model recovers foreground on SOD images but its type judgement follows the training distribution rather than the foreground-background relation, so the two decisions require separate mechanisms. SegDis factorizes the output into an explicit foreground probability and a conditional type probability given foreground: FLR provides high-quality task-agnostic support, and RTA refines the SOD/COD assignment from the foreground-background relation without a task identifier. Because support is explicit, each ground-truth foreground pixel is classified as correct-type, type-swapped, or missed, so foreground-recovery and type-assignment errors are diagnosed separately. With PVT-v2-B2, SegDis attains 68.98% FG-mIoU and 78.35% mIoU on USC12K at about one-eighth of USCNet's parameters; CSCS is 5.75.

</details>


### [156] [Let the Gallery Learn Itself: Training-Free Iterative Side-View Face Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11391)
*Zijun Huang,Suncheng Xiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GSE通过自适应的画廊机制，在无需梯度更新的情况下，于识别前调整，显著改善侧视角度的识别性能并提升零错误率的检测率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的面部识别系统在遇到新面孔时需要重新训练模型来适应，而在GSE框架中，系统能够在无需训练的情况下适应新的面部信息，这使得系统更加灵活和高效。

Method: GSE采用了一种名为‘dedup-FIFO’的自运维机制，该机制在成功识别后自动保存新的面部特征，并且不会更新已注册的模板。这样，系统能够随着时间的推移不断适应新的面部数据。

Result: 在CFP-FP和IJB-C基准测试上，GSE在45°侧视角度的识别性能提高了23个百分点，并将 TAR@FAR=0.001 提高了9.4个百分点。

Conclusion: GSE提供了一种无需梯度更新且无需重新训练的面部识别方法，证明了该方法的有效性，在提高侧视角度识别性能的同时，降低了资源需求。

Abstract: What if a face recognition system could learn from every encounter without a single gradient update? We present Gallery Self-Evolution (GSE), a training-free framework where the gallery itself adapts at test time. The core mechanism---dedup-FIFO curation---archives novel appearance samples after successful recognition while permanently locking the enrollment template, bounded at 30 embeddings per identity. On CFP-FP and IJB-C benchmarks, GSE closes the side-view gap by +23 points at 45° yaw and boosts TAR@FAR=0.001 by +9.4 points, all at CPU-level cost. No retraining. No GPU. Just a gallery that grows smarter every time it meets you.

</details>


### [157] [GenRM-Flow: Generators are Process-aware Reward Models in Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11421)
*Siming Fu,Ruizhe He,Zheming Fu,Zeyue Xue,Fengkai Liu,Yufei Jiao,Jie Huang,Xiaoxiao Ma,Xuan Yang,Lihui Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的奖励模型框架GenRM-Flow，通过将其与视频生成模型结合，直接在噪声潜在空间中作为过程感知奖励模型运行。该框架基于一个视频生成器来优化奖励，这是通过对生成的视频的连续时间速度预测误差进行流匹配替代计算得到的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的视频奖励模型依赖于视觉语言模型或是固定生成器特征，这些方法没有考虑到生成器在预测速度、去除噪声和生成视频方面的能力。本文旨在通过优化生成器的连续时间速度预测误差来更好地反映人类对视频的偏好。

Method: 新框架GenRM-Flow通过将奖励项与分析解耦，并将生成的视频的log-likelihood转换为流匹配的近似来获得经验奖励。此外，不同的微调目标（如对比式DPO和IPO，以及非对比式RWR）都可以导向同一个最优策略，从而获得从生成器速度预测误差中读取的奖励。

Result: 该方法在下游视频生成中显示出可测量的改进，无需使用辅助的奖励网络，仅基于原始潜在输出直接驱动生成器的改进。

Conclusion: GenRM-Flow框架通过直接优化生成器的预测性能，能够更好地学习人类的视频偏好，而不是依赖视频的视觉特征，从而提高视频生成的质量。

Abstract: Aligning video generation models with human preference depends critically on the quality of the reward model that scores generated videos. Current video reward models, however, source their reward signal from a model's representational rather than generative capacity: they either repurpose vision-language models as pixel-space scorers, or train auxiliary scoring heads on top of frozen generator features. The generator's actual ability to predict velocities, denoise latents, and produce videos plays no role in scoring its own generations. We argue that this overlooks a structural property of offline preference learning. Any preference optimization objective that approximates an offline preference dataset mathematically targets a strictly defined KL-constrained optimal policy. By isolating the reward term from this analytical solution and mapping the exact generation log-likelihood to its flow-matching surrogate, the empirical reward emerges deterministically as the relative difference in continuous-time velocity-prediction errors. We formalize this equivalence into GenRM-Flow, a framework where a preference-tuned video generator inherently operates as a process-aware reward model directly in the noisy latent space. We further show theoretically that distinct fine-tuning objectives, whether contrastive like DPO and IPO or non-contrastive like RWR, are alternative optimization pathways toward the same optimal policy, each inducing a reward readout from the generator's velocity-prediction errors. Furthermore, the extracted process reward seamlessly substitutes external VLM scorers in FlowAWR. Operating purely on native latent outputs without auxiliary reward networks, this generative reward drives measurable improvements in downstream video generation.

</details>


### [158] [Flex-DDCM: Zero-Shot Task-Oriented Image Compression via Diffusion Trajectory Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11427)
*Yixin Gao,Runsen Feng,Xin Li,Zhibo Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了Flex-DDCM框架，通过指导噪声选择来调整编码的扩散轨迹，以适应不同任务的需求。该方法在保持图像感知质量的同时，还能优化下游任务性能，解码速度也更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的零样本图像压缩方法虽然可以生成视觉上令人愉悦的重建图像，但缺乏满足多种机器分析需求的灵活性。本文提出了一种新的框架Flex-DDCM，旨在改善这一点。

Method: Flex-DDCM通过任务指导噪声选择来调整编码的扩散轨迹，其影响被嵌入在压缩表示中，并且指导术语可以单独或组合应用，时间步长依赖的强度控制其在整个去噪过程中的作用。

Result: 实验表明，在保证像素保真度和感知质量的同时，Flex-DDCM可以灵活地在不同任务性能之间进行权衡，并且在性能上与训练的任务导向型编解码器相当，同时具有更快的解码速度。

Conclusion: 因此，Flex-DDCM为零样本任务导向的图像压缩提供了一种有效的方法，通过融合扩散模型的强大先验知识，改善了图像质量和任务性能之间的平衡。

Abstract: Recent zero-shot image compression methods exploit the powerful priors of pretrained diffusion models to produce perceptually pleasing reconstructions without compression-specific training. However, image compression serves not only human viewing but also machine analysis, while existing zero-shot codecs have limited flexibility in meeting the diverse reconstruction requirements of these applications. In this paper, we propose Flex-DDCM, a framework for zero-shot task-oriented image compression via diffusion trajectory guidance. Building on Turbo-DDCM, we adapt the coded diffusion trajectory through task-guided noise selection, embedding the effects of task guidance into the compressed representation. Guidance terms can be applied individually or combined, with timestep-dependent strengths controlling their influence throughout denoising. This design enables task adaptation without introducing additional decoding complexity. Experiments demonstrate flexible trade-offs among pixel fidelity, perceptual quality, and downstream task performance, with competitive performance against trained task-oriented codecs and faster decoding than Diff-ICMH.

</details>


### [159] [Unlearning at Speed: Rapid Activation Dampening for Efficient Machine Unlearning in Real-World Face Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11433)
*Rouqaiah Al-Refai,Leo Scheubel,Philipp Terhörst*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为RAD的方法，用于大规模开放集面部识别系统的机器遗忘，通过抑制与目标身份最相关的神经元来实现快速且针对性的遗忘，同时保持模型的整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着GDPR等法规的出现，用户有权要求删除其个人数据，这在基于面部识别的人脸验证场景中是个挑战。现有的遗忘方法主要针对封闭集分类的小型模型，无法很好地应用于大规模开放集的人脸识别系统，因此需要一个新的方法。

Method: RAD方法通过计算遗忘和保留身份的平均神经元激活差异，识别并选择性地抑制与目标身份最相关的神经元，同时引入了一种新的遗忘评分(FS)，以更适合评估开放集环境下的遗忘效果。

Result: 在多个大规模人脸识别架构和数据集上的实验表明，RAD可以实现有效的遗忘，同时保持模型的整体性能，并显著提高遗忘速度。

Conclusion: 研究结果证明RAD是一个可扩展且实用的方法，用于解决大规模开放集人脸识别系统中的机器遗忘问题。

Abstract: Machine unlearning has become increasingly important in face recognition, where regulations like the GDPR empower users to request the removal of their personal data from deployed models. However, most existing unlearning methods are designed for closed-set classification with small-scale models and training data, and therefore do not generalize to real-world face recognition systems, which operate in an open-set setting with large-scale models and data. In this work, we propose Rapid Activation Dampening (RAD), a fast and targeted unlearning method tailored specifically for large-scale open-set face recognition. RAD approximates differences in average neuron activations between forget and retain identities, identifying and selectively suppressing neurons that are most associated with the targeted identity through a sensitivity-controlled dampening mechanism.
