We further propose the Forget Score (FS), which addresses the mismatch between existing unlearning metrics and open-set problems by providing a probabilistic interpretation of forgetting directly in the representation space. Experiments across several recent large-scale face recognition architectures and datasets show that RAD achieves strong forgetting while preserving overall model utility and substantially improving unlearning speed. These findings establish RAD as a scalable and practical approach to machine unlearning in face recognition systems.

</details>


### [160] [How to "train" a surgeon? Benchmarking generalist agents in surgical scene understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11437)
*Gengyuan Zhang,Xiao Han,Shijie Zhou,Abdullah Koukash,Jingpei Wu,Jindong Gu,Yuqicheng Zhu,Nassir Navab,Volker Tresp,Ghazal Ghazaei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种两阶段评估框架来评估多模态大型语言模型在手术场景理解中的性能，通过引入SurgKnowBench和SurgAgentGym来分别评估模型的预训练能力和手术理解和应用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多模态大型语言模型在手术场景理解中的表现有限，主要原因在于缺乏特定手术数据和不统一的评估标准。因此，研究者提出了一个两阶段评估框架以克服这些挑战。

Method: 该研究设计了一种两阶段的评估框架，第一阶段使用SurgKnowBench将公开的手术数据集统一化并评估预训练的多模态大型语言模型；第二阶段则通过SurgAgentGym，让这些语言模型在手术任务中应用感知信息，评估其在手术理解方面的表现。

Result: 结果显示，通用模型在感知密集型任务中有所进步，但在精细定位和专家级别的评估方面仍存在不足。

Conclusion: 研究表明，虽然通用多模态大型语言模型在某些方面已经能够应用手术相关的信息进行手术理解，但要达到高水平的手术理解仍有许多挑战需要克服。未来的研究可以进一步探索这些模型的潜在能力。

Abstract: Evaluating general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for surgical scene understanding remains limited due to scarce surgical data and fragmented evaluation protocols. We address these challenges through a two-stage evaluation framework for surgical scene understanding. In Stage I, we introduce SurgKnowBench, a diagnostic benchmark that harmonizes public surgical datasets across procedures and tasks and evaluates proprietary and open-source MLLMs to map the boundary of pretrained surgical competence. SurgKnowBench reveals that current models retain partial visual priors but remain weak on relational and procedural understanding and workflow assessment. Building on this failure frontier and motivated by the scaffolded nature of surgical training, we introduce SurgAgentGym, an agentic environment where general-purpose MLLM agents can use bounded knowledge search over SurgWiki and general-purpose visual grounding for surgical tasks. SurgAgentGym evaluates whether generalist agents can improve surgical understanding at inference time through tool-mediated evidence use, without additional surgical training. Our results show that agentic inference narrows the gap mainly for perception-heavy tasks, while fine-grained localization and expert-style assessment remain persistent bottlenecks. This opens a path toward future studies of agentic surgical understanding.

</details>


### [161] [Semantically Aligned KV Cache Compression for Efficient Agentic Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11452)
*Weizhong Huang,Huaijia Kou,Tianyu Xie,Xiawu Zheng,Liujuan Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SemanticKV 是一种无需训练的方法，用于使用规划器提取的语义约束对 KV 缓存进行压缩，从而减少视觉历史的存储并提高合成控制性，实验结果显示其在压缩比为0.7的情况下，速度提升了1.22倍，且在内存使用上减少了3.35倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有压缩方法主要优化单个生成器而不考虑规划器的语义约束，可能导致重要状态被忽略。

Method: Text cross-attention识别与约束相关的位置，将其自注意力查询分组。在每个组内取平均，在组间取最大值，从而为每个缓存项分配高分。采用单次top-k选择来保留高评分项，同时保持键、值和位置不变。

Result: 在四个不同的AR视频框架上进行实验，结果表明，与最强的基准压缩相比，SemanticKV在5，30和60秒生成中取得了84.10的VBench Total Score，速度提高了1.22倍，内存使用减少了3.35倍。

Conclusion: SemanticKV 方法验证了使用语义约束进行KV 缓存压缩的有效性，在性能和效率方面均达到了很好的平衡。

Abstract: Agentic autoregressive video generation combines semantic planning, sequential generation, and visual verification for controllable synthesis. Growing visual histories enlarge the key-value (KV) cache, increasing memory use and attention costs across candidate rollouts. Existing compression methods primarily optimize individual generators without the planner's semantic constraints, risking low priority for states supporting requested attributes or actions. We introduce SemanticKV, a training-free method for semantically aligned KV cache compression. To our knowledge, SemanticKV is the first KV cache compression method for agentic autoregressive video generation that explicitly uses planner-extracted semantic constraints to guide retention. Text cross-attention identifies constraint-related video positions, whose self-attention queries are collected into separate groups. Attention weights are averaged within each group and maximized across groups, giving each cached entry a high score when strongly used by any represented constraint. A single top-k selection retains high-scoring entries under the memory budget, leaving their keys, values, and positions unchanged. For fixed query groups and equal entry costs, this selection minimizes an additive upper bound on worst-group discarded attention. The method operates independently within each candidate without retraining or additional video generations. We evaluate four AR video backbones on three benchmarks for 5-, 30-, and 60-second generation. On Causal Forcing at a compression ratio of 0.7, SemanticKV obtains a VBench Total Score of 84.10, compared with 84.05 for the strongest compressed baseline and 83.99 for Full KV. It achieves a 1.22x speedup over Full KV and reduces KV-cache memory from 6.04 GB to 1.81 GB, a 3.35x reduction.

</details>


### [162] [ForeAct: Geometry-Guided Action Learning from World Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11500)
*Wei Lu,Jiaxi Zhang,Yunheng Wang,Taowen Wang,Yuetong Fang,Zhenhui Zhang,Shuning Zhang,Zizhao Yuan,Yixiao Feng,Zecui Zeng,Renjing Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ForeAct 通过利用预训练的视频世界模型并在单次前向传递中处理当前观察的干净潜空间，实现了低延迟控制，而无需未来的帧合成或迭代去噪，同时通过可学习的标记实现空间知识到未来导向表示的转变，从而实现了低延迟、几何感知的控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的机器人操纵方法大多分别处理场景几何结构和交互过程中场景结构的演变，这导致了高计算成本和缺乏对空间结构的明确建模。为了解决这些问题，作者提出了一种新的方法ForeAct，利用预训练的视频世界模型实现低延迟控制。

Method: ForeAct 直接处理当前观察的干净潜空间，采用双向自注意力机制，通过可学习的标记和未来帧相对深度的监督，将空间知识转换为未来导向的表示，从而实现低延迟、几何感知的控制。

Result: ForeAct 在 LIBERO、SimplerEnv-Bridge 和 90 个真实的实验场景中的成功率分别为 96.6%、63.5% 和 74.4%，展示了其在低延迟和几何感知控制方面的卓越性能。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了 ForeAct，一种基于预训练视频世界的低延迟、几何感知的控制方法，通过利用空间知识的前瞻性表示，显著降低了计算成本并提高了交互场景中的表现。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation requires representations that capture both scene geometry and its evolution during interaction. Existing approaches have largely treated these two aspects separately. World action models capture such dynamics by coupling action prediction with future video generation, but their reliance on iterative diffusion or rectified-flow inference leads to high computational cost, while their representations lack explicit spatial structure. Explicitly modeling scene geometry typically requires auxiliary modules that increase both parameter count and computational cost. Conversely, geometry-centric policies primarily recover observed spatial structure and often lack explicit supervision for anticipating future geometric changes during interaction. To address these limitations, we introduce ForeAct, which repurposes a pretrained video world model as a single-pass representation backbone for low-latency control. ForeAct directly processes the clean latent of the current observation in one forward pass, eliminating future-frame synthesis and iterative denoising while retaining the backbone's pretrained spatiotemporal priors. Rather than introducing a separate geometry backbone, ForeAct uses learnable tokens supervised by next-frame relative depth to shape the shared video representation through bidirectional self-attention. This compact interface turns the spatial knowledge already encoded in the backbone into a future-aware representation for action generation, with little parameter overhead. The lightweight geometry readout is used only during training and removed at deployment, enabling low-latency, geometry-aware control without depth input or an external geometry backbone. Without additional large-scale pretraining, ForeAct achieves 96.6% average success on LIBERO, 63.5% on SimplerEnv-Bridge, and a 74.4% success rate across 90 real-world rollouts.

</details>


### [163] [AgentCT: A Vision-Language Agent for Universal CT Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11503)
*Zhihao Chen,Qi Gao,Chuang Niu,Qiegen Liu,Yi Zhang,Hongming Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AgentCT 是一个视觉-语言代理，能够在低剂量CT、稀视CT和金属伪影减少任务间切换，通过控制器和专门的图像恢复模型实现精确识别和针对性处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管低剂量CT、稀视CT和金属伪影减少的任务各具特色，传统的CT恢复方法大多使用单一网络来处理，这可能会导致性能不佳。因此，本研究提出了一个能够自动识别不同类型CT损伤的视觉-语言代理 AgentCT。

Method: AgentCT 基于 LoRA 调整的 Qwen3-VL-4B 控制器，能够预测损伤类型和严重程度，并选择相应的专家模型。对于低剂量CT，采用图像域的扩散模型；稀视CT和金属伪影减少则结合了投影域纠正、数据一致性、可微滤波反投影和图像精修。

Result: 在 Mayo 2020 腹部CT数据上分别针对三种严重程度进行评价，AgentCT 达到了95.7%的损伤类型识别准确率和93.9%的损伤严重程度识别率，且 PSNR/SSIM 平均值分别为46.18 dB/0.984，优于 AMIR 和 TAMP。特别地，在稀视CT场景下，其双域专家模型仅使用4.2百万参数即达到了46.04 dB的 PSNR，比单任务AMIR的44.43 dB和所有任务集成的AMIR（使用23.5百万参数）的43.57 dB表现更优。

Conclusion: AgentCT 提供了基于控制器的模型选择机制，用于支持不同类型CT损伤的专门恢复，其结果表明自动路由和专业模型选择能够有效提高CT图像的质量，但未来的工作仍然需要在自动化路由下评估独立临床数据上的表现。

Abstract: Computed tomography (CT) restoration methods often use a single network for low-dose CT (LDCT), sparse-view CT (SVCT), and metal artifact reduction (MAR), despite the distinct physics of these degradations. We propose AgentCT, a vision-language agent that identifies the degradation and routes images to task-specific restoration models. A LoRA-adapted Qwen3-VL-4B controller predicts degradation type and severity, selects a specialist, and reassesses the restored image. The LDCT specialist uses an image-domain diffusion model, whereas the SVCT and MAR specialists combine projection-domain correction, data consistency, differentiable filtered back-projection, and image refinement. We evaluated the controller and specialists separately on patient-disjoint Mayo 2020 abdominal CT data across three severity levels for each degradation. The controller achieved 95.7% accuracy for degradation type and 93.9% for severity, with a 100% JSON parse rate. Using ground-truth degradation labels for routing, AgentCT achieved an overall PSNR/SSIM of 46.18 dB/0.984, compared with 44.93 dB/0.976 for AMIR and 44.29 dB/0.979 for TAMP, and attained the highest PSNR in all nine settings. For SVCT, its dual-domain specialist achieved 46.04 dB with 4.2 million parameters, compared with 44.43 dB for single-task AMIR and 43.57 dB for all-in-one AMIR with 23.5 million parameters. These results support degradation-specific CT restoration with controller-based model selection; evaluation under automatic routing and on independent clinical data remains necessary. Code is available at https://github.com/hao1635/AgentCT.

</details>


### [164] [Reaching Is Not Finding: Map-Anchored Visual Prompting for the Last Mile of Aerial Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11510)
*Ningbo Li,Kebin Liu,Jingcan Chen,Weichen Zhang,Rong Ding,Yunhao Liu,Mo Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这种间隙是由导航器所面临的一种特殊任务设定所导致的，即导航器学会接近标记而不是识别描述中的物体。MAP-VP模块可以将指定的地标投影到无人机当前视图上，有助于提高识别准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究发现，现有的导航器无论采用模仿学习还是微调大模型的方法，都存在一个重要的结构性问题：即使接近了目标位置，也无法准确识别目标物体。这类问题在不同的导航器设计中普遍存在，特别是在地标较多、表述复杂的环境中。

Method: MAP-VP模块通过将地图上的地标轮廓投射到无人机视图上，利用一个微调的小模型来相对地标识别目标物体。这种方法在不重新训练任何导航器的情况下提高了六种导航器在CityNav数据集上的表现。

Result: MAP-VP模块显著提升了六种导航器的性能。特别是对于两种表现最强的导航器，HETT分别提高了28.7%和24.7%，而CityNav的官方基于检测器的最后一步则仅提高了不到2个百分点。

Conclusion: MAP-VP通过增强地标识别能力，填补了无人机VNL任务中的重要空白，展示了在不大幅改动现有导航器架构的情况下提升其准确性的潜力。

Abstract: Aerial vision-language navigation (VLN) asks a drone to find an object described in natural language. The description usually locates the object relative to named landmarks, such as streets and buildings. We observe that current navigators often bring the drone close to the target and then stop at the wrong place: they reach the target without finding it. This gap is shared by navigators of very different designs, from imitation learners to a fine-tuned 7B vision-language model. A simple test reveals the cause. When we replace the target object in the instruction with another one next to the same landmarks, no navigator goes to it, and most stop where they did before. Navigators learn to reach the landmarks, not to identify the described object. We therefore propose MAP-VP, a plug-and-play module for the last step. After any navigator stops, MAP-VP draws the landmarks named in the instruction onto the drone's current view, using the landmark outlines that the benchmark provides on a map. A fine-tuned 4B vision-language model then locates the target relative to these landmarks. The training data are generated automatically from the benchmark annotations. Neither drawing the landmarks nor fine-tuning helps much alone, but together they are highly effective. Without retraining any navigator, MAP-VP significantly improves all six navigators we test on CityNav. It roughly doubles the success rate of the two strongest trained navigators, raising HETT from 25.9% to 54.6% and FlightGPT from 24.2% to 48.9%, whereas CityNav's official detector-based last step adds less than two points to HETT.

</details>


### [165] [InfCoiL: Coordinated Planner-Controller Learning for Closed-Loop Physics-Based Human-Object Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11517)
*Yude Zou,Yifei Yao,Yiwei Hao,Hanqing Wang,Xing Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: InfCoiL 是一种新的闭环框架，用于基于物理的人-物交互（HOI），它结合了形态感知的流动匹配规划器和统一的多形态控制器，通过共享的形态接口在自回归计划和执行循环中工作。这种方法能够改善物理追踪精度并提高目标获取任务的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的规划-控制器系统要么开环执行规划，要么闭环执行但保持规划器固定，这会导致规划中不考虑执行反馈。InfCoiL 通过结合流动匹配规划器和多形态控制器，能够在执行过程中利用反馈进行学习和优化。

Method: InfCoiL 采用了一种新颖的自动回归计划-执行循环方法，通过共享形态接口连接流程匹配规划器和多形态控制器。规划器的优化引入了语义流动策略优化（SFPO），这是一种将选择性的噪声消除过渡随机化并赋予群体相对的序列级奖励的方法。

Result: 实验结果显示，InfCoiL 在目标获取任务的成功率和物理追踪精度方面优于现有的开环层次基线。

Conclusion: InfCoiL 提供了一种有效的方法，用于在基于物理的人-物交互场景中实现复杂的高层面意图，并能通过优化过程中的反馈进行实时学习。

Abstract: Text- and goal-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) provides an intuitive interface for specifying high-level intents in physics-based character animation. Mapping such intents to physically plausible, contact-rich behaviors naturally calls for a generative planner and a physics-based controller, yet existing planner-controller systems either execute plans open-loop or close the loop while keeping the planner fixed, so execution feedback never reshapes what is planned. We present InfCoiL, a closed-loop framework for physics-based HOI from coordinated planner-controller learning. InfCoiL couples a morphology-aware flow-matching planner with a unified multi-morphology controller through a shared morphology interface in an autoregressive plan-and-execute loop, and alternately fine-tunes both components with reinforcement learning from the same physical rollouts. To optimize the flow-matching planner online, we introduce Semantic Flow Policy Optimization (SFPO), which stochasticizes selected denoising transitions with channel-wise semantic covariance over heterogeneous HOI features and assigns group-relative, sequence-level rewards from complete closed-loop executions. On held-out OMOMO sequences, InfCoiL outperforms open-loop hierarchical baselines in goal-reaching task success and physical tracking accuracy. Project page: https://infcoil.github.io/

</details>


### [166] [Dropping Tokens Without Dropping Them: Causal Attribution for Diabetic Retinopathy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11547)
*Pramath Girish Haritz,Chandra Sekhar Seelamantula*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了视觉变换器中基于注意力的归因图是否能为糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分类提供因果解释，引入了贡献和拉力两种归因图，并展示了拉力在因果对齐、必要性和充分性方面优于其他方法，证明了此方法在医学诊断中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来深度学习模型在医疗影像诊断中的应用越发广泛，但缺乏有效的解释性，因此本研究旨在探索基于注意力机制的归因图是否能提供有效的因果解释，以提高医疗影像诊断模型的可靠性和透明度。

Method: 本研究使用了MAPLES-DR数据集，通过分解注意力机制为贡献和拉力两种归因图，并通过删除/插入标记的方法测试了每种图在因果忠实性方面的表现。此外，还通过对比特定方法在平均精度上的表现，验证了所得方法的有效性。

Result: 研究结果表明，拉力在因果对齐、必要性和充分性方面表现出色，超过了Attention Rollout、Grad-CAM和AttnLRP方法。同时，在具有可比性的HRDecoder方法上，拉力达到了其约70%的平均精度，而后者需要像素级别的监督信息。此外，虽然Occlusion保留了更大的充要性但计算效率较低。

Conclusion: 实验结果证明，贡献和拉力两种归因图可以形成高效可靠的归因映射，用于在安全关键的医疗诊断中进行因果解释，从而提高诊断系统的可解释性。

Abstract: In this work, we investigate whether attention-based attribution maps in a vision transformer provide causal explanations for diabetic retinopathy (DR) classification. We introduce a principled decomposition of attention into two attribution maps: the contribution ($c_t$), which satisfies the completeness axiom in explainable artificial intelligence (xAI), and the pull ($p_t$), which quantifies causal explanations. We define an identity relating $c_t$ and $p_t$ that characterizes when $c_t$ fails to capture causality. We test whether each map is causally faithful on the MAPLES-DR dataset by dropping/inserting tokens, and report Necessity ($N$), Sufficiency ($Su$), and Faithfulness Correlation ($FC$). The pull $p_t$ achieves the highest causal alignment ($FC = 0.53$, $N = 0.71\%$, $Su = 3.0\%$), outperforming Attention Rollout, Grad-CAM, and AttnLRP. Occlusion retains better sufficiency ($Su = 1.6\%$) but is about 800 times slower. Furthermore, on MAPLES-DR, $p_t$ achieves $70\%$ of the average precision (AP) of HRDecoder, a state-of-the-art supervised lesion segmentation model, despite the absence of pixel-level supervision. Together, these findings show that the pull $p_t$ and the contribution $c_t$ form computationally efficient attribution maps for reliable causal interpretation in safety-critical medical diagnostics. The code and demo are available at https://github.com/pramath-haritz/dr-xai.

</details>


### [167] [NightSteps: A Night-Time Dataset and Benchmark for Pedestrian Crossing Intention Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11583)
*Sjoerd Takken,Shaodi You*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文构建了一个名为NightSteps的数据集，用作夜间过街意图预测基准。通过使用Gemini、ChatGPT和人类评估，研究了数据集的适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的行人过街意图预测模型在夜间和低光条件下的鲁棒性尚不清楚，因为缺乏夜间视频数据集。因此，该论文旨在评估NightSteps数据集的有效性，用作未来模型评估的基准。

Method: 论文通过收集来自六个城市夜间行车记录仪的视频，构造了NightSteps数据集。该数据集包括行人位置的原始数据、准确的过街行为标签以及从Gemini、ChatGPT和人类评估结果的预测。

Result: 人类评估在准确性和F1分数上分别达到了88.17%和80.21%。Gemini和ChatGPT的预测准确率分别为60%和79.13%，F1分数分别为42.50%和63.64%。

Conclusion: NightSteps数据集可以用于未来模型评估，以测试夜间行人过街意图预测（PCIP）的性能，提高夜间道路安全性。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles use pedestrian crossing intention prediction (PCIP) to participate safely in traffic. Existing models are largely trained under favourable daytime conditions with sufficient daylight. Little is known about the robustness of these models under night-time and low-light conditions, due to the lack of datasets containing night-time footage. This paper investigates how a dataset, named NightSteps, can be constructed and evaluated as a baseline benchmark. The dataset is based on nighttime dashcam footage collected from six different cities around the world, capturing a wide variety of road conditions. The dataset consists of dashcam-recorded point-of-view footage, raw data of pedestrians' locations with corresponding 'track ids' and ground-truth labels containing accurate information about pedestrian crossing behaviour, resulting in a diverse dataset. Gemini, ChatGPT, and human assessment are used to demonstrate the usability of the dataset by predicting crossings in clips from the dataset and comparing the results with the initial ground-truth labels. These results show that human input achieves an accuracy of 88.17% and an F1-score of 80.21%. Predictions from Gemini and ChatGPT perform lower, with accuracies of 60% and 79.13% respectively, and F1-scores of 42.50% and 63.64%. The evaluation demonstrates that the NightSteps dataset can be used for future model evaluation to test the performance of PCIP, with the aim of improving road safety at night.

</details>


### [168] [FastGRT: Accelerating Training of 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11586)
*Meet Banthia,Xiaoteng Liu,Hexu Zhao,Aurojit Panda,Jinyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过分析 GPU 上基于高斯的光线追踪（GRT）计算方式，提出 FastGRT 方法来提高性能，同时保留原有渲染公式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于高斯的光线追踪（GRT）相比 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）需要更高的训练成本。本文旨在通过改进计算组织方式，减少训练成本。

Method: 作者研究了在 GPU 上执行使用高斯的光线追踪方法，并提出 FastGRT，通过分离光线遍历和混合操作，并利用前向传播的工作来优化后向传播。

Result: FastGRT 进一步结合了快速梯度累积和混合 BVH 更新策略来解决训练管道中的其他主要瓶颈。与 3DGRT 相比，FastGRT 将训练时间提高 1.9 至 4.97 倍，同时保留了原有的渲染公式。

Conclusion: 作者在 Vulkan 中实现了 FastGRT，这是首个支持训练和渲染的基于 Vulkan 的 GRT 实现。

Abstract: Ray Tracing enables rendering capabilities that are difficult to achieve with rasterization-based approaches such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). However, the training cost of Gaussian-based ray tracing (GRT) is much higher than that of 3DGS. In this paper, we study how ray tracing using Gaussians executes on GPUs and show that a considerable fraction of the training cost arises from how the computation is organized. We develop FastGRT, which decouples ray traversal from blending and reuses work done in the forward pass for the backward pass. FastGRT further incorporates optimizations such as fast gradient accumulation and a hybrid BVH update strategy to tackle other major bottlenecks in the training pipeline. We implement FastGRT in Vulkan. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first Vulkan-based GRT implementation that supports both training and rendering. Compared to 3DGRT, FastGRT improves training time by 1.9$\times$ to 4.97$\times$, while preserving the original rendering formulation. Our code is open source.

</details>


### [169] [Martine: Benchmarking Multi-View 3D Surface Reconstruction Across Viewpoint Coverage, Resolution, and Lighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11602)
*Robin Bruneau,Baptiste Brument,Frederic Giraud,Bastian Sigrist,Sascha Jecklin,Philipp Fürnstahl,Bjoern Menze,Lilian Calvet*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Martine 提供了 28 个对象的多视角 3D 表面重建基准，包含透明材料和精细结构，提供了全面的校准信息和高精度的 3D 地面truth，实现了对多视角重建方法的精确评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的基准测试方法存在着限制视角覆盖、分辨率或照明等偏见，无法全面评估多视角 3D 表面重建方法。为了提供一个更为精确和全面的评价基准，作者开发了 Martine。

Method: Martine 包括 28 个对象，以 9568x6376 像素从 84 个视角在一个球形帽覆盖下拍摄，包含单一光源和多光源两种照明模式。这些对象包括透明材料和精细结构，使用高分辨率图像并提供了包括相机校准、高精度 3D 地面truth、图像到几何图形的校准准确性以及3D属性掩码等全面信息。

Result: 在多种重建方法，如光学校正法、经典多视角立体视觉、神经隐式表面重建和多视角光度立体视觉方法的实验中，Martine 显示出了能够实现对多种方法的全面评价。并且能够分辨毫米级甚至亚毫米级的重建差别，Chamfer 距离最低可达 0.058 mm。

Conclusion: Martine 为多视角 3D 表面重建提供了一个高质量的基准，允许明确地控制参考数据的准确性，使得不同重建方案之间的比较更为公平和精确。

Abstract: Controlled acquisition setups are widely used for high-accuracy multi-view 3D surface reconstruction, as they allow sensor configuration, image resolution, viewpoint distribution, and illumination to be specified. Yet benchmarking remains difficult, since reconstruction accuracy depends jointly on the reconstruction paradigm, object properties, and acquisition regime. Existing benchmarks often restrict viewpoint coverage, resolution, or illumination, which can bias comparisons towards methods suited to the chosen setting. Others lack accurate 3D ground truth or quantified image-to-geometry alignment, limiting their use for metric surface evaluation. We introduce Martine, a benchmark for controlled 3D object surface reconstruction. Martine comprises 28 objects, including transparent materials and fine structures, captured at 9568 x 6376 pixels from 84 views over a spherical cap under both single-light and multi-light regimes. It provides object-independent camera calibration, accurate 3D ground-truth scans, calibration and image-to-geometry accuracy quantified on test images, and 3D property masks for analysing errors by material properties, visibility, curvature and fine structures. Experiments across photogrammetry, classical multi-view stereo, neural implicit surfaces, Gaussian-splatting-based reconstruction, and multi-view photometric stereo show that Martine enables regime-aware evaluation with explicit control over reference-data accuracy. The benchmark resolves sub-millimetric reconstruction differences, with a best observed Chamfer distance of 0.058 mm over the evaluated visible surface.

</details>


### [170] [Rethinking Geometric Depth in Monocular 3D Object Detection: A Projection-Consistent Reformulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11607)
*Zhihao Zhang,Abhinav Kumar,Huaizhi Qu,Tianlong Chen,Xiaoming Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MonoPCA提出了一种解决单目3D检测中前后表面偏差的方法，通过在投影一致重构中结合对象大小和方向，改善了深度估计精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目3D检测依赖于从单张图像中恢复深度，传统的方法存在前后表面偏差，导致尺寸依赖的深度估计低估。MonoPCA旨在解决这一问题，通过结合对象的大小和方向来改善深度估计。

Method: MonoPCA提出了一个统一框架MonoPCA，其中核心的PCDepth通过保持可测量的2D高度$h_{2D}$并引入一个基于透视几何的定向和尺寸感知修正来弥补中心深度的差距，从而消除偏差。

Result: MonoPCA在四个具有挑战性的基准上实现了最佳性能，包括在KITTI排行榜上提高了1.44%的AP$_{3D}$和在Omni3D$_{OUT}$上提高了2.80%。

Conclusion: MonoPCA通过引入GeoAlign框架，使深度检测与对象的大小和方向关联，提高了3D检测的准确性，特别是在具有挑战性的场景下表现出色。

Abstract: Monocular 3D detection (Mono3D) hinges on recovering depth from a single image, for which the geometric formulation $z \approx f \cdot H / h_{2D}$ is widely adopted due to its simplicity and direct grounding in projective geometry. We show that this formulation harbors a systematic, projection-induced bias: substituting the 2D bounding-box height $h_{2D}$ recovers the depth of an object's visible front surface rather than its center, causing size-dependent underestimation that persists even under ground-truth inputs. We address this front-surface bias with MonoPCA, a unified framework built on a projection-consistent reformulation. At its core, PCDepth retains the measurable $h_{2D}$ and closes the gap to center depth through an orientation- and size-aware correction derived from perspective geometry, eliminating the bias without introducing ill-posed regression targets. Because PCDepth couples depth to predicted object size and orientation, attribute perception becomes essential. We therefore introduce GeoAlign, a teacher-student framework that transfers geometric representations from Vision Foundation Models into a lightweight student, strengthening attribute perception at no inference cost. Across four challenging benchmarks, MonoPCA achieves SoTA performance, including a +1.44% AP$_{3D}$ gain on the KITTI leaderboard and +2.80% on Omni3D$_{OUT}$. Code is available at https://github.com/alanzhangcs/MonoPCA.

</details>


### [171] [MICE: Multi-animal Interaction Context Encoder - A Hierarchical Foundation Model for Mouse Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11644)
*Yen-Shuo Su,Weihan Li,Anqi Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MICE是一种用于多动物交互上下文编码的自监督基础模型，能够在不重新训练的情况下处理不同数量的动物群体，超越了现有的关键点基础模型基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自监督姿态模型无法处理多动物相互作用的行为，因为它们通常独立编码每个动物并丢弃交互信号。MICE旨在解决这个问题，通过在一个模型中同时处理多个动物的行为来提高行为识别能力。

Method: MICE采用了一种分层个体编码器，能够捕获每只动物的动态，并结合了一种受Perceiver架构启发的社交编码器，学习到的可变大小的码本能够在无需重新训练的情况下支持任何数量的动物群体。

Result: MICE在四种评估协议中的六种数据集上匹配或超过了先前的关键点基于的基础模型基准。层次式探针显示社交编码器在个体编码器的基础上进一步提高了区分能力。

Conclusion: MICE为多动物交互行为分析提供了一种有效的方法，能够在处理不同数量的动物群体时无需重新训练。

Abstract: Quantifying mouse behavior from pose is a foundational tool in neuroscience, ethology, drug discovery, and animal welfare. Self-supervised foundation models are a natural fit, but a foundation model for mouse behavior must handle social behavior - many behaviors that matter (aggression, courtship, mounting, allogrooming) are inherently multi-animal. Existing self-supervised pose models fall short: they encode each animal independently and discard interaction signal, hard-code the animal count, and pretrain one dataset at a time. We introduce MICE (Multi-animal Interaction Context Encoder), a hierarchical foundation model for mouse behavior that pretrains jointly on six mouse-pose corpora spanning one to four mice and 7 to 27 keypoints. MICE combines a hierarchical individual encoder capturing per-mouse kinematics at multiple temporal scales with a Perceiver-style social encoder whose learned latent codebook decouples parameter count from animal count, so a single checkpoint serves any group size without retraining. Across four evaluation protocols spanning six datasets, MICE matches or exceeds prior keypoint-based baselines, and layer-wise probing shows the social stage incrementally improves discriminability beyond the individual encoder. Code, weights, and data are available at https://github.com/eric0708/MICE.

</details>


### [172] [Med-DualLoRA: Local Adaptation of Foundation Models for 3D Cardiac MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10967)
*Joan Perramon-Llussà,Amelia Jiménez-Sánchez,Grzegorz Skorupko,Fotis Avgoustidis,Carlos Martín-Isla,Karim Lekadir,Polyxeni Gkontra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Med-DualLoRA 提出了一种能够提高 3D CMR 疾病检测性能并且在通信成本上显著优化的联邦适应框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了克服单站点数据适应带来的性能不佳和偏见问题，并解决在临床应用中由于隐私限制而难以进行集中微调的问题。

Method: Med-DualLoRA 是一种基于客户端的高效参数优化（PEFT）联邦框架，它通过可加分解分离全局共享和局部低秩适应模块，仅在各个站点之间共享和汇总全局组件，同时保持局部适配器的隐私。

Result: 实验结果表明，仅适应两个变压器块也可以保留性能并进一步提高效率。Med-DualLoRA 方法在 ACDC 和联合 M&M 数据集上进行多中心 3D CMR 基础模型的疾病检测适配时，实现了与现有联邦 PEFT 基线相比在统计学上有显著改善的性能（平衡精度 0.768，特异性 0.612），并且保持了通信效率。

Conclusion: Med-DualLoRA 提供了一种在真实临床约束下可扩展的医疗 FM 地方式联邦适应解决方案。

Abstract: Foundation models (FMs) show great promise for robust downstream performance across medical imaging tasks and modalities, including cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), following task-specific adaptation. However, adaptation using single-site data may lead to suboptimal performance and increased model bias, while centralized fine-tuning on clinical data is often infeasible due to privacy constraints. Federated fine-tuning offers a privacy-preserving alternative; yet conventional approaches struggle under heterogeneous, non-IID multi-center data and incur substantial communication overhead when adapting large models. In this work, we study federated FM fine-tuning for 3D CMR disease detection and propose Med-DualLoRA, a client-aware parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) federated framework that disentangles globally shared and local low-rank adaptations (LoRA) through additive decomposition. Global and local LoRA modules are trained locally, but only the global component is shared and aggregated across sites, keeping local adapters private. This design improves personalization while significantly reducing communication cost, and experiments show that adapting only two transformer blocks preserves performance while further improving efficiency. We evaluate our method on a multi-center state-of-the-art cine 3D CMR FM fine-tuned for disease detection using ACDC and combined M\&Ms datasets, treating each vendor as a federated client. Med-DualLoRA achieves statistically significant improved performance (balanced accuracy 0.768, specificity 0.612) compared to other federated PEFT baselines, while maintaining communication efficiency. Our approach provides a scalable solution for local federated adaptation of medical FMs under realistic clinical constraints.

</details>


### [173] [SurfScaff3D: Bridging Geometric and Semantic Representations for LLM-based 3D Object Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11678)
*Anay Loya,Rishi Gupta,Arnav Samal,Anirban Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了HPS表示方法和基于HPS的SurfScaff3D框架，以实现无需昂贵调整或限制性几何先验的高质量3D内容生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前3D生成方法依赖于昂贵的微调或者限制性的结构先验，缺乏表达能力和有机形状生成能力，因此提出了HPS和SurfScaff3D以更好地适应自然语言推理和2D / 3D内容生成。

Method: HPS是一种设计基于语义有意义的、可解释的部分级别抽象的表示方法，能够实现更灵活、可编辑和开放域的3D生成。SurfScaff3D框架结合了HPS的优点，提供了文本和图像到3D生成的交互方式。

Result: 实验证明SurfScaff3D在几何保真度、语义对齐和灵活编辑方面表现优异，适用于多种对象类别。

Conclusion: 通过结合语义化级别的部分表示和交互式框架，HPS和SurfScaff3D有效地解决了当前3D生成技术的瓶颈，提供了一种新的3D生成方法。

Abstract: Creating high-quality 3D content has traditionally required specialist expertise and experience with complex tools. The growing ecosystem of AI-assisted creativity demands accessible and intuitive 3D generation systems. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising directions, yet extending their generative capabilities to 3D remains fundamentally challenging because existing 3D representations are not naturally compatible with language-based reasoning. Current approaches either depend on expensive fine-tuning or impose restrictive structural priors that sacrifice expressiveness and exclude organic shapes. We argue that the mismatch between LLM-native reasoning and conventional 3D parameterizations is a core bottleneck of LLM-driven 3D generation. To address this, we introduce the Hierarchical Patch Scaffold (HPS), a representation designed around semantically meaningful, interpretable part-level abstractions that are naturally understood by both humans and LLMs, enabling expressive, editable, and open-domain 3D generation without imposing restrictive geometric priors or expensive fine-tuning.
  Building upon HPS, we introduce SurfScaff3D, an interactive framework for text and image-to-3D generation. HPS inherits the flexibility of B-spline patches, while exposing an interface that leverages open-world capabilities of foundation models to reliably generate 3D. Its hierarchical part-level semantic labels enable targeted, natural-language edits at any level of granularity without re-running generation. Further, HPS offers explicit per-patch control over surface detail, enabling more expressive geometry capable of representing arbitrary objects. Extensive experiments against state-of-the-art LLM-based 3D generation methods demonstrate strong geometric fidelity, semantic alignment, and flexible editing across diverse object categories.

</details>


### [174] [LocateAnyMesh: Grounding 3D Mesh Queries in 2D Images with Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11692)
*Chris Choy,Zhiding Yu,Jan Kautz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LocateAnyMesh 是一种通过使用 3D 网格作为提示部分的视觉-语言模型，能够识别特定资产在图像中的位置，无需渲染查询视角或视图模板匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了提高在图像中识别特定 3D 网格资产的效率和准确性，该模型使用了未冻结的 3D 编码器将彩色表面点转换为紧凑的标记序列，并运用学习连接器将这些序列与图像和指令标记放在一起。

Method: 该研究引入了两种接地模型，即 LAM-Select 和 LAM-Direct。LAM-Select 选择图像区域提案，LAM-Direct 预测坐标。研究还比较了不同的网格编码器，并研究了表面颜色对 LAM-Direct 的影响。

Result: LAM-Select 在报告的真实图像套件和官方的 BOP YCB-V 评估中改善了定位效果。单独的 LAM-Select 继续实验提供指向和网格仅描述证据，而无需替换报告的定位模型。

Conclusion: 网格标记作为查询表示具有支持证明，但仍存在决策存在性、身份绑定、提案覆盖范围和描述准确性等方面的问题。

Abstract: Textured 3D meshes specify object geometry and appearance, making them a natural query for finding a particular asset in an image. We introduce LocateAnyMesh, a vision-language model that uses the mesh itself as part of its prompt. A frozen 3D encoder maps colored surface points to a compact token sequence, which a learned connector places alongside image and instruction tokens. We evaluate two grounding models with PPAT mesh tokens: LAM-Select selects image-region proposals, while LAM-Direct predicts coordinates directly. Neither requires rendered query views or view-template matching. New objects require a single encoder pass and no object-specific fine-tuning. LAM-Select improves localization on the reported real-image suites and the official BOP YCB-V evaluation. Secondary experiments compare mesh encoders, and a LAM-Direct study isolates surface color. A single-seed LAM-Select continuation supplies pointing and mesh-only description evidence without replacing the reported localization model. The results support mesh tokens as a query representation, with remaining limitations in presence decisions, identity binding, proposal coverage, and descriptive fidelity.

</details>


### [175] [SurgTAP-3D: A Large-Scale Cross-Surgery Video Dataset with Contact-Aware 3D Motion Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11697)
*Jiaxin Guo,Wenzhen Dong,Taoyu Wu,Haomin Kuang,Mengya Xu,Kejian Shi,Ziyi Wang,Tongfan Guan,Mingkai Jia,Yue Wang,Qi Dou,Yun-Hui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究构建了一个名为SurgTAP-3D的大规模临床手术运动跟踪数据集，包含52万帧、4,549个动作片段以及140万条2D/3D点轨迹，通过设计统一的手术3D点跟踪框架，支持复杂条件下的长时间跟踪，并在多个基准上验证其效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公共数据集在真实临床场景中的适用性和多样性不足，且通常只关注组织或器械，忽视了工具与组织的相互作用。因此，该研究旨在构建一个大规模的伪3D手术运动跟踪数据集，为增强现实手术引导和基于视觉-语言-动作模型的自主手术提供高质量监督。

Method: 研究设计了一个统一的手术3D点跟踪框架，将未标定的单目手术视频转化为结构化的4D注释，并适应基础先验知识，生成时间上一致的轨迹、假定的尺寸几何结构、相机姿态和器械掩码。

Result: SurgTAP-3D数据集能够在具有挑战性的手术环境中捕捉到真实的动力学问题，如遮挡、烟雾、出血和快速器械运动。在SurgPose、SurgT和STIR基准上进行的实验表明，该数据集和注释框架在3D手术点跟踪、重构和手术动作理解方面具有有效性。

Conclusion: SurgTAP-3D数据集和注释框架为复杂手术环境下的3D视觉分析和理解提供了有力支持，为自主手术系统的发展奠定了重要基础。

Abstract: Understanding 3D scene dynamics in minimally invasive surgery (MIS) is a fundamental step toward physically intelligent and autonomous surgical systems. However, existing public datasets offer limited scalability and diversity in real-world clinical scenarios. Moreover, annotations typically focus on either tissue or instruments alone, overlooking tool-tissue interactions. This gap limits applications such as augmented reality guidance and autonomous surgery driven by vision-language-action (VLA) models or world models, which demand large-scale, high-quality 3D supervision. In this work, we construct SurgTAP-3D, a large-scale in-vivo pseudo-3D surgical motion tracking dataset and benchmark, comprising 520K frames, 4,549 action clips, and 1.4M 2D/3D point trajectories from diverse robotic and manual procedures under unified action categories. To make annotation scalable, we design a unified framework for surgical 3D point tracking that converts uncalibrated monocular surgical videos into structured 4D annotations through contact-region prompting, active-tool segmentation, dynamic bundle adjustment, and global 4D refinement. This pipeline adapts foundation priors to surgical videos and produces temporally consistent trajectories, pseudo-scale geometry, camera poses, and instrument masks. The dataset captures realistic challenges inherent to surgical environments, including occlusions, smoke, bleeding, and rapid instrument motion. We establish a comprehensive benchmark on SurgPose, SurgT, and STIR, covering both instrument and tissue tracking. We demonstrate instrument displacement estimation, deformable surface reconstruction, and foundation-model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of our dataset and annotation framework for 3D surgical point tracking, reconstruction, and surgical action understanding. Homepage: https://wrld.github.io/surgtap-3d/

</details>


### [176] [Correctness Metric Matters: NWD-Based Calibration Loss for Tiny Person Detection in UAV Infrared Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11735)
*Tian Zhang,Zhirong Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对无人机热成像中微小目标检测的新校准方法，使用规范化Wasserstein距离（NWD）替代了传统基于IOU的目标，从而提高了图像级别的局部校准误差（LaECE），同时保持了mAP不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有校准损失基于边界框回归的正确性定义，使用IOU阈值。对于无人机红外图像中的微小目标，这种方法在几何上是不良定义的，导致了过校准现象。

Method: 提出了使用连续、尺度不变的规范化Wasserstein距离（NWD）作为校准损失的目标，通过实验证明了NWD在提高LaECE方面的有效性。

Result: NWD方法显著降低了IoU目标下的LaECE值，提升了校准效果，并且在mAP保持不变的情况下，验证了其作为几何校正的有效性。

Conclusion: 此研究表明，对于无人机热成像中的微小目标，使用NWD作为一种新的校准损失定义，可以有效提高校准准确性，同时不需要额外的映射层。

Abstract: Detection calibration aligns predicted confidence with empirical correctness. Existing calibration losses inherit their correctness definition from box regression, specifically IoU against a hard threshold. We show that this target is geometrically ill-posed for tiny objects in UAV infrared imagery, where persons occupy less than 0.1\% of the image. The same pixel error is penalized more heavily as the target shrinks, so binary prediction calibration (BPC) actively suppresses confidences that should be high. On HIT-UAV, BPC with an IoU target degrades image-level localization-aware ECE (LaECE) from 0.0689 to 0.0761, 0.0649 to 0.0733, and 0.0653 to 0.0682 across Low, Mid, and High signal-to-clutter ratio (SCR) groups. We replace the IoU target with a continuous, scale-invariant normalized Wasserstein distance (NWD). The NWD target reduces LaECE\(_{\mathrm{NWD}}\) relative to BPC+IoU on all three groups (\(p<10^{-7}\)) with mAP neutral (0.9356 vs.\ 0.9347), and an independent center-offset anchor confirms that the gain is a genuine geometric correction. The improvement holds across a broad plateau of calibration weights. The NWD formulation requires no inference-time mapping layer. If a validation-fitted isotonic map is applied on top of it, calibration is lowered further, and the two corrections act on different components of the same error. The metric-level remedy has a measurable boundary. Target-background thermal pairing in the training distribution and detection-level aggregation under per-image detection-count heterogeneity lie outside it. Both are quantified independently of the NWD target.

</details>


### [177] [Dense Flow from Adaptive Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11738)
*Cheng-Lin Hsieh,Stella X. Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FATE通过将对应关系规模与流分辨率分离，根据图像结构调整支持区域的大小和形状，从而提供可靠匹配并进行精确的像素级流重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法匹配和估算流都在同一粗略网格上进行，然后通过学习上采样恢复密集流，而不直接将视觉支持与密集流重建联系起来。FATE通过将流分辨率与匹配支持分离，重新利用这些支持进行准确的密集流重建。

Method: FATE采用自适应Token预估方法，根据连贯区域扩大支持区域并在运动边界附近收缩。共享像素到Token的关联聚合特征，用于匹配和重建像素流。

Result: 在FlyingChairs/FlyingThings3D上训练后，FATE在Sintel Final和KITTI上的零样本精度最高。对于可见像素，其在连贯区域内提高了精度，并在运动边界附近也有改善。关于直接匹配不可用的区域（如被遮挡或超出视窗的像素），FATE表现尤为出色。

Conclusion: FATE的自适应对应关系通过像素到Token的分组能够实现可靠的匹配和准确的像素级流重建，从而提高对未见真实场景的泛化能力。

Abstract: Optical flow requires reliable matching from sufficient visual context and precise motion at every pixel. Existing methods such as WAFT match and estimate flow on the same coarse grids, then recover dense flow through learned upsampling, without explicitly linking visual support for matching to dense flow reconstruction. Our key insight is that dense pixel-level flow does not require equally dense matching. We decouple correspondence scale from flow resolution by adapting the size and shape of spatial supports to image structure for reliable matching, while reusing these supports for precise dense flow reconstruction. We realize this in Flow from Adaptive Token Estimation (FATE), whose token supports expand within coherent regions and contract near motion boundaries. Shared pixel-to-token associations pool features for matching and reconstruct pixel flow from token motions. Flow supervision jointly trains pixel grouping, token matching, and flow estimation without grouping labels, allowing FATE to anticipate which pixels are likely to move together from appearance alone. Trained on FlyingChairs/FlyingThings3D, FATE achieves the highest zero-shot accuracy on Sintel Final and KITTI, a critical setting given scarce real-world flow labels. For visible pixels, FATE improves accuracy within coherent regions, and more near motion boundaries. Its largest gains occur where direct matches are unavailable: Occluded or out-of-frame pixels account for roughly 10% of valid pixels but 50% of WAFT's total error. Experiments show that adaptive correspondence through pixel-to-token grouping enables reliable matching and precise pixel-level flow, improving generalization to unseen real scenes.

</details>


### [178] [GeoPilot: Diagnosis-Guided Interventions and Geometric Evaluation for Aerial Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11751)
*Pengyu Yin,Jie Pan,Junxiang Tan,Mengqi Fu,Kun Cheng,Yifan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoPilot 是一种工作流，它将诊断和先验观察转化为可执行的程序或相机配置干预，通过数值工具重建网格并在外部评估器下测量其几何形状。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当从空中遥感影像重建的网格与参考几何不符时，需要对重建过程进行诊断以决定应如何修改，GeoPilot 提供了一种方法来进行这种诊断。

Method: GeoPilot 使用大语言模型提出修改建议，并通过数值工具重新生成网格，然后由外部评估器在给定的坐标和参考协议下测量其几何。

Result: 在 224 张开发图像上，共享内在参数提高了所有六个固有坐标测量指标，并减少了表面到参考距离的平均值。与参考辅助对齐不同，后者反转了平均距离排名，使得共享内在参数的改进仅适用于固有坐标交付。

Conclusion: 通过比较不同的相机处理方式，提供了关于相机处理的条件性证据。此外，通过三个端到端的运行完成了所有 327 张影像的网格重建和六度评价值评估。

Abstract: When a mesh reconstructed from aerial remote-sensing imagery disagrees with reference geometry, deciding what to change requires a diagnosis of the reconstruction process. We present GeoPilot, a workflow that turns diagnostics and prior observations into executable program or camera-configuration interventions. A large language model proposes the change, numerical tools reconstruct the mesh, and an external evaluator measures its geometry under a stated coordinate and reference protocol. The main case tests a shared-intrinsics hypothesis proposed before the comparison. On 224 Metashape-raster development images, shared intrinsics improved all six native-coordinate measures and reduced mean surface-to-reference distance by 7.04%. Reference-assisted alignment fitted and evaluated on separate within-scene checkerboard samples reversed the mean-distance ranking, limiting that gain to native-frame delivery. A separate matched comparison on publisher-undistorted images favored fixed published cameras on all six measures, reducing mean distance by 12.11%; the cameras retain upstream image and laser-scanning adjustment information. With one reconstruction per configuration, these comparisons provide conditional evidence for camera handling. Three end-to-end runs each delivered a mesh and six-metric evaluation from all 327 images of a second development scene.

</details>


### [179] [SpinSCI: Mask-Conditioned Spatial-Temporal Spin Transformer for Video Snapshot Compressive Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11753)
*Seungki Hong,Zhishuai Zhang,Taekwang Jang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpinSCI提出了一种基于旋量的空间-时间变换器模型，通过掩码调节的旋量Ising精炼块结合注意力逻辑和传感信息，实现对多帧视频的高效重构。实验结果表明SpinSCI在多个基准测试中PSNR比现有方法有轻微优势，同时在参数量、计算量和内存使用上具有显著优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频片段压缩成像（SCI）旨在从单一时空编码的度量中恢复多帧，而现有的方法在参数量、计算量和内存使用上存在劣势。

Method: SpinSCI通过将注意力逻辑和传感信息结合到掩码条件下的旋量Ising精炼块中，引入了有限均场更新控制残差特征精炼。还采用了物理指导的初始化和最终数据一致性确保与度量模型相容。

Result: 旋量SCI在不同规模的灰色、中间色和大型彩色基准测试中，相较于HiSViT$_9$平均PSNR提升了0.51 dB、0.23 dB和0.04 dB，参数量减少16.9%，FLOPs减少21.0-21.6%，延迟降低17.1-49.9%，峰值内存减少62.3-63.3%。与DU-9stg相比，平均PSNR差异不超过0.13 dB，FLOPs减少28.2-28.7%，推理延迟降低64.6-71.7%，峰值内存降低30.1-35.0%。

Conclusion: 综上所述，SpinSCI通过优化计算复杂度和内存使用，可以在保证或小幅提升重建质量的同时提供更好的性能。

Abstract: Video snapshot compressive imaging (SCI) recovers multiple frames from one spatiotemporally coded measurement. This paper proposes SpinSCI, a mask-conditioned Spatial-Temporal Spin Transformer whose Mask-Conditioned Ising Refinement Block (MC-IRB) combines attention logits and sensing information to form signed spin couplings. Finite mean-field updates gate residual feature refinement. Physics-guided initialization and final data consistency incorporate the measurement model. Compared with HiSViT$_9$, SpinSCI achieves average PSNR gains of 0.51 dB, 0.23 dB, and 0.04 dB on small-scale gray, mid-scale color, and large-scale color benchmarks, respectively, with 16.9% fewer parameters, 21.0-21.6% fewer FLOPs, 17.1-49.9% lower latency, and 62.3-63.3% lower peak memory. Relative to DU-9stg, average PSNR differs by at most 0.13 dB across these benchmarks, with 28.2-28.7% fewer FLOPs, 64.6-71.7% lower inference latency, and 30.1-35.0% lower peak memory. Qualitative comparisons on the real benchmark further show recovery of fine details and textures. Code and reference checkpoints are available at https://github.com/skethz/SpinSCI.

</details>


### [180] [Calibrated Alarm Thresholds for Compact Fire and Smoke Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11757)
*Vikas Sandireddy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文在图像级别评估了两个紧凑型检测器在D-Fire测试集上的性能，通过比较不同规则将检测框转换为单个警报得分，并使用分层一致程序确定适应的阈值，以满足误报率和漏报率的目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的基于目标检测器的火灾和烟雾检测系统通常使用框级度量标准和固定的置信阈值进行评估。然而，火灾监控系统需要根据整个图像做出一项决策：是否报警。本文探讨了在图像级别评估紧凑型检测器的方法，比较了不同的决策规则并将结果应用分层一致程序以满足不同误报率和漏报率的目标。

Method: 研究在D-Fire测试集上比较了YOLOv8n和其他紧凑型检测器的性能，并使用了分层一致程序来设置适应性的警报阈值。对警报阈值的选择基于保持漏报率低于目标值来做出最终决策。

Result: 结果表明，两个检测器在相同固定的阈值下达到了不同的漏报率。调整后的阈值满足了所有规则和两个检测器的不同漏报率目标。此外，仅含有烟雾的图像即使在总体目标达成的情况下也能满足目标要求。同时，研究也指出了该方法的主要故障情形。

Conclusion: 研究得出了适用于不同场景下的紧凑型火灾和烟雾检测器的评估方法，同时为未来的工作提供了一致性的警报阈值设置方案。

Abstract: Compact object detectors such as YOLOv8n are a common choice for camera-based fire and smoke detection on low-power devices. These detectors are usually evaluated with box-level metrics such as mean average precision, and their outputs are turned into decisions with a fixed confidence threshold such as 0.25 or 0.5. A fire monitoring system, however, makes one decision per image: raise an alarm or not. In this paper we evaluate two publicly available compact detectors on the D-Fire test set at the image level. We compare three simple rules for turning box detections into one alarm score per image, and we use a split conformal procedure to choose the alarm threshold from held-out images so that the expected fraction of missed fire and smoke images stays below a chosen target. We find that the same fixed threshold leads to very different miss rates for the two detectors, 17.3 and 8.4 percent at a threshold of 0.5, while the calibrated threshold meets miss-rate targets of 10, 5 and 1 percent for both detectors and all three rules. At a 5 percent target, the false alarm rate on images without fire or smoke stays between 1.2 and 3.0 percent. We also find that smoke-only images stay below the target even when the overall target is met, and we describe the main failure cases.

</details>


### [181] [LangDepth: Vision-Language Scene Priors for Semantic Binning and Cross-Domain Monocular Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11763)
*Reyhaneh Ahani Manghotay,Jie Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LangDepth是一种结合强视觉特征与场景条件输出空间的单目深度估计架构，通过预训练的CLIP编码器与场景导向的概念键将图像特征转换为紧凑的场景描述符，Scene Prior Module (SPM)将该描述符映射到场景条件下的度量深度区间，提供全局范围锚点，而Per-Pixel Assignment Network (PPAN)负责像素级别的分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的单目深度估算方法在场景级别的尺度上仍不够敏感，而室内和室外场景的深度范围有很大差异。LangDepth试图通过利用场景级别的语义结构作为上游先验，重塑度量输出空间，然后再进行密集预测，从而提供更大范围的深度估算。

Method: LangDepth架构包括一个预训练的CLIP编码器和可学习的概念键库，用于将图像特征转换为紧凑的场景描述符。一个Scene Prior Module (SPM) 将描述符映射到场景条件下的度量深度区间，以及一个Per-Pixel Assignment Network (PPAN) 负责像素级别的分配。

Result: LangDepth在多个场景下的单目深度估计算法上取得了较好的表现，包括NYU Depth V2, KITTI, DIODE室内和iBims-1，其精度与其他方法相当，特别是在室外场景中，SPM占比更加明显。此外，对场景上下文的任意修改会导致深度估计显著下降，证明了场景先验的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种新的单目深度估计框架，该框架通过利用场景级别的辅助信息来提高跨域单目深度估计的性能，并证明了这种预先假设对深度估计的影响显著。

Abstract: Monocular depth estimation has advanced through large-scale pretraining and strong visual backbones, yet metric depth remains sensitive to scene-level scale. Indoor rooms and outdoor driving scenes occupy very different depth ranges, but most depth decoders infer this global structure implicitly from visual features. We ask whether scene-level semantic structure can instead act as an upstream prior that shapes the metric output space before dense prediction.
  We present LangDepth (SemanticBins), a monocular depth architecture that couples strong visual features with a scene-conditioned output space. A frozen CLIP encoder and a learnable bank of scene- and geometry-oriented concept keys convert image features into a compact scene descriptor, without requiring per-image text or an external captioner. A Scene Prior Module (SPM) maps this descriptor to a scene-conditioned metric depth interval, providing a global range anchor before dense decoding. In parallel, a DINOv2-L backbone with a lightweight FPN extracts dense visual features, and a Per-Pixel Assignment Network (PPAN) assigns pixels to the scene-prescribed bin structure. A confidence gate fuses the dense visual estimate with the SPM prior.
  We train LangDepth jointly on NYU Depth V2 and KITTI under a modest supervised depth budget, without web-scale depth supervision or pseudo-labelled depth data. A single model achieves delta_1 = 0.960 on NYU, 0.960 on KITTI, 0.887 on DIODE indoor, 0.946 on iBims-1, and 0.861 on SUN RGB-D. Beyond aggregate accuracy, the SPM predicts compact indoor ranges and much wider outdoor KITTI ranges, the gate becomes SPM-dominant on outdoor scenes, and perturbing the routed scene context causes large drops on KITTI and iBims-1. These results support scene-conditioned output spaces as a practical and interpretable mechanism for cross-domain monocular depth estimation.

</details>


### [182] [Towards Rotation-Only Imaging Geometry: Multi-View Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11770)
*Xinrui Li,Qi Cai,Yuanxin Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GRAM方法直接从初始相对旋转和平内点匹配中估计全局旋转，通过最小化边旋转代数残差。MORE方法进一步扩展旋转主导的成像几何到多视图，并通过加权最小二乘法恢复全局平移。实验表明，该方法具有高准确性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的结构从密集匹配中估计全局旋转的方法通过两两成对优化来获取相对姿态，这种方法没有充分结合特征级约束和多视图一致性。所以该研究提出了一种新的方法，直接从初始相对旋转和平内点匹配中估计全局旋转。

Method: GRAM方法首先估计全局旋转，通过最小化边旋转代数残差；MORE方法进一步扩展旋转主导的成像几何到多视图，并通过加权最小二乘法恢复全局平移。

Result: 合成和真实实验表明了新方法的高准确性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 研究提出了一种直接从初始相对旋转和平内点匹配中估计全局旋转的方法（GRAM）以及扩展多视图旋转主导重构几何的方法（MORE），实验结果显示了方法的优越性。

Abstract: Global structure-from-motion (SfM) commonly refines relative poses on individual image pairs and then estimates global rotations by rotation averaging. Pairwise refinement does not explicitly combine feature-level constraints with multi-view consistency during rotation initialization. We introduce Global Rotations from Aggregated Matches (GRAM), which estimates global rotations directly from initial relative rotations and inlier matches by minimizing edge-wise rotation-only algebraic residuals. GRAM replaces two-view relative-pose optimization and rotation averaging with a single stage. We further extend rotation- only imaging geometry to multiple views and develop Multi-view Optimization with Rotation-only Reprojection Error (MORE) for nonlinear global rotation refinement. Analytical Rotation-guided Translation (ART) derives locally scaled triplet translations from Linear Global Translation (LiGT) constraints and recovers global translations using weighted least squares. Synthetic and real-world experiments demonstrate the accuracy, robustness, and efficiency of the proposed methods.

</details>


### [183] [FMA-Net: Flexible Modality Adaptation for Robust Multimodal Face Presentation Attack Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11790)
*Yuhao Gao,Yichen Shi,Zitong Yu,Hongyang Wang,Hongrui Li,Ruixin Zhang,Shouhong Ding,Jun Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了FMA-Net框架，通过指示引导的潜空间翻译来补偿缺失的模态，适用于RGB和其他缺失模态的多模态人脸识别攻击检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有灵活模态方法通常采用零填充或模态省略，可能会丢弃跨模态信息并引入模态依赖偏见。FMA-Net旨在提供一种统一框架，利用指示引导的潜空间翻译来补偿缺失模态，提高fPAD的鲁棒性。

Method: FMA-Net通过Face Modality Instruct Translator (FMIT)估计目标模态观察值，并使用Context-aware Category Enhancement以可学习的文本提示作为模态不变的语义锚点。此外，引入了Facial Feature Adapter (F2A)整合全局面部结构和局部欺骗相关线索，以增强判别性表示。最后，通过Synthetic-to-Real Face Domain Alignment (SR-FDA)减少迁移后领域间特征不一致性。

Result: FMA-Net框架在WMCA 和 PADISI-Face 数据集上进行了验证。与最强基线相比，在具有70%缺失模态比例的WMCA上，FMA-Net 的平均ACER 为3.22%，而基线为4.24%。 当深度和红外完全不可用时，FMA-Net 达到 5.23% 的 ACER，优于最佳竞品的结果 (5.99%)。此外，跨域实验揭示了合成到真实领域对齐在数据集偏移时的局限性。

Conclusion: FMA-Net 为 fPAD 中灵活和不完整的模态提供了实用的方法，具有较高的鲁棒性和有效性。

Abstract: Multimodal face presentation attack detection (fPAD) improves robustness using complementary RGB, depth, and infrared (IR) cues, but deployment remains challenging when modalities are unavailable or incomplete. Existing flexible-modality methods mainly use zero-filling or modality omission, potentially discarding cross-modal information and introducing modality-dependent bias. We propose the Flexible Modality Adaptation Network (FMA-Net), a unified framework that compensates for missing modalities through instruction-guided latent-space translation. The Face Modality Instruct Translator (FMIT) estimates target modality observations from RGB inputs, while context-aware category enhancement uses learnable text prompts as modality-invariant semantic anchors. A Facial Feature Adapter (F2A) integrates global facial structure and local spoof-relevant cues to enhance discriminative representations. Synthetic-to-Real Face Domain Alignment (SR-FDA) reduces feature discrepancies between translated and real modalities, with benefits depending on the missing-modality pattern and data domain. Experiments on WMCA and PADISI-Face validate the framework. On WMCA with a 70% modality missing ratio, FMA-Net achieves a mean ACER of 3.22% across four intra-domain missing-modality protocols, compared with 4.24% for the strongest baseline by the same criterion. When both depth and IR are entirely unavailable, it achieves 5.23% ACER, compared with 5.99% for the best competing result. Cross-domain experiments also reveal limitations of synthetic-to-real alignment under dataset shifts. These results support FMA-Net as a practical approach to fPAD with flexible and incomplete modalities.

</details>


### [184] [Benchmarking CNNs, Vision Transformers, and Foundation Models for Explainable Brain Tumor MRI Classification: Calibration, Decision Analysis, and External Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11793)
*Akwasi Asare*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究比较了六种不同架构的深度学习模型在公共MRI图像分类任务上的表现，发现内部数据集上各模型性能相似，而去重后的外部数据集上不同模型表现出了显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前研究发现，在使用深度学习模型进行脑肿瘤MRI分类时，人们往往仅根据准确率进行比较，而未对数据集的独立性进行验证。本研究旨在全面评估六种不同架构的深度学习模型，考察其准确率、校准性、可解释性、集成学习和决策曲线等多方面的性能。

Method: 研究采用了包括高效网V2-M、ConvNeXt-V2-Tiny、Swin-V2-S、ViT-L/16在内的六种不同架构的深度学习模型，并对它们进行了四类脑肿瘤分类任务的对比。此外，还对模型进行了去重测试、校准、属性图分析以及外部数据集测试等。

Result: 六种模型在公共MRI图像内部集合上的准确率范围为94.5%至95.6%，且经过霍姆斯校正后没有显著差异，而在去重后的测试集合上，准确率降至90.3%至91.7%；集成学习未能取得优于最佳单模型的效果；属性图通过了模型随机化测试但难以精确定位专家标注的肿瘤；在外部BDNeuro-MRI数据集上，MedSigLIP-448和ViT-L/16的准确率分别为77.6%和95.0%，两者表现显著不同。

Conclusion: 本研究结果表明，在公共数据集上，不同架构的深度学习模型在脑肿瘤MRI分类任务上的性能相似，但在未重复使用的外部数据集上，不同模型间的表现差异显著。

Abstract: Deep learning models for brain tumor MRI classification are usually compared by accuracy alone, on public datasets whose independence is rarely checked. We benchmarked six architectures: two convolutional networks (EfficientNetV2-M and ConvNeXt-V2-Tiny), two vision transformers (Swin-V2-S and ViT-L/16), and two foundation models (DINOv2-L and MedSigLIP-448), for four-class classification of 7,216 public MRI images. We assessed accuracy, calibration, explainability, ensembles, and decision curves, with every fitted quantity estimated on validation data only. Pixel-verified duplicate screening showed that 36% of the test images had a near-duplicate in the training data. Test accuracy ranged from 94.5% to 95.6%, with no pairwise difference after Holm correction, and fell to 90.3% to 91.7% on the 773 test images free of duplicates and shared patients. Ensembles did not outperform the best single model. Attribution maps passed a model-randomization test but localized expert-annotated tumors poorly. On 1,675 external BDNeuro-MRI images that did not duplicate the training data, accuracy ranged from 77.6% (MedSigLIP-448) to 95.0% (ViT-L/16), and 12 of 15 pairwise differences were significant. Internal accuracy on this public collection therefore did not distinguish the architectures, whereas the duplicate-filtered external test did.

</details>


### [185] [Direct Trajectory Optimization for Inference-Time Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11821)
*Huixuan Zhang,Xiaojun Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一个无需训练的Direct Trajectory Optimization (DTO)框架，通过直接优化扩散模型的采样轨迹实现在生成过程中的规范性调整，同时解决了采样过程中的出界问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的文本到图像的扩散模型对齐方法依赖于优化模型输入或精调去噪网络，这样需要通过大型去噪模型进行复杂的反向传播计算。DTO框架通过直接优化扩散模型的采样轨迹来解决这个问题，以减少计算成本。

Method: DTO框架将中间去噪分数和采样噪声作为优化变量，避免了通过去噪网络计算梯度的需求。此外，该方法引入了Reward-Optimized Score Guidance，通过插值调和预训练模型预测来稳定采样过程，并在约束分布下提供了一个证明可证明的奖励改进理论保证。

Result: 在三个扩散模型上的两个基准测试中，DTO方法提高了对齐性能，优于现有在推理时的对齐方法，并且维持了高效率。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，轨迹级优化是实现扩散模型高效和有效对齐的一个有前景的方向。

Abstract: Alignment of text-to-image diffusion models with reward functions is a key challenge in controllable generation. Existing approaches typically rely on optimizing model inputs or fine-tuning denoising networks, which requires computationally expensive backpropagation through large denoising models. In this work, we propose Direct Trajectory Optimization (DTO), a training-free framework that performs alignment by directly optimizing the sampling trajectory of diffusion models. Specifically, DTO treats intermediate denoising scores and sampled noise as the optimization variables, eliminating the need for gradients through the denoising network. To mitigate the out-of-distribution problem, we introduce Reward-Optimized Score Guidance, which interpolates between the optimized scores and the pretrained model predictions to stabilize sampling, while providing a provable theoretical guarantee of reward improvement under constrained distributions. Empirically, DTO improves alignment performance across three diffusion models on two benchmarks, outperforming existing inference-time alignment methods while maintaining high efficiency. These results suggest that trajectory-level optimization is a promising direction for efficient and effective diffusion model alignment.

</details>


### [186] [When to Trust Adaptation: Contextual Fusion for Transferable Vision-Language Prompting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11824)
*Zhenyuan Chen,Wenshuo Tao,Zhuo Huang,Shuo Chen,Mingming Cheng,Xiang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种称为Contextual Adaptive Fusion（CAF）的方法，通过结合分支预测置信度和局部一致性的频次，使模型在遇到新类别或领域时能够更加合理地信任其学习到的提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究发现，当视觉语言模型遇到新类别或领域时，如果完全依赖预训练模型的提示可能会导致预测偏差，因此需要一种方法来评估模型的预测置信度，以更合理地利用先前学习的提示。

Method: CAF 方法结合了四个预测分支，每个分支都有冻结和提示的视觉和文本表示。通过根据未标记目标集合中的局部一致性频率，与预测概率集成，CAF 让模型在预测时更信任那些具有高度局部可信度且较少受到全局频率偏差支配的预测。

Result: CAF 在 ImageNet 上的训练结果表明，该方法在十个多数异构数据集基准测试中的平均准确率为 69.96%，比 ManiPT 高出 1.92 个百分点。在多种 ImageNet 变体数据集和新类别到基础类别的知识迁移任务中，CAF 的表现也非常突出。

Conclusion: CAF 方法有效地解决了视觉语言模型在面对新类别或领域时的问题，通过与预测概率集成，增强了模型对于自信且不过度依赖全局频率偏差的预测的信任。

Abstract: When a vision-language model encounters a new class or domain, how much should it trust its learned prompts? Because source adaptation can correct pretrained errors on some target images while disturbing valid predictions on others, we introduce Contextual Adaptive Fusion (CAF), which retains four prediction branches by pairing frozen and prompted visual and textual representations. To arbitrate when branches disagree on an image, CAF combines each branch's predictive confidence with how frequently the branches favor its proposed class across the unlabeled target collection, placing greater trust in predictions that are locally confident yet less dominated by collection-wide frequency bias. The fusion coefficients are learned once on source data and remain fixed at inference. Trained on ImageNet, CAF achieves 69.96% average accuracy across ten cross-dataset benchmarks (1.92 percentage points above ManiPT) and remains highly competitive across four ImageNet variants, setting a new best of 52.21% on ImageNet-S. In base-to-novel transfer across eleven datasets, CAF further reaches 79.77% novel-class accuracy and an 82.81% harmonic mean. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyuanchenai/CAF.

</details>


### [187] [End-to-End Joint Training of Super-Resolution and Compression Artifact Removal for Industrial Machine Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11831)
*Dang BuiDinh,Sang NguyenQuang,Anh NguyenPhuong,Wen-Hsiao Peng,Xiem HoangVan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种端到端的质量增强框架，该框架结合了超分辨率和压缩艺术移除，优化了人类感知和机器感知目标。实验结果表明，在严重JPEG压缩下，该方法在PCB Defect数据集上的mAP@50从0.461提高到了0.887，同时PSNR仅略有下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业机器视觉中，由于带宽限制，由边缘设备捕获的图像会进行下采样和压缩，这导致分辨率损失和压缩伪影，严重影响了后续任务（如缺陷检测）的表现。现有的质量增强方法主要关注优化人类视觉保真度，而不是机器感知。

Method: 提出了一种端到端的质量增强框架，将超分辨率和压缩伪影移除统一训练，并且采用了固定权重和不确定性动态权重损失函数来平衡重建质量和机器视觉任务表现。

Result: 在PCB Defect、DeepPCB和NEU-DET数据集上的实验表明，提出的联合训练模型在严重JPEG压缩下优于单独或分别训练的SR-CAR管道。特别是在PCB Defect数据集上，mAP@50从0.461提高到了0.887，而PSNR仅略有下降。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，联合优化对于意识压缩的工业机器视觉系统至关重要。

Abstract: In industrial machine vision, images captured by edge devices are often downsampled and compressed to reduce bandwidth, introducing resolution loss and compression artifacts that severely degrade the performance of downstream tasks, such as defect detection. Existing quality enhancement methods typically apply super-resolution (SR) or compression artifact removal (CAR) independently or in a sequential manner and are largely optimized for human visual fidelity rather than machine perception. This paper proposes an end-to-end quality enhancement framework that integrates SR and CAR with a unified training strategy that optimizes both human-perception and machine-perception objectives. We investigate fixed-weight and uncertainty-based dynamic-weight loss functions to balance reconstruction quality and machine vision task performance. Extensive experiments on PCB Defect, DeepPCB, and NEU-DET datasets show that the proposed jointly trained model generally outperforms standalone and separately trained SR-CAR pipelines. In particular, under severe JPEG compression, our method improves defect detection performance from 0.461 to 0.887 mAP@50 on PCB Defect over sequential SR-CAR baselines, with only a slight reduction in PSNR. These results demonstrate that joint optimization is critical for compression-aware industrial machine vision systems.

</details>


### [188] [Answer or Defer? Testing VLMs' Stated Confidence on Brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11833)
*Amir Sabbaghziarani,Parsa Ghazvinian,Sepehr Salem,Sergey Plis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了使用置信度阈值筛选医学影像解读结果的方法，发现不同模型在不同人群中的表现差异显著，使用未验证的置信度阈值作为委托医疗人员判断的唯一信号是不恰当的，应进行人群特定验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在医学图像解释方面的潜在应用引起了关注。然而，在实际应用中，如何决定哪些解释接受，哪些图像需要医疗人员介入尚不清楚。

Method: 研究者测试了使用置信度阈值筛选不同医学图像（glioma脑MRI和健康志愿者的MRI）的方法，评估了八种开源VLMs（包括两种推理模型），在BraTS 2024和IXI数据集上的表现。

Result: 在BraTS数据集上，没有任何置信阈值能选择出错误率在5%以下的非空集。即使在高错误预算（10%和20%）下，大多数模型的表现也有限。研究发现，模型在正确和错误答案之间的信心差异大于在每个答案内部的差异。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，不应单独使用模型的置信度作为是否委托医疗人员判断的信号，而应在特定人群中进行验证后再部署。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) could support medical-image interpretation, but their use requires deciding which interpretations to accept and which images to refer to a clinician. We test whether thresholding stated confidence can retain useful coverage while limiting errors among accepted answers, and how this depends on the population. Eight open-weight VLMs, including two reasoning models, assess 3,888 brain MRI slices from post-treatment glioma patients (BraTS 2024) and healthy volunteers (IXI) for tumor or gross abnormality. BraTS labels are mask-derived; IXI slices are treated as negatives. On BraTS, no threshold selects a nonempty set with at most 5% empirical error for any model, even when chosen retrospectively. This also holds for four models evaluated on a large-lesion, distant-negative subset. At a 10% error budget, Gemma-4-12B retains 24.4% of slices and every other model at most 2.5%. To investigate this limited selection ability, we separate confidence differences between predicted answers from differences within each answer. For four models with available outcome-level summaries, pooled mean confidence differs more between answers than between correct and incorrect responses within each answer. A covariance decomposition explains how this pattern can produce opposite confidence-correctness associations across populations. At a 20% error budget, accepting every "tumor" answer covers more slices than any confidence threshold for two models. These findings caution against using unvalidated stated confidence as a standalone deferral signal and support population-specific validation before deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/amir-sbg/VLM-Answer-or-Defer.

</details>


### [189] [MDA framework: multi-architecture domain adaptation for unsupervised person re-identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11836)
*Wei Zhang,Peijun Ye,Dihu Chen,Tao Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多架构自适应域适应方法Mamba，它能增强域适应能力，并通过实验展示了在CNN和Transformer架构下的显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了应对无监督行人再识别领域的挑战性问题，即领域差距和多网络架构支持不足，本文提出了Mamba增强的多架构域适应框架，旨在提高模型的灵活性和适应性。

Method: 本文通过构建多架构域适应能力来增强域适应。具体地，在第一层，引入了一种称为MDA操作符的复合算子以增强Mamba；在第二层，基于此操作符，提出了MDA增强的多架构域适应框架（MDA框架）。

Result: 在行人再识别基准测试上，MDA框架展示了跨CNN和Transformer架构的显著性能提升。在单一部署配置下，MDA框架超越了多种SOTA方法，针对CUHK03到Market-1501的适应任务，与CNN主干结合使用时改进了10.2%的mAP，与Transformer主干结合使用时改进了19.8%的mAP。

Conclusion: 本文提出的MDA框架通过增强多架构适应性，展示了在不同的主干架构下显著的性能提升，为无监督行人再识别任务提供了灵活性和适应性的新方法。

Abstract: Unsupervised person re-identification not only faces the challenge of domain gaps, but existing methods also rarely support multiple network architectures. To tackle both issues, this paper proposes a multi-architecture auto-adaptive domain adaptation method: Mamba augmented multi-architecture domain adaptation framework. Specifically, this paper constructs the multi-architecture domain adaptation capability at two levels. At the first level, we propose a composite operator(MDA operator) that encapsulates Mamba as a component for enhancing domain adaptation. At the second level, based on this operator, we propose a Mamba-enhanced multi-architecture Domain Adaptation framework(MDA framework). Comprehensive experiments on person re-identification benchmarks validate the consistency and flexibility of the proposed framework. The MDA framework supports versatile deployment strategies without being confined to a single integration point. Under a single deployment configuration, it surpasses several SOTA methods. Moreover, it demonstrates substantial performance improvements across both CNN and Transformer architectures. When embedded into a CNN backbone, the framework achieves a 10.2% mAP improvement on the adaptation task from CUHK03 to Market-1501. Integrated with a Transformer backbone, it yields a 19.8% mAP improvement on the same task.

</details>


### [190] [Aggregation-Induced Calibration Failure in Sum-Based Label Expansion for Multi-Label Facial Expression Recognition: A Diagnostic Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11843)
*Weihang Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究发现，标签空间扩展方法的效果取决于聚集规则而非特征表示，建议在实际部署时需对阈值进行校准或使用学习到的聚集机制以支持多标签决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了探究标签空间扩展在多标签面部表情识别中的效果及其可能存在的局限性，作者通过实验评估了条件感知标签扩展（CALE）方法，并与其他基准进行比较。

Method: 在自建数据集和公共数据集RAF-DB及RAF-ML上，使用不同神经网络骨干架构进行实验，调整融合规则中的阈值，并与简单的基线方法进行对比。

Result: 研究发现，固定阈值下的聚合分数差异巨大，而阈值无关的平均精度（mAP）变化相对较小，表明问题在于聚合规则而非特征表示。

Conclusion: 结论指出，基于聚合的方法在实际应用中需要在特定数据规模下校准阈值或采用学习到的聚合机制，才能有效支持多标签决策。

Abstract: Label-space expansion - predicting a larger joint space and summing back to the original labels - is a natural design for multi-label facial expression recognition, but its failure modes have not been characterised. We evaluate Condition-Aware Label Expansion (CALE) on a self-built dataset (30,240 training images, 3,460 multi-label test images), on seven backbones, and on the public RAF-DB and RAF-ML benchmarks. The central finding is that the aggregation rule, not the representation, decides whether the method works. With a fixed threshold of 0.5, the aggregate score spans 28x across five backbones at 10% of the training data (0.24 to 6.79) and collapses to a 1.9x range at full data, while threshold-free mAP stays within 1.28x over the same backbones, which localises the fault to the summation step. The mechanism is the uncalibrated aggregation rule, which adds the main-branch score to half the sum of the three non-main branches; we verify it by measuring main- and non-main-branch activations. Two plain seven-dimensional sigmoid baselines (BCE, ASL) reach mAP 0.5055 and 0.5175; ASL exceeds three of the five CALE configurations and falls within 0.03 of the best. On single-label FER the gain over a seven-dimensional baseline is nominally significant (paired t-test, p = 0.0436) but does not survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction (p_BH = 0.2055) or a Wilcoxon test (p = 0.1250). We conclude that sum-based label expansion requires threshold calibration at the deployment data scale, or a learned aggregation, before it can support multi-label decisions.

</details>


### [191] [Where Does Proposal Selection Fail? Diagnosing Frozen Vision-Language Queries over Detector Proposals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11873)
*Bo Ma,Weiqi Yan,Jinsong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究发现，尽管特定提案选择器在RefCOCOg数据集上表现良好，但在更广泛的场景中性能下降。改进的提案和验证方法未能显著提高模型在未见过的视觉上下文中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了评估和改进基于视觉和语言模型的模块化接地系统，研究者旨在探究冻结的提案选择器和不同选择接口对模型性能的影响。

Method: 研究者使用两个VLM（Qwen2.5-VL-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B），逐一改变选择接口参数，并在RefCOCOg、RefCOCO+/g和两个推理基准（Ref-Adv-s和RefBench-PRO）上进行评估。

Result: 研究结果表明，选择查询文本对模型性能有显著影响；在RefCOCOg上，图像条件查询比纯文本查询性能更好，但在扩展到未见过的视觉数据时表现较差。

Conclusion: 尽管通过监督每个有效提案的十字注意力选择器能够在RefCOCOg上达到VLM的坐标解码性能，但在更具挑战性的场景中（如Objects365和公共推理基准），模型表现不佳，表明当前的方法需要进一步改进。

Abstract: In modular grounding a frozen detector proposes regions and a vision-language model (VLM) selects one, at lower cost than letting the VLM decode a box, but it is unclear where such systems fail. We hold perception fixed---every trained selector chooses among the same frozen proposals, which contain the referent for at least $99.8\%$ of RefCOCO/+/g queries---and vary the selection interface one factor at a time for two VLMs of one family (Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B). On RefCOCOg, what the selector reads matters more than how it is built: the VLM's image-conditioned query encodes the referent's location and beats a text-only query by $0.15$--$0.18$ with every head tested (by less for InternVL3-8B, whose vision encoder differs; one head tested). The remaining errors are rankings among a few top candidates; a cross-attention selector supervised with every valid box reaches the VLM's coordinate decoding on RefCOCOg, and with Qwen2.5-VL on RefCOCO/+ when also trained on their data. Beyond that distribution it does not: on Ref-L4's Objects365 images, mostly of categories outside training, every trained head falls to $0.19$--$0.28$ while Qwen decoding keeps about $0.8$ (InternVL3's drops too), neither a wider detector prompt nor a class-agnostic proposer closes the gap, and on public reasoning benchmarks Ref-Adv-s and RefBench-PRO full-budget heads trail decoding by $0.19$--$0.37$ although proposals cover most referents. A trained verifier reduces to an existence probe on the VLM's query state and does not beat the VLM's yes/no answer on public no-target benchmarks.

</details>


### [192] [Beyond Head Importance: Collective Computation in Video Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11875)
*Yi Yang,Siyuan Liu,Bingbing Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究展示了视频Transformer中不同注意力头的功能贡献不仅仅是基于单任务的表现，还取决于其在下游处理中的使用方式及其对跨层局部交互的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨视频Transformer中不同注意力头的集体计算，以理解其功能性贡献。

Method: 通过对四种视频Transformer进行消融分析，分析注意力模块后不同模块对头输出的重要性以及不同注意力头组合在跨层交互中的影响。

Result: 高度重要的头能够在多个视频理解任务中支持其它任务并保留区分视频的表征结构。MLP模块对下游处理的微调能改善低重要性头输出的使用效率。此外，不同注意力头按空间时间距离组合对远离节点的扰动反应更强烈，联合撤除比单独撤除同等重要性的头造成的性能下降更大。

Conclusion: 集体计算是理解注意力头功能的关键视角，功能贡献取决于头输出的下游使用方式及其跨层交互的组成方式。

Abstract: Attention heads in video Transformers vary greatly in functional importance. Understanding their contributions requires examining not only which heads are important, but also how they participate in collective computation within the network. We study this collective computation from two perspectives: the downstream use of head outputs and the composition of interactions across layers. Ablation analyses of four video Transformers show that high-importance heads identified on a single task also support other video understanding tasks and help preserve the representational structure that distinguishes different videos. Representational responses to head ablation correlate weakly with head importance after the attention module, but more strongly after the MLP in the same block. Adapting this downstream processing through MLP-only fine-tuning further improves the use of lower-importance head outputs. Meanwhile, through composition across layers, sets of heads with shorter spatiotemporal attention distances support stronger perturbation responses at distant tokens than sets with longer distances. Their joint ablation causes even greater performance loss than ablating equally sized sets of high-importance heads, revealing collective contributions not fully captured by individual importance rankings. These findings highlight collective computation as a key perspective for understanding attention head function: functional contributions depend on both how head outputs are used downstream and how local interactions compose across layers.

</details>


### [193] [Training Vision Transformers to Focus: Emergence of Spatial Attention Head Specialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11890)
*Yuji Nozawa,Yu-Chieh Lin,Youyang Ng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通过引入视觉聚焦损失函数来增强Vision Transformer模型的注意力机制，使其在无需标注数据的情况下，具有更好的空间选择性和多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自监督学习的Vision Transformer模型缺乏聚焦机制，在训练过程中产生的感知表示往往是模糊或过于相似的，因此需要引入一种机制来提高模型的聚焦能力。

Method: 作者提出了两种视觉聚焦损失函数，利用模型内的多头注意力机制来引导模型聚焦于特定图像区域，从而增强空间注意力头的特殊化能力。

Result: 实验结果显示，引入该方法后，模型在空间选择性和多样性方面有了显著提升，特别是在零样本图像分割等密集预测任务上的性能得到了改进。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，通过引入视觉聚焦损失函数可以有效提升Vision Transformer模型的性能和解释性，特别是在需要高空间分辨率和多样性的任务中表现出色。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning in Vision Transformer models, such as DINO, enables robust visual perception without requiring labeled data by leveraging large-scale image datasets. However, these models lack a focusing mechanism during training, resulting in perceptual representations that are often ambiguous or overly similar. In this work, we introduce two visual focusing loss functions designed to establish correspondence between the model's attention and specific regions within images. Specifically, we leverage the multi-head attention mechanism within the model to selectively steer the model's focus, leading to the emergence of spatial attention head specialization, characterized by diverse and spatially focused perceptual capabilities without requiring annotations. Through both qualitative and quantitative evaluations, we demonstrate that our method substantially increases the spatial selectivity and diversity of attention heads, improving both interpretability and performance on dense prediction tasks such as zero-shot image segmentation.

</details>


### [194] [Developing a Street View Imagery Processing Pipeline for Building-Level Vacant House Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11893)
*Dongjoon Park,Sunjae Lee,Jung Woo Kim,Bumjoon Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种自动评估街道视图图像（SVI）是否适合任务及目标房屋的身份识别管道，极大地提高了目标房屋评估的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自动化评估通常假设每张图像都能清晰显示目标建筑物，但实际情况并非如此，这可能导致模型评分无法反映正确评估的能力。

Method: 研究设计了一种可复用的SVI处理管道，包括任务适用性筛选和目标房屋对齐两个关键步骤。

Result: 任务适用性筛选能够保持覆盖面，即使在不使用单一统一筛选标准的情况下，也额外提供了101个可用图像；目标房屋对齐不需额外训练，能识别图片中的目标房屋，且匹配人类标签的准确率提高了5.8%。结合筛选与对齐， vacancy分类的AUROC提高了近3.5%。

Conclusion: 该研究区分了图像适合性、目标识别和模型证据呈现这三个独立问题，并强调仅依赖评分无法解决这些问题。同时，记录使用哪些图像和选择了哪个建筑物可以让审查人员验证每个评估，并支持人类虚拟审计。

Abstract: Street view imagery (SVI) is widely used to audit urban environments remotely. Automated assessments usually assume that each image shows the target building clearly. In practice, an image may lack task-relevant evidence or show a neighboring house. If this goes unchecked, a model's score cannot show whether it judged the correct building. We present a reproducible SVI processing pipeline that makes image suitability and target identity explicit and checkable. We apply it to vacant house assessment in South Korea, using 10,311 images of 1,609 detached-house parcels. Task-suitability filtering adapts its criteria to image composition and administrative area. This keeps coverage even across areas. While keeping as many images as a single uniform filter, our filtering left 101 more parcels with a usable image. Target-house alignment identifies the parcel's house from camera metadata and parcel boundaries. It needs no building footprints or additional training. Alignment matched human labels for 85.6% of images, compared with 79.8% for the best simple rule. In vacancy classification, filtering and alignment raised AUROC from 0.684 to 0.719, but marking a different house in the same image still gave 0.709. Grad-CAM showed that the model often looked at areas outside the target house. Image suitability, target identification, and model evidence are therefore separate problems, and scores alone do not resolve them.
