Recording which images were used and which house was selected lets reviewers verify each assessment and can support human virtual audits.

</details>


### [195] [RBA: A Read-out Basis Adapter for Parameter-Efficient Interactive OCTA Vessel Segmentation with SEEM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11906)
*Jaafar M. Al-Ghabban,Mohammad Reza Mohammadi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为RBA（Read-out Basis Adapter）的新方法，该方法通过生成32个特定图像的基本图来优化SEEM模型，以更精细地识别OCTA图像中的血管，从而大幅提升血管分割的准确性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用光学相干断层扫描血管成像（OCTA）进行视网膜疾病监测时，传统的改进方法如LoRA、Conv-LoRA和AdaptFormer存在精度不足或参数效率低的问题，特别是对于细小血管（1-3像素宽）的分割效果不佳。

Method: RBA方法通过对SEEM模型进行改进，在保持模型结构不变的情况下，新增了一个读取分支生成32个图像特定的基本图，并由每个候选区域通过自己的向量和零初始化的投影访问这些基础图，从而调整SEEM模型的输出。同时，RBA还引入了一种标准的低秩方法来提供动脉与静脉区分的信息。

Result: 在OCTA-500 3mm大血管的模拟错误驱动点击测试中，RBA方法显著优于LoRA、Conv-LoRA和AdaptFormer，分别在交并比（IoU）和Dice分数上提高了2.90%和1.72%。在6mm子集上，RBA方法也显示出明显的优势。

Conclusion: 与传统的参数稀疏化方法相比，RBA提高了SEEM对细小血管的分割精度，为视网膜OCTA血管成像的后续改进提供了新的思路和技术支持。

Abstract: Retinal disease monitoring with optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) relies on segmentation of vessels and the foveal avascular zone (FAZ). Promptable models such as SEEM (Segment Everything Everywhere All at Once) allow click-based refinement, but without adaptation SEEM segments thin vessels poorly and needs many clicks. Fully fine-tuning its 342 million parameters on a few hundred images is costly and risks overfitting, and parameter-efficient methods such as low-rank adaptation (LoRA) usually adapt only the encoder. Yet SEEM reads every candidate mask from one feature map at quarter resolution, too coarse for vessels one to three pixels wide. This study introduces the Read-out Basis Adapter (RBA), whose read-out branch generates 32 image-specific basis maps at half resolution. Each candidate accesses them through its own vector and a zero-initialised projection, so the model starts exactly as SEEM. The encoder branch, a standard rank-1 LoRA, supplies the information needed to tell arteries from veins. RBA adds 0.47 million trainable parameters. Under simulated error-driven clicks, with the ground truth used only to place them, RBA outperforms LoRA, Conv-LoRA andAdaptFormer on OCTA-500 3mmlarge vessels. Averaged over three seeds, it reaches an intersection over union (IoU) of 85.16% and a Dice score of 91.93%, 2.90 and 1.72 percentage points above Conv-LoRA. On the 6 mm subset, one run gives margins of 4.35 and 2.76 points. The gain extends to arteries, veins and ROSE-O but not to the FAZ. In SEEM, adaptation capacity pays more at the mask read-out than in the encoder.

</details>


### [196] [LO-World: Unified BEV Latent Modeling for Joint 4D Occupancy and LiDAR Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11912)
*Zhimin Liao,Ping Wei,Kai Mao,Shuaijia Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LO-World 提出了一种单一流水线的 4D 世界模型，同时预测 LiDAR 点云和 3D 语义占用图，以增强语义和几何信息的互补性，提高占用概率预测和点云配准的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的世界模型通常独立或以经验性的方式处理 LiDAR 点云和 3D 语义占用图，导致了潜在的跨模态正则化机会的缺失。LO-World 的提出旨在解决这一问题。

Method: LO-World 使用一个高效的混合范围-体素自编码器和流匹配生成器，在共享的 BEV 潜在空间内同时预测 LiDAR 点云和 3D 语义占用图。

Result: 在广泛的实验中，LO-World 显著优于之前的最佳基准，提高了占用概率预测的 IoU 10.9%，减少了 LiDAR 溜彻距离 30.1%，并在单个 RTX 4090 上持续超过 25 FPS 的实时处理能力。

Conclusion: LO-World 显示出在 4D 世界建模和跨模态整合中的巨大潜力，可以为自动驾驶等应用程序提供更准确和实时的环境感知。

Abstract: LiDAR point clouds and 3D semantic occupancy represent two distinct modalities capturing fine-grained metric geometry and dense volumetric semantics, respectively, holding natural potential for mutual complementarity. However, existing world models typically forecast these modalities independently or cascade them heuristically, missing the opportunity for reciprocal cross-modal regularization. To address this, we propose \textbf{LO-World}, a unified 4D world model that forecasts both modalities within a shared BEV latent space. This single-stream formulation enables dense semantics and metric geometry to mutually reinforce each other, while eliminating multi-pipeline redundancy. Specifically, LO-World couples an efficient hybrid range-voxel autoencoder with a flow-matching generator that caches historical context to reduce iterative sampling latency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LO-World outperforms prior state-of-the-art baselines, improving occupancy forecasting IoU by 10.9% and reducing LiDAR Chamfer Distance by 30.1%. Meanwhile, it sustains a real-time throughput exceeding $25$~FPS on a single RTX 4090. Our code is available at https://github.com/lzzzzzm/LO-World.

</details>


### [197] [Text Alone Predicts Which Classes a Segmentation Readout Keeps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11926)
*David Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究揭示了一种基于开放词汇的分割读出可能沉默地丢弃未经过训练的类别，并不受影响地生成高置信度的掩码，但该类别从未赢得任何像素。作者通过仅基于类别名称与训练词汇之间的文本相似性，便能预测哪些类别风险更高，从而在不重新训练模型的情况下通过减小读出幅度或提前终止训练来恢复这些类别的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文旨在揭示一种基于开放词汇的分割读出在训练阶段如何处理未见过的类别，以及这种处理方式对模型性能的影响。

Method: 通过分析未训练类别名称与训练词汇的文本相似性来预测哪些类别在训练中更容易消失，并通过实验验证了这种机制的有效性。

Result: 作者发现类别消失的风险可以通过训练词汇的相似性进行预测，并通过调整分割读出的幅度或提前终止训练，成功恢复了消失类别的表现。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，基于开放词汇的分割读出可能会沉默地丢弃未训练过的类别，但可以通过控制读出的幅度和调整训练策略来缓解这一问题。

Abstract: An open-vocabulary segmentation readout silently loses a class deployed beyond its training categories. It still emits masks with high confidence, but the class never wins a single pixel. The training loss falls anyway, and mIoU can even rise while classes die. We show that which classes collapse is written in the class-name list alone. Before any image is seen, we rank each class's collapse risk from its text similarity to the training vocabulary alone. The ranking holds at AUROC 0.69-0.96 across nine model families, twelve backbones and eight pretraining recipes. Two further families, measured only after the predictions were written down, land in the same band. What the list writes, it can rewrite. With identical images and a class's counterpart moved in or out of the training list, retraining flips that class's gain over the frozen baseline by 21 IoU points; swapping in unrelated names changes nothing. We find a vocabulary-distance mechanism behind the collapse. Collapsed classes lose every vote to near-name neighbors, but in the frozen features they survive. Turning down the readout's amplitude, or stopping training early, brings them back, up to +16 points, without retraining; trained with its amplitude held down, the readout never collapses.

</details>


### [198] [Scale-Consistent Monocular Fisheye Visual Odometry via Spherical Bundle Adjustment-Guided Unsupervised Depth Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11934)
*Wanhui Luo,Hongbo Zhao,Yi Zhou,Qijun Chen,Yiming Nie,Rui Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为S$^2$D-FVO的单目鱼眼视觉里程计框架，利用球面束调整(SBA)引导的无监督深度学习技术来改进尺度一致性并提高深度估计精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目鱼眼视觉里程计因其视野宽广和单目设置简单，在机器人定位和制图方面具有吸引力，但长时间轨迹中存在尺度漂移问题。为解决此问题，该研究结合了无监督深度学习和球面束调整技术。

Method: S$^2$D-FVO框架通过球面球束调整(SBA)指导下的无监督深度学习技术来改进尺度一致性和深度估计精度。研究采用球面上的对数映射来获得视角偏差的切空间角度重新投影残差，并集成中值深度尺度正则化项。

Result: 实验结果表明，该框架在多个公开数据集以及两个大规模新收集的数据集上，相对于现有代表性的方法，在深度估计和轨迹估计精度方面都有显著提升，适用于不同相机模型。

Conclusion: 研究证实了S$^2$D-FVO框架的有效性，为单目鱼眼视觉里程计的性能提升提供了新的方法和思路。

Abstract: The wide field of view of fisheye cameras and the simplicity of a monocular setup make monocular fisheye visual odometry (VO) attractive for robotic localization and mapping. Nevertheless, scale drift remains a major challenge over long trajectories. Unsupervised depth learning can help to mitigate this issue, but the pronounced distortion of fisheye images poses challenges for accurate depth estimation. This article presents S$^2$D-FVO, a monocular fisheye VO framework integrating spherical bundle adjustment (SBA)-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy. Given that pixel reprojection residuals do not uniformly reflect angular deviations between viewing rays and that the first-order linearization of a scalar angular reprojection residual is insensitive to perturbations along one tangent direction, SBA employs tangent-space angular reprojection residuals derived from the spherical logarithmic map. These residuals retain sensitivity along both tangent directions, with their norms equal to the corresponding scalar angular residuals. A median depth-based scale regularization term is further integrated into SBA to constrain the reconstruction scale. Building on these formulations, SBA replaces the pose estimation network during unsupervised depth learning, providing more reliable relative poses for view synthesis. In turn, depth estimates from the well-trained depth estimation network provide scale references for SBA, improving scale consistency while allowing individual 3-D landmark positions to be refined. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple public datasets, as well as two newly collected large-scale datasets, demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms representative existing approaches in both depth and trajectory estimation accuracy and is applicable to different camera models.

</details>


### [199] [Watching Itself Watch: Self-Auditing Visual Reliance for Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11949)
*Rohan Dugad,Mi Luo,Kristen Grauman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VIOS是一种后训练框架，通过自我蒸馏提高了视频推理模型的性能，通过单次在线策略滚出自动生成监督信息，使得模型更加依赖视频输入，并专注于视觉未充分利用的区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的后训练方法在视频推理中过于关注粗略的轨迹级奖励，需要多次滚动并依赖外部评判。VIOS方法提供了一种新的视角，通过自我审计模型对视觉输入的依赖程度，找到模型忽视的视觉证据，并针对性地进行学习。

Method: VIOS方法使用了一个指数移动平均（EMA）教师模型与学生模型并行演化，对比目标鼓励预测依赖于视频输入，并引入了依赖区间门控机制来聚焦于视觉未充分利用的区域。通过这种方式，VIOS能够在较少的训练步骤和计算资源下提升模型性能。

Result: 在12个覆盖广泛、时间和空间理解、知识密集型以及长视频理解等标准下的实验中，VIOS在三种不同的模型架构上均取得了改进，并且比当时的视频推理系统表现更好。同时，它只需要不到1/9的训练步骤、60倍少的FLOPs和111倍少的生成令牌。

Conclusion: VIOS提供了一种更有效的视频推理模型后训练策略，通过自我审查依赖性和使用低成本的监督机制，显著提升了模型对视频信息的利用效率，同时减少了计算资源和时间成本。

Abstract: Video reasoning hinges on a small number of visually decisive tokens embedded in otherwise largely language-driven chains of thought. Yet prevailing post-training methods such as GRPO overlook this structure, assigning coarse trajectory-level rewards while requiring multiple rollouts and often costly external judges. We introduce Visually-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation (VIOS), a post-training framework that identifies where a model under-utilizes visual evidence and concentrates learning at those positions. Our key insight is that a model can audit its own visual reliance: the divergence between its next-token distributions with and without the video reveals how strongly each prediction depends on the visual input. Measuring this reliance for both a student and an answer-privileged teacher exposes a per-token reliance gap, identifying positions where the teacher exploits visual evidence that the student overlooks. VIOS translates this signal into dense, targeted supervision through three complementary components: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher that co-evolves with the student, a contrastive objective that encourages predictions to depend on the video, and a reliance-gap gate that focuses learning on visually under-utilized tokens. Crucially, VIOS requires only a single on-policy rollout from a single model, without external rewards, judges, or larger teachers. Across 12 benchmarks spanning general, temporal, spatial, knowledge-intensive, and long-video understanding, VIOS consistently improves three model backbones and outperforms contemporary video-reasoning systems, while training in over 9x fewer steps, 60x fewer FLOPs, and 111x fewer generated tokens. Project page: https://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/VIOS/

</details>


### [200] [UltraVoxelGS: Voxel-First Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for 3D Ultrasound Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11951)
*Yue Wang,Haoxin Chen,Xiaoqing Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UltraVoxelGS 是一种全新的 3D 超声波重建方法，实现了快速重建和物理上真实的渲染，首次将实时空间反馈带到 2D 超声扫描中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的超声图像处理方法对每一场景都需要消耗大量时间，限制了其应用。UltraVoxelGS 通过预测全三视图场景表示以及视图相关的外观渲染使实时反馈成为可能，提高了效率。

Method: UltraVoxelGS 采用了一种前瞻性的设计，从配置好的超声图像直接预测完整的高斯场景表示，并跳过了之前的每场景优化瓶颈，这使得方法可以在神经端到端模型中实现。为了快速重建，引入了一个前瞻性的体素到高斯的过程，将所有的图像拆解到固定规模的体素支持中，并直接预测高斯参数。为了实现真实的渲染效果，提出的超声波感知的外观渲染策略将反射与累积衰减分离，训练时并用外观连续性在渲染时实现快速外观适应。

Result: 在真实和模拟数据集上，UltraVoxelGS 的 PSNR/SSIM 指标最佳，并且相较基于每场景优化的方法，推理时间缩短了 35 倍以上，甚至可以处理超过 1000 帧的序列。

Conclusion: UltraVoxelGS 对 3D 超声图像处理领域带来了革新，通过加速重建和保持物理准确性，为实时反馈提供了现实可能，并展示了其在处理大规模超声序列方面的潜力。

Abstract: We present UltraVoxelGS, a 3D ultrasound reconstruction method that achieves both fast reconstruction and physically faithful rendering for the first time, bringing live spatial feedback during 2D ultrasound scanning within reach. This is made possible by a feed-forward design that predicts a complete Gaussian scene representation from posed ultrasound images directly, entirely bypassing the per-scene optimization bottleneck that has confined prior methods to offline use. Realising such feed-forward prediction in this setting is non-trivial: unlike natural images, ultrasound slices share at most one-dimensional intersections and exhibit view-dependent appearance due to acoustic propagation and attenuation, violating the dense overlap and photometric consistency assumed by existing feed-forward Gaussian methods. Hence, to achieve fast reconstruction, we introduce a feed-forward voxel-to-Gaussian pass that decouples representation size from input count by lifting all posed slices into a fixed-size voxel support and predicting Gaussian parameters directly. For faithful rendering, we propose ultrasound-aware appearance rendering strategy factorize reflection from cumulative attenuation during training and exploit appearance continuity among spatially adjacent slices for efficient Render-time Appearance Adaptation. On both real-world and simulated datasets, UltraVoxelGS achieves best PSNR/SSIM compared with per-scene optimization baselines while reducing inference from 10-20 minutes to approximately 10 seconds (over 35 times faster) and scales to sequences exceeding 1,000 frames. Code is available at https://github.com/YuebyYue/UltraVoxelGS-camera-ready.

</details>


### [201] [3R-Adapter: Retrieval, Rewiring, and Refinement for Efficient Adaptation of 3D Reconstruction Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11964)
*Zixiang Ai,Zhenyu Cui,Xu Zou,Jiahuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了3R-Adapter，这是一种针对长尾3D重建场景的参数高效细调（PEFT）方法，通过可变形检索、关系重布和一致性精炼三个组件增强了鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在低光照重建、多人物场景重建和测试时自适应方面存在对应关系失败问题，3R-Adapter旨在通过域移适应中的对应关系恢复来解决这些问题。

Method: 3R-Adapter 方法包括Deformable Retrieval、Relational Rewiring和Consistency Refinement三个组件，分别用于任务自适应关系候选检索、重建跨视图关系结构和将重布关系注入稳定预测。

Result: 在低光照重建、多人物场景重建和测试时自适应方面的实验表明，本文方法比现有PEFT方法具有更好的鲁棒性，同时保持了高效的轻量级适应。

Conclusion: 本文提出的3R-Adapter方法显著改善了针对长尾3D重建场景的鲁棒性，同时保持了轻量级的参数高效细调。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have demonstrated strong generalization under large-scale pre-training, yet they struggle in long-tail scenarios such as low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation. We observe relational attention structure collapse, manifested as the failure of cross-view correspondences, as a primary cause of these limitations. While adaptation offers a practical way to bridge this gap, existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) approaches mainly perform channel-wise feature adjustment and lack mechanisms to explicitly adapt relational structures, leaving correspondence failures unresolved. In this work, we formulate adaptation of 3D reconstruction models as a problem of correspondence recovery under domain shift and propose 3R-Adapter, a PEFT paradigm for long-tail 3D reconstruction scenarios. Our method consists of three components: Deformable Retrieval for task-adaptive relation candidate retrieval, Relational Rewiring for reconstructing cross-view relational structures, and Consistency Refinement for injecting the rewired relations into stable predictions. Extensive experiments on low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation demonstrate that our approach significantly improves robustness over existing PEFT methods while maintaining efficient lightweight adaptation. Our code is released at https://github.com/PKU-OV3-LAB/3R-Adapter.

</details>


### [202] [AnyBreak: Towards Jailbreaking Any T2I Model for Any Concept](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11980)
*Qi Lu,Zehui Guo,Yucheng Zhao,Zijing Li,Chuhan Song,Wenrui Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AnyBreak 是一种新型的脱狱框架，可以在完全黑盒的情况下，使用清洁文本提示和生成的对抗性图片来使文本到图像模型生成包含恶意概念的图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的文本到图像模型存在安全风险，尤其是被用于生成不安全的内容。目前的防御措施主要依赖于白盒假设，缺乏针对黑盒攻击的有效防护。

Method: AnyBreak 通过多尺度渐进语义对齐生成对抗性图像，使生成过程向潜在危险的数据流转移，使得文本中的恶意概念转移到图像中。它不依赖于任何模型的内部结构或参数信息，在黑盒环境中操作，并引入了一个补偿机制以绕过后续的安全检查器。

Result: 实验结果表明，AnyBreak 在保持视觉保真度和语义一致性的同时，能够以高成功率实现攻击目标。展示了现有 T2I 防御方法的不足之处。

Conclusion: AnyBreak 提出了一个新的脱狱框架，显著提升了 T2I 安全性研究的视角，并展示了黑盒环境下的攻击可能性，为相关领域的研究提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in image generation and editing, yet this progress has also introduced significant security risks. Prior work has shown that adversarial prompt can induce the generation of Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content, including pornographic, violent, and graphic imagery. However, such attacks are typically mitigated by prompt filters and often rely on white-box assumptions. In this paper, we propose AnyBreak, a novel jailbreak framework that constructs adversarial images via multi-scale progressive semantic alignment. During the generation process, these adversarial images steer the generation trajectory in latent space towards unsafe data manifolds, enabling cross-modal transfer of malicious concepts from the text modality to the image modality. AnyBreak operates using only clean textual prompts and adversarial images at inference time, and can jailbreak any T2I models towards any malicious concepts in a fully black-box setting. We further introduce AnyBreak-V, an enhanced variant that incorporates a compensation term to bypass post-hoc safety checkers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AnyBreak achieves high attack success rates while preserving visual fidelity and semantic consistency with the input prompts under black-box and clean-text constraints. Our findings reveal that existing T2I defense leave critical cross-modal attack surfaces insufficiently addressed. The code is available at https://github.com/luqi-glory/AnyBreak.

</details>


### [203] [HIST3R: Decomposing and Rectifying State Updates with History for Streaming 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12011)
*Kenneth Yang,Yu-Chiang Frank Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HIST3R 提出了一个无需训练的框架，通过历史信息来控制状态更新的方向和幅度，从而改善了长时序的 3D 重建性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法如 CUT3R 等在累积历史上下文中存在几何漂移的问题，HIST3R 力图解决该问题并通过分解更新操作的方式提出了一个统一的视角。

Method: HIST3R 通过对更新过程进行方向和幅度的分解，引入了使用历史信息来控制几何意图和更新强度的机制。

Result: HIST3R 在多种测试任务中表现优异，尤其是在长时间序的数据上的几何误差得到了显著改善，尤其是在 ScanNet 和 TUM-Dynamics数据集上相比最强的竞品分别减少了23.87%和33.65%。

Conclusion: HIST3R 为长视频场景理解提供了有效的改进，不仅保留了 CUT3R 的内存和推理速度，还增强了几何精度。

Abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction with recurrent states enables long-video scene understanding under bounded memory, but turns reconstruction into a state-evolution problem: each incoming frame updates a compact scene memory on which all subsequent predictions depend, so unreliable updates overwrite historical context and accumulate into long-horizon geometric drift. We analyze CUT3R-style recurrent updates through a direction--magnitude decomposition, in which the magnitude sets the update gain, i.e., how strongly an observation is written into the state, and the direction encodes the geometric intent, i.e., where the update drives the state. This decomposition provides a unified view of CUT3R and its variants, revealing that existing training-free extensions perform magnitude-only control: they can attenuate an unreliable update but cannot correct its direction. We propose HIST3R, a training-free framework built on CUT3R that controls both components using history. HIST3R rectifies the update direction using locally consistent historical states, and modulates the update magnitude according to the visual discrepancy between the current observation and its history, suppressing redundant updates while preserving complementary evidence. Across camera pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, and video depth estimation, HIST3R consistently improves long-horizon performance while retaining the memory footprint and inference speed of CUT3R. With 1000 input frames, it reduces ATE by 23.87% on ScanNet and 33.65% on TUM-Dynamics relative to the strongest competing method; with 500 frames, it improves median reconstruction accuracy over the strongest CUT3R-based variant by 56.52% on 7-Scenes and 33.96% on NRGBD.

</details>


### [204] [TIRAD: Text-guided Image Residual Learning for Generalist Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12023)
*Seongsu Lee,Seunghyun Oh,Seungjae Moon,Youngmin Ro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为TIRAD的方法，通过文本引导的图像残差学习来增强通用异常检测，该方法利用文本残差特征和图像残差特征之间的差异来生成更具判别力的异常表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于残差的方法主要依赖图像表示中的视觉差异，而文本表示中的语义差异尚未得到充分探索，TIRAD旨在通过结合文本和图像信息来提高异常检测的性能。

Method: TIRAD通过构建文本残差特征和图像残差特征之间的转换机制来实现。首先，引入文本融合模块将文本残差转换为门控机制，以此来调节每个图像分割单元的残差。这种机制使得可以保留与缺陷相关的视觉差异，并减弱其他差异，从而增强了异常表示的判别性。

Result: TIRAD在工业基准数据集和从工业到医疗的跨模态任务中均表现出色，优于现有的以图像为中心的残差学习方法。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法TIRAD通过利用文本和图像信息之间的互补作用，改进了异常检测的效果，并在多种数据集上验证了其有效性和优越性。

Abstract: Recent anomaly detection studies have shown that residual features, which model the discrepancy between normal and abnormal patterns, provide strong generalization to anomalies unseen during training. However, existing residual-based approaches mainly rely on visual discrepancies derived from image representations, while semantic discrepancies that can be explicitly expressed through language remain largely underexplored. To address this problem, we propose TIRAD, Text-guided Image Residual Learning for Generalist Anomaly Detection, a multimodal residual learning framework that defines the discrepancy between textual representations of normal and abnormal states as a Text Residual Feature and uses it to guide the Image Residual Feature. Specifically, a Text Fusion Module converts patch-level text residuals into a gate that modulates the image residual of each patch. The gate retains the visual discrepancies that the text residual identifies as defect-related and attenuates the others, leading to more discriminative anomaly representations. Extensive experiments on industrial benchmarks and industrial-to-medical transfer demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing image-centric residual learning methods.

</details>


### [205] [Single Image Super-Resolution via Semantic Prompt and Cross-Modal Training on Content Area](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12025)
*Xiao Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种新的超分辨率方法，结合像素强度和语义信息以增强图像细节恢复效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于深度学习的图像超分辨率方法虽在像素级增强方面表现出色，但往往忽视了图像中的丰富语义信息。因此，论文旨在通过结合像素强度与语义信息，改进图像和视频处理中的细节恢复。

Method: 论文提出了一种结合像素强度和语义信息的方法，包括：(1) 提取并编码文本描述和空间定位等语义数据；(2) 使用跨模态特征融合模块通过多模态训练生成语义特征图；(3) 引入提示牵引头增强主网络以利用语义洞察，从而提高图像细节修复效果。

Result: 通过在多个数据集上的实证结果，证明了本研究所提出方法的有效性和优越性。

Conclusion: 该研究有效地将语义信息融入传统的基于像素的超分辨率模型中，显著提升了图像细节恢复的表现。

Abstract: Enhancing image quality through super-resolution is crucial in image and video processing. While contemporary deep learning models, such as CNNs and Transformers, excel in pixel-level enhancements, they often overlook the rich semantic context within images. To address this, we introduce a novel approach that synergizes pixel intensity with semantic information for superior detail recovery. Our method involves extracting semantic data, including textual descriptors and spatial positioning, and encoding this information. We also present a Cross-Modal Feature Fusion module for generating semantic feature maps via multimodal training, and a Prompt Traction Head to augment the backbone network with semantic insights, thereby refining image details. Our empirical results across various datasets validate the superiority of our approach.

</details>


### [206] [SAFE-Hair: Scalp-Anchored Fields for Exportable Single-View Hair Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12037)
*Yucheng Wang,Zedong Wang,Yuetong Wu,Yue Ma,Dan Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAFE-Hair 通过从单张肖像中重建显式发束，提出了一个新的框架，该框架通过优化几何有效性和直接导出具 follicle ID 和引导族元数据的资产来改善3D发束的重建保真度和资产可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前单视图3D发束重建方法主要关注视觉合理性，而忽略了可直接用于剪发、编辑或模拟管道的发束资产的生产。SAFE-Hair 的目标是解决这一问题，通过直接优化几何有效性和提供直接导出的资产来实现在单张肖像上的3D发束重建。

Method: SAFE-Hair 采用基于模板头部的框架，将自监督图像特征投影到头皮上，使用条件化矩形流量模型生成头皮域的潜在场，并在固定头皮毛囊处解码毛发的占用、段方向、长度分配和总长度。同时引入了附着、碰撞和弯曲先验以提高几何有效性。

Result: SAFE-Hair 在基准测试 HairBench-3D 中，Chamfer 距离从 3.74 mm 提升到 3.28 mm，F-分数从 77.9 提升到 81.7，不可见区域 F-分数从 66.1 提升到 69.8，穿透率从 4.8% 降低到 3.9%，超越了最强的基线方法。

Conclusion: 这项研究展示了一种新的单视图3D发束重建方法，该方法不仅提高了重建保真度，还提供了直接使用的发束资产，展示了其在几何有效性和资产可用性上的显著提升。

Abstract: Single-view 3D hair reconstruction has progressed rapidly, but many methods optimize for visual plausibility rather than producing strand assets that can be directly used in grooming, editing, or simulation pipelines. We propose SAFE-Hair, a framework that reconstructs explicit strand grooms from a single portrait by decoding hair from persistent follicles in a canonical scalp-UV domain. Given a fitted template head, SAFE-Hair projects self-supervised image features onto the scalp, uses a conditional Rectified Flow model to generate latent scalp fields, and decodes occupancy, segment directions, length allocation, and total length at a fixed set of scalp follicles. This representation enforces scalp-rooted strand identities by construction and enables direct export with follicle IDs and guide-family metadata. We further introduce attachment, collision, and bending priors to improve geometric validity without per-subject test-time optimization. To evaluate both reconstruction fidelity and asset usability, we introduce HairBench-3D, a benchmark built from public 3D hair assets with standardized alignment, rendering, resampling, and metrics for geometry, direction consistency, invisible-region completion, silhouette agreement, and collision. SAFE-Hair improves Chamfer distance from 3.74 mm to 3.28 mm, F-score from 77.9 to 81.7, invisible-region F-score from 66.1 to 69.8, and penetration ratio from 4.8% to 3.9% over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [207] [Leveraging Complementary Event Frame and Voxel Representations for RGB-Guided Multimodal Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12040)
*Wentao Wu,Xiao Wang,Yi Wang,Chenglong Li,Yonghong Tian,Bin Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CM3AE 2.0 是一个用于 RGB 帧和事件体素/帧的统一预训练框架，通过联合学习多模态时空表示和跨模态生成，增强多模态信息交互和协作建模能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统预训练方法在建模多模态信息和跨模态依赖关系方面存在不足，CM3AE 2.0 通过事件感知的时空掩码重建策略和层次跨模态生成策略，提升了多模态信息交互和跨模态依赖关系的建模能力。

Method: 提出了事件感知的时空掩码重建 (ESMR) 策略，结合多模态融合重建和跨模态对比学习，以及层次跨模态生成 (HCG) 策略。

Result: 在四个不同的下游任务上进行的大量实验表明，CM3AE 2.0 统一框架在所有任务上都取得了显著的性能提升，验证了框架的有效性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 提出的CM3AE 2.0框架证明了其在多模态时空表示和跨模态依赖学习上的优势，且在多个下游任务上的效果提升显著，具有较高的应用价值。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose CM3AE 2.0, a unified RGB Frame and Event-Voxel/-Frame pre-training framework. By jointly learning multimodal spatiotemporal representations and exploiting latent cross-modal dependencies through cross-modal generation, the framework enhances multimodal information interaction and collaborative modeling capabilities. Specifically, we first propose an Event-aware Spatiotemporal Masked Reconstruction (ESMR) strategy to learn unified multimodal spatiotemporal representations. It leverages event responses to guide masking toward dynamically salient regions. Through spatiotemporal masked reconstruction, it learns spatial structures and their temporal variations from continuous RGB-Event observations. In addition, it incorporates multimodal fusion reconstruction and cross-modal contrastive learning to facilitate the modeling of cross-modal complementary information and the learning of shared representations. Building upon this, we further propose a Hierarchical Cross-modal Generation (HCG) strategy to learn latent cross-modal dependencies through visual and language generation. At the visual level, Event-conditioned RGB generation is performed using a pre-trained diffusion model to capture visual associations between the two modalities. At the language level, video-level text description generation based on joint RGB-Event representations establishes connections between multimodal visual features and linguistic semantics, further enriching the learning of cross-modal dependencies. Extensive experiments on four diverse downstream tasks demonstrate that CM3AE 2.0 consistently improves performance, validating the effectiveness and generalization capability of the proposed pre-training framework.

</details>


### [208] [Four-Step Text-Bearing Image Generation via Distillation with Local Response Regularization and Teacher-Guided Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12042)
*Kairui Wen,Sheng Ye,Yong-Jin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种四步蒸馏框架，结合局部响应正则化和教师引导的文字训练，用于从文本生成图像。与四步教师驱动的模型相比，该方法在综合评估和文本准确度方面表现更优，同时提高了速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大型文本到图像模型需要大量采样以生成高质量的图像，这增加了计算成本。为了降低成本，但又能保持图像质量和文本准确性，提出了一种新的蒸馏框架。

Method: 该方法基于分布匹配，通过四步蒸馏保留了教师模型的自回归视觉先验、字符编码器和VAE，并结合了局部响应正则化、路径长度惩罚和教师引导训练。

Result: 该研究的模型在GenEval综合评估和CVTG-2K单词准确性测试中取得了更好的结果，单张图像推理速度提高了3.34倍。

Conclusion: 研究证明了该四步蒸馏框架的有效性，并可能为未来文本到图像模型的高效生成提供新的途径。

Abstract: Generating text-bearing images requires coherent scenes and accurate characters. Large text-to-image models improve both capabilities through repeated denoising, at substantial sampling cost. Few-step distillation reduces this cost but requires the student to organize scenes and refine glyphs within a short trajectory. We present a four-step distillation framework combining local response regularization with teacher-guided text training. Built on distribution matching, the framework distills the GLM-Image DiT while retaining its autoregressive visual prior, glyph encoder, and VAE. A path-length penalty promotes consistent local responses of the conditional denoising field. Progressive training combines synthetic strings with teacher-generated imagery to preserve character accuracy and scene-integrated typography. The student achieves GenEval Overall 0.84 and CVTG-2K word accuracy 0.5045, compared with 0.81 and 0.1690 for four-step TDM. A coefficient study favors $10^{-5}$, and Qwen-Image experiments show additional gains from response regularization and text supervision. Single-image inference takes 1.742 s, compared with 5.818 s for the teacher, yielding a $3.34\times$ speedup at the same 40 GB GPU memory requirement.

</details>


### [209] [Attention-Guided Sequence Feature Fusion and Mixed-Space Metric Learning for Cross-View Image Sequence Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12051)
*Nan Wu,Chunfang Yang,Jiangshan Li,Xiangyang Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种通过注意力引导的序列融合和度量学习方法（ASML）来进行跨视角图像序列地理定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了克服常规融合策略在跨视角匹配中削弱空间关系的问题，本文提出了ASML方法来优化图像序列的地理定位。

Method: 该方法包含三个部分：1）序列内容融合模块（SCF）用于建模跨图像特征相关性，抑制冗余内容并适应性地保护地理信息丰富的非重叠区域；2）空间特征聚合模块（SFA）用于捕捉和聚合局部特征的空间和语义信息，保持图像序列的布局；3）Geo-InfoNCE损失函数，综合考虑特征距离和地理距离进行混合空间度量学习，增强模型识别硬负样本的能力。

Result: 在SeqGeo和CrossRoad-66K数据集上进行的广泛实验和可视化结果表明，与最先进的（SOTA）方法相比，ASML在R@1指标上分别实现了3.37%和2.10%的改进。

Conclusion: 研究表明，ASML方法在跨视角图像序列地理定位方面具有优越性。

Abstract: Cross-view image sequence geo-localization aims to determine the geographic location of a sequence of ground images by matching it against geo-tagged satellite imagery. Although sequential observations provide complementary scene information, substantial overlap between adjacent images introduces feature redundancy, while conventional fusion strategies may weaken spatial relationships essential for cross-view matching. Therefore, we propose a cross-view image sequence geo-localization method via Attention-guided Sequence fusion and Metric Learning (ASML). Specifically, a Sequential Content Fusion (SCF) module models cross-image feature correlations to suppress redundant content and adaptively preserve geographically informative non-overlapping regions. Next, a Spatial Feature Aggregation (SFA) module is used to capture and aggregate the spatial and semantic information of local features, so as to maintain the spatial layout of the image sequence. Finally, a Geo-InfoNCE loss function is proposed, which comprehensively considers the feature distance and geographic distance for mixed-space metric learning, thus improving the ability of the model to distinguish hard negative samples. A new cross-view image sequence dataset CrossRoad-66K is established to provide more complex scenarios. Extensive experiments and visualizations on the SeqGeo and CrossRoad-66K datasets demonstrate that compared to state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, the proposed method ASML achieves an improvement of 3.37% and 2.10% at R@1, respectively.

</details>


### [210] [Weight-Space Programming for Medical Imaging: Do We Still Need Training Data?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12066)
*Maximilian Lindholz,Richard Ruppel,Annette Milnik,Sebastian Halskov,Semil Eminovic,Charlie A. Hamm,Robin Schmidt,Anika Knupfer,Jana Hutter,Johanna P. Müller,Carolina Dominguez Aleixo,Jawed Nawabi,Jens Vogel-Claussen,Tobias Penzkofer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究发现，大型语言模型（LLM）可以仅利用医学知识生成医疗图像分类器的参数，但性能仍不及直接使用标记数据训练的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索是否可以通过语言模型直接生成医疗图像分类器的参数，从而减少对大量标记图像数据的依赖。

Method: 使用两个大型语言模型Claude Opus 5.5和GPT-6 Astra，通过权重空间编程（WSP）方法生成神经网络参数，与直接训练的模型进行对比。

Result: 语言模型生成的网络在所有MedMNIST任务中均表现优于随机猜测，且使用参数数量明显少于直接训练的模型，但效果仍低于直接训练在仅有少量标记图像上的效果。

Conclusion: 研究表明，语言模型能够生成功能性的医疗分类器，但仍无法完全替代使用标记数据的训练方法。

Abstract: Can a large language model (LLM) write the parameters of a medical image classifier from medical knowledge alone, without any training data? Such classifiers normally require labelled images, which are costly and often unavailable. We investigate this question through weight-space programming (WSP), in which an LLM writes or adapts the weights and biases of a neural network directly, without optimisation on training data. Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra each generate the parameters of a small LeNet-style CNN in a single reply, without tool use and without access to any image. We compare these networks against zero-shot MedSigLIP and against the same architecture trained on labels using the Adam optimiser, across 7 classification tasks in four modalities: chest X-ray, breast ultrasound and abdominal CT (all from MedMNIST), and pelvic MRI (SynthUterus). The LLM-written networks perform above chance on all six MedMNIST tasks, with a mean test AUC of 0.719 for Opus and 0.711 for Astra. Both models outperform MedSigLIP on 5 of 6 tasks while using more than 10,000 times fewer parameters. However, the same network trained with Adam on only 256 labelled images achieves a higher AUC on every MedMNIST task (mean AUC 0.828). On SynthUterus, Opus attains an AUC of 0.764, whereas Astra falls below chance (AUC 0.136) owing to a systematic error. These results show that LLMs can write functional medical classifiers, but that they do not yet replace training data. We release the protocol, logs and all generated weights at https://github.com/MaximilianLindholz/weight-space-programming-medical.

</details>


### [211] [MPEG-Diffusion: Mixed-Resolution Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12069)
*Dennis Menn,Tianpei Gu,Guande He,Aryan V S,Yanke Song,Nan Liu,Desai Xie,Xun Huang,Chenfeng Xu,Diana Marculescu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MPEG-Diffusion 提出了一种有效的解决混合分辨率生成视频质量问题的方法，通过引入双重分辨率注意机制、混合分辨率解码器以及自选的高分辨率区域，使得在仅处理 30% 的全分辨率token下就能显著提升视频的生成速度与质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的混合分辨率生成方法虽然能够降低计算成本，但会导致视频质量下降，并且需要提前知道高分辨率区域，MPEG-Diffusion 的目标是解决这些不足。

Method: MPEG-Diffusion 方法通过利用双重分辨率注意机制，使得每个查询只读取自己分辨率的 K/V；采用混合分辨率解码器，结合高分辨率和低分辨率的潜在空间，在最后进行解码以减少失真；并且通过利用 DiT 的知识，自动选出视频中视觉重要区域，无需提前知道。

Result: MPEG-Diffusion 在减慢了 30% 的全分辨率 token 处理量的情况下，提高了去噪速度 4.8 倍 (1.3B 模型是 3.8 倍)，并且其性能在几乎所有指标上都优于现有方法。用户研究表明，该方法生成的视频质量非常高，超过 90% 的情况下用户体验优于其他混合分辨率方法，并接近全分辨率的视频。

Conclusion: MPEG-Diffusion 通过这些问题的解决，成功平衡了计算效率与视频质量之间的关系，为更广泛的实际应用铺平了道路。

Abstract: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate realistic videos, but their heavy computational cost limits broader real-world applications. Mixed-resolution generation reduces this cost by generating the visually important region at high resolution (HR) and the rest at low resolution (LR), yet existing methods suffer a severe quality drop on videos and require knowing the HR region in advance. We show that these failures are not inherent to mixed resolution, and propose $\textbf{MPEG-Diffusion}$ to address their three root causes: (1) dual-resolution attention to mitigate the curse of mixed resolution, where each query reads the K/V of its own resolution, (2) a mixed-resolution decoder to blend the HR and LR latents before decoding and resolve distortion, and (3) a self-selected HR region using the DiT's knowledge to find the visually important region without requiring it in advance. Processing only $30\%$ of full-resolution tokens, MPEG-Diffusion speeds up denoising by $4.8\times$ on Wan2.1 14B ($3.8\times$ on 1.3B), outperforming prior methods on nearly every metric. In the user study, we demonstrate the high quality of MPEG-Diffusion, with raters preferring it over prior mixed-resolution methods in over $90\%$ of pairs and rating it close to full resolution.

</details>


### [212] [Color wave: A systematic evaluation of active screen illumination for injection attack detection in remote face authentication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12070)
*Daniyar Kurmankhojayev,Elmurat Nigmatov,Dmitrii Gordin,Andrei Shadrikov,Mikhail Shkorin,Danijar Gabdullin,Vyacheslav Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过将主动屏幕照明方法应用于颜色波形并开发了一套系统性的攻击针对性评估协议，旨在评估其在注入攻击检测中的有效性，并发现在受控条件下具有较强的鉴别信号，但在过度曝光、低屏幕亮度和动作等操作条件下性能受限，且存在一定的逃避策略漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程面部认证需要对屏幕投影攻击和生物特征数据注入攻击进行防护，尽管已有很多针对屏幕投影攻击检测的方法研究，但针对注入攻击检测的研究仍显不足。因此，研究者分类了注入内容类型，并将主动屏幕照明方法应用于颜色波形，开发了注入攻击针对性评估协议。

Method: 研究者将主动屏幕照明方法应用于颜色波形，并开发了一套新的评估协议，该协议涵盖了识别效果、不同操作条件下的泛化能力、信号降级的鲁棒性以及针对特定逃避策略的易感性。

Result: 在受控条件下，颜色波形方法能有效地检测注入攻击，但在过度曝光、低屏幕亮度和运动等情况下效果较差，且存在一定的针对图像识别、动作遮挡和面部变换的逃避策略漏洞。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，颜色波形方法在注入攻击检测中有强烈的鉴别信号，但在特定条件下存在性能局限和脆弱性。研究结果为理解主动屏幕照明方法在注入攻击检测中的成功率和失败原因提供了可解释的评估。

Abstract: Remote face authentication requires protection against both presentation attacks and biometric data injection attacks prior to face matching. Methods based on active screen illumination appear promising for both by introducing randomized visual stimuli through the user's device screen and evaluating the corresponding facial responses. Although such methods have been more studied for presentation attack detection (PAD), their systematic evaluation for injection attack detection (IAD) remains limited. To address this gap, we first classify injected content into static images, prerecorded videos, and real-time deepfakes based on their expected responses to the challenge. We then adapt an active screen-illumination approach into an implementation we term color wave and develop a systematic, injection-specific evaluation protocol. The protocol examines detection effectiveness, generalization across operating conditions, robustness to signal degradation, and susceptibility to selected evasion strategies. The findings demonstrate a strong discriminative signal under controlled conditions but also reveal performance limitations under overexposure, low screen brightness, and subject motion, as well as vulnerabilities to selected evasion strategies. By relating detection outcomes to attack types and operating conditions, this study provides an interpretable assessment of when and why active screen illumination succeeds or fails as an IAD mechanism.

</details>


### [213] [How a Model's Architecture and Performance Influences Explainability: A Study of Grad-CAM and CRAFT in CNN-Based Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12075)
*Kilian Göller,Haadia Amjad,Steffen Seitz,Carsten Knoll,Ronald Tetzlaff*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究使用10个ImageNet-1K数据集子集，训练了VGG16、ResNet50和ConvNeXt-Tiny三种不同复杂度的CNN模型，并通过Grad-CAM和CRAFT两种XAI方法评估了这些模型的 Faithfulness、Correctness、Sensitivity和Simplicity等关键指标，结果显示复杂架构的模型在解释的鲁棒性方面有所提高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗和自主系统等高风险应用中，AI模型的决策需要透明和可追溯。本文旨在通过实证研究，理解模型复杂度和训练精度对解释质量的影响，以改进XAI方法。

Method: 研究使用Grad-CAM和CRAFT两种常见XAI方法，对三个不同复杂度的CNN模型在10个ImageNet-1K数据集的10个子集上的训练情况进行分析。通过评估模型在Faithfulness、Correctness、Sensitivity和Simplicity等四个关键指标上的表现来研究影响解释质量的因素。

Result: 研究发现，随着训练的进行，ResNet50和ConvNeXt-Tiny复杂模型的Faithfulness提高，Sensitivity降低，意味着它们的解释更加稳健；而VGG16结构简单模型虽解释更简单，但在Faithfulness和Correctness上表现较差。

Conclusion: 本研究提供了一种系统的方法来评估模型复杂程度和训练精度对XAI解释质量的影响，并为进一步研究和完善XAI方法提供了依据。

Abstract: Deep learning models, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), are widely adopted in computer vision, yet their opaque decision-making raises concerns in high-risk applications like healthcare and autonomous systems, where trust and accountability are critical. Therefore, robust explainable AI (XAI) methods are desirable to provide transparent insights into model decisions. To ensure these methods are reliable and effective across diverse scenarios, it is important to understand how model performance and architectural complexity influence explanation quality. Our study takes an initial step toward systematically investigating the impact of these two factors on key XAI evaluation metrics. We constructed a pipeline using 10 subsets of ImageNet-1K, each containing 80 unique classes, on each of which we trained three CNN architectures of increasing structural complexity: VGG16, ResNet50, and ConvNeXt-Tiny. For each individual model, we analyzed 10 training checkpoints representing increasing levels of model accuracy using two XAI methods: Grad-CAM (feature-attribution-based) and CRAFT (concept-based). We assessed these methods across four evaluation categories: Faithfulness, Correctness, Sensitivity, and Simplicity. Our findings reveal that as training progresses, the complex architectures (ResNet50 and ConvNeXt-Tiny) exhibit improved Faithfulness and lower Sensitivity, indicating more robust explanations. In contrast, VGG16's simpler architecture yields simpler but less faithful and correct explanations.

</details>


### [214] [Compass 1: Towards Open-World and Persistent Embodied Navigation from Monocular RGB Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12087)
*Hai Zhang,Siqi Liang,Yanjun Guo,Shoufeng Zhang,Yunhao Wang,Hangyu Du,Haoguang Mai,Hongchen Li,Jiazhi Yang,Jialong Zeng,Yu Hu,Chen Chen,Gangcheng Jiang,Zishun Zhuo,Lirui Zhao,Zhigang Li,Yu Qiao,Zhenjie Yang,Fu Zhang,Hongyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Compass 1 是一种无偏置的统一架构，能够通过整合语言理解和视频生成，支持超过2分钟的视觉历史记录，引入了History Representation和History Utilization机制，使得长周期上下文保持稳定性，最终在开放世界评估中取得了显著优越的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的导航架构难以同时保持长期空间意识和远期执行稳定性，限制了其在开放世界环境下的应用。本文旨在解决这一问题，通过引入一种新的框架和机制，实现持久的导航稳定性和长期上下文的保持。

Method: Compass 1 通过统一语言理解和视频生成，并利用稀疏视觉关键帧和明确的历史表示地图，整合了强大的历史记录能力。此外，还提出了 History Utilization，这是一种结构化的VQA监督协议，包括任务阶段定位、探索一致性和时空目标检索，增强了模型的长期导航能力。

Result: Compass 1 达到了79.4%的整体成功率，相比之下，最强的基线为17.8%。在基础任务上的零样本执行超过了90%，探索效率提高了250%，在挑战性持久历史回溯任务上的表现前所未有地达到了58%。

Conclusion: Compass 1 成功地结合了开放领域的导航需求，展示了广泛的场景适用性和优异的性能，为未来的真实世界导航系统奠定了基础。

Abstract: Embodied navigation requires agents to achieve persistent spatial awareness and long-horizon execution stability in open-world environments. However, existing navigation architectures struggle to sustain both capabilities, remaining effective only over a handful of recent frames. We present Compass 1, the first embodied navigation foundation model to unify language understanding and video generation while enabling memory backtracking through nearly 2mins of visual history. Without altering the underlying architecture, we introduce History Representation, which integrates sparse visual keyframes with an explicit History Representation Map to preserve long-term spatiotemporal context. To effectively leverage this history, we further introduce History Utilization, a structured VQA supervision protocol comprising three categories: task-stage grounding, exploration consistency, and spatiotemporal target retrieval, enabling map-grounded reasoning and stable persistent long-horizon navigation. To fuel this system, we establish a complete annotation pipeline for monocular RGB videos and open-source a massive dataset featuring over 500 hours of high-quality real-world interactions and over 2,000 hours of annotated web videos. Trained mainly on the distribution of 1m height camera, Compass 1 generalizes seamlessly across diverse embodiments and scenarios, ranging from indoor environments to pedestrian-dense streets, spanning wheeled robot at 0.35m, quadruped dog at 0.5m, humanoid at 0.85m, and aerial drone at 1.5m. Compass 1achieves a dominant overall success rate of 79.4% across open-world evaluations, compared to 17.8% for the strongest baseline. It demonstrates exceptional zero-shot execution exceeding 90% on foundational tasks, a 250% boost in exploration, and an unparalleled leap from 0% to 58% in challenging persistent history backtracking.

</details>


### [215] [RAPA: Ray-Aware Physics Augmentation for Robust Camera-LiDAR Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12129)
*Kyung-Rin Oh,Ji-Hoon Kim,TaeJoon Ha,Jae-Sang Hyun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过将棋盘定位问题转换为2D检测问题，并提出了一种基于射线感知物理增强（RAPA）的合成数据生成方法，显著提升了在不同环境条件下的检测鲁棒性和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于目标的相机- LiDAR校准方法依赖于棋盘格特征的提取，但由于LiDAR点云测量的稀疏性，准确地从点云中提取这些特征具有挑战性。现有的方法要么需要人工标注三维角点，要么依赖于几何特征提取方法，这两种方法在棋盘格特征观察不足时会变得不可靠。

Method: 该方法首先将棋盘格定位问题表示为2D检测问题，并利用圆柱形LiDAR反射图像。为了克服缺乏标注训练数据的问题，提出了一种基于射线感知物理增强（RAPA）的方法。该方法从单个棋盘格观察中生成多样化的合成样本，生成的数据被用来提高检测器在不同感知条件下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

Result: 在四个独立捕捉的室内和室外地点中，提出的方法在mAP@0.5上超越了最强的图像空间增强基准，最高提升了43.1个百分点。与基于242次观察的无训练方法相比，RAPA提供了有效的目标定位，有96.4%的检测结果可以成功提取有效的目标姿态。

Conclusion: 总体而言，RAPA通过仅使用单个标注的目标观察即实现在LiDAR端的自动化目标定位，解决了基于目标的校准方法中的关键瓶颈问题。

Abstract: Camera-LiDAR calibration is essential for reliable perception in robotic and autonomous systems. Most target-based calibration methods rely on checkerboard observations, but accurate checkerboard feature extraction from LiDAR point clouds remains challenging due to measurement sparsity. Existing approaches either require manual annotation of 3D corners or depend on geometric feature extraction methods, both of which can become unreliable when checkerboard features are insufficiently observed. In this paper, we formulate checkerboard localization as a 2D detection problem using cylindrical LiDAR reflectivity images. To overcome the limited availability of labeled training data, we propose ray-aware physics augmentation (RAPA), which generates diverse synthetic samples from a single checkerboard observation. The generated data are used to improve detector robustness and generalization under varying sensing conditions. Across four independently captured indoor and outdoor locations, the proposed synthetic augmentation exceeds the strongest evaluated image-space augmentation baseline by 16.1-43.1 percentage points in mAP@0.5. Compared with training-free target-based methods on 242 observations, RAPA yields the largest number of valid target localizations, with 96.4% of its returned detections yielding valid target poses. These reliable localizations support downstream camera-LiDAR calibration across all four evaluated locations. Overall, RAPA addresses a key bottleneck in target-based calibration by enabling automated LiDAR-side target localization with only a single annotated target observation.

</details>


### [216] [DisasterVL: Evidence-Based Visual Reasoning Dataset and Model for Disaster Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12144)
*Ali Diba,Aisha Al-Mohannadi,Yin Yang,Muhammad Imran,Ferda Ofli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DisasterVL是一个包含约120万张灾害图像和2500万结构化注解的灾害图像视觉语言数据集和基准，实验表明9B DisasterVLM模型在图像描述、开放型VQA、灾害事件推理和区域层级定位上优于通用基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前灾害应对领域缺乏足够的数据和基准测试来评估人工智能模型的生成和解析能力，特别是在困难的环境下。因此，需要一个具有挑战性的灾害图像视觉语言数据集，以促进相关研究的发展。

Method: DisasterVL数据集通过收集来自142个国家的120万张灾害图像，附以2500万条结构化注解，涵盖了场景描述、灾害事件评估、空间关系和视觉问题回答。特别地，注解包括可视证据与问题的回答、存在的和不存在的线索、多种答案格式以及难度标签。

Result: 在DisasterVL基准上，9B DisasterVLM模型在图像描述、开放型VQA、灾害事件推理和区域层级定位上优于检查点和基线模型，特别是在文本重叠度上取得了更好的成绩。

Conclusion: 未来可能会有更多的研究基于DisasterVL进行，以改善在灾害图像理解中的模型表现，同时数据集的公开也会促进更多相关研究的开展。

Abstract: We introduce DisasterVL, a dataset and benchmark for evidence-grounded reasoning about disaster imagery. It contains approximately 1.2 million images from 142 countries, paired with 25 million structured annotations covering scene captions, incident and location assessments, spatial relationships, and visual question answering (VQA). The VQA annotations link answers to visible evidence and include questions about both present and absent cues, multiple answer formats, and difficulty labels. Region-level annotations link caption phrases to bounding boxes and spatial relationships to the regions they connect. The test set contains 38,254 images spanning 75 countries and 28 hazard types. Gemini 3.1 Pro audited the test annotations, and human reviewers validated a stratified subset. On this benchmark, the 9B DisasterVLM model outperforms the evaluated general-purpose baselines on captioning, open-ended VQA, incident reasoning, and region-level grounding. Gains in text overlap are larger than gains in evidence scores. We plan to publicly release the dataset, trained models, and code.

</details>


### [217] [EgoLabel: Zero-Shot Egocentric Auto-Labeling with Cross-Modal Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12149)
*Xiaozhi Zhang,Changjia Xu,Yaoyuan Yan,Haoxiang Jie,Bingjie Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoLabel 是一个零样本管道，结合了一组预先训练好的模型，解决了跨模态注册和一致性诊断的问题。通过使用 H2O 传感器深度进行手部评估，显示了显著的残差减少和与真实参考数据之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自中心标注需要多个独立开发模型之间的深度、相机姿态、物体和人类姿态估算相互一致，但由于单位、坐标约定和比例的差异，可能变得几何上不一致。因此，提出了 EgoLabel 管道来解决这些问题，无需目标域的标注训练，并提供明确的跨模态注册和一致性诊断。

Method: EgoLabel 使用 MonST3R 进行几何计算，LocateAnything 与 GMC-BoT-SORT 和 SAM~2 进行物体识别，以及 V-HPOT 进行手部识别；FisheyeViT 提供了全身兼容性的演示。该管道结合了这些模型并在多个序列上进行了手部评估，使用 H2O 传感器深度作为参考。

Result: 在 20 个序列的手部评估中，使用 H2O 传感器深度的人手深度锚定降低了平均序列中手部深度残差的 23%，使得平均深度残差降低至 84.6 毫米，与 20.5 毫米的真实参考相比。手部 PA-MPJPE 为 14.53 ± 1.29 毫米，绝对 MPJPE 为 119.1 ± 31.3 毫米，显示出对齐和度量准确度之间存在显著差距。在三个 RGB 仅序列中，摄像机 ATE 为 1.40 ± 0.29 厘米，通过 Sim(3) 对齐后。

Conclusion: EgoLabel 管道通过手部锚定和残差的措施增强了跨模态注册和一致性的评估，但也揭示了目前实现中的潜力和限制。

Abstract: Egocentric auto-labeling requires depth, camera pose, object, and human-pose estimates to agree across independently developed models. Differences in units, coordinate conventions, and scale can make individually plausible predictions geometrically inconsistent. We present \textbf{EgoLabel}, a zero-shot pipeline that combines off-the-shelf models without target-domain labeled training and provides explicit cross-modal registration and consistency diagnostics. The pipeline integrates MonST3R for geometry, LocateAnything with GMC-BoT-SORT and SAM~2 for objects, and V-HPOT for hands; FisheyeViT provides a separate whole-body compatibility demonstration. Our main hand evaluation uses H2O sensor depth. Across 20 sequences, per-hand depth anchoring reduces the mean of per-sequence median hand--depth residuals by $23\%$ relative to a single global scale, yielding a pooled median of $84.6\,\mathrm{mm}$ against a $20.5\,\mathrm{mm}$ ground-truth reference. Hand PA-MPJPE is $14.53\pm1.29\,\mathrm{mm}$, whereas absolute MPJPE is $119.1\pm31.3\,\mathrm{mm}$, revealing a substantial gap between aligned and metric accuracy. On three RGB-only sequences, camera ATE is $1.40\pm0.29\,\mathrm{cm}$ after $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ alignment. We also identify a sliding-window implementation issue that allows sensor-initialized depth to change during optimization. Because hand anchoring and its residual share the same depth map, the residual measures internal consistency rather than independent accuracy. These results characterize both the utility and the current limits of the registration pipeline.

</details>


### [218] [CADMA: Capacity-Aware Coverage Decomposition for Generative Model Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12243)
*Debin Meng,Zheng Gao,Ziquan Liu,Yanran Li,Ioannis Patras,Georgios Tzimiropoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出CADMA框架，通过局部容量匹配评估生成模型的分布覆盖能力，区分几何覆盖与有效覆盖，提供了多维度的覆盖诊断，能更可靠地评估覆盖情况，并提供更细粒度、可解释的多样性失败诊断信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的召回率度量简化了分布覆盖到基于几何的覆盖，导致诊断值和解释性减弱。

Method: CADMA通过局部容量匹配评估生成样本的分布覆盖，而非单纯依赖几何覆盖，区分几何覆盖与有效覆盖，从而量化模态丢失和模态坍缩等问题。

Result: 在玩具数据、真实数据集和生成模型上的实验表明，CADMA提供了比现有度量更可靠的覆盖估计和更细粒度、可解释的多样性失败诊断信号。

Conclusion: CADMA框架提高了分布水平上的评估质量，为生成模型的质量提升提供了有力工具，其代码已开源。

Abstract: Evaluating generative models requires measuring not only sample fidelity but also how well a generated set covers the real data distribution. Recent work has therefore introduced recall-oriented metrics for distribution-level evaluation. However, existing recall metrics often reduce distributional coverage to geometry-based coverage. This simplifying assumption weakens their diagnostic value and interpretability in two ways: these metrics provide only a single aggregate score that cannot distinguish essential diversity failures such as mode dropping and mode collapse, and geometry-based coverage can provide unreliable estimates by assigning high scores to poorly covered generative distributions. We therefore introduce CADMA, a capacity-aware framework for recall-oriented evaluation and diagnosis. CADMA evaluates distributional coverage through local capacity matching between real and generated samples, separating geometry-based coverage from effective coverage. This yields multi-dimensional coverage diagnostics that quantify mode dropping and mode collapse while reducing the overly optimistic estimates produced by geometry-based metrics. Through extensive experiments on toy data, real-world datasets, and generative models, we show that CADMA provides more reliable coverage estimates and more fine-grained, interpretable diagnostic signals of diversity failures than existing metrics. Our code is available at https://github.com/Open-Debin/CADMA_NeurIPS2026.

</details>


### [219] [A forensic evaluation framework for egocentric foundation models: an EFM3D case study for crime scene reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12259)
*Davidson Chisom Onwubiko,Shahana Bano,Carlos Francisco Moreno-García*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一个结构化的司法现场评估框架评估egocentric基础模型，使用EFM3D对四个室内司法现场进行了模拟记录。EFM3D生成了多边形数量较大的网格模型，并且在细粒度的司法证据方面表现较弱，被定位为辅助而不是替代高保真司法现场捕捉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于基础模型在三维场景理解中整合了几何、语义和空间上下文，但其在司法犯罪现场重建中的适用性尚不清楚，本文旨在为egocentric基础模型提供一个结构化的司法评估框架。

Method: 本文通过在Robert Gordon大学东洛奇房屋司法培训设施模拟记录四个室内司法现场，采用EFM3D模型进行了评估。

Result: 研究结果表明，EFM3D生成的大规模网格模型在总体几何和语义理解上达到一定水平，但在细粒度的司法证据支持上较弱。数据处理速率及时间等性能表现良好。

Conclusion: EFM3D作为用于司法现场背景记录和审查的辅助工具，而非完全替代传统的高保真司法现场捕捉。这项研究框架为未来egocentric基础模型在专门司法环境中的评估提供了可重复的基准。

Abstract: Foundation models increasingly combine geometry, semantics, and spatial context for three-dimensional scene understanding, but their suitability for forensic crime scene reconstruction remains unclear. This study presents a structured forensic evaluation framework for egocentric foundation models and demonstrates it using the Egocentric Foundation Model for 3D (EFM3D). Four simulated indoor crime scenes were recorded with Meta Project Aria Gen~1 at Robert Gordon University's East Lodge House forensic training facility. The framework evaluates room-scale reconstruction, semantic scene understanding, computational performance, and forensic suitability. Across the four scenes, EFM3D generated meshes averaging $12{,}668\pm2{,}430$ vertices and $24{,}838\pm4{,}903$ faces, with 39,529 recorded semantic predictions spanning 21--24 categories at a mean confidence of 0.40. Because reference meshes and expert-labelled 3D ground truth were unavailable, these statistics are treated as descriptive outputs rather than measures of geometric or detection accuracy. Final inference runs processed $1{,}388\pm203$ snippets per scene at $0.69\pm0.01$ samples/s and required $50.77\pm6.12$ minutes per recording. A seven-criterion capability profile indicated stronger support for room geometry, furniture localisation, scene context, and spatial relationships than for fine-scale forensic evidence. The results position EFM3D as a complementary tool for contextual documentation and scene review rather than a replacement for high-fidelity forensic capture. The framework provides a reproducible basis for evaluating future egocentric foundation models in specialised forensic settings.

</details>


### [220] [TMT: Adapting CLIP to Infrared Imagery via Text-Derived Modality Knowledge Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12345)
*Ruofan Wang,Puzuo Wang,Xin Chen,Zibo Yu,Jungang Yang,Yi Hou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TMT 提出了一种方法，通过结合文本导向的红外-可见光方向和配对图像监督，改进 CLIP 在红外可见光图像上的模态知识迁移，显著提高了零样本分类和红外文本检索任务的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究如何通过有限的红外-可见光配对图像调整基于文本-图像的模型 CLIP，使得机器能够更好地理解和处理红外图像。由于红外标签的标注成本高昂，这一研究意义重大。

Method: TMT 方法首先通过文本嵌入差异的方向引导可见光和红外模态之间的知识转移，保持了红外图像的特定信息。然后，TMT 引入了一种生成感知协监督方法，结合 CLIP 可见光图像编码的语义对齐及扩撒噪声预测反馈，提升了红外图像的语义和细节表示。

Result: TMT 在四个来源互斥的红外分类基准测试中达到了最高的零样本准确率（48.92%）。在红外文本检索任务中，TMT 也表现出最佳的结果。在 CART 和 SemanticRT 上的开集语义分割 miou 中，TMT 达到了最高的 CLIP 类方法中的 miou。

Conclusion: TMT 成功地实现了 CLIP 对红外图像的适应性改进，并在多个基准测试上展示了优于其他方法的性能，这表明该方法的有效性和可靠性。

Abstract: Vision-language models such as CLIP achieve strong performance across computer vision tasks, yet their image-text alignment is less reliable for infrared (IR) imagery because large-scale pre-training is dominated by visible-spectrum data. Due to the high cost of the infrared-text labeling, we investigate adapting CLIP to IR through only paired infrared-visible images, which requires considering modality-specific knowledge while preserving scene content and CLIP's image-text alignment. To achieve this, we propose TMT (Text-Derived Modality Knowledge Transfer), which adapts CLIP's image encoder through a text-defined infrared-to-visible direction and supervision from paired IR-visible images. First, we found that modality discrepancy can be described by corresponding text embeddings, thus using the direction of text embedding differences to guide the knowledge transfer between visible and infrared modalities without erasing infrared-specific information. To enhance the representation of semantics and details of infrared images, we introduce Generative-Perceptual Co-Supervision that combines semantic alignment from CLIP visible image encoder with diffusion noise-prediction feedbacks. On four source-disjoint IR classification benchmarks, TMT achieves the highest mean zero-shot accuracy among the compared methods (48.92%). It also achieves the best IR-text retrieval results among the compared methods without infrared-text supervision during adaptation and the highest open-vocabulary segmentation mIoU on both CART and SemanticRT among the CLIP-like methods.

</details>


### [221] [ReVMap: Vectorized Global Mapping via Connectivity-Aware Local Map Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12346)
*Hongjae Shin,Jungho Kim,Donghyuk Kwak,Myeongjun Kim,Seunghoon Yu,Jiyong Oh,Jun Won Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReVMap 通过集成局部地图预测的局部不确定性与全局地图先验，并结合局部预测可靠性进行不确定性感知融合，以迭代方式提高局部地图准确性和全局地图一致性，实现卓越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的局部到全局自动标注方法往往忽略预测不确定性，并依赖启发式的地图整合，这可能导致错误传播和拓扑不一致性，ReVMap 提出旨在解决这些局限性。

Method: ReVMap 结合点位定位不确定性与全局地图先验，局部预测不确定性指导全局图修订。具体而言，它首先利用局部预测不确定性融合全局地图先验以改进局部地图预测，然后预测局部到全局的连通性，并基于局部预测的可靠性进行不确定性感知融合以选择性地更新全局地图。

Result: 实验结果表明，ReVMap 在局部地图预测和全局地图构建方面均达到最先进的性能。

Conclusion: ReVMap 代表了一种有效的局部到全局框架，通过逐步优化局部和全局的一致性与准确性，提高了自动化 HD 地图标注的可行性和高效性。

Abstract: Large-scale annotation of vectorized high-definition (HD) maps is labor-intensive and costly, motivating local-to-global auto-labeling approaches that incrementally construct global maps from local vectorized predictions. However, existing approaches often overlook prediction uncertainty and rely on heuristic map integration, potentially propagating errors and introducing topological inconsistencies. To address these limitations, we propose ReVMap, a reliable local-to-global framework that iteratively refines local map predictions and global map construction through uncertainty-guided prior utilization and connectivity-guided global map revision. Specifically, ReVMap leverages point-wise localization uncertainty to incorporate global map priors into local map prediction, improving robustness against inaccurate prior information. It then predicts local-to-global connectivity and selectively updates the global map through uncertainty-aware fusion based on the reliability of local predictions. By iteratively coupling local prediction and global revision, ReVMap progressively improves both local map accuracy and global map consistency. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 benchmarks demonstrate that ReVMap achieves state-of-the-art performance in both local map prediction and global map construction.

</details>


### [222] [QCC-WM: Linking Macro-State Dynamics and Visual Generation via Quotient Causal Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12353)
*Zhizhong Fu,Wei Zhou,Zhaoyang Jiang,Yudong Lin,Songlun Li,Zhi Li,Feifan Chen,Gaoming Li,Xiaorong Ding,Yifan Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: QCC-WM 提出了一个新的基于因果构建的视觉世界模型，能通过行动反应构建宏状态进行递归预测，并通过共享参考度量约束预测状态与观察到的视觉变化的一致性。该模型在 US-VLA 数据集上实现了四步预测的 ROI-MSE 为 0.01861，同时在多步递归外推中相比基准提升了显著的感知质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决高维观测场景下的宏状态构建难题，支持在行动条件下的递归预测，并确保预测演化与生成观测视觉变化的一致性。

Method: QCC-WM 使用基于因果构建的方法，通过行动反应引导宏变量构建，利用共享参考度量约束预测状态和观察到的视觉变化的一致性，将局部视觉特征聚合为具有空间对应关系的宏节点，通过因果抽象进行递归预测，并通过节点级错误反馈进一步提高生成观测的一致性和感知质量。

Result: QCC-WM 在 US-VLA 数据集上的四步预测 ROI-MSE 为 0.01861；在多步递归外推中，与最佳基线相比，四步、八步和十六步的 LPIPS 分别降低了 48.59%、41.68% 和 30.23%。

Conclusion: QCC-WM 通过因果构建方法提高了高维观测场景下的递归预测能力，并保证预测演化与视觉变化一致，具有显著的性能优势。

Abstract: A key challenge in action-conditioned world modeling is to construct macro-states from high-dimensional observations that support recursive prediction under actions, while keeping their predicted evolution consistent with visual changes in generated observations. We propose QCC-WM, a visual world model based on Quotient-based Causal Construction. QCC-WM uses action responses to guide macro-variable construction for recursive action-conditioned prediction. A shared reference quotient measurement constrains the consistency between predicted states and observed changes, allowing macro-level predictions to provide structured constraints for future visual generation.
  Using translational and rotational actions and their predicted responses, the model aggregates local visual features into macro-nodes with spatial correspondence through causal abstraction, and recursively predicts node content and motion under a shared reference measurement. Macro-level predictions guide future observation generation, while predicted motion transports historical appearance information. Node-level errors between generated observations and macro-level targets are then mapped back to the corresponding spatial regions for correction, improving consistency between visual generation and macro-level predictions.
  On the US-VLA dataset, QCC-WM achieves an ROI-MSE of 0.01861 for four-step prediction. Compared with the best baseline at each prediction horizon, it reduces LPIPS by 48.59%, 41.68%, and 30.23% for four-step prediction and eight- and sixteen-step recursive extrapolation, respectively. Ablation studies and mechanism analyses show that motion-guided reference transport mainly improves pixel reconstruction, while node-level error feedback further improves perceptual quality and consistency between generated observations and macro-level predictions.

</details>


### [223] [TRIAD: Multimodal Retrieval across Abstraction, Constraints, and State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12364)
*Xiangyang Wu,Chen Ju,Xu Chen,Likang Peng,Jinsong Lan,Haihong Tang,Yang Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TRIAD 是一个用于评估检索系统在处理复杂、不断发展用户请求方面能力的多模态检索基准。它包含三项评估任务：抽象性（测试不同层次概念和视觉实例之间的双向检索）、约束性（测试同时满足正负条件的能力）和状态性（测试跨对话回合整合需求和更新早期条件的能力）。基准测试包含六个子集，每个子集由1000个查询组成，每个查询有1000个固定的候选者，使用共同的多正项平均精确度协议进行评估。研究发现，没有系统在所有六组数据中都表现出色，特别是在处理高层级请求时性能下降，且单一负面查询通常不如相同约束数目的正面查询表现好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的多模态检索系统在处理涉及不同层次关系和随着对话过程不断调整的用户请求时表现不佳，TRIAD 检查了这些系统在满足复杂且不断变化的用户需求方面的有效性。

Method: TRIAD 设计了三个不同的评估轨道，涵盖抽象性、约束性以及状态性方面，通过六个子集共包含6000个查询来评估系统表现，此外还设置了简单的参考任务和特定的否定样例以定义检索挑战。

Result: TRIAD 的评估结果显示，没有任何单一系统在所有六组数据中表现出色，且随着层次距离的增加检索性能下降。单一负性查询通常不如具有相同约束数目的单一正性查询表现好，并且跨回合检索在表达相同最终意图的配对任务中平均性能较低。

Conclusion: 这些发现揭示了从检索类似内容过渡到满足完整请求之间的差距，并且强调了多模态检索系统在理解和执行用户意图方面改进的需求。

Abstract: Multimodal retrieval increasingly supports agentic systems, where user requests can involve cross-level relations, combine multiple constraints, and evolve across dialogue turns. In these settings, a highly similar result may still violate the user's requirements, while retrieved content may directly inform downstream actions without human screening. We introduce TRIAD, a multimodal retrieval benchmark for evaluating how well retrieval systems satisfy these complex, evolving requests. TRIAD comprises three tracks: abstraction, testing bidirectional retrieval between visual instances and concepts at different hierarchical levels; constraints, testing the joint satisfaction of positive and negative conditions; and state, testing the integration of requirements across dialogue turns and the updating of earlier conditions when users revise their requests. The benchmark contains six subsets, each with 1,000 queries and a fixed pool of 1,000 candidates per query, evaluated using a common multi-positive mean average precision (mAP) protocol. Simpler reference tasks and hard negatives grouped by the requirements they violate help characterize specific retrieval difficulties. We evaluate 20 configurations of 17 systems and find that no system leads across all six subsets. Performance declines with hierarchical distance, and negative-only queries generally underperform positive-only queries with the same number of constraints. Across paired tasks expressing the same final intent, multi-turn retrieval yields lower mAP in 39 of 40 configuration-domain comparisons. The benefits of explicit reasoning also vary across models and tasks. These findings highlight the gap between retrieving similar content and satisfying a complete request.

</details>


### [224] [PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12411)
*Harold Haodong Chen,Rui Peng,Lingteng Qiu,Kejie Qiu,Chao Xu,Zilong Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysOPSD通过使用可执行代码作为高级物理上下文，提升了视频生成的物理合理性，同时保持了通用视频生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代视频生成模型在视觉保真度方面取得了显著进展，但在生成物理合理的动态和复杂的相互作用方面仍然脆弱。传统方法（如文本提示和参考视频）无法有效提供物理约束。

Method: 提出了一种名为PhysOPSD的方法，该方法通过结合物理特权信息和可控的物理变化，利用可执行代码作为一种高级物理上下文，在生成视频时提供详细的物理反馈。

Result: 在各种模型架构上，实验表明PhysOPSD显著提高了物理合理性，仅需3000个样本就超越了基于强化学习和静态视觉观察的基线，同时保持了通用视频生成的质量。

Conclusion: PhysOPSD将物理特权信息与可控的物理变化结合，通过可执行代码提供详细的物理反馈，从而显著提高了视频生成的物理合理性，并展示了其在多种视频生成网络中的广泛应用潜力。

Abstract: While modern video generative models achieve remarkable visual fidelity, they remain noticeably brittle when generating physically plausible dynamics and complex interactions. Targeted post-training is crucial, yet supervised fine-tuning suffers from offline state mismatch, and reinforcement learning is hindered by sparse, ill-defined physical reward functions. On-Policy (Self-)Distillation (OPSD) reconciles on-policy rollouts with dense corrective feedback, shifting the core challenge to designing effective privileged context. However, conventional modalities fall short: text prompts are inherently declarative, whereas real reference videos heavily entangle physical laws with visual appearance without parametric control. To this end, we propose PhysOPSD, introducing executable code as privileged physical context for video generation. Unlike static visual observations, executable code instantiates an editable physical world with intrinsic abstraction and controllability. Powered by PhysOPSD-Engine, we translate real-world physical scenarios into verifiable simulation programs. PhysOPSD then incorporates (i) dual-level physical privilege to bridge the information gap via an intermediate bottleneck, alongside (ii) controlled physical variations under shared rollout noise to expose causal dynamic shifts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysOPSD substantially improves physical plausibility across diverse backbones, outperforming SFT and RL baselines with only $3$K samples, while preserving general video generation quality.

</details>


### [225] [dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12426)
*Xiaotong Li,Zhengrong Yue,Xu Huang,Jialv Zou,Minhao Jing,Wenhao Yan,Haodong Li,Hai Huang,Bo Zhao,Yan Feng,Peng Pei,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: dNaViT是一种自回归离散视觉Transformer，通过轻量级残差调制和双重目标注入重建提示，保持语义和像素级别的信息，适用于多任务统一编码和高保真图像解码，在多种视觉理解、生成和编辑基准测试中表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索有限离散词汇是否能有效地表示视觉世界的丰富性，从而为视觉和语言模型提供一个统一的框架。

Method: dNaViT基于冻结的预训练编码器，使用分组产品量化来扩展离散容量，同时保持较短的空间序列长度。它还通过轻量级残差调制和双重目标注入重建提示，以平衡的训练方案保持语义和像素级信息。

Result: dNaViT在12个视觉理解基准、4个生成基准和一个图像编辑基准中表现出色，匹配或超过了特定任务的基线。

Conclusion: dNaViT展示了紧凑的离散词汇可以作为通用视觉货币，并解锁完全统一的多模态方法的全部潜力。

Abstract: Discrete autoregressive modeling, notably through next-token prediction, has become a cornerstone of modern language models. Extending this paradigm to vision allows visual and language models to converge on a unified framework, thereby fostering shared methodology and infrastructure. This work investigates a central question: how far can a finite discrete vocabulary go in representing the richness of the visual world? We present dNaViT, a Discrete Native-resolution Vision Transformer that produces discrete visual primitives analogous to language tokens. Built upon a frozen pretrained encoder, dNaViT applies lightweight residual modulation with a dual-branch objective to inject reconstruction-aware cues into semantic features. By leveraging grouped product quantization, it scales discrete capacity without inflating spatial sequence lengths, while a balanced training recipe maintains both semantic and pixel-level information. Consequently, dNaViT functions as a versatile discrete visual tokenizer, enabling unified encoding across downstream tasks alongside high-fidelity image decoding. Extensive evaluations show that dNaViT matches or exceeds task-specific baselines across 12 visual understanding benchmarks, 4 generation benchmarks, and an image editing benchmark. These findings demonstrate that a compact discrete vocabulary can serve as a universal visual currency and unlock the full potential of fully unified, native multimodal methodology.

</details>


### [226] [Occupancy Modelling of Biased Landslide Inventories: When Does Separating Occurrence from Recording Improve on Neutralisation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12437)
*Abdirashid Omar,Abdikadir Ugaas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究采用生态学中的占用检测模型改进滑坡易发性模型，结果显示该模型在减少道路偏差和提高预测准确性方面有显著效果，但在某些情况下（如道路偏差较小的地区）则不如标准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的滑坡易发性模型依赖于滑坡观测记录，这些记录本身可能存在偏差。研究希望采用生态学中的占用检测模型改进这一方法。

Method: 研究使用了2018年北海道东部伊布里地震、2015年尼泊尔地震和2010年海地地震的近完全观测数据，通过模拟报告偏差进行比较。对于北海道地震，进行了虚假记录测试；在尼泊尔和海地地震记录中，使用了三个实际的历史记录作为对照组。

Result: 与标准方法相比，占用检测模型减少了24个样本中的25次道路偏差，并在尼泊尔和海地的AUC上分别提高了0.08至0.14和0.03，而在伊布里地震中仅提高了0.01至0.02。此模型将预测滑坡率与实际滑坡率的比率保持在0.99，而基线模型则在0.24至0.30之间。重新调整基线模型来匹配同一锚区域后，模型预测的滑坡发生率趋于更好，但在实际偏差方面差距更大（0.20至4.34）。细胞层面的概率仍然过于极端（校准斜率为0.59）。与最佳中性化模型相比，AUC在伊布里地区有所提高（0.03至0.07），但在尼泊尔和海地的AUC有所不同（减少0.01至0.05）。实际的尼泊尔地震记录受到坡度偏见的影响，而非道路偏见，使得占用检测模型在这些地区没有额外收益。

Conclusion: 相比之下，研究认为报告为基础的目录仍然是未经测试的主要挑战。

Abstract: Landslide susceptibility models are trained on inventories that record where landslides were seen, not where they occurred. The established remedy fits bias-describing variables and neutralises them when mapping. We adapt occupancy-detection modelling from ecology, treating several inventories as imperfect observers of one event and separating occurrence from recording, and ask when this improves on neutralisation. We use near-complete inventories of the 2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi, 2015 Gorkha and 2010 Haiti earthquakes with simulated reporting bias, and three real Gorkha inventories. Compared with standard practice, the occupancy model reduces road bias in 24 of 25 paired draws and raises AUC by 0.08-0.14 on Gorkha and 0.03 on Haiti, but only 0.01-0.02 on Iburi. Its median predicted-to-true landslide rate is 0.99 (range 0.44-1.89), against 0.24-0.30 for the baselines. Rescaling the baselines with the same anchor area corrects their median but leaves larger errors (range 0.20-4.34). Cell-level probabilities remain too extreme (calibration slope 0.59). Compared with the best neutralised model, AUC is higher on Iburi (by 0.03-0.07) and lower on Gorkha and Haiti (by 0.01-0.05). Transplant experiments tie the Iburi advantage to the structure of its true landslide pattern, not to its terrain or road network. In all eight settings with a low interaction gap, computable from biased records, neutralisation was at least as accurate, including a prespecified test on Haiti; a high gap did not guarantee an advantage. The real Gorkha inventories are slope-biased, not road-biased, and there the model brings no meaningful gain. Report-based catalogues remain the main untested case.

</details>


### [227] [MoSTE: Mixture of Spatio-Temporal Experts for Deepfake Detection in Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12443)
*Charbel Yahchouchi,Nabyl Quignon,Noemi Roggero,Laurent Saroul,Antitza Dantcheva*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoSTE 提出了一种新的自适应框架，通过将适应过程分解为同时并行的时空专家池，并通过无监督的标记级路由机制动态地将标记路由到最相关的专家，从而实现对不同伪造类型的适应和专业化。这种机制能够在不依赖明确的伪造标签或多阶段训练的情况下，自然地专业化识别伪造的时空特征。实验表明，MoSTE 在跨数据集和跨伪造类型的基准测试中，不仅提高了泛化能力，还在多种伪造类别中保持了强大的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的参数高效自适应方法依赖单一的共享表示，容易受到特定伪造技术偏差的影响，无法推广到未见的伪造。MoSTE 通过拆分适应过程和引入标记级路由机制解决这些限制。

Method: MoSTE 提出了一种分解适应过程的方法，将空间和时间专家库并行部署，并通过无监督的标记级路由机制动态地将标记定向到最相关的专家。

Result: 实验结果显示，MoSTE 在多种伪造类别中表现出色，不仅在平均泛化方面达到了新标准，还有效地将 CLIP 表示转移到视频领域。

Conclusion: MoSTE 通过创新的时空专家池和标记级路由机制成功地解决了现有技术在适应不同伪造类型时的限制，为伪造视频检测领域提供了具有潜力的新解决方案。

Abstract: Generalizable deepfake video detection remains challenging because forgery artifacts vary substantially across manipulation types and often combine diverse spatial and temporal inconsistencies. Existing parameter-efficient adaptation methods typically rely on a single shared representation, rendering them prone to manipulation-specific bias and limiting transfer to unseen forgeries. To address this challenge, we propose Mixture Of Spatio-Temporal Experts (MoSTE), an adaptation framework that enables conditional specialization of forensic representations. Instead of forcing one adapter to model all forgery patterns, MoSTE decomposes adaptation into parallel spatial and temporal expert pools and dynamically routes tokens to the most relevant experts through an unsupervised token-level routing mechanism. This allows experts to naturally specialize in complementary forgery cues without requiring explicit manipulation labels or multi-stage training, while effectively transferring representations from CLIP to the video domain. Extensive experiments across cross-dataset and cross-manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MoSTE sets a new state of the art in average generalization while preserving strong performance across diverse manipulation families. Additional analysis of expert routing and attention behavior reveals the emergence of expert diversity, suggesting that MoSTE learns complementary spatio-temporal forensic features. Code is available at https://github.com/charbelyah/MoSTE

</details>


### [228] [LongSCOP: Semantically Consistent Long Video Outpainting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12445)
*Yu Tang,Zhiyuan You,Zhixiao Wang,Fanghua Yu,Qingyu Zhang,Xiang Yin,Chao Dong,Jinjin Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为LongSCOP的方法，该方法通过自激励训练、潜在校准和未来参考来实现长时间稳定且具有一致性的视频出画处理。并通过一个高质量的数据集和专家评审的基准LVO-Bench对方法进行了验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要集中在短视频出画上，长视频出画这一新兴领域尚未得到充分探索。为了应对长视频出画过程中的生成不稳定性和语义漂移问题，本文旨在提出一种方法解决这些问题。

Method: 本文提出了一种名为LongSCOP的方法，通过自激励训练、潜在校准和未来参考等策略提高了生成过程的稳定性和一致性。

Result: 实验结果表明，LongSCOP方法在生成稳定性和语义一致性上优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法LongSCOP用于长视频出画处理，在生成稳定性和语义一致性方面比现有方法更优，为相关领域的研究做出了贡献。

Abstract: Video out-painting is an important problem, yet existing research focuses primarily on short clips, leaving long video out-painting largely underexplored. Extending video out-painting to long videos poses substantial challenges. A natural solution is iterative out-painting, i.e., generating videos chunk by chunk, but this introduces two major issues: generation instability or even failure caused by inter-chunk inconsistencies and error accumulation, and semantic drift over long temporal horizons. In this paper, we propose LongSCOP, short for Semantically Consistent long Video Out-Painting. First, we introduce a training recipe with three components for smooth and stable long-horizon generation: self-forcing training, latent calibration, and future references. Beyond generation stability, we recognize that the rich temporal context of long videos provides valuable references for maintaining semantic consistency. We therefore develop a VLM-based agent that automatically selects the most informative reference frames from the entire video to maintain consistent subjects, scenes, and backgrounds throughout long-horizon generation. We also construct a high-quality training dataset of 62K video clips. To facilitate research on this underexplored problem, we introduce LVO-Bench, a benchmark curated by human experts to assess long-horizon stability and semantic consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both generation stability and semantic coherence.

</details>


### [229] [Perturb, Aggregate then Reconstruct: Consensus Aggregation and Fourier-Attended Multi-Decoders for Reconstruction-based Multi-View Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12477)
*Yongho Son,Junyeong Yun,Je Hyeong Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了PAR框架，一种基于重建的多视角异常检测方法，通过特征扰动策略、视角特异的多解码器架构和Fourier注意力机制，克服了多视角异常检测中的视图一致异常挑战，实验表明其在样本、图像和像素级异常检测中均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前的单视角重建基线方法在多视角场景中鲜有应用，且对于视图不一致的假异常检测存在问题，PAR框架旨在解决这一问题。

Method: PAR框架采用了特征扰动策略、视角特异的多解码器架构和Fourier注意力机制。通过跨视角整合扰动特征来减轻视图不一致的异常，使用特定视角的解码器生成高可行性局部异常图，并结合Fourier注意力机制强调全局频率结构。

Result: 实验在Real-IAD数据集上的结果表明，PAR在样本、图像、像素级别的异常检测中均优于现有的先进方法。

Conclusion: PAR框架通过引入创新技术成功提高了多视角异常检测的性能，为工业检查提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-view anomaly detection is crucial for industrial inspection to identify defects hidden from single viewpoints. Yet, despite their strong success in single-view applications, reconstruction-based methods remain largely underexplored in multi-view settings. A key challenge in extending these methods lies in generating view-consistent pseudo-anomalies. To address this, we propose PAR, a reconstruction-based framework for enhanced multi-view anomaly detection.
