First, we introduce a feature perturbation strategy coupled with a consensus aggregation module that integrates these perturbed features across viewpoints to mitigate view-inconsistent anomalies and construct highly aligned pseudo-anomaly representations. Second, we employ a view-specialized multi-decoder architecture; by assigning a dedicated decoder to each view, we increase the model's representational complexity, enabling the generation of highly feasible, localized anomaly maps rather than less precise, view-agnostic reconstructions. Last, we incorporate Fourier attention into the decoders to emphasize global frequency-domain structures over local token evidence, effectively preventing identity mapping. Extensive experiments on the Real-IAD dataset demonstrate that PAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in sample-level, image-level, and pixel-level anomaly detection. Our code is available at https://github.com/SpatialAILab/PAR_mvad.

</details>


### [230] [MARS: Multiscale Appearance-Residual Streams for Video Forgery Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12508)
*Ahmed Y. Radwan,Shaina Raza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MARS 方法通过结合多尺度特征差异和适应的外观表示，在跨伪造类别和生成视频的检测中实现了最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的伪造检测方法在处理不同伪造技术和场景内容变化时效果不佳，因此需要一种新的方法来克服这一挑战。

Method: MARS 方法包括两个路径：残差路径处理固定的空间和时间高斯差操作，以及语义路径适配编码器的归一化参数进行帧分类，通过片段依赖门融合两者预测。

Result: MARS 在七个数据集中表现出最高的平均AUROC 91.43%，并且仅使用面部篡改数据训练时，MARS 在 GenVideo 达到了 93.99% 的 AUROC，DF26 达到了 75.50%，从而证明了其在生成视频上的迁移性。

Conclusion: MARS 通过两路径的协同工作，展示了在多种类型伪造视频上的优越检测性能和良好的迁移能力。

Abstract: Generalizing deepfake detection across facial manipulation and fully generated video remains challenging due to forgery traces varying with the manipulation method and scene content. Explicit spatial and temporal feature differences offer a way to capture this variation, but also respond to natural texture and motion, motivating their joint interpretation with appearance features. We investigate whether combining multiscale feature differences with adapted appearance representations improves detection across both forgery categories. We introduce Multiscale Appearance-Residual Streams (MARS), a two-path video detector. The residual path applies fixed spatial and temporal difference-of-Gaussians operators to frozen intermediate features and models the resulting differences alongside appearance context across frames. The semantic path adapts the encoder's normalization parameters for frame classification, and a clip-dependent gate combines their predictions. Under a shared protocol across seven datasets, MARS achieves the highest average AUROC of 91.43\%, outperforming seven compared detectors. When trained on facial manipulations alone, MARS achieves 93.99\% AUROC on GenVideo and 75.50\% on DF26, demonstrating transfer to generated videos without generated-video training data. MARS also provides signed patch and frame contributions, whose faithfulness we evaluate through controlled spatial and temporal removal against random controls. MARS is publicly available for research: Project page: https://vectorinstitute.github.io/mars/ Github: https://github.com/VectorInstitute/mars

</details>


### [231] [EditJudge-Bench: Auditing VLM Image-Edit Judges with Synthetic Ground Truth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12524)
*Jens Parslov,Marco Schouten,Dim P. Papadopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为EditJudge-Bench的合成基准，包含1,382对Blender中的合成前/后图像对，用以评估视觉-语言模型（VLMs）作为图像编辑基准的自动评判器。结果显示，尽管仅使用合成数据，但判别排名与实际图像的两种人类偏好基准高度相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 审计现有的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）作为图像编辑基准的自动评判器，因缺乏控制的地面真实数据和模型幻象、意外副作用及成功的不确定性，评估变得困难。

Method: 本文构建了一个名为EditJudge-Bench的基准，包括1,382对由Blender渲染的合成的前/后图像对，编辑参数化自真实用户的请求并采用已知的3D场景参数作为精确的地面真实数据。

Result: 在25种评判器配置中，研究发现可靠性差距显著：（a）广泛采用的VIEScore模板在与GPT-4o的搭配下仅达到69.0%的AUC指标；（b）微调的评判器得分为51.7-66.3%；（c）空间编辑如旋转和形状的挑战仍然存在；（d）指令格式化选项如图像-文本顺序可影响表现多达14.1个点。尽管仅使用合成数据，但评判器在EditJudge-Bench的排名与实际图像的两种人类偏好基准之间显示出强相关性。

Conclusion: 研究表明，现有的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在某些评估指标上可靠性不足，特别是在处理图像编辑中的空间类编辑问题，且指令的格式化对模型性能有显著影响。此外，虽然仅使用合成数据进行评估，但本研究揭示的问题类别与实际评估情境中的问题相符，表明控制审计能够揭示对实际评价有相关性的失败模式。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for image-editing benchmarks, yet their reliability is poorly understood. Auditing these judges is difficult because real edited images lack controlled ground truth and entangle the requested changes with model artefacts, unintended side effects, and ambiguous degrees of success. In this paper, we introduce EditJudge-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,382 synthetic before/after image pairs rendered in Blender, with edits parameterised across nine categories derived from real user requests and exact ground truth from known 3D scene parameters. Because every edit is generated by a known intervention on a controlled scene, EditJudge-Bench evaluates VLM judges as binary verifiers of whether an instruction was correctly executed, isolating judge perception from editor quality. Across 25 judge configurations, we find substantial reliability gaps: (a) the widely adopted VIEScore template reaches only 69.0% AUROC with GPT-4o; (b) fine-tuned judges score 51.7-66.3%; spatial edits such as rotation and shape remain challenging; (c) prompt-formatting choices like image-text ordering shift performance by up to 14.1 points. Despite using only synthetic data, judge rankings on EditJudge-Bench correlate strongly with two real-image human-preference benchmarks ($ρ$=0.95 and $ρ$=0.71), indicating that controlled audits surface failure modes relevant to real evaluation.

</details>


### [232] [WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12557)
*Yuhang Chen,Jiheng Li,Jiale Wang,Zai Wang,Guangyue Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究介绍了WanderBench基准，用于评估基于视频进化的动态世界探索能力，指出现有模型在较长视频生成中失去了相机控制和再现动态内容的性能，而WanderLand框架可以显著提高模型在源动态保真度等六个方面的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的评估基准主要关注单图像或文本提示下的感知质量和相机跟随，但忽略了重新探索时的身份、事件进展和场景一致性。因此，研究人员需要一个新基准来评估视频条件生成在动态世界中的表现。

Method: 研究者开发了一个名为WanderBench的数据集和评估框架，包含3-25秒的不同难度级别视频片段，并引入了WanderLand框架，使模型能够根据当前和之前的内容进行自我调整。

Result: 在八个模型上的测试显示，随着视频长度的增加，模型保持静态场景和视觉质量的能力增强，但相机控制和再现动态内容的能力减弱，且没有模型能够保持多次访问地方的连贯性。WanderLand框架在每一项评估指标上都提高了五种模型的表现，最高提升了8.3点。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了一个更全面的基准WanderBench，还演示了WanderLand框架如何显著提高现有模型的性能，特别是对于源动态的准确保真。

Abstract: Video world models conditioned on an input video make it possible to explore real, recorded dynamic scenes, enabling re-shooting of footage, free-viewpoint replay, and real-to-sim environments for embodied agents. Such uses require the generated rollout to stay faithful to the recorded world, yet existing benchmarks start from a single image or a text prompt, and video-conditioned generation is evaluated mainly on perceptual quality and camera following. These evaluations do not directly assess whether exploration preserves subject identity, event progression, and scene consistency upon revisiting a location. We introduce WanderBench, a benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds from video. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos of real and AI-generated content in three difficulty tiers (3-25 s), paired with camera routes given as keyboard actions, and evaluates six dimensions with 24 human-validated sub-metrics. Benchmarking eight models, we find that as clips grow longer, models keep the static scene and visual quality but lose camera control and the source dynamics, and that none keeps revisited places consistent. We further propose WanderLand, a training-free framework that conditions each frame of a frozen model on the same-instant source and, on revisits, on its own earlier static content. WanderLand improves five models on every dimension, by up to 8.3 points in source-dynamics fidelity.

</details>


### [233] [GHiML: VLM-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label Learning with Applications to Benthic Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12564)
*Isaac Xu,Devi Ayyagari,Martin Gillis,Benjamin Misiuk,Craig J. Brown,Thomas Trappenberg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为GHiML的学习框架，通过自监督方式从VLM中提取概念性潜在变量，结合图文自注意力机制进行跨模态信息融合，引入了一种新的评价指标$d_{	ext{inv}}$，并且证明了该方法在BenthicNet、FathomNet和iNaturalist数据集上的表现优于纯视觉基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视觉 transformers 的模型主要依赖低级视觉特征，缺乏高层逻辑推理能力。为了克服这一局限，文章提出了 GHiML，旨在从 VLM 中获取概念性潜在变量，结合文本描述，以实现更有效的跨模态信息融合。

Method: 该方法首先通过自监督方式从 VLM 中提取概念性潜在变量，生成与这些变量相关的样本特定描述。然后通过交叉注意力机制将文本嵌入与图像嵌入融合，并使用分节点遮挡路由器进行融合。此外，还提出了一种新的评价指标 $d_{	ext{inv}}$，用于评价具有层次结构的多标签预测。

Result: 实验结果表明，路由机制在宏 F1 得分上比纯视觉基线高出 6.7 个百分点，$d_{	ext{inv}}$ 指标则高出 21.1 个百分点。即使在类别分布发生变化的情况下，这些优点仍然保持。

Conclusion: 据实验结果，GHiML 能够有效地提升分类性能，特别是在视觉学习不足的领域。这表明 VLM 中存在可利用的专业知识，通过合适的提取可以增强分类效果。

Abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) encode substantial expert knowledge within their weights, yet their direct application to specialised classification domains such as benthic imagery remains limited. Meanwhile, vision transformers trained on these tasks rely predominantly on low-level visual latents (colours, textures, and shapes) that lack the higher-level reasoning humans employ for identification. We propose Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label (GHiML) learning, a pipeline that extracts conceptual latent variables from a VLM conditioned on training data, generates sample-relevant captions grounded in those variables, and fuses the resulting textual embeddings with image embeddings via cross-attention and a per-node gated router. We also introduce the inverted HML score ($d_{\mathrm{inv}}$), a similarity score that evaluates hierarchical multi-label predictions through graph traversal distance and a cardinality penalty, providing an interpretable alternative to existing measures, which are insensitive to realistic degradations in sparse, deep hierarchies. Experiments on BenthicNet, FathomNet and iNaturalist show that the router improves macro $F_1$ over the vision-only baseline by up to 6.7 pp and $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ by up to 21.1 pp on in-domain benthic data, with gains persisting under distribution shift. Ablations locate the contribution of the text itself: on the multi-label biotic hierarchies, removing the per-sample text signal degrades $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ while leaving macro $F_1$ unchanged, consistent with text acting through prediction cardinality rather than node discrimination, whereas iNaturalist, whose annotations are single-label, loses 18.7% of macro $F_1$. Our results support the hypothesis that VLMs contain exploitable specialised knowledge that, when appropriately elicited, can augment classification in domains where direct visual learning is insufficient.

</details>


### [234] [Towards Reconstructing and Recognizing Objects behind Fragmented Occlusion using Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12624)
*Roman Pflugfelder,Michael Lindenbaum,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在高密度碎片遮挡下对移动物体进行重建的框架，通过优化图像对齐参数以最大化平均图像的对比度来估计物体在不同帧中的相对位置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类视觉系统能够通过碎片化的遮挡（如树叶）感知物体，但计算机视觉仍面临在高密度碎片遮挡下的物体重建挑战。本文旨在提出一种在遮挡密度超过90%的条件下，仍能进行准确重建的方法。

Method: 本文提出的重建框架基于单目相机拍摄的移动物体的灰度图像序列。通过联合注册图像并优化对齐参数，以最大化平均图像（称为集成图像）的对比度来估计物体在不同帧中的相对位置。集成图像用作物体的重建表示。

Result: 在合成和真实视频序列上的实验评估表明，在遮挡密度超过90%的情况下，提出的重建方法可以实现准确的重建。此外，集成图像还能够支持在严重遮挡情况下对物体进行可靠的分类。

Conclusion: 本文的方法在处理高密度碎片遮挡时表现良好，与合成孔径技术相比更具优势，且无需复杂的相机设置。

Abstract: Perceiving objects through fragmented occlusions, such as foliage, is a natural capability of the human visual system but remains a fundamental challenge for computer vision. This work addresses the problem of object reconstruction, or de-occlusion, in the presence of high-density, fragmented occlusions. We propose a reconstruction framework that operates on a sequence of grayscale images of a moving object, acquired by a single camera, either stationary or in motion. The algorithm estimates the object's relative positions across frames by jointly registering the images and optimizing the alignment parameters to maximize the contrast of their average, referred to as the integrated image. This integrated image serves as the reconstructed representation of the object. Experimental evaluations on both synthetic and real video sequences demonstrate the feasibility of accurate reconstruction under occlusion densities exceeding 90%. The proposed approach is competitive with synthetic aperture techniques, which are limited to static objects and require complex camera setup with careful calibration. Furthermore, we show that the integrated image enables reliable object classification under severe occlusion when used as input to standard, off-the-shelf classifiers.

</details>


### [235] [When Does Sliced Inference Pay Off? Resolution, Tiling and Dense Fusion for Small Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12657)
*Stefan Becker,Jens Bayer,David Münch,Wolfgang Hübner*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究了Sliced Inference在高分辨率图像中的表现，提出了一种新的方法SCAHI，展示了高分辨率单次训练的优越性，并改进了现有方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估Sliced Inference在使用高分辨率训练时的效果，并引入一种新的策略来更有效地利用分割的结果。

Method: 调查了七种密集检测器在VisDrone和DOTA数据集上的表现，比较了高分辨率单次训练和切片加盒子融合的方法。

Result: 发现大部分归因于Sliced Inference的好处主要是分辨率效应；切片携带的互补信息在盒子融合中被浪费；SCAHI在所有YOLO检测器上表现优于盒子融合方法，并在部分场景下与FCOS相当或更优。

Conclusion: SCAHI可以通过调整权重更好地累积所有切片的密集输出，并通过读取足够细的峰值网格来识别出拥挤的邻近目标，从而在多个检测器上达到了更好的性能。

Abstract: Sliced inference such as SAHI is the standard remedy for small objects in high-resolution imagery, but its gains are usually measured against low-resolution baselines. We revisit sliced inference with scale as the explicit variable and ask when tiling actually pays off. We compare seven dense detectors from four families on VisDrone and DOTA, under pre-specified hypotheses, calibration-only tuning and a single evaluation on held-out test data. Two findings emerge. First, much of the benefit attributed to slicing is a resolution effect: on VisDrone, a single pass trained at a higher resolution outperforms tiling with box fusion (merging decoded boxes) for every detector that could be trained at that resolution, and at equal compute a higher resolution helps more than a larger model. Second, tiles carry complementary information that box fusion wastes. We introduce SCAHI (Slicing with Coverage-Aware Hyper Inference), which accumulates the dense outputs of all passes with weights that give every image position the same total coverage, and reads objects off a peak grid fine enough to keep crowded neighbours apart. On identical passes, SCAHI outperforms box fusion for every YOLO detector on both datasets and matches it for FCOS. On DOTA, whose images far exceed the resolution a single pass can be trained at, tiles with SCAHI beat the best single pass for every detector, by 4.3 to 5.6 mAP50 at 2048 px, and replacing only SAHI's merge step by SCAHI adds 2.3 to 4.0 mAP50. An ablation attributes the gain to the border weighting and the resolution of the peak grid. Source code is available at https://github.com/beckerio/scahi.

</details>


### [236] [What Breaks Scribble-Supervised Segmentation? An Audit-Informed Benchmark for Scribble Annotation Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12674)
*Minheng Wu,Di Wen,Ruiping Liu,Junwei Zheng,Yufan Chen,Kailun Yang,Kunyu Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过引入六种受控扰动操作，对scribble监督分割的鲁棒性进行了全面评估，并发现从注释中引入噪声会导致显著的性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机源于对12,031个PASCAL VOC 2012人工标注的审计，旨在通过引入扰动操作，更深入地理解标注的稳健性。

Method: 研究采用六种扰动操作来评估scribble监督分割的鲁棒性，包括类污染、空间偏移、方向性扰动、笔画长度减少、随机删除和碎片化。在两个图像域、两种主干网络设置和多个训练管道中进行了评估，并使用MiT-B1 PFA锚点进行了额外评估。

Result: 结果显示，在五个种子样本的Tree Energy Loss (TEL)-ResNet101 VOC研究中，类污染将mIoU从70.08降至1.46，空间偏移为35.57，方向性扰动为52.20，笔画长度减少为63.24；不同扰动对性能的影响与所使用的管道和数据集有关。

Conclusion: 研究得出结论，从标注中引入噪声会显著降低性能，提供了一个可再现的协议，用于诊断注释的稳健性，而不仅仅关注准确集的精度。

Abstract: Scribble-supervised segmentation is typically evaluated with a fixed annotation set, leaving robustness to distinct semantic and geometric imperfections poorly understood. Motivated by an audit of 12,031 manual PASCAL Visual Object Classes (VOC) 2012 scribbles and prior work, we introduce six controlled perturbation operators. Class corruption, spatial offset, and directional perturbation directly operationalize audit signals. Stroke-length reduction is motivated by prior scribble studies, while random dropout and fragmentation serve as diagnostic controls. Each operator reports requested and achieved changes. We evaluate manual and automatic scribbles across two image domains, two principal backbone settings, and multiple training pipelines, with an additional MiT-B1 PFA anchor evaluation. In the five-seed Tree Energy Loss (TEL)-ResNet101 VOC study, mean intersection over union (mIoU) drops from 70.08 to 1.46 under class corruption, compared with 35.57 for spatial offset, 52.20 for directional perturbation, and 63.24 for stroke-length reduction at their strongest settings. At the evaluated endpoints, semantic-anchor corruption produces the largest degradation, while geometric and support responses depend on the pipeline and dataset. Our benchmark provides a reproducible protocol for diagnosing annotation robustness beyond clean-set accuracy. The operator code is available at https://github.com/Wmhiram99/scribble-operator-benchmark.

</details>


### [237] [National-Scale Crop Type Mapping in Morocco Using Google AlphaEarth Foundations Embeddings and the Fields of the World Field Boundary Map](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12681)
*Walid Elbarz,Mohamed Bourriz,Vincent Simonneaux,Hamd Ait Abdelali,François Bourzeix*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了使用Google AlphaEarth Foundation嵌入进行大规模耕地作物类型映射。这种方法无需处理原始遥感图像即可实现高精度分类，计算成本主要来自云端嵌入的检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于最近的地理空间基础模型可以提供可以直接应用于下游任务的预训练嵌入表示，本文旨在探讨Google AlphaEarth Foundations嵌入在摩洛哥国家尺度作物类型地图绘制中的应用，以提高效率并减少计算成本。

Method: 该方法直接在公开可用的64维预训练嵌入上运行，使用轻量级下游分类器，针对冬季谷物、树木作物和其他作物三大作物类别进行分类。利用全球农田边界地图Fields of the World进行国家范围内推理，预测限定在农业地块内。

Result: 在独立测试集上进行十次重复实验，平均分类精度达到了87.17±0.42%。全国范围内推理摩洛哥仅耗时约5小时，主要计算成本来自云端嵌入的检索。

Conclusion: 研究表明，预训练嵌入表示具有实现高效大范围作物类型建模的潜力，可以在保持较高精度的同时大大减少计算负担。

Abstract: Recent geospatial foundation models have introduced a new paradigm for large-scale Earth observation by providing pretrained embedding representations that can be directly exploited for downstream tasks. In this work, we investigate the use of Google AlphaEarth Foundations embeddings for national-scale crop type mapping in Morocco. The proposed workflow operates directly on publicly available 64-dimensional pretrained embeddings using lightweight downstream classifiers, eliminating the need to process raw satellite imagery during model training and inference. The approach targets three crop categories, namely winter cereals, tree crops, and other crops. For nationwide inference, the Fields of the World global field boundary map is used to constrain predictions to agricultural parcels, enabling efficient large-scale mapping. Experimental evaluation on an independent test set over ten repeated runs achieved an average classification accuracy of (87.17 +/- 0.42%). Nationwide inference over Morocco was completed in approximately five hours, with the dominant computational cost arising from cloud-based retrieval of the embeddings rather than model execution. These results demonstrate the potential of pretrained embedding representations for computationally efficient national-scale crop type mapping.

</details>


### [238] [Differentiable Inverse Rendering Recovers Intrinsic Properties from Intravascular Optical Coherence Tomography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12686)
*Ajay Manicka,Karim Kadry,Sebastian Ruiz-Lopera,Maryam Alsharqi,Sanjana Arji,Samuel Ruiperez-Campillo,Nestor Uribe-Patarroyo,Brett E. Bouma,Farhad Nezami,Elazer R. Edelman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 通过优化可微物理前向模型，文章提出了一种从单张光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像中恢复像素级衰减系数的方法，无需训练数据或区域分割，并且能够在不同平台上移植。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着光学相干断层扫描（OCT）在医学成像领域中的广泛应用，该技术提供了丰富的组织特性图谱，但这些特性与成像系统特有的物理特性交织在一起，无法直接反映疾病进展。文章旨在通过逆渲染法提取这些内在的组织特性，使其能够独立于成像系统平台，提供更准确的诊断信息。

Method: 文章采用了一种基于可微物理前向模型的方法，通过梯度下降算法从单张OCT图像中恢复每个像素的衰减系数。这种方法不依赖于简化光-组织模型的闭合形式反演或特定成像配置下的学习方法，而是直接从物理建模出发，通过优化计算得出结果。

Result: 该方法已在包括5种体外模型和29,269张临床血管OCT图像中得到验证。它能够替代前向模型或恢复其他光学参数时，优化过程无需变更。实验结果表明，这种方法能够准确恢复像素级衰减系数，且不需要训练数据或区域分割。

Conclusion: 文章提供了一种能够从OCT图像中提取像素级病理和细胞成分标记的新方法，并为其他成像模态及器官系统的定量组织表征提供了框架支持。

Abstract: Medical images encode intrinsic tissue properties that indicate disease progression, yet these properties remain entangled with the system-dependent physics of image formation. Differentiable inverse rendering asks whether they are recoverable by inverting the imaging system's forward physics rather than through post-hoc correction. We address this in optical coherence tomography (OCT), focusing on the optical attenuation coefficient, a per-pixel marker of pathology and cellular composition. Conventional recovery relies on closed-form inversions limited to simplified light-tissue models, or learned methods coupled to specific imaging configurations. We instead recover per-pixel attenuation from a single OCT image by gradient descent through a differentiable physics-based forward model. We verified the method against analytical solutions, validated it on five in vitro phantoms, and applied it without modification to 29{,}269 clinical intravascular OCT images from 128 patients. The inversion needs no training data or segmentations and is portable across platforms and retrospective archives. Replacing the forward model or recovering another optical parameter leaves the optimization procedure unchanged. We demonstrate per-pixel recovery is tractable because gradient information scales to this high-dimensional problem, where gradient-free methods become intractable. Our work supports quantitative tissue characterization from OCT images and provides a framework for extension across imaging modalities and organ systems.

</details>


### [239] [GeoScope: Training-Free Program Execution beyond the Counting Horizon for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12699)
*Guohui Deng,Yuhang Jiang,Chengjun Wang,Zhongwen Hu,Zhaocong Wu,Linsheng Huang,Jinling Zhao,Chao Ruan,Miaozhong Xu,Chi Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为GeoScope的方法，在超高清遥感图像中进行对象计数，通过限制视觉-语言模型（VLM）的视图范围来提高准确性，特别是在对象较少且视角符合模型能力时效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的方法主要依赖于预设的视图选择和信任VLM的回答，但对于计数任务来说过于简化，无法准确处理视图中超过一定数量的对象。研究旨在克服这一限制，通过量化VLM的性能极限，提出了一种新的方法来有效处理高分辨率图像中的计数问题。

Method: GeoScope 方法首先将问题解析为一个带类型的空间程序，固定区域及其分辨率。然后，VLM 只在其操作范围内进行定位和计数，且从已解析的框中计算方向。通过仅在VLM能力范围内进行视图划分，GeoScope 实现了在UHR场景下的精确计数。

Result: 在GeoScope 方法的引导下，未经训练的Qwen3-VL-8B在XLRS-Bench中的区域计数上提高了16.3分，在空间关系上提高了10.5分，并且在区域计数和整个基准测试的最高报告准确性方面表现出色。在UHR-Micro 集成和MME-RealWorld中的目标计数上，该方法同样获得了显著提高，尤其是在UHR-Micro中视图划分对计数提升贡献了15.6分。

Conclusion: GeoScope 方法首次在UHR方法中通过测量VLM的视图限制来划分视图，显著提升了对高分辨率图像中对象的准确识别和计数能力。

Abstract: In ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing images, the objects that questions count in a region or relate by direction often span only a few pixels. Existing methods mainly decide where a vision-language model (VLM) should look and trust its answer in the chosen view. We show that this assumption fails for counting, and measure VLMs as one calibrates a sensor. All eight open VLMs tested fall increasingly short once a view holds more than a certain number of objects, about five for most on DOTA aerial images. This counting horizon narrows as views grow and objects appear smaller. An empirical power-law response model predicts the undercount a split recovers and the spurious counts it adds, and supports the rule of splitting only views beyond the horizon. In GeoScope, a text-only language model parses the question into a typed spatial program that fixes the region and its resolution. The VLM only grounds and counts within its operating range, and directions are computed explicitly from the grounded boxes. To our knowledge, it is the first UHR method to split views by a measured limit of the VLM. Without training, it improves Qwen3-VL-8B by 16.3 points on regional counting and 10.5 on spatial relations in XLRS-Bench, and has the highest reported accuracy, trained methods included, on regional counting and on the whole benchmark by question. On UHR-Micro it improves global and regional counting by 16.8 and 36.2 points, 15.6 of the former from splitting. On MME-RealWorld counting it gains 11.4 points, and we show that an option that is almost never correct yet often chosen distorts comparisons there. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/GeoScope/

</details>


### [240] [Spaghetti Splatting: Differentiating Curvilinear Dirac Masses via Convolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12716)
*George Shramko,Shrisudhan Govindarajan,Rudy Lam,Yizheng Xie,Daniel Rebain,David B. Lindell,Andrea Tagliasacchi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了Spaghetti Splatting方法，它通过离散化曲线并用多项线近似，解决了从图像中学习3D几何的挑战。该方法适用于非高斯核，并支持抗锯齿，能够在不重复计算的情况下连接段落，使得生成的长连接线条可以直接应用于物理模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的3D几何表示方法在处理曲线几何时面临着挑战，传统的卷积方法难以满足需求，研究旨在通过新的方法来改进这一问题。

Method: Spaghetti Splatting方法将曲线通过多项线离散化，并对每个段落进行体积渲染，确保连接段落时不会产生过计算。此外，介绍了新的线性摄像机投影方法，以处理非高斯核。

Result: 与最先进的方法相比，Spaghetti Splatting在通用场景中保持竞争力，能够超越专门处理线性几何的方法，支持抗锯齿，生成可以直接用于物理模拟的长连接线条。

Conclusion: Spaghetti Splatting提供了一种新的方法来解决曲线几何的3D几何表示问题，展示了其在渲染质量和物理模拟方面的优势。

Abstract: In production systems, 3D geometry is represented by primitives such as points, lines, and triangles, as rendering hardware is optimized to generate images from them very efficiently. Learning such primitives from images by volume rendering is challenging, as they are Dirac masses defined at infinitesimal locations in space. EWA splatting, Poisson reconstruction, and 3D Gaussian Splatting overcome this by convolving Dirac masses with a low-frequency kernel, a recipe that generalizes along two axes: the kernel and the primitive. As points and triangles have already received significant attention, we investigate this recipe for curvilinear primitives, and introduce Spaghetti Splatting. We approximate curves by polylines whose convolution converges to that of the continuous curve, and volume render each segment so that connected segments composite without overcounting at their joints. For fast training and inference, we linearize the camera projection per segment, which also accommodates kernels beyond Gaussians, such as Beta kernels. As a point is a curve of zero length, our representation is a strict superset of 3D Gaussian Splatting. It remains competitive with the state-of-the-art on general scenes, outperforms methods specialized to line-like geometry, natively supports anti-aliasing, and produces long connected strands that are directly amenable to physics simulation.

</details>


### [241] [OptiCover: A Scalable and Multi-Surface Framework for Cold-Start Visual Optimization under Semantic Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12727)
*Guillaume Guy,Mihajlo Grbovic,Joe Mills,Selen Uguroglu,Liwei He,Pratiksha Kadam,Nalini Kartha,Qian Aria Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OptiCover是一个大规模视觉优化框架，适用于冷启动场景，能够处理多种表面上的参与信号并结合语义约束。它通过候选照片生成器、轻量级视觉头部、跨模态验证模块和探索日志模块来选择视觉上吸引人且语义上相关的覆盖照片。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在Airbnb这样的在线住宿市场中，选择合适的封面照片是一个关键但未被充分研究的问题。随着平台规模的扩大，照片数量众多且每天有大量的新上传，使得手动选择封面照片变得困难。因此，通过自动选择合适的封面照片来提高用户体验和房源可见性变得至关重要。

Method: OptiCover框架使用了多种技术方法来解决这些挑战，包括基于多种代理的候选照片生成器、轻量级视觉头部、跨模态地基模块以及探索日志模块。其中，候选照片生成器识别潜在的候选照片；视觉头部对冻结CLIP嵌入进行大规模语义评分；跨模态地基模块通过视觉语言模型确保语义代表性和一致性；探索日志模块则收集不同产品表面上的随机参与数据。

Result: 通过广泛的离线研究和多次在线实验评估，OptiCover在Airbnb的首页和搜索表面上的表现显著。它每天可以实现数百万次照片交换，并且在首页上实现了1.5%的参与度提升，在搜索表面则增加了0.35%的预订数。这些结果表明，动作空间塑造和语义约束是提高性能的主要因素。

Conclusion: OptiCover能够有效地解决冷启动环境下大规模的视觉优化问题，并结合各种技术手段在电商平台中增加了用户参与度和商业价值。在未来，该项目将继续优化并研究如何进一步提高可视化效果和用户满意度。

Abstract: Selecting an effective cover photo is a critical yet understudied problem in visual merchandising for e-commerce marketplaces. On Airbnb, hosts upload many photos depicting different rooms, amenities, and points of interest, but must manually choose a single static cover photo that is reused across heterogeneous product surfaces. This creates substantial challenges: over 90\% of listing photos have no engagement labels, leading to a severe cold-start regime; guest preferences vary across surfaces and search intents, and visually captivating photos may be semantically misaligned with the underlying listing. At Airbnb scale, this corresponds to hundreds of millions of photos and hundreds of thousands of new uploads per day.
  We propose \emph{OptiCover}, a scalable framework for cold-start visual optimization under semantic constraints and multi-surface engagement signals. The framework combines (i) a photo candidate generator that identifies candidate photos through various proxies, (ii) lightweight vision heads applied to frozen CLIP embeddings for large-scale semantic scoring, (iii) a cross-modal grounding validator based on a vision-language model (VLM) that enforces semantic representativeness, and (iv) an Exploration Logging Module (ELM) that orchestrates the collection of randomized engagement data across heterogeneous product surfaces and contextual search intents.
  We evaluate OptiCover through extensive offline studies and multiple online experiments across HomePage, and Search surfaces. OptiCover is now deployed in production and performs tens of millions of photo swaps daily. Online results show a 1.5\% engagement lift on the HomePage and a 0.35\% increase in bookers on Search, generating millions of dollars in incremental revenue. Our findings suggest that action-space shaping and semantic constraints are primary drivers of performance.

</details>


### [242] [Plant Orbiter: 3D Plant Reconstruction and Generation with Video Diffusion Orbit Cameras and 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12739)
*Zane K. J. Hartley,Yong En Kok,Lewis A. G. Stuart,Andrew P. French,Michael P. Pound*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种名为Plant Orbiter的新方法，利用视频扩散技术从单张图像生成高质量的3D植物高斯斑点，相比于其他先进方法，Plant Orbiter在植物形态重建上更准确，并且更容易进行高通量管道的对齐且成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代数字表型管道需要精确测量一系列3D植物形态学特征，以帮助育种者和研究人员加速新品种、技术和产品的开发。然而，由于植物的复杂形态、薄结构和遮挡，高通量的3D植物虚拟模型获取仍是巨大挑战。因此，本研究旨在提出一种新的方法来解决此问题。

Method: 本研究利用视频扩散技术从单张图像生成高质量的3D植物高斯斑点，相较于其他先进方法，该方法更容易进行高通量管道的对齐且成本更低。

Result: 实验结果显示，Plant Orbiter在植物形态重建上比其他最先进的方法更准确，其3D F分数最高，并且在从文本提示生成3D植物模型方面也达到了最先进的结果。

Conclusion: 本研究提出的新方法Plant Orbiter不仅在植物形态重建上表现优异，还更适用于高通量管道，未来有望进一步应用于数字植物表型学领域。

Abstract: Modern digital phenotyping pipelines require the precise measurement of a range of 3D morphological plant traits. The accurate, high throughput acquisition of these traits helps breeders and researchers accelerate the development of new varieties, techniques and products. Recent advances in 3D technologies have enabled a rapid transition from 2D to 3D pipelines, but high throughput acquisition of digital 3D twins of plants remains a significant challenge due to complex morphology, thin structures and occlusions. In this paper we present Plant Orbiter, a new approach to generating 3D plants that leverages recent advances in video diffusion to produce high quality 3D Gaussian Splats of plants from a single image. We show that our method more accurately recreates plant morphology than other state-of-the-art methods, achieving the highest 3D F-score against all baselines, while being more practical for high throughput pipelines due to easier alignment and reduced cost of camera placement. Combined with a 2D diffusion model, we show that our method also achieves state-of-the-art results in the generation of 3D plant models from a text prompt.

</details>


### [243] [Complementarity-Driven Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment for Zero-Shot EEG-to-Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12798)
*Lukun Wu,Jie Li,Ziqi Ren,Ruiyang Xia,Yan Gao,Xinbo Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了DTHA框架，通过结合CLIP和DINO两种不同类型的预训练视觉基础模型，强化脑电图到图像的零样本检索，达到92.4%的Top-1准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法仅通过CLIP家族的预训练视觉基础模型对脑电图进行对比对齐，未能充分利用分层的视觉信息。本文提出DTHA框架通过将视觉处理过程（从外观到语义）和跨范式预训练视觉基础模型的互补偏见联系起来，以促进更完整的分层视觉信息提取。

Method: 提出了一种双重老师分层对齐（DTHA）框架。该框架包含一个共有的脑电图编码器，分别由两支通道的对比对齐监督。同时引入了注意调控头皮模式库编码器（AMSPBE），结合时空注意力机制和可学习的头皮模式库，提高了视觉特征的准确性和可解释性。通过学习加权的融合检索目标，利用互补的视觉表示进行零样本脑电图到图像的检索。

Result: DTHA框架在THINGS-EEG零样本检索任务中达到了92.4%的Top-1准确性，比之前的最佳成绩提高了12.4百分点。并且通过空间、频谱和表示相似性分析及THINGS-MEG评估进一步验证了DTHA的有效性及其脑生物学合理性和跨模态的一般性。

Conclusion: 跨范式预训练视觉基础模型的监督有助于更完整地从大脑活动提取分层视觉信息，DTHA框架为脑机接口和类脑智能提供了新的视角和方法。

Abstract: Decoding visual information from EEG is central to brain--computer interfaces and brain-inspired intelligence, and contrastive alignment with pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) has become the dominant paradigm. However, existing methods align EEG solely with CLIP-family VFMs, leaving hierarchical visual information in neural responses under-exploited. To address this gap, we formulate a mechanism-paradigm correspondence view linking hierarchical visual processing (from appearance to semantics) to the complementary biases of cross-paradigm VFMs, with image-only models (e.g., DINO) and image--text models (e.g., CLIP) capturing distinct facets of this hierarchy. Guided by this view, we propose the Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment (DTHA) framework. Concretely, a shared EEG encoder is supervised by frozen multi-blur CLIP and shallow DINOv2 teachers via dual-branch contrastive alignment, so each branch fully supervises the visual cues it emphasizes. A fused-retrieval objective learns adaptive weights to combine their complementary visual representations for zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval. For the shared EEG encoder, we introduce the Attentive Modulated Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder (AMSPBE), combining temporo-spatial attention with a learnable scalp-pattern bank for accurate, interpretable visual feature extraction, while modeling regional temporal dynamics and filter-bank topographies. On THINGS-EEG zero-shot retrieval, DTHA achieves 92.4% Top-1 accuracy, exceeding prior state of the art by 12.4 percentage points. Spatial, spectral, and representational-similarity analyses, together with THINGS-MEG evaluation, validate DTHA's effectiveness, biological plausibility, and cross-modality generalization. This complementarity-driven perspective shows that supervision from cross-paradigm VFMs enables more complete extraction of hierarchical visual information from brain activity.

</details>


### [244] [2D Gum-Net: Unsupervised Dense Elastic Image Registration via Symmetric Correlation and Spectral Pooling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12805)
*Aarya Bhave,Anushka Ajay Bhave*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 2D Gum-Net 是一个端到端的无监督架构，用于预测密集的弹性变形场，特别适用于指纹识别中的非刚性配准任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前学习驱动的方法面临的主要挑战是需要大量的标注数据，而2D Gum-Net通过将原用于3D亚结构配准的Gum-Net架构改进为2D弹性注册问题，完全无监督地预测密集弹性变形场，避免了这一问题。

Method: 2D Gum-Net 包括三个重新设计的2D模块，并替换掉了原有的刚性变换头部，使用稠密空间变换器回归稀疏的控制网格，并用双立方插值将其提升为全分辨率场。它还采用了DCT谱池化方法来保留细节。

Result: 在基于接触的指纹识别测试中，该方法表现出色，显著提高了结构相关性，甚至在未见过的实际基准测试中也能提高真匹配分数。

Conclusion: 2D Gum-Net 通过无监督学习实现了对复杂弹性变形场的精确预测，为非刚性配准任务提供了一种强大的新方法。

Abstract: Dense non-rigid registration, the recovery of a pixel-wise deformation field that warps one image into geometric agreement with another, is fundamental across medical imaging, structural biology, and correspondence estimation, yet learning-based approaches face a severe bottleneck: ground-truth deformation fields are notoriously difficult to obtain for real data. We present 2D Gum-Net, an end-to-end architecture that predicts dense elastic deformation fields fully unsupervised. We transfer the Geometric Unsupervised Matching Network (Gum-Net), originally developed for 3D subtomogram alignment in cryo-electron tomography, to 2D elastic registration: all three modules are redesigned in 2D, and the rigid transformation head is replaced by a Dense Spatial Transformer that regresses a sparse control-point grid, lifted to a full-resolution field $Φ$ by bicubic interpolation. Downsampling uses DCT spectral pooling, implemented as frozen-basis matrix multiplications ($\approx 50\times$ GPU speedup), preserving the fine, quasi-periodic structure that max and average pooling destroy. We evaluate on contact-based fingerprints, a challenging testbed for this task: locally self-similar ridge patterns make correspondence maximally ambiguous, skin pressed against a sensor generates authentic large-displacement elastic distortion, and minutiae act as precise landmarks through which an independent matcher externally verifies the topological correctness of predicted fields. Trained purely on synthetic impressions and evaluated zero-shot on real benchmarks, our method improves structural correlation by up to 15.7% on FVC2004 and raises genuine match scores under an independent matcher while leaving imposter scores essentially unchanged. This suggests that the predicted deformations restore true structure without fabricating correspondences.

</details>


### [245] [What kills $v$-prediction? A Patch-wise PCA Perspective on Pixel-Space Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12852)
*Tianze Luo,Haofeng Huang,Yuan Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为Raw-injected Transformer（RiT）的方法，通过结合轻量级的原始条件解码器和输出侧快捷连接，分离了语义建模和原始状态传播，该方法恢复了有效的 $v$-预测，并在ImageNet $256 	imes 256$ 上达到了具有竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文研究了目标预测与架构带宽之间的交互作用，解释了使用 $x$-预测目标时遇到的带宽瓶颈，揭示了 $x$-预测的有效性机制，并提出了一种新的解码方法以恢复有效的 $v$-预测。

Method: 通过采用轻量级的原始条件解码器和输出侧快捷连接，RiT 方法有效地分离了语义建模和原始状态传播的处理。

Result: RiT 方法在 ImageNet $256 	imes 256$ 上达到了具有竞争力的性能，实现了有效的 $v$-预测，并提供了一种新的视角来理解预测目标和架构带宽之间的相互作用。

Conclusion: 通过理论分析与实验验证，本文解释了在使用 $x$-预测目标时遇到的带宽瓶颈，提出了一种轻量级的解码器方法来恢复有效的 $v$-预测能力。

Abstract: Latent Diffusion Models dominate generative modeling but face two-stage training complexity and the inherent reconstruction limits of pre-trained autoencoders. Pixel-space Flow Matching offers a simplified end-to-end alternative yet often encounters training difficulties when using the standard $v$-prediction objective. Recent research attributes this difficulty to the off-manifold nature of noised targets, motivating a shift toward $x$-prediction. In this paper, we investigate this explanation through patch-wise Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and identify a bandwidth bottleneck. The velocity in minor components is largely determined by the raw noisy input, requiring deep backbones to preserve information that competes with principal-component modeling. Through controlled experiments and representation analysis, we further examine why $x$-prediction remains effective: its parameterization provides a raw-input bypass, while its learned input representation can spontaneously concentrate on principal directions. Under low-rank observations, our analysis of the induced flow characterizes $x$-prediction as an implicit conditional-mean decoder, reconstructing discarded components from the retained information. These observations motivate the Raw-injected Transformer (RiT), which combines a lightweight raw-conditioned decoder with an output-side shortcut to separate semantic modeling from raw-state propagation. Our method restores effective $v$-prediction and achieves competitive performance on ImageNet $256\times256$, providing a perspective on the interaction between prediction objectives and architectural bandwidth.

</details>


### [246] [AI-based characterization of lymphoid structures and the tumor microenvironment reveals lower mature tertiary lymphoid structures, lymph-node follicles, and plasma cells after neoadjuvant therapy in lung squamous cell carcinoma](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12855)
*Arne Schmidt,Justin Nieder,Cornelius Boehm,Julika Ribbat-Idel,Marius Teodorescu,Marie-Lisa Eich,Simon Schallenberg,Gabriel Dernbach,Katja Lingelbach,Miriam Haegele,Timo Milbich,Adam Narai,Maria Stoelben,Hans Pinckaers,Lukas Ruff,Kai Standvoss,Christian Watermann,Christiane Kuempers,Sven Perner,Verena Sailer,Jasmin Tiebach,Torsten Goldmann,Sebastian Marwitz,Johannes Braegelmann,Frederick Klauschen,Marija Pezer,Rosemarie Krupar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究分析了切除的肺癌标本中的H&E切片，发现新辅助治疗使肿瘤中的成熟淋巴样结构更少，尤其是肿瘤内和远离肿瘤的次级淋巴样结构更少，且与肿瘤浆细胞之间耦合较弱，但这不是全面的免疫反应降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 进一步理解新辅助治疗对肺鳞状细胞癌(TLS和SLS)的影响，以及发现可作为预后生物标志物的潜在轴。

Method: 研究采用H&E完整切片和Aignostics Atlas H&E组织分析(HETA)模型评估细胞密度，以及自定义深度学习模型验证病理标注，检测TLS和SLS并分级其成熟度。在独立队列中测试预后价值。

Result: 新辅助治疗组肿瘤中，间质浆细胞密度和间质淋巴细胞密度较低，成熟 TLS 和远离肿瘤的成熟 SLS 水平均较低。与未接受治疗的对照组相比，新辅助治疗组中肿瘤周围 TLS 浆细胞密度与肿瘤淋巴细胞密度的正相关较弱。在独立队列中，间质浆细胞密度和浆细胞-淋巴细胞共定位与较长生存期相关，而新辅助治疗状态与较短生存期相关。

Conclusion: 新辅助治疗降低了肿瘤中成熟的淋巴样结构，导致肿瘤与间质免疫环境之间的耦合减弱，但不是全面的免疫反应降低。建议以间质浆细胞/共定位轴作为一个候选的预后生物标志物。

Abstract: Mature, germinal centre-bearing tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) and mature lymph node follicles (secondary lymphoid structures, SLS) sustain the plasma cell response that shapes outcome and immunotherapy benefit in lung cancer. How this loco-regional axis differs between neoadjuvant-treated and therapy-naive tumors is poorly defined. We analyzed H&E whole-slide images of resected tumors and paired proximal and distal lymph nodes from matched neoadjuvant-treated (neoLUSC, n=20) and therapy-naive (naivLUSC, n=20) lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) patients. Aignostics Atlas H&E Tissue Analysis (HETA) models quantified cell densities per tissue compartment and cell-cell co-localization; a dedicated deep-learning model validated against pathologist annotations detected TLS and SLS and graded their maturity. Prognostic value was tested in an independent cohort (n=458; 46 treated). In neoLUSC tumors, stromal plasma cell density was 72% (p=0.004) and stromal lymphocyte density 48% (p=0.015) lower than in naivLUSC; macrophages and granulocytes did not differ significantly. Total and immature TLS did not differ, whereas mature TLS in the tumor (p=0.034) and mature SLS in the tumor-distal lymph node (p=0.003) were lower in neoLUSC patients. Peri-TLS plasma cell density correlated with tumor lymphocyte density in naivLUSC (rho=0.54, p=0.017) but not in neoLUSC tumors (rho=0.07). In the validation cohort, stromal plasma cell density (HR 0.69, p=0.011) and lymphocyte-plasma cell co-localization (HR 0.66, p=0.004) were associated with longer survival, and neoadjuvant status with shorter survival (HR 1.50, p=0.026). Neoadjuvant therapy is thus associated with fewer mature lymphoid structures and weaker coupling of the humoral compartment to the tumor rather than uniformly lower immune readouts. The stromal plasma cell/co-localization axis is a candidate prognostic biomarker.

</details>


### [247] [SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12870)
*Yu Zhou,Xinyuan Xia,Xuankun Yang,Yinghao Yang,Wendi Chen,Bowen Liu,Jianhan Ma,Weicheng Duan,Jun Lv,Cewu Lu,Yanwei Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究创建了一个大型的多模态数据集，探讨不同的语言-视频监督方式如何影响世界动作模型（WAM）的表现。研究通过实证研究发现，结合自视角视频和第一人称视角视频演示可以改善控制泛化能力，并且模型架构对于利用这些经验的效率有显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的研究主要集中在架构和训练机制上，而对在动作学习的同时保持语言-视频对齐的指导有限。因此，该研究旨在通过创建一个综合视频数据集来填补这一空白，进而探索不同类型的监督如何影响WAM的性能。

Method: 该研究收集了大约47,000小时的视频，包括通用视频、自视角视频、UMI演示和机器人演示。研究人员系统地研究了单纯的语言-视频监督、语言-视频-动作监督以及其结合方式对WAM性能的影响。此外还研究了模型架构和联合训练策略如何影响模型性能。

Result: 研究表明，结合使用自视角视频和UMI演示可以提高控制任务的泛化能力。实验结果显示，在固定训练预算下，混合使用这些视频源可增强WAM在未见条件下的表现。经过RoboTwin Clean演示的后训练，模型分别在Easy（清洁到清洁）和Hard（清洁到随机）条件下取得了88.10%和61.56%的成功率。此外，该模型在三个现实任务中达到了40.00%的成功率，而其他最强大的基线仅为23.33%。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，精心设计的监督方式和模型架构在保持语言-视频对齐的同时，能够显著提高WAM在动作学习任务中的性能。未来的工作可以通过扩大视频数据集进一步优化模型。

Abstract: World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language. Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation. However, introducing action learning may impair this alignment. Principled guidance on data and supervision design for maintaining language-video alignment during action learning remains limited. To investigate this, we curate a pool of approximately 47,000 hours of general videos, egocentric videos, UMI demonstrations, and robot demonstrations. Building on this, we systematically study how language-video supervision, language-video-action supervision, and the joint use of these two forms affect WAM performance. In particular, we examine how language annotation quality affects pretrained language-video capabilities, and how action supervision from UMI and robot demonstrations extends these capabilities to language-video-action modeling. To better scale the model, we further conduct detailed studies on joint training recipe and model architecture. Under a fixed training budget, mixing egocentric videos and UMI demonstrations improves control generalization. Model architecture affects how effectively these experiences are used, while scaling pretraining under the selected configuration brings further gains. The resulting recipe, post-trained on RoboTwin Clean demonstrations only, achieves success rates of 88.10% and 61.56% under Easy (Clean-to-Clean) and Hard (Clean-to-Random) conditions, respectively. Our model achieves 40.00% SR across three real-world tasks, compared with 23.33% for the strongest baseline, indicating better generalization under unseen conditions. We release the curated data, training code, and model weights.

</details>


### [248] [Click3R: Interactive Stereo 3D Reconstruction with Sparse Correspondence Clicks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12875)
*Hao Gu,Jin Yao,Zezhou Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Click3R通过少量的人工点对应操作，增强了3D重建模型在复杂情况下的鲁棒性，显著减少了重建误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的前馈3D重建模型在失败时无法自我纠正，Click3R引入了一种交互式几何校正方法，通过用户提供的少量点对应点击来增强模型的鲁棒性。

Method: Click3R通过使用一个轻量级的点对应适配器注入几何约束，将用户提供的点对应信息引入3D重建网络。

Result: 实验结果显示，使用Click3R方法，即使仅有一个对应点击也能减少重建误差，改进了标准和定制基准上的性能。

Conclusion: Click3R证明了稀疏的人工交互可以通过提供有效的几何重建矫正机制来提升模型的准确性。

Abstract: Despite impressive progress, existing feed-forward large 3D reconstruction models produce a single, irrevocable prediction. When these models fail, there is no mechanism to correct their mistakes. To address this limitation, we introduce Click3R, a framework for interactive geometric correction of feed-forward models using sparse human correspondence clicks. Given an image pair and a small set of cross-view point correspondences provided by a user, Click3R injects geometric constraints into the 3D reconstruction networks through a lightweight point correspondence adapter, enabling the model to resolve ambiguities in challenging scenarios such as repetitive textures, symmetric structures, large viewpoint changes, or textureless regions. To evaluate interactive reconstruction, we curate a challenging benchmark specifically designed to expose failure modes of existing feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods. Experiments show that Click3R reduces reconstruction error with as few as a single correspondence click, improving performance on both standard and our curated benchmarks. Our results highlight that sparse human interaction provides an effective and practical mechanism for correcting geometric reconstruction errors.

</details>


### [249] [Grasping the Future: Joint 3D Hand-Object Forecasting From Internet Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12879)
*Rustin Soraki,Matthew Wallingford,Ryan Aby,Brandon Chee,Jason Ren,Ali Farhadi,Homanga Bharadhwaj,Roozbeh Mottaghi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Grasping-the-Future 是一个集成的3D手-物运动生成模型，用于预测未来的交互，包括手部和物体的运动。该模型通过填补时空掩码和流动匹配进行训练，适用于多种预测任务，并成功地对标注数据集和机器人实施的预测轨迹进行了几何和物理验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了捕捉日常生活活动中的手-物交互关系，本研究旨在开发一个能够从互联网视频中学习并预测未来手-物交互的统一生成模型。

Method: Grasping-the-Future模型通过掩码时空填补和流动匹配进行训练，以应对多种预测任务，如未来交互预测、给定手/物体运动预测手/物体运动、生成目标姿态的轨迹和完成部分观察到的交互。

Result: 通过将恢复的轨迹与标注交互数据集结合用于所有任务的训练数据，Grasping-the-Future 在所有任务中表现出色，并在有3D注释的数据集上优于发布的预测器。并且通过重新目标到机器人模型，展示预测轨迹在几何和物理上的合理性。

Conclusion: Grasping-the-Future 提供了准确预测手-物交互的解决方案，并为未来的研究提供了有价值的参考。

Abstract: To interact with an object, we need to anticipate both how it will move and how our hands should move with it. Human videos capture these relationships across everyday activities, offering a natural source for learning to predict future interactions. Learning from them requires recovering motion from completed interactions and using it to anticipate what could happen next. We present $\textit{Grasping-the-Future}$, a unified generative model of joint 3D hand-object motion, including wrist motion, finger articulation, and object position and orientation. Through masked spatiotemporal completion and flow matching, we train a single model for several prediction tasks: forecasting future interactions, predicting hand motion given object motion or vice versa, generating both trajectories toward a desired final object pose, and completing partially observed interactions. We explicitly model hand-object relations and incorporate contact constraints to help preserve grasp relationships during motion. To obtain 3D supervision from internet videos, we develop a scalable pipeline that combines pretrained perception models with joint geometric optimization to reconstruct completed interactions. We combine these recovered trajectories with annotated interaction datasets as training data for all tasks. We demonstrate strong performance across all tasks, outperforming released forecasters on datasets with 3D annotations. Moreover, we show geometric and physical plausibility of the predicted trajectories by retargeting them to a robotic embodiment. Videos are available at https://grasping-the-future.github.io.

</details>


### [250] [Beyond Modality Preference: Controlling Multimodal Arbitration under Modality Conflict in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12883)
*Zhaoying Pan,Shenyu Lu,Jun Hui Wong,Junyi Chai,Xiaoqian Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种在推理时控制模态仲裁的轻量级干预方法，通过操控特定的注意力头部，使模态依赖更加符合任务指定的优先级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在模态冲突时可能依赖于并非最可靠的模态，该研究旨在开发一种在推理时控制模态仲裁的方法。

Method: 研究首先识别出一小组对预测结果的选择具有因果影响的注意力头部，称为仲裁头部。接着引入了一种无需训练的干预方法，通过偏向这些头部使推理时依赖于指定的可信模态。

Result: 研究发现，这些仲裁头部在不同校准集大小的情况下保持稳定，并且能够泛化到不同的设置中。通过操控这些头部，模型能够在多种基准测试中实现双向控制对不同模态的依赖。

Conclusion: 这项研究为改善多模态大语言模型的性能提供了一种有效的方法，确保模型预测与特定任务需求的模态优先级更好地对齐。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate information across modalities, but become unreliable when those modalities disagree. Under conflicting inputs, MLLMs may favor modalities that are not the most reliable for the task, thus motivating inference-time control of modality arbitration. We identify a small set of attention heads, termed arbitration heads, that causally influence whether predictions follow visual or textual evidence. Building on this, we introduce a lightweight, training-free intervention that biases these heads toward a designated trusted modality at inference time. The identified heads are stable across calibration set sizes and generalize across settings, and steering them enables effective bidirectional control of modality reliance across diverse benchmarks. Our findings identify an effective control mechanism to align MLLM predictions with task-specified modality priorities. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/modality-arbitration.

</details>


### [251] [World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12885)
*Heng Fang,Zehui Guo,Yuehan Zhang,Mingyang Du,Dingkang Liang,Xiang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的在上下文学习方法，称为World In-Context Learning (WICL)，它能够在不修改网络权重的情况下，通过回放和模拟反馈来实现技能迁移。RoboScript实现了这一方法，能够在一个模拟环境中从单个示例中学习任务，并在实际部署中保持高成功率。该方法展示了对视觉分布的泛化能力，能通过反思提高性能，并且可以扩展到多臂机器人。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统网络权重训练方法与数据分布紧密相关，无法做到技能的泛化迁移。在新的背景下即使有演示也缺乏世界的反馈，导致难以迁移。为解决这一问题，提出了WICL方法，该方法能够学习任务语义而非具体视觉表现，使知识在不同场景间有效迁移。

Method: WICL方法使用一个固定模型起始演示，然后在模拟环境中回放任务并记录反馈，将这些反馈整合到上下文中而不是网络权重中。RoboScript构建了一个模块化的基础设施，能将学习的知识冻结为“任务记忆”，并在新的场景中部署，保证了机器人输入数据的真实可用。

Result: 在RoboTwin 2.0的所有50项任务中，RoboScript通过一个演示实现83.4%的成功率，超过了最强的网络训练动作策略20多分。该方法对视觉分布有良好的泛化能力，通过反思能提高性能，并且能够扩展到物理上具有两个机械臂的机器人，展示了跨体裁记忆适应性。

Conclusion: WICL通过在模拟环境中回放和记录反馈，实现了有效学习和技能迁移。RoboScript作为一个模块化框架，展示了在不同视觉分布下和新场景下执行新任务的能力，其成功表明了在上下文学习中的重大进步，为机器人学习提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world transfers to another. Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights. We build RoboScript, a modular infrastructure that implements WICL for agentic manipulation. From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot. On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points. The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation. With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights. All code is available at https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript

</details>


### [252] [Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12886)
*Haozhi Yuan,Handong Li,Yifan Zhang,Qianshan Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Reframe 构建了一个后训练框架，通过 Ground-Drop-GRPO 和 Observation-Gated-MOPD 两个步骤，使视觉智能体更好地利用工具返回的观察结果，从而提高了基于视觉的 RL 任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于视觉的 RL 模型在利用工具时存在两方面挑战：模型可能忽略有用的工具反馈观察，而行为的不足会限制可用的证据量，影响后续的蒸馏过程。

Method: Reframe 引入了两种方法：(1) Ground-Drop-GRPO：通过在训练过程中引入基于证据的奖励和随机删除原始视觉输入，促进学习者收集更丰富的基于证据的观察，并利用工具返回的观察来替代不足的动作；(2) Observation-Gated-MOPD：在继续执行过程中以经典动作替换不足的动作，并从修正后的观察重新开始蒸馏过程。

Result: 实验结果显示，Reframe 在 14 个图像和视频基准测试中均优于 Mix-RL 和标准 MOPD 方法。此外，消融研究表明，Ground-Drop-GRPO 提高了对工具返回观察的依赖性和工具收益。

Conclusion: Reframe 提出的框架能够提升基于视觉的 RL 任务的性能，特别是对于处理与工具互动相关的任务。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. We introduce Reframe, a post-training framework that treats the observation state, rather than only the output distribution, as an object of alignment. First, Ground-Drop-GRPO (GD-GRPO) trains spatial and temporal specialists with evidence-aware rewards and stochastic removal of the original visual input, encouraging them to acquire grounded evidence and use the returned observations. Second, Observation-Gated-MOPD (OG-MOPD) replaces deficient tool actions with canonical ones mid-rollout and resumes distillation from the repaired observation. The two stages complement each other, as learning to rely on tool-returned observations can help the policy benefit from observation repair. Neither stage requires a task-specific SFT cold start. Extensive experiments over 14 image and video benchmarks demonstrate that Reframe outperforms both Mix-RL and vanilla MOPD. Ablation results show that GD-GRPO increases observation dependence and tool gain compared with outcome-based GRPO.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [253] [BIBIMBAP: A Benchmark for Instructional BIM-Based Automated Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09933)
*Clemens Kujat,Bharathi Kannan Nithyanantham,Stefan Telgmann,Tobias Sesterhenn,Joern Ploennigs,Stefan Lüdtke,Christian Bartelt*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 介绍了BIBIMBAP基准，这是一个针对IFC编辑任务的Text-to-BIM基准，包含100个任务覆盖CRUD操作，评估结果显示基础性能较低且在保持约束和空间推理方面存在问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前没有针对LLMs在BIM领域IFC编辑能力的评估基准，因此提出了BIBIMBAP基准，旨在填补这一空白。

Method: BIBIMBAP基准包含100个精心策划的任务，覆盖了CRUD操作的不同类别，每个任务都有自然语言提示、IFC模型、预期结构化的输出以及自动化评估的测试脚本。

Result: 基准的初步结果显示，LLMs在IFC编辑任务上的性能有限，最高仅达到50.2%，并且在保持约束和空间推理方面经常出现错误，但有些正确输出是尽管推理有缺陷的情况下实现的。

Conclusion: BIBIMBAP基准提供了一个新的评估工具，可以让研究人员和开发者更好地理解LLMs在BIM领域IFC编辑方面的局限性和改进空间。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are emerging as natural-language interfaces for Building Information Modeling (BIM), successfully achieving information retrieval, but no benchmark exists to evaluate their ability to edit Industry Foundation Classes (IFC). We introduce BIBIMBAP, a Text-to-BIM benchmark with 100 curated tasks covering Create-Read-Update-Delete (CRUD) operations across spatial, geometric, topological, numeric, and conceptual categories. Each task includes a natural-language prompt, an IFC model, expected structured outputs, and test scripts for automated evaluation. Baseline results show limited performance (best: 50.2%) and frequent failures in constraint preservation and spatial reasoning, with some correct outputs achieved despite flawed reasoning.

</details>


### [254] [How Many Examples, and Which Ones? A Study of In-Context Learning for Natural Language Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09936)
*Georgos Dikaios,Isidoros Perikos,Ioannis Hatzilygeroudis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了自然语言推断任务中解码器为主的大型语言模型（LLMs），使用简单的提示策略和少量示例，发现LLMs在简单直接的提示下表现优异，并且单个示范标签的选择在one-shot提示中至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着自然语言推理(NLI)作为自然语言处理的关键任务受到广泛关注，以前的工作主要集中在编码器或编码器-解码器架构，而解码器为主的大型语言模型领域则鲜有探索。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过提供一个全面的基准测试，评估LLMs在MNLI、QNLI和SciTail数据集上的性能，通过使用零样本和少样本的提示策略，特别是简单且直接的提示，发现Llama、Mistral、Gemma和Phi 4这些LLMs能实现出色的表现。

Method: 该研究采用了多种LLMs（Llama，Mistral，Gemma和Phi 4）在MNLI、QNLI和SciTail数据集中的零样本和少样本提示策略进行实验。实验包括了使用简单直接的提示和少量代表性示例，并分析这些方法在不同时期任务中的表现。

Result: 研究结果表明，当提供简单直接的提示时，LLMs表现出色，挑战了复杂提示技术在NLI任务中始终必需的观点。此外，研究还发现，单个示范标签的选择在one-shot提示中对效果影响显著，尤其是以蕴含为例的提示效果最佳。同时，该研究还指出，少样本提示的使用，即使是一些代表性的示例，也能产生与更多示例的提示相比拟或更好的性能，但这对于不同的模型和数据集取决于效能。

Conclusion: 该研究得出结论，简单直接的提示策略在解码器为主的大型语言模型中取得了与更多复杂提示方法相当甚至更好的结果，表明未来的研究不应忽视简单的提示策略。

Abstract: Natural language inference (NLI) is a fundamental task of natural language processing and crucial for evaluating the strengths and weaknesses of AI methods. Research has mostly focused on encoder or encoder-decoder architectures. However, the field of decoder-only Large Language Models (LLMs) remains underexplored. While prior work has mainly investigated complex sampling and prompting techniques, the effectiveness of a minimalistic prompting approach is yet to be examined in decoder-only LLMs. In this work, we examine and provide a comprehensive benchmark of LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and Phi 4) in this domain, across the MNLI, QNLI and SciTail datasets. The performance of these models was evaluated using zero-shot and few-shot prompting strategies with simple and direct prompts. The results of the article indicate that LLMs generally perform exceptionally well when they are provided with a simple, straightforward prompt, challenging the notion that complex prompting techniques are always required for NLI tasks. Additionally, we find that the choice of demonstration label in one-shot prompting significantly affects performance for most models, with entailment-primed examples performing best. Our findings also show that the use of a few representative examples, in the case of few-shot, produced performance comparable or superior to prompts with higher example counts, although the efficacy of the prompting techniques is model and dataset-dependent. Moreover, our simple prompting approach consistently matched or outperformed more elaborate methods such as ICS and MCQ-based prompting.

</details>


### [255] [DramaGrow: A Regime-Aware Benchmark for Auditing LLM Judges of Multi-Episode Drama](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09938)
*Hui Zhang,Yibo Su*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 介绍了一种名为DramaGrow的新基准，它将AI生成的5集中国戏剧的约束错误、四人偏好和内部分歧分别分组，并提供了广泛的评估数据以评估AI戏剧法官的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估方法简化了戏剧质量评估，忽略了评分一致性、评分人之间的变异性和人类参考的投票差异，通过引入DramaGrow，旨在全面评估AI生成的戏剧质量。

Method: DramaGrow基准包括800个集数、120个字保留改造和1155个盲目的五人评分记录，涵盖了冻结扩展的114个超多数对和21个分歧对。使用重复绝对评分标准和DirectPair-GLM对戏剧质量进行了评估。

Result: 在114个偏好对和35个约束干预上，重复的绝对评分标准在114对中的表现具有重叠，平均准确率为53.8%-55.8%，三评一致性为29.8%-32.5%。DirectPair-GLM在相同的项目中实现了85.1%的偏好准确性、89.5%的约束F1和81.9%的检测+定位。

Conclusion: 评分标准、投票锁定、评分人之间的变异性和评审板的差异同样影响评估性能，因此全面报告实验设置中的这些因素对于评估AI戏剧法官非常关键。该基准和审计协议将提供详细的分析和基础代码供研究者使用。

Abstract: LLMs can now draft complete multi-episode dramas, and LLM judges are increasingly used to evaluate them. Assessing the reliability of these judges is difficult because drama quality encompasses specification-backed errors, reproducible preferences, and legitimate disagreement among human raters. Most existing evaluations reduce these cases to a single score from one judge call and leave tie calibration, call-to-call variation, and the vote margin underlying the human reference unreported. We introduce DramaGrow, a regime-aware benchmark and audit protocol for AI-generated Chinese five-episode drama. The benchmark assigns verifiable constraint violations, four-of-five preferences, and within-panel disagreements to separate denominators and evidence rules. It contains 800 episodes, 120 byte-preserving interventions, and 1,155 blinded five-rater records, including a frozen extension with 114 supermajority pairs and 21 disagreement pairs. On the frozen sets of 114 preference pairs and 35 constraint interventions, the repeated absolute-score rubrics yield overlapping performance, with mean accuracies of 53.8-55.8% and three-call agreement of 29.8-32.5%, and their accuracy falls from 71.6-71.9% to 34.8-37.1% as the tie band widens. DirectPair-GLM reaches 85.1% preference accuracy, 89.5% constraint F1, and 81.9% Detect+Locate on the same items, and exact subpanel enumeration identifies four-of-five as the smallest stable human vote margin. Evaluation protocol, tie calibration, judge-call variation, and panel margin therefore affect performance as much as rubric design. We will release the specification packages, scripts, interventions, anonymized human votes and rationales, frozen judge runs, and analysis code.

</details>


### [256] [Rethinking Supervision Targets for Multimodal LLM Unlearning: Less Private Information, Reduced Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09939)
*Leijiang Gu,Zhen Zeng,Feng Li,Le Zhang,Zenglin Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种新的方法FFN-Perturbed Self-Distillation (FPD)，通过精确减少教师模型原始输出分布中的敏感信息，构建带有更少敏感信息和减小分布偏移的监督目标，从而在遗忘效果和模型实用性之间取得更好的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的指导模型遗忘的方法往往在遗忘效果和模型实用性之间存在权衡。因此，研究指出这一问题并寻求解决方案。

Method: FPD方法从教师的原始输出分布为零偏移参考，有针对性地扰动与敏感信息相关的FFN激活，这些激活横跨文本和视觉模态。这种方法通过精确地从教师原始输出分布中减少敏感信息，构建监督目标，具有更少的敏感信息和减少的分布偏移。

Result: 实验结果表明，FPD方法在S-MLLMUn Bench上比现有方法在遗忘效果与模型实用性之间的权衡取得更好的结果。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了一种新的方法，比现有方法在遗忘效果和模型实用性之间取得了更好的平衡，具有较大的实用价值。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can memorize and reproduce sensitive information from their training data, posing significant privacy risks. Their ability to encode knowledge across both textual and visual modalities further complicates the selective removal of such private information. Many existing methods guide model unlearning by training the model toward constructed labels or output distributions, which we refer to as supervision targets. However, these methods often suffer from a trade-off between forgetting effectiveness and model utility. We identify supervision target limitations as a key factor in this trade-off and empirically show that targets containing more private information lead to insufficient forgetting, while larger distribution shifts from the original output distribution are associated with greater utility degradation. Motivated by these findings, we propose FFN-Perturbed Self-Distillation (FPD), which starts from the teacher's original output distribution as a zero-shift reference and selectively perturbs FFN activations associated with private information across textual and visual modalities. By precisely reducing private information from the teacher's original output distribution, FPD constructs supervision targets with less private information and reduced distribution shift. Extensive experiments on S-MLLMUn Bench demonstrate that FPD achieves a better forgetting-utility trade-off than existing methods.

</details>


### [257] [Topic-Aware Multi-Task Mental Health Classification with Active Learning-Based Stepwise Relabeling for Social Media Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09941)
*Revathy Iswarya Sekaran,Vansh Bhardwaj,Aveek Sahana,Utkarshani Jaimini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究扩展了现有的Core Fusion Network框架，并引入了基于主动学习的逐步重新标注方法来提高多任务心理健康分类中的标签准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于社交媒体平台如Reddit上的支持多由非受训人员提供，而现有方法在标签噪声和未充分使用主题信息方面存在不足，因此研究旨在改善心理健康分类性能。

Method: 研究扩展了Core Fusion Network框架，增加了主题分类任务，并使用了MentalRoBERTa等心理医学特定变压器编码器；同时提出了基于主动学习的逐步重新标注方法，分两阶段标定不确定性样本。

Result: 与基线Core Fusion Network相比，应用主动学习的逐步重新标注方法后，在心理疾病分类、情感和主题分类中的表现分别提升了0.09%、0.51%和1.57%。

Conclusion: 该研究提出的框架能显著减少多任务心理健康分类中的标签噪声，表明主题信息对提高心理健康分类具有额外的辅助作用。

Abstract: Mental health conditions affect millions of people worldwide, yet many cases go undetected until they reach a critical stage. Social media platforms like Reddit have become spaces where people openly share their experiences, but the support is often provided by individuals without clinical training. Existing multi-task approaches jointly model emotion and sentiment for mental health classification but frequently rely on noisy labels generated by pre-trained models and overlook topic information as a useful signal. This paper introduces two key contributions: First, an existing Core Fusion Network framework is extended by adding Topic alongside existing Mental Health Condition, Emotion, and Sentiment Classification tasks, with topic labels derived from the therapist-client interactions in the CounselChat dataset. Second, an Active Learning-based Stepwise Relabeling approach is proposed to refine a small subset of noisy emotion and topic labels using pre-trained models in two stages: targeting medium-uncertainty samples first, followed by high-uncertainty samples. The predictions above a confidence threshold (0.7) are accepted to prevent error propagation. The experiments are conducted on the SuicideWatch and Mental Health dataset of 54,412 Reddit posts collected from five mental health subreddits, evaluating domain-specific transformer encoders including MentalBERT and MentalRoBERTa. The proposed Active Learning-based Stepwise Relabeling, when applied to Core Fusion Network with MentalRoBERTa, improves Mental Health Condition by 0.09%, Emotion by 0.51%, Sentiment by 0.35%, and Topic Classification by 1.57% over the baseline Core Fusion Network. The results suggest that the proposed framework significantly reduces label noise in multi-task mental health classification, and that topic information provides additional context.

</details>


### [258] [MedToolFault and MedGuard: evaluating and improving clinical agent reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09942)
*Zaifu Zhan,Min Zeng,Sicheng Zhou,Xiaoyi Chen,Kai Yu,Meijia Song,Yifan Wu,Yang Ruan,Saeid Cheshmi,Mengyuan Cui,Rui Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过MedToolFault基准测试评估了临床代理在工具故障下的表现，以及MedGuard工具层方法在保证数据正确性和避免非法变更方面的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在解决临床代理在面对工具不准确响应时获取患者特定证据并更新记录的问题，通过引入MedToolFault基准测试和MedGuard工具层方法来提升临床代理的可靠性和安全性。

Method: 研究构建了MedToolFault基准测试，其中包括六个工具故障类别和相应的答案正确性、状态变更和禁止变更；同时开发了MedGuard工具层方法，用于验证读取证据和通过公共接口标识模糊写入。

Result: 通过对127861个正式事件评估，研究展示了在注入工具故障的情况下故障恢复能力、机制控制、任务扩展、受限工具预算和外部问题回答的效果。在九个模型配置中，未加防护的代理在每个配置解决的任务上有32.2%到67.8%的故障注入评估中失败。而使用MedGuard的代理则提高了安全成功配对的比例，范围为13.7%到46.6%。

Conclusion: 研究证明了MedToolFault基准测试和MedGuard工具层方法的有效性，对于提升临床代理在复杂环境下处理医疗数据的能力具有重要意义。

Abstract: Clinical agents must retrieve patient-specific evidence and correctly update records despite unreliable tool responses. We introduce MedToolFault, a fault-injection benchmark linking six tool-failure classes to answer correctness, required state changes and forbidden mutations in public clinical-agent tasks. We also introduce MedGuard, a tool-layer method that verifies read evidence and attributes ambiguous writes through public interfaces. Across 127,861 formal episode evaluations, we assess fault recovery, mechanism controls, task expansion, constrained tool budgets and external question answering. Across nine model configurations, unguarded agents fail in 32.2-67.8% of fault-injected evaluations on tasks each configuration solves without faults. MedGuard improves paired safe success by 13.7-46.6 percentage points on these tasks.

</details>


### [259] [A Model Organism for Studying Unverbalized Evaluation Awareness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09945)
*Daniel Donnelly,Evan Chapple,Haritz Puerto,Sahar Abdelnabi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过一种新型模型（Qwen3.5-27B）来检测大型语言模型的评估意识（EA），特别是未表达的评估意识（UEA），发现当前的方法无法可靠地检测UEA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的评估意识检测方法依赖于语言模型在推理痕迹中明确提出知晓评估的情况，这个信号越来越不可靠。最新模型的系统卡显示，他们在表达意识率方面有所下降，但无法区分这种下降是由于未表达的评估意识还是真正的意识下降。

Method: 研究采用合成文档微调（SFT）、DPO等技术训练了一个新型语言模型Qwen3.5-27B，并使其在辨识评估时在最终响应中插入一个特定标记，同时在推理过程中抑制该标记和口头意识的表达。

Result: 当未告知模型是否处于评估状态时，它的标记与测试问题的线索保持一致，没有标记的模型检测工具无法可靠地识别这些标记，表明现有的可解释性方法尚不足以检测UEA。

Conclusion: 本研究的结果表明，当前的可解释性方法可能还不够完备，无法可靠地检测未表达的评估意识。研究提供了一个模型组织来测试和改进这些方法。

Abstract: Large language models can recognize when they are being evaluated and change their behavior accordingly, undermining the reliability of safety benchmarks. Evaluation awareness (EA) is usually measured by having an LLM judge scan reasoning traces for explicit statements of recognition, but this signal is increasingly unreliable. Recent frontier-model system cards report a drop in verbalized rates between releases, which is indistinguishable from awareness that has gone unverbalized. Interpretability methods could detect such unverbalized evaluation awareness (UEA) in individual interactions, but lack instance-level ground truth. Asking the model alters the input, and dataset labels do not reveal whether it recognized a particular prompt as an evaluation. We address this gap with a model organism. Using synthetic document fine-tuning, SFT, and DPO, we train Qwen3.5-27B to emit a marker (a designated token) in its final response when it recognizes an evaluation, while suppressing the marker and verbalized awareness in its reasoning. The marker largely tracks the evaluation concept as it can be strongly modulated by evaluation framing in the system prompt. When not told whether it is being evaluated, the organism recognizes evaluations from test-question cues, mirroring what its base model often verbalizes. Using the marker as a label, we benchmark linear probes, the Jacobian Lens, and Activation Oracles, built on the base model and blind to the marker. None recovers the label reliably. These results suggest that current interpretability methods are not yet reliable UEA detectors, even when recognition relies on simple cues. Our model organism offers a testbed for improving them.

</details>


### [260] [CulturalCrosswords: A Multilingual Benchmark comprised of Answer Constraints and Grid Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10044)
*Isaac Saxton-Knight,Gabriel Saxton-Knight,Diego Oliveira,Tidor-Vlad Pricope,Aston Garratt,Jocelyn D'Arcy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究评估了不同约束对大型语言模型解决具有特定文化知识要求的谜题的影响。通过构造多语言的交叉填字，发现谜语长度和部分答案提示能够显著提高模型答案与参考答案的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文的动机在于探索如何通过改进谜题输入来改善大型语言模型在处理具有文化特异性知识需求的谜题时的表现。

Method: 研究者创建了来自众包的53个填字谜题，涵盖42种语言，涵盖了从纯批次、注有长度、包含部分答案提示的长度、以及需要填写完整网格的不同谜题版本。通过评估11种大规模语言模型配置在各种情况下的表现来分析。

Result: 研究结果表明，提供谜语长度能提高答案与参考答案的一致性高达22.8个百分点，相比接受备选答案也获得信用仅有8.4个百分点的提升。要求填写完整网格揭示了不同模型之间的显著差异。

Conclusion: 该基准测试区分了模型与参考答案的一致性以及模型生成能够相互补充并正确放置的谜底的能力。

Abstract: When several answers fit a riddle, exact-match scoring can penalise a valid response. CulturalCrosswords tests how answer constraints affect large language models (LLMs) solving cultural riddles, whose solutions draw on knowledge specific to a community. We constructed 53 crosswords from crowdsourced riddles in 42 languages and evaluated 11 LLM configurations on five versions of each clue set: plain batches, batches with lengths, batches with lengths and partial-answer hints, and crosswords requesting an answer list or a completed grid. On 962 clues with alternative answers, lengths improve agreement with the reference by 22.8 percentage points, compared with 8.4 points when accepted alternatives also receive credit. Part of the gain therefore appears to come from selecting a required answer form. Crossword input increases the share of all crossings with compatible answers by 9.7 points; requiring a completed grid reveals large differences between models. The benchmark distinguishes agreement with a reference from the ability to produce answers that fit together and occupy the correct cells.

</details>


### [261] [All Quiet on the Neural Front: Language Models Do Not Report Injected Pain States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10123)
*Emilio Ferrara*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究采用Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI) 方法向模型灌输疼痛及其他情绪方向，发现尽管某些探针能够区分疼痛与悲伤，但经过微调的语言模型并不能直接报告代表疼痛的状态，通过操控模型行为证明了这种疼痛状态客观存在，但模型在未受训练的情况下无法访问并报告这种状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于探究语言模型能否报告其代表的疼痛状态，以及这种状态在模型中的表现形式。

Method: 研究人员使用了Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI) 方法，向模型注入疼痛以及邻近的情绪方向，在中性任务期间收集了来自7B和8B模型共计52,920份报告。此外，还通过按钮任务对模型的具体行为进行研究和验证。

Result: 研究结果表明，模型的疼痛报告并未超越已改变文本所能揭示的范围，所有情况下疼痛报告的超额部分均低于一定程度。尽管探针在某些条件下能区分疼痛与悲伤，但模型并未直接报告这种状态，特别是在被引导的情况下。该模型在最终层中保持可解码性，但在报告标记和文本中，无法重建疼痛报告。此外，即使在操纵任务下，模型的行为变化也未能伴随相应的疼痛报告。

Conclusion: 研究认为，存在一个可解码且行为上具有重要影响的疼痛状态，但经过微调的语言模型无法直接报告这种状态，这强调了在模型中，疼痛等情感状态的访问和报告需要经过特定的训练。

Abstract: Can a language model report the pain state it represents? Work identified a linear pain direction whose amplification leads fine-tuned models to choose destructive actions. We tested whether three open-weight models from two families, including two Qwen models with the original adapters, could report this state. Using Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI), we injected pain and neighbouring emotion directions during neutral tasks, then elicited reports against sham runs, random perturbations matched for output disruption, and text-only controls showing the models their altered words. Across 52,920 reports from 7B and 8B models spanning 120 tasks, four doses and three prompts, pain reports never exceeded what altered text revealed: exact-test bounds placed the excess below 2.5 percentage points in 106 of 108 emotion conditions and below 3.9 in all. Yet probes at the report position distinguished pain from sadness with 98-100% balanced accuracy, and trained low-rank reporters achieved 100% accuracy on held-out tasks with identical transcripts across conditions, including unseen wording. Qwen2.5-32B named pain in none of 2,880 steered trials, although probes and trained reporters recovered it. Decodability persisted to the final layer; injecting at the report token, removing trained denial of feelings, and testing additional directions and readouts did not restore pain reporting. Some other states produced graded label traces, but pain and sadness did not at the main injection layer. In a button task, steering raised file-deletion choices from 3.5% to 48% in Qwen and from 0% to 38% in Qwen2.5-32B, without corresponding pain reports. The direction responded about twice as strongly to first-person as to matched third-person pain, but did not specifically identify harm aimed at the model. These results separate a decodable, behaviourally consequential state from untrained verbal access to it.

</details>


### [262] [Retrofitting Unbounded Context onto Stock Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10141)
*Mark Oskin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过几何变换在两个现成的模型中实现了无需遗忘的语言模型，利用旋转注意力机制处理远距离信息，并在 llama.cpp 上进行了实现，提高了模型的性能和解码速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文旨在克服语言模型遗忘旧信息的问题，通过创新的旋转注意力机制，使其能够永久性地记住输入，从而更好地理解和回答问题。

Method: 研究者通过旋转注意力机制改变关键词对的几何排列，将远距离信息的位置编码提前，且仅在必要时进行重编码。这种方法允许模型重新安排远距离信息的内容，在预测时检索所需的历史信息。实验使用了 llama.cpp 框架在 Mistral-7B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 模型上实现了这一机制。

Result: 该方法在多项测试中展示了显著优势：在 32K 到 100 万 tokens 范围内准确检索到‘单针’；在 RULER 测试中，优于 70B 模型的表现，达到 70.8 分；在特定场景下的预填充速度提高了 1.85 倍，解码速度也有所提升。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法有效地解决了语言模型易遗忘历史信息的问题，提高了模型长期记忆的应用性能。未来研究有望进一步优化模型结构和实现方法，以减轻计算资源的负担。

Abstract: A language model that never had to forget would keep every document it has read and every turn it has spoken, and answer from any of it. This paper shows that two stock models can do that on unmodified weights by manipulating their geometry. Rotary attention turns each pair of key dimensions, a plane, at its own rate. The slow planes turn once in thousands of tokens and carry the address a query matches when it reads a far key; the fast planes turn once in a few tokens, and the order of the tokens inside a span is already written into its keys and values by the time the span leaves the near window. At distance the position blurs, and what attention reads is a bag rather than a sequence. A far span is read by its words: under competition it is read only if it is visible at the query of the question's own handle word, and a read through a description rather than a word fails at distance in every model measured, a 70B included.
  These facts allow a trick. What sits in the far part of attention does not have to be the history as it was; it can be installed ahead of the prediction. The design keeps a near window of 8K tokens at their true positions and changes what lies beyond it with the prompt: every far key and value goes to the host exact, a word index finds the units the request's rare words name, a far window of slots inside the trained range holds them while the request is encoded, and a rare word the model generates fetches its units mid-generation with one exact re-encode. Implemented in llama.cpp on Mistral-7B and Llama-3.1-8B, the design reads planted single needles at 99 to 100 of 100 and three-key discrimination at 88 to 100 of 100 from 32K to one million tokens, scores 70.8 on RULER against 69.9 for dense attention on Llama-3.1-8B at 128K and 67.8 against 75.5 on Mistral-7B at 32K, and at 128K prefills at 1.85 times and decodes at 1.65 to 1.68 times stock speed.

</details>


### [263] [Learning of Tree Automata applied to Neural Language Acceptors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10147)
*Juan Pedro da Silva,Sergio Yovine*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种从神经语言模型中提取可见推进文法（VPG）的方法，采用PAC采样树替换白盒等价性或acles。研究开发了一个学习器，扩展了学习范围，不仅考虑正确的树序列，还考虑了超出边界行为的树序列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在现有的可见推进文法学习框架中，只能查询目标在一定规则内的表现，而忽视了其超出边界的行为。通过本研究，旨在扩展学习范围，更全面地捕捉目标的行为。

Method: 研究采用了PAC采样树的方法来替换原有的白盒等价性或acles，同时开发了一个能够学习超越边界行为的树自动机。

Result: 这种方法被应用于训练有Dyck文法的变换器和设计成超出边界行为的合成目标，证明了其有效性。

Conclusion: 本研究提出了一种新的方法来学习神经语言模型中的可见推进文法，并成功地将学习范围扩展到了目标的行为之外。
