<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型在计划阶段消耗大量时间，预测的轨迹成本不总是与实际控制结果一致，存在长规划时间和短规划时间的计划失衡。

Method: WARP-JEPA采用了一种新的层次化计划框架，利用预训练的多个候选轨迹提议者，替换在线梯度优化进行推理。

Result: 在四个基准测试上，WARP-JEPA使长周期任务的推理速度快9.6-18.8倍（立方体任务上快2.9-3.0倍），成功控制提高了最多33.3百分点，而无需重新训练世界模型。

Conclusion: WARP-JEPA通过消除在线梯度优化提升了模型的推理效率和控制性能，可以在保持世界模型不变的情况下达到更好的控制效果。

Abstract: Hierarchical Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (H-JEPA) enable long-horizon visual control but rely on costly test-time gradient descent for planning. Our analysis reveals that iterative optimization consumes up to 97.7% of episode runtime and that low predicted rollout costs do not necessarily translate into successful control. We further identify a planning-horizon asymmetry between long-horizon top-level composition and short two-step subordinate planning. To address these challenges, we propose WARP-JEPA, a hierarchical amortized planning framework that replaces online gradient optimization with learned multi-candidate trajectory proposers while keeping the world models frozen. WARP-JEPA combines a lightweight world-model-in-the-loop causal Transformer at the top level with parallel residual MLPs at subordinate levels. The proposers are trained using model-based rollout costs and best-of-K behavior cloning, enabling efficient candidate selection without test-time gradient optimization. Across 30 frozen H-JEPA models on four benchmarks, WARP-JEPA achieves 9.6-18.8x faster episode inference on long-horizon tasks (2.9-3.0x on Cube) and improves task success by up to 33.3 percentage points. These results demonstrate that amortized planning can substantially improve both inference efficiency and control performance without retraining the world models. Code is available at https://github.com/hideinsewer/WARP-JEPA.

</details>


### [448] [ATHENA: Hypergraph-Based Learning for Toddler Autism Classification from Eye-Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10818)
*Quang-Anh N. D.,Duc Pham Minh,Thao Pham Phuong,Minh-Anh Nguyen,Thuy Linh Nguyen Thi,Hung Ha Manh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种用于自闭症谱系障碍（ASD） toddlers 分类的架构，该架构利用眼动追踪数据进行早起和精准检测。模型通过FMMix增强特征学习能力，使用ATHENA方法捕捉复杂特征关系。模型在两个数据集上取得了99.80%和99.86%的AUC得分，以及高水平的准确率、敏感性和特异性，显示出超越现有方法的性能，表明了其在临床 ASD 筛选中的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着对自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）早期检测需求的增长，本研究开发了一种旨在利用眼动追踪数据进行婴幼儿 ASD 分类的新型架构。这项研究填补了现有方法在精度和准确率上的不足，以便实现更早、更精准的诊断。

Method: 研究人员提出了一种结合FMMix（特征层次增强技术）和ATHENA（自适应超图框架）的架构。FMMix 提升了模型的特征学习能力，而ATHENA 则允许进行复杂特征关系的捕捉。

Result: 该研究在两个数据集上进行了评估，结果显示出卓越的性能，AUC达99.80%和99.86%，准确率为98.45%和98.56%，敏感性为98.01%和98.10%，特异性为98.74%和99.02%。

Conclusion: 研究成果表明该模型在识别与 ASD 相关的微妙眼动模式方面具有优越性，远超现有方法。未来的工作将集中在更广泛人群的应用验证和多模态数据集成上，以进一步提高诊断准确性。

Abstract: In this work we proposed a architecture designed for the classification of ASD in toddlers using eye-tracking data, addressing the critical need for early and precise detection. The proposed model incorporates FMMix, a feature-level augmentation technique that bolsters the model's learning capacity, and in this work we proposed the ATHENA, which captures intricate feature relationships via an adaptive hypergraph framework. Evaluated on two datasets dataset of gaze coordinates-the model achieves state-of-the-art performance, with AUC scores of 99.80% and 99.86%, respectively. It also exhibits high accuracy of 98.45% and 98.56%, sensitivity 98.01% and 98.10%, and specificity 98.74% and 99.02%, respectively. Demonstrating its superior ability to identify subtle gaze patterns associated with ASD, these results significantly surpass existing methods, highlighting the model's potential for clinical ASD screening. Future efforts will focus on validation across broader populations and integration with multi-modal data to further refine diagnostic accuracy.

</details>


### [449] [Multimodal Models Can See, But Can They Think? A Study of Turkish Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10831)
*Berke Bunyamin Sule,Yavuz Selim Aygan,Ahmed Zeer,Elif Ince,Ali Mert Temizsoy,Ozgur Agar,Himmet Toprak Kesgin,Muzaffer Kaan Yuce,Mehmet Fatih Amasyali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究分析了视觉语言模型在高阶认知任务中的表现，发现模型在找到潜在规则和保持中间步骤方面仍存在问题，这些模型往往在最终答案准确性上表现出更稳定的推理，但SFT方法可能导致模型崩溃，研究强调现有VLMs在抽象视觉推理方面仍然存在局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于探究当前视觉语言模型在处理高阶认知任务时存在的不足，特别是它们在发现潜在规则和保持中间步骤上的局限。

Method: 该研究使用多语言评估框架，包括BİLSEM、MM-IQ、Visual Puzzles和PuzzleVQA数据集来评估各种数据混合策略和监督微调（SFT）方法。研究采用LLM-as-a-Judge方法评估推理质量，超越最终答案准确性。

Result: 研究结果表明，基础模型在推理稳定性上通常优于微调模型。同时，研究发现SFT可能导致模型崩溃，表现为无限文本循环或空输出。

Conclusion: 研究结论指出，当前视觉语言模型在处理抽象视觉推理任务方面仍然存在局限，需要进一步改进以解决这一问题。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models have had massive leaps in recent years. Yet, when tested on high-level cognitive tasks like pattern completion, abstract logic, and relational reasoning, they still fall short. This limitation stems from the models' lack of ability to find out underlying rules and maintain constant intermediate steps, rather than merely deciding on the correct option. To research these shortcomings, this study analyzes visual reasoning performance throughout a multilingual evaluation framework encompassing the BİLSEM, MM-IQ, Visual Puzzles, and PuzzleVQA datasets. We evaluate various data mixing strategies and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) methods. We observed that a correct answer does not always mean the reasoning chain is valid. Because of this, we adopt an LLM-as-a-Judge approach to assess the quality of reasoning beyond final answer accuracy. Our experimental results reveal that baseline models often exhibit more stable reasoning compared to fine-tuned counterparts. Most importantly, we observe that SFT can lead to model collapse, manifesting as infinite text loops or empty outputs. The study concludes that current VLMs still struggle with abstract visual reasoning.

</details>


### [450] [A Gamified Framework for Conflict-Driven Design: Discovering Strategies for Collaborative Resilience with Multi-Agent Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10841)
*Jin Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）来模拟具有冲突目标的多方在城市设计中的资源分配，提出了改善城市韧性的策略，并通过数字棋盘游戏展示了学习政策的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究针对城市韧性建设中的多方冲突目标，试图通过提供一种协调机制来促进城市资源的有效分配和可持续发展。

Method: 研究采用多智能体强化学习（MARL）方法进行学习策略的训练，并在不同规模和条件下模拟多方资源配置过程。

Result: 结果显示，在4x4和8x8棋盘上，学习的策略取得了接近模拟退火基准的得分；在更大的12x12棋盘上，在历史地图基础上的培训策略实现了显著的总分提升，证明了在复杂环境下的适应性。

Conclusion: 研究提出的方法为参与式城市规划提供了试验平台，有助于探索适应性、可持续性、洪水防护和绿化等与活力、密度之间的权衡问题。

Abstract: Conflicting stakeholder objectives make it difficult to coordinate investments in urban resilience. We model conflict-driven urban design as a non-zero-sum digital board game in which stakeholder agents allocate scarce resources and balance individual payoffs against shared urban development and resilience objectives. We use multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to train policies and examine their behavior across three settings. On a 4 x 4 board, learned policies reach about 84% of the total return found by a simulated annealing benchmark. On an 8 x 8 board with spatial and resource constraints, trained agents favor projects that improve resilience in self-play. In a 12 x 12 simulation initialized from historical maps of Tatsumi, Tokyo, trained agents achieve a mean total score of 452.1, compared with 357.3 for a random-policy baseline across 10,000 simulation runs. Gains in adaptability, sustainability, flood resistance, and greenery come with reductions in vitality and density. A human-in-the-loop interface supports replay and lets participants take over stakeholder decisions, providing a testbed for exploring these trade-offs in participatory urban planning.

</details>


### [451] [Factor Rank: A Canonical Algebraic Generalization of Tree Decision Diagrams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10842)
*Alexis de Colnet,Stefan Szeider*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究引入了代数树决策图（ATDD），通过变量树（vtrees）切矩阵的秩代替TDD中的子函数计数，从而提供了比TDD更强的紧凑性和更广泛的适用性，同时保持了严格同一性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的有序二叉变量子树表示（OBDD）依赖于固定的变量顺序，而TDD通过vtrees进行推广，但子函数的计数忽略了线性结构。ATDD通过使用切矩阵的秩来替代计数，解决了这一缺点。

Method: 研究团队首先定义了ATDD的概念，并展示了如何将TDD转换为ATDD，同时保持相同的最大秩（即宽度）。此外，他们验证了ATDD的严格同一性和高效计算特性，包括局部验证性和多项式时间的模型计数。

Result: 研究发现，ATDD不仅比TDD更为紧凑，还比结构化的确定性DNNF更有优势。ATDD是第一个基于秩表示形式的严格同一形式，适用于任意vtrees。关键成果是可以在不损失严格同一性的前提下，将TDD转换为ATDD。

Conclusion: ATDD提供了更高效的布尔函数表示，比之前的方法更为紧凑。同时，这种转化过程是输出多项式时间的，从计算学角度来看是稳定的。

Abstract: Tree decision diagrams (TDDs), recently introduced by Capelli et al. (SAT 2026), are representations of Boolean functions. They generalize OBDDs by replacing variable orders with vtrees. The width of a TDD counts the distinct subfunctions across each vtree cut. Counting subfunctions is blind to linear structure. We introduce algebraic tree decision diagrams (ATDDs) by replacing this count with the rank of the cut matrix. The maximum of these ranks over all cuts, the factor rank, is exactly the width of the ATDD. Every TDD can be converted into an ATDD of no greater width. An ATDD is a tree tensor network in canonical form. ATDDs are exponentially more succinct than TDDs, and quasi-polynomially more succinct than structured deterministic DNNFs. Our main result is that this gain in succinctness does not cost canonicity. ATDDs are the first strict canonical form for a rank-based representation over arbitrary vtrees. For each function and vtree there is exactly one ATDD, over the rationals and without any genericity assumption. The canonicity admits a local characterization. Whether a tree tensor network is the ATDD of the Boolean function it computes can be checked in polynomial time from its tensors alone. Equivalence checking becomes a test of syntactic equality. The operation set includes polynomial-time model counting, weighted model counting, and a test whether a tree tensor network represents a Boolean function.
  Capelli et al. asked for the complexity of changing the vtree of a TDD and suggested local vtree changes. We answer the question. After a rotation of the vtree at one node, the new ATDD differs from the old one in two tensors only. Vtree change runs in output-polynomial time both for TDDs and for ATDDs.
  We formalize and verify our core results in Lean. We provide a prototype implementation of TDD and ATDD compilers as a first empirical validation.

</details>


### [452] [What Broke & Why: Practical Lessons from Reinforcement Learning Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10844)
*Luv Verma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本书对语言模型后训练的强化学习进行了实用的介绍，详细解析了奖励设计、评价、训练工具使用代理、常见故障的调试、可重复性、滚动引擎和硬件等内容，旨在帮助研究人员和实践者理解如何训练模型、识别问题并决定下一步尝试的内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本书的目标是为研究人员和实践者提供一个实用的指南，帮助他们更好地理解和应用后训练强化学习技术，特别是在语言模型的奖励设计、评价和调试方面。

Method: 本书首先介绍了后训练的基础知识，然后详细解释了每个训练程序的步骤，包括数学推理、搜索代理、模型稳定性、混合专家模型和软件工程任务。每个程序都展示了它们遇到的问题、作出的修改和吸取的经验教训。

Result: 通过详细的案例分析，书中揭示了后训练强化学习的成功与失败的原因，提供了优化奖励设计、评价标准和调试工具的具体建议，有助于提高强化学习在实际应用中的效果和可靠性。

Conclusion: 本书为语言模型的强化学习后训练提供了全面的指南，不仅介绍了基础理论，还展示了实践中的具体应用和改进建议，有助于研究人员和实践者更好地理解和应用这些技术。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important way to improve how language models reason, solve problems, and use tools. But getting it to work in practice is not always straightforward. Training can fail because a model receives no useful reward, learns to exploit the reward system, stops exploring, or appears to improve when the evaluation itself is misleading.
  In this book, we give a practical introduction to reinforcement learning post-training for language models, focusing on what works, what fails, and why. We begin with the foundations of post-training, explain GRPO and the training loop step by step, and then follow five training programs covering math reasoning, search agents, training stability, mixture-of-experts models, and software engineering tasks. Each program shows the problems encountered, the changes made, and the lessons learned.
  The book also examines what reinforcement learning actually changes inside a model. The remaining chapters provide a practical reference for reward design, evaluation, training tool-using agents, debugging common failures, reproducibility, rollout engines, and hardware. Written for researchers and practitioners working with open models, the book aims to help readers understand how to train models, recognize when something goes wrong, and decide what to try next.

</details>


### [453] [Inference for Reasoning Models: Practical Lessons from Evaluation and Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10845)
*Luv Verma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这篇论文探讨了语言模型运行时的多种因素如何影响评估结果和系统部署，涵盖了从模型评估到服务性能的各个方面，并提供了一系列实用建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于相同的模型在不同的评估和运行条件下可能会得到完全不同的评分，产生不同的答案或是导致不同的成本，因此本文旨在解释推理设置如何塑造我们报告的结果和部署的系统。

Method: 作者通过实验和详细阐述论证过程，讨论了评估、输出变化、服务性能等多个方面的原因，并提供了具体的指导。

Result: 详细分析了从评估到服务性能的各个方面的原因，提高了对语言模型推理结果的理解、可复现性和可信度。

Conclusion: 本文强调了记录推理运行、检查评估、估算容量及公平比较系统的重要性，为研究者和工程师提供了一套实用指南。

Abstract: Running a language model involves more than its trained weights. The same model can receive very different benchmark scores, produce different answers, or cost more to serve depending on how it is evaluated and run. In one experiment in this book, changing only the maximum response length moved accuracy on a math benchmark from 0.08% to 93.18%.
  This book explains how inference settings shape the results we report and the systems we deploy. We begin with evaluation, including generation limits, answer extraction, scoring methods, and quantization. We then examine why outputs can change across batches, attention backends, and caching, even when sampling is disabled. The next chapters cover serving performance, including batching, memory capacity, latency, throughput, and cost. We also study structured outputs, tool calls, reasoning budgets, and long-context tasks, showing what these controls and benchmarks do and do not establish.
  The book concludes with practical guidance for recording inference runs, checking evaluations, estimating capacity, and comparing systems fairly. Written for researchers and engineers working with language models, it aims to make inference results easier to understand, reproduce, and trust.

</details>


### [454] [Polynomial Denoisers on the Image Manifold: Volterra Networks for Self-Contained Pixel Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10857)
*Siddharth Roheda,Rohit Chowdhury,Amit Satish Unde,Aniruddha Bala*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一个新的像素空间扩散模型架构，采用低秩维特拉层作为混合操作，不使用注意力机制、卷积、预训练组件或残差路径上的激活函数，在ImageNet数据集上与自包含像素空间扩散模型性能相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了提高自然图像建模的效率和效果，研究者探索了低维度流形和像素空间扩散模型在图像去噪中的应用。特别地，研究者关注到了传统的自注意力机制在处理图像像素数据时的局限性，在去噪任务上提出了使用维特拉层作为新混合操作的可能性。

Method: 该方法包括两部分：首先，使用瓶颈嵌入对原始图像块进行压缩；然后，通过一系列低阶维特拉层对嵌入后的图像块进行处理。每个维特拉层都是非线性的，能够直接实现多项式映射，从而在数据流形上提供更低的逼近误差率，而不是像传统的高维像素空间模型那样依赖于像素空间的维度。

Result: 实验结果显示，这种新的像素空间扩散架构在ImageNet 256x256和512x512数据集上，与自包含的像素空间扩散模型在参数和FLOP预算相同的情况下，具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 研究提出的维特拉层在混合操作上的使用，展示了在像素空间扩散模型中处理图像数据的新方法，并且在具体的数据集上证明了其有效性和优越性。

Abstract: Natural images are often conjectured to lie on a low-dimensional manifold within the high-dimensional pixel space. Recent work leverages this to build self-contained pixel-space diffusion models without specialized machinery or pretrained components. A plain Transformer on raw image patches suffices, provided it predicts the clean image rather than the noise and compresses each patch through an aggressive bottleneck. The mixing operator, however, has remained softmax attention, inherited from sequence modeling rather than derived from denoising. For Gaussian noise, the optimal denoiser admits a canonical expansion in polynomial functionals of the observation, the Wiener--Volterra series. We prove that softmax attention, and any normalized mixing rule (including linear attention), cannot realize any polynomial map beyond an affine one. In contrast, Volterra layers realize this class directly and, on a data manifold, achieve approximation rates governed by the manifold dimension rather than the ambient pixel dimension. We therefore propose the architecture these results prescribe; raw image patches passed through a bottleneck embedding, followed by cascaded low-rank Volterra layers, which carry no activation function because each layer is nonlinear in its own right. To our knowledge this is the first pixel-space diffusion architecture whose mixing operators are Volterra layers throughout, with no attention, no convolution, no pretrained components, and no activation function on the residual path. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$ and $512 \times 512$, the resulting model is competitive with self-contained pixel-space diffusion at matched parameter and FLOP budgets.

</details>


### [455] [Keeping LLM Agents on Procedure: Executable Finite-State Control for Long-Horizon Instruction Fidelity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10884)
*Yutao Sun,Haokun Li,Mingshuai Chen,Guanyan Li,Zhongyi Wang,Shengchao Qin,Jianwei Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这篇文章展示了通过引入可执行有限状态机（FSM），可以提高语言模型长期运行时的可靠性和有效性。FSM在工具调用、状态转换和代理结束时强制执行工作流状态，使得代理能够遵循既定的程序而不偏离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的自动化代理在长时间运行时可能会偏离既定的程序，本文旨在提供一种方法来确保长期运行的可靠性。

Method: 研究了一个可执行有限状态机（FSM），该FSM在工具调用、状态转换和代理结束时强制执行工作流状态。通过在SOP-Bench和SWE-bench等基准上进行注册实验来验证方法的有效性。

Result: 通过FSM改进后的代理在平均200个账户的SOP-Bench批次中正确并严格按照程序处理了139个账户，而最强基准模型仅处理了48个。此外，FSM使较小的代理模型能够承担更多的程序性工作。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，可靠的长期自动化不仅可以通过更强大的模型来实现，还可以通过增强执行控制来实现。

Abstract: Much of the automation handed to language-model agents is procedural: each step needs little intelligence, but a long unattended run must follow a skill or SOP stated once at the start. We show that agents drift from such procedures over long runs, and that restating the instructions or resuming a stopped agent only moves the drift to another shortcut. We study an executable finite-state machine (FSM) that keeps the workflow state outside the model's context and enforces it at three points: tool calls, state transitions and the end of the agent's turn. In a pre-registered experiment on 200-account SOP-Bench batches, Claude Haiku 4.5 with the FSM decided on average 139 accounts correctly and by the procedure, against 48 for the strongest baseline (95% CI of the difference [46, 130]), and kept this rate to the end; across three models, the gain tracked how much the plain agent drifted. Because the runtime, not the model, supplies this long-horizon reliability, the FSM can let small models carry procedural work: Haiku 4.5 with it averaged more such decisions than plain Claude Sonnet 4.6 at 38% of the cost. Analyses on SWE-bench Verified, $τ^2$-bench, and staged and cross-context workflows further suggest that reliable long-horizon automation can come from stronger execution control, not only stronger models.

</details>


### [456] [Approximate Recall, Approximate Forecasts: Recall as a Diagnostic for LLM Forecasting Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10891)
*Prashanth Bhaskara,Shubhaankar Gupta,Seojoon Yeon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个新的召回忠真度得分指标，用于研究内部知识的不精确性如何影响未来事件的预测能力。在已解决的历史市场中发现，围绕语义相似的过去事件的更高局部召回忠真度预测较低的预测误差，并预测与开盘市场价格的距离更小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前对于大型语言模型(LLMs)在面对具体事件细节丢失的情况下，其对未来事件的预测能力的影响缺乏研究。研究者通过引入新的召回忠真度得分来填补这一空白。

Method: 通过分析已解决的历史市场的预测数据，研究者探索了局部召回忠真度与预测误差之间的关系，特别考察了语义上相似的过去事件对预测能力和定价精度的影响。

Result: 研究发现，在已解决的历史市场中，围绕语义相似的过去事件具有较高局部召回忠真度的模型，其预测误差较低，并且预测的价格与开盘市场价格的距离更小。

Conclusion: 研究认为，虽然LLMs在处理具体事件细节方面存在不精确性，但它们在预测语义上相似的未来事件时表现出色。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit approximate recall: they retain coarse associations about past events while losing fidelity on specific details. Past research on LLMs has quantified different models' forecasting ability in real-world events using prediction markets, but has not studied how losing said fidelity impacts their forecasting abilities. For example: while an LLM correctly recalls that the answer to: ''Did Anna Sawai win the Best Drama Actress in the 76th Emmy Awards?'' is ''Yes,'' it incorrectly states the event date as September 22 rather than September 15. In this paper, we introduce a novel metric called the Recall Fidelity Score to study how imprecision in internalized knowledge propagates to forecasting capability on future events. On resolved historical markets, we find that higher local recall fidelity around semantically similar past events predicts lower forecasting error on resolved markets, and the same signal predicts smaller distance from open markets prices.

</details>


### [457] [Complementarity without ground truth?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10893)
*Andrea Ferrario,Alessandro Facchini,Federico Cabitza*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨了在缺乏准确真实标签的情况下，如何评估人类与人工智能的互补性，特别是在决策支持任务中，并提出了使用基于多准则决策分析框架的上下文依赖性适当性标签的评分方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对于人类与人工智能的互补性研究大多集中在预测任务上，但有更多任务关注于输出的适当性，这些评估依赖于多个评价维度，并且传统的实况标签可能并不适用。本文的工作旨在扩展人类与人工智能互补性的研究范围，以便更好地量化评估在缺乏真实标签的决策支持环境中二者的表现。

Method: 本文提出了一种两步评分方法，利用多准则决策分析框架生成上下文依赖性适当性标签，并将参考构建过程中的规范性选择明确化。同时，借鉴计算可靠主义的思路，识别出支持适当性标签构建的相关技术和科学因素。

Result: 本文方法允许在缺乏真实标签的决策支持任务中定量评估人类与人工智能的互补性，并扩展了人类与人工智能互补性的研究范围。

Conclusion: 本文的研究为在决策支持中的人类与人工智能互补性评估提供了一个新的方法和视角。

Abstract: Human-AI complementarity captures the idea that a human assisted by an AI system can outperform both the human and the AI acting alone. In prediction tasks, this improvement is assessed against ground truth labels produced through a reference construction procedure and intended to represent the state of affairs to be predicted. Many human-AI interactions, including those where medical AI provides treatment recommendations, however, concern tasks other than predicting what obtains. Their relevant output concerns adequacy relative to a practical goal and depends on several evaluative dimensions. In this work, we examine the ground truth dependence of complementarity and extend it to human-AI interactions where ground truth is not the appropriate reference. We show that tasks beyond prediction can still admit a reference construction procedure that generates adequacy labels. We develop a route for extending complementarity to such settings. It replaces ground truth labels with context-dependent adequacy labels generated through a two-step scoring methodology inspired by multi-criteria decision analysis frameworks in healthcare and it makes the normative choices underlying reference construction explicit. Because the construction of adequacy labels embeds evaluative choices, we draw methodological inspiration from computational reliabilism to identify technical, scientific, and social factors relevant to supporting their construction. Our approach expands the empirical study of human-AI complementarity beyond prediction tasks, enabling its quantitative evaluation in decision-support settings where ground truth is not the appropriate evaluative reference.

</details>


### [458] [How Short Is Too Short? Length-Conditional Calibration and Abstention for Detecting AI-Generated Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10901)
*Ritesh Janga,Justin Zhan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究了文本长度对基于分数的AI生成文本检测器的影响，并提供了一种基于长度分层的方法来调整阈值，确保误报率在各种长度下保持在预设水平。实验表明，这种方法在不同长度和不同检测器下都能有效控制误报率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的AI生成文本检测器通常针对较长的文本片段进行调校和验证，但许多实际案例中文本较短，本研究旨在探索短文本场景下检测器的表现。

Method: 通过理论分析（提供一段长文本的误报率随长度变化的解析公式），利用模拟数据验证公式准确性，并通过实际检测器在不同长度文本上的表现来校准阈值。

Result: 研究发现，对于10到200个词的文本片段，通过分层校准的方式可以使误报率维持在5%左右。不同检测器在不同长度上的表现差异显著，最佳表现的检测器在长文本长度时能达到59%的真正检出率，但在较短文本上表现不佳。

Conclusion: 研究提出了一种分层校准方法，能够在不同长度的文本上更稳定地控制误报率，特别适用于较短的文本片段。

Abstract: Detectors of AI-generated text are usually tuned and tested on passages of several hundred tokens, yet many real cases are short. We study score-based detection as a function of passage length. We give a closed form for how the false-positive rate of a threshold set on long text changes as length falls, and a formula for the number of tokens a detector needs to reach a target true-positive rate. We calibrate thresholds within length bins with conformal p-values, and we add a bin-level rule that abstains when the detector cannot be informative at that length. On synthetic scores the formulas agree with simulation, and binned calibration holds the false-positive rate at its nominal value at every length. On three zero-shot detectors (log-likelihood, log-rank, Binoculars), three corpora and two open-weight generators, binned calibration gives a mean false-positive rate of 5.0% in every detector-length cell from 10 to 200 tokens, averaged over 300 random document-level resplits. A single threshold set at 200 tokens gives 29% for Binoculars at 10 tokens and about 1% for log-likelihood, as the closed form predicts. No detector reaches an 80% true-positive rate, and the best, Binoculars at 200 tokens, reaches 59%, so the rule abstains in every cell at that floor and releases only the 200-token bins at floors of 0.3 and 0.5.

</details>


### [459] [Improving Analytic Constants via Interpretable AI-Guided Lean Proof Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10961)
*Rahul Saha,Alan Li,Anton Xue,Swarat Chaudhuri,Adam Klivans,Pravesh K. Kothari,Raghu Meka*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 介绍了一种可解释的框架，该框架利用AI辅助数学发现，通过改进中间引理的松弛部分，获得了Grothendieck常数和Korenblum常数的精确度提高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有证明通常包含中间引理中的松弛部分，这些部分可以通过不重构整个论证的方式进行收紧，从而改善数学常数的定量边界。

Method: 使用部分形式化的Lean蓝图表示证明，作为一种人类可读的依赖图，定义、引理和定理。AI代理通过迭代细化Lean代码来维持蓝图的依赖结构，从而使局部改进可以自动传播到验证的最终边界。

Result: 对于Grothendieck常数($oldsymbol K_G$)，获得$oldsymbol K_G 	ext{ 	extleq rac{oldsymbol	extpi}{2	ext*log(1+oldsymbol	extsqrt{2})} - 10^{-	ext{17}}$)，相比Krivine 1977年的上界有所改进。对于Korenblum常数($oldsymbol K_K$)，获得$oldsymbol K_K 	ext{ 	extgeq 0.356565$)，相比Wang 2025年的下界有所改进。

Conclusion: 通过部分形式化的证明和迭代式的AI代理优化，展示了数学发现的可解释潜力。

Abstract: AI agents are increasingly capable of discovering new mathematical results, yet their reasoning and generated proofs can be difficult to understand and verify. We introduce an interpretable framework for AI-guided mathematical discovery, focused on improving quantitative bounds on analytic constants. Our key insight is that existing proofs often contain slack in intermediate lemmas, which can be tightened without reconstructing the entire argument. To exploit this structure, we represent proofs as partially-formalized Lean blueprints: human-interpretable dependency graphs of definitions, lemmas, and theorems. An AI agent then iteratively refines the Lean code while preserving the blueprint's dependency structure, allowing local improvements to automatically propagate to a verified final bound. This interpretable structure allows humans to inspect the agent's refinements and understand how local improvements propagate to the final theorem. For Grothendieck's constant ($\mathcal{K}_G$), we obtain $$
  \mathcal{K}_G \leq
  \fracπ{2\log(1+\sqrt{2})} - 10^{-17}, $$ an explicit numerical improvement over Krivine's 1977 bound. For Korenblum's constant ($\mathcal{K}_K$), we obtain $$
  \mathcal{K}_K \geq 0.356565, $$ improving Wang's 2025 bound of $0.3554$. Our experiments demonstrate the potential of both partial formalization and iterative agentic refinement for interpretable mathematical discovery.

</details>


### [460] [Lightfoot: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Exact, Model-Free Document Deletion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11010)
*Uday Allu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Lightfoot 提出了一种基于图的检索增强生成系统，通过将每个实体、链接、事实和同义边作为每个段落提取的确定函数来构建图，从而减少了图构建和删除文档的成本，与 HippoRAG 2、LightRAG 和 fast-graphrag 相比，Lightfoot 在多个数据集上具有更低的图构建成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lightfoot 的动机在于减少基于图的检索增强生成系统的两个常见成本：图构建和从图中删除文档。

Method: Lightfoot 通过将图中的每个实体、链接、事实和同义边作为段落提取的确定函数来构建图，从而降低了构建和删除文档的模型调用次数。

Result: Lightfoot 在 MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA 和 HotpotQA 数据集上的图构建成本分别比 HippoRAG 2、LightRAG 和 fast-graphrag 低 26-31％、3-6 倍。此外，Lightfoot 在 MuSiQue 检索上表现优于 HippoRAG 2 和 HotpotQA 答案，但在 2WikiMultiHopQA 上表现较差。

Conclusion: Lightfoot 通过创新的方法显著降低了图构建和删除文档的成本，展示了其在多个数据集上的成本效益。

Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) improves multi-hop question answering, but deployed systems face two costs that research comparisons rarely measure: building the graph, and removing documents from it. We present Lightfoot, a GraphRAG system in which every entity, link, fact and synonym edge is a deterministic function of per-passage extractions carrying chunk-level provenance. Indexing makes one language-model call per passage, retrieval makes none, and deleting a document is a database operation with no model calls. On the full 11,402-passage MuSiQue corpus we verify that, after deleting 10% of the documents, the graph is identical to a fresh index of the surviving documents. We compare Lightfoot with HippoRAG 2, LightRAG and fast-graphrag under identical extraction, answer and embedding models on MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA. Lightfoot builds the cheapest index on all three datasets, 26-31% below HippoRAG 2 and 3-6x below LightRAG and fast-graphrag. Against HippoRAG 2 it is significantly better on MuSiQue retrieval (+2.8 points recall@5 and +4.3 recall@10 on a held-out split) and on HotpotQA answers (+7.7 points exact match), and significantly worse on 2WikiMultiHopQA (-3.9 recall@2, -8.4 F1). Deleting the same documents took LightRAG 2,187 model calls and 3.7 hours; fast-graphrag has no deletion path. Code and per-question results: https://github.com/udayallu-ml/Lightfoot-GraphRAG

</details>


### [461] [But It Was True When I Checked: Compiling SHOP-Style Method Preconditions into Partially-Ordered HTN Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11055)
*Harrison Oates*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文解决了经典HTN规划中关于方法前提条件的长期问题，通过仅使用两个额外的事实，将第一动作逻辑编译为标准部分有序HTN规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法前提条件的含义在两种不同的语义中有差异，导致编码和应用不便。

Method: 提出了一种编译方法，将需要前提条件的第一动作逻辑转换为标准部分有序HTN规划。

Result: 成功解决了编译问题，无需方法前提就能应用HDDL规划的方法。

Conclusion: 这项工作为HTN规划提供了一个更加灵活和通用的解决方案，解决了HTN规划社区长期存在的难题。

Abstract: Method preconditions specify when a method may be applied in hierarchical task network (HTN) planning, but their meaning differs under two established semantics. The SHOP planners, like the classical HTN formalism of Erol, Hendler and Nau, require the precondition to hold immediately before the method's first action. HDDL, the input language of the International Planning Competition's HTN track, instead introduces an auxiliary action to check it; under partial order, unrelated actions may invalidate the precondition before the method starts. HDDL's designers adopted this weaker semantics because the first-action reading could not easily be compiled. Subsequent work has repeatedly identified its compilation under partial order as an open question, with existing transformations limited to total order. We give a compilation of the first-action semantics into standard partially ordered HTN planning without method preconditions using only two additional facts, thereby resolving a longstanding question in the HTN planning community.

</details>


### [462] [GARP: Real-Time Generative Agents on Local Hardware in a Game Engine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11064)
*Piero Molino,Patrick John Chia,Federico Bianchi,Jonathan P. Chen,Paul Szerlip*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GARP平台实现了本地运行的实时生成型游戏角色，通过情绪系统、个性轴、需求和关系管理等增强游戏体验，同时采用优化策略确保模型推理与游戏互动无缝衔接。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了解决原演示中的云服务依赖问题，并提升游戏表现的质量，开发了一个能在本地硬件上运行的实时生成型游戏角色平台。

Method: 利用了一个3B参数的开放权重模型，并设计了情绪系统、个性轴、需求和关系系统，以及决策优化策略。

Result: GARP平台成功实现了本地运行的实时生成型游戏角色，并通过九场景评估中的25次顺利运行验证了其实用性。

Conclusion: GARP平台展示了在本地运行生成型游戏角色的可能性，并为未来的游戏设计和开发提供了新的思路和技术支持。

Abstract: Generative agents are game characters whose plans, conversations, and memories are written on the fly by a large language model (LLM). The original Generative Agents demonstration used cloud inference in a custom simulation. We present GARP, a platform for real-time generative agents inside Godot, and describe the Character Behavior System used in GARP 2. The complete loop runs on local hardware using a 3B-parameter open-weight model and no cloud service. Alongside the original planning, memory, and reflection, GARP gives each agent an emotion system driven by LLM appraisal, four graded personality axes drawn from the Big Five that set simulation parameters as well as prompt text, six needs whose urgency grows over time, and pairwise relationships updated after every conversation. The system narrows 50+ candidate actions to typically 3-8, constrains model responses with JSON schemas, and surfaces important memories in decision prompts. A layered optimization strategy (an adjustable game clock, decisions taken ahead of need, multi-tier caching, prompt compression, and fully asynchronous execution) keeps the game responsive while the model thinks. In a nine-scenario evaluation, 25 of 27 runs passed log-based checks. Both failures occurred in the birthday party scenario, where one guest omitted the event from their daily plan.

</details>


### [463] [When Are Nearby Experts Composable? Cross-Task Model Merging in Neural Thickets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11177)
*Suxin Ji,Hungtao Wan,Mingjun Liu,An Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了从共享检查点的微小随机扰动中生成具有不同任务专家的方法，提出了联合基相对保留的选择形式，利用质量约束谱选择方法，在多个实验条件下提高了严格联合成功率，并在部分模型上表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究的动机在于解决从共享检查点生成不同任务专家时存在的组合效果不佳的问题，通过精确的有限差分分解和任意小的正交反例说明了单纯基于近似和正交性选择专家的不足，旨在提出一个能够有效提升组合效果的专家选择方法。

Method: 研究方法包括精确有限差分解法和任意小正交反例分析，结合质量约束谱选择策略，设计了一个固定预算框架，包括跨任务筛选、分层配对几何、独立验证和基底回退，通过不同规模模型在多个检查点上的实验验证该方法的有效性。

Result: 在六个检查点、21个任务对和五个独立扰动池的实验中，与Top-1平均值相比，该方法在所有条件下均提高了严格联合成功率。对于至少1.5B参数的五种模型，匹配的仅质量和全球余弦相似度及谱排名分别达到49.1%，50.5%和53.1%的联合成功率，并且谱选择器在最差任务增益、较弱帕累托率和回归率方面表现最佳。平均最差任务增益为+0.61个百分点，同时17.1%的回归率和13.0%的回避率表明组合效果仍是条件性的。

Conclusion: 研究表明，通过质量约束谱选择的方法，能够更加有效地组合不同任务的专家，在联合保留方面取得显著的提升，在多个模型规模和检查点上优于其他方法。

Abstract: Random perturbations around a shared checkpoint can produce experts for distinct tasks, but shared origin does not ensure that their gains survive composition. We formulate expert-pair selection for joint base-relative retention, measured by strict joint success and worst-task gain with unconditional abstention accounting. An exact finite-difference decomposition and an arbitrarily small orthogonal counterexample show why proximity and orthogonality alone are insufficient. We instantiate this formulation with quality-constrained spectral selection, a fixed-budget framework combining cross-task screening, layerwise pair geometry, separate validation, and Base fallback. Across six checkpoints, 21 task pairs, and five independent perturbation pools, the procedure improves strict joint success over Top-1 averaging throughout and leads the four-method model-scale comparison on four of six checkpoints. For the five models with at least 1.5B parameters, matched quality-only, global-cosine, and spectral ranking attain 49.1%, 50.5%, and 53.1% joint success. Under this matched protocol, the spectral selector also yields the highest worst-task gain and Weak Pareto rate and the lowest regression rate. Mean worst-task gain reaches +0.61 percentage points, while 17.1% regression and 13.0% abstention show that composability remains conditional. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Thickets-Merge/.

</details>


### [464] [When Self-Consistency Hurts: The Hidden Cost of Majority Voting in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11201)
*Wanrong Yang,Lingfang Li,Jun Zhang,Dominik Wojtczak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究了小语言模型在特定范式下的自一致性（SC），表明可预测的闸门比固定自一致性更为有效，同时提供了一种可部署的近似方法来减少计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在小语言模型中应用自一致性，尽管在大型模型中广泛使用，但实际上由于每查询计算预算紧张，该技术并未被优化适用于小模型。本文旨在评估自一致性在小模型中的效果，并提出改进方案。

Method: 通过在Qwen-2.5-0.5B和Gemma-3-1B两个模型家族以及FP16、MLX-Q4（4位量化）下，针对GSM8K和MATH-500两个数学基准进行了实验。实验设计包括8种针对任务的试验和4种跨任务池的试验，每次试验使用200至400个样本，计算结果通过配对Bootstrap置信区间表示。

Result: 研究发现，一个基于每个提示的预测闸门比始终使用自一致性的方法具有更好的准确性和计算效率。此外，提出了一种近似方法，可以减少高达79%的自一致性计算成本，同时保留近似98%的准确性。

Conclusion: 研究得出了两种结论：一种是改进自一致性应用的方法，另一种是可以部署的近似方法，两者均通过实验证明了其有效性。

Abstract: We study prompted chain-of-thought (CoT) with self-consistency (SC), i.e. sampling N traces and plurality-voting, on small language models, a regime where per-query compute budgets are tight yet SC is commonly applied with a fixed sample budget inherited from large-model practice, regardless of instance difficulty. Across two model families (Qwen-2.5-0.5B, Gemma-3-1B) at FP16 and MLX-Q4 (4-bit quantisation in Apple's MLX framework), on GSM8K and MATH-500, we run 8 per-task and 4 task-pooled experiments at n=200-400 with 1,000x paired-bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs). Our first result is an upper bound: an oracle gate deciding per prompt whether to invoke SC reaches 109-174% of always-SC's accuracy at 23-30% of its compute in all 12/12 cases, so at N=5 always-SC is dominated everywhere on our grid. That margin is exactly the rate at which SC flips correct greedy answers to wrong, here 3-10.5% of prompts, which on Qwen-Q4 x MATH-500 exceeds the wrong-to-right rate and leaves always-SC 3 pt worse than always-greedy. Our second result is a deployable approximation: a gate over greedy-pass signals skips 45-99% of SC calls, with bootstrap CI half-widths under 5 pt, removing 36-79% of always-SC compute. Accuracy retention at those operating points has point estimates of 98.1-98.8%, which we report as point estimates because their CIs are wide (lower bounds 76-86%) over an SC accuracy of only 15-36%. The evidence covers N=5 on two <=1B families and two math benchmarks, which is the scope we claim. Code is available at https://github.com/heywanrong/SiftSC.

</details>


### [465] [LoMASA: A Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant with Confidence-Gated Delegation for B2B Quoting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11234)
*Yu Liu,Xingbang Du*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LoMASA 是一种无需培训的多智能体系统，可以自动处理销售报价中的多数决策，将销售员的干预减少至最少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了解决销售报价过程中由于客户需求变化、成本变动等原因导致的频繁重新协调问题，提出了一种无需培训的多智能体系统 LoMASA，以减少销售过程中的协调成本和时间。

Method: LoMASA 包含一个 35B 的混合专家模型和一个 27B 的密集模型。混合专家模型负责每次决策，根据答案选项的概率读取自信心；密集模型负责撰写客户回复和升级摘要，并在混合专家模型不确定性时被咨询。系统的代码计算每项价格、毛利和选项，并使用硬定价规则不可被覆盖。

Result: 在测试集中的 500 模拟回合共 1512 决策中，销售员只需要对其中的 19.5% 决策进行干预。38.0% 的决策能自动解决，中位处理时间为 2.67 秒；42.5% 决策会被硬规则升级至经理处理。系统在自动决策的准确性上与规则基线相当（0.894 VS 0.894），但承诺边际低于地板率较低（2.61% VS 4.53%），但额外增加了向经理升级的次数。密集模型在设计上极少改变决策。

Conclusion: LoMASA 显著减少了销售过程中的协调工作量，实现了决策的自动化处理，提高了决策的准确性和效率，但仍需要进一步优化以减少需要经理处理的决策次数。

Abstract: Frontline sales staff spend much of their day re-coordinating quotes after customers change quantities, ask for discounts or new payment terms, or costs move. We present LoMASA (Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant), a training-free multi-agent system that runs entirely on one desktop computer. A 35B mixture-of-experts model (System-1) makes each decision in a single forward pass and reads its confidence from the probabilities of the answer options. A 27B dense model (System-2) writes customer replies and escalation briefs and is consulted when System-1 is unsure. Code computes every price, margin and option, and hard pricing rules cannot be overridden. On a test split of 500 simulated episodes with 1512 decisions built from public supply-chain data, the salesperson has to decide only 19.5% of decisions: 38.0% are settled automatically, with a median latency of 2.67 seconds, and 42.5% are escalated to a manager by the hard rules. On the automatically settled decisions LoMASA is as accurate as a rule baseline (0.894 vs.\ 0.894) and makes fewer commitments whose margin later falls below the floor (2.61% vs 4.53%); the price is additional escalations to the manager. Option probabilities are well calibrated without any training, unlike confidence stated in words by the same model. We also report where the design does not help: the 27B model rarely changes a decision.

</details>


### [466] [Verify Before You Fetch: Reliable KV Cache Compression for LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11319)
*Devanshu Jha,Gaurav Kumar,Agniva Chowdhury,Kumar Krishna Agrawal,Aditya Desai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VerKV通过保留部分关键查询无关的标记以及完整KV缓存在CPU内存中，结合新颖的PoissonComp采样方法和KVFetch算法，实现了精确度受控的注意力计算，减少CPU到GPU的数据传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了解决在长上下文应用中，由于KV缓存超过GPU HBM容量导致的性能瓶颈，尤其是减少CPU到GPU的频繁数据传输，从而提高推理延迟。

Method: VerKV提出了一种混合方法，维护一个GPU上的紧凑集查询无关的重要标记和完整KV缓存的标记级草图，使用PoissonComp采样程序选择这些标记，并在推理时使用KVFetch算法来估算相对错误，如果满足指定的$(ε, δ)$容差，则无需访问主机内存，否则进行查询感知检索以获取更多标记，从而调整注意力计算。

Result: PoissonComp相比现有KV缓存压缩方法表现出优越性，在不同模型上（Qwen3-4B, Qwen3.5-9B, Ministral-3-8B）实现了接近密集性能（90-100%），同时减少了8-32倍的GPU内存占用，并保持了2-23%的CPU到GPU内存获取率，与每个生成标记相关的缓存大小相比。

Conclusion: VerKV通过在减少CPU到GPU数据传输的同时保证注意力计算的精确度，展示了在长上下文应用中提升大型语言模型性能的有效性。

Abstract: Long-context applications, long-lived agents, and multi-agent systems require large language models (LLMs) to process and retain extensive information. In these settings, the KV cache can exceed GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity, necessitating offloading to host memory, where CPU-to-GPU transfers can dominate inference latency. While KV cache compression can reduce data movement, query-agnostic compression that guarantees accurate attention for arbitrary queries is extremely challenging, if not impossible. We introduce VerKV, a hybrid approach that provides $(ε, δ)$ guarantees for approximating attention on any given query. VerKV maintains a compact set of query-agnostic pivotal tokens on the GPU, together with a token-level sketch of the full KV cache, while retaining the complete cache in CPU memory. We introduce a novel stochastic sampling procedure, PoissonComp, to select the pivotal tokens. At inference time, our proposed KVFetch algorithm uses the pivotal tokens and the sketch to estimate the relative error of the resulting attention computation. If the estimate satisfies a user-specified $(ε, δ)$ tolerance, inference proceeds without accessing host memory. Otherwise, VerKV performs query-aware retrieval to fetch additional tokens from the CPU, refining the attention computation to meet the required tolerance. Thus, VerKV enables attention with bounded approximation error while minimizing CPU-to-GPU transfers. We show that PoissonComp outperforms state-of-the-art approaches to KV cache compression. Combined with KVFetch, it achieves near-dense performance (90-100% of dense quality at 32K context length, averaged over RULER and LOFT), using Qwen3-4B, Qwen3.5-9B and Ministral-3-8B, while reducing the GPU memory footprint by 8-32x and keeping CPU-to-GPU memory fetches within 2-23% of the cache per generated token, depending on the model.

</details>


### [467] [Separation of Skilling Context for Standard Operating Procedure-based Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11348)
*Mitsuhiro Nakayama,Toshiaki Sota,Takehiko Yamaguchi,Michiaki Tatsubori*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种新的方法来解决标准操作程序（SOP）和情境知识（CK）之间的技能差距问题。通过将SOP和CK分开管理，并使用合同感知评估方法，实验结果显示自动化等效率从12%提高到58%，并且现有情境知识覆盖了79.5%的新自动化缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的LMM代理在从SOP生成可执行技能时，缺乏必要的隐含知识和实现细节，导致需要人工干预。SOP的知识随时间演进，人工干预不得不重复进行，这被称作SOP-skill drift问题。因此，研究提出了一个新的方法来解决这个问题。

Method: 研究提出了一个将SOP和情境知识分开管理的方法，并设计了一种合同感知的评估方法来区分真正的违例和通过情境知识解决的不同之处。通过使用Indeed的工作流程数据，并进行SOP修订干扰实验，评估了该方法的有效性。

Result: 本研究在单个LMM代理上测试了该方法，在八个Indeed衍生的工作流程中，自动化等效率从12%提高到58%。并且，以前提取的情境知识已经覆盖了79.5%新增的自动化缺口。

Conclusion: 该方法能有效提高自动化等效率，显著减少了人工干预的次数。

Abstract: Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are kept concise for human readability, so LLM agents that generate executable skills from them lack the tacit knowledge and implementation details needed for automation. Human intervention fills these gaps, but must be repeated as SOPs evolve---a problem we call \textit{SOP-skill drift}. We propose managing SOPs and Contextual Knowledge (CK) separately, together with a \textit{contract-aware} evaluation that distinguishes genuine violations from CK-resolved differences. On eight Indeed-derived workflows (single LLM), it raises the functional-equivalence rate from 12\% to 58\%. Under three SOP-revision perturbations, previously extracted CK already covers 79.5\% of newly introduced automation gaps.

</details>


### [468] [BiVerify: Closing the Loop Between Backward and Forward Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11368)
*Rui Zou,Xin Zhao,Mengqi Wei,Ji-Rong Wen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BiVerify是一个双向验证框架，通过先进行反向验证再进行正向验证，旨在提高复杂数学问题求解的准确性，并引入了共享的数学工具以分离逻辑推理和精确计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的大型语言模型在数学推理方面取得了显著进展，但仍难以在复杂问题上提供正确的解答，需引入更为可靠和动态的自纠错机制。

Method: BiVerify采用动态调度的双向验证策略。首先执行反向验证，筛选出符合原始约束的候选答案，然后进行正向验证，检查推理过程。根据验证结果调整方向、重置状态并重新验证直至双重验证均通过。

Result: 在五个具有挑战性的数学推理基准测试上，BiVerify使用 DeepSeek、GPT 和 Gemini 模型进行了系统评估，其平均准确率提高了13.5个百分点，对GPT的效果提升达到了31.2个百分点。

Conclusion: 对比单纯使用反向或正向验证方向，BiVerify的整体性能更优，表明结合双向验证策略能更有效地解决复杂数学推理问题。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning but still produce incorrect solutions to complex problems, indicating the need for more reliable self-correction mechanisms. Mathematical self-correction typically identifies errors through verification, which can proceed backward or forward. The two directions provide complementary verification capabilities. Backward verification checks a candidate answer against the original constraints, bypassing complex intermediate reasoning, but cannot ensure correct reasoning or objective completeness. Forward verification follows the problem conditions and current solution, enabling it to locate reasoning errors and assess objective completeness, but may overlook key constraints in complex solution chains. We propose BiVerify, a dynamically scheduled framework for bidirectional mathematical verification. BiVerify begins with backward verification to screen the answer against the original constraints, followed by forward verification of the reasoning process; subsequent direction switching, state resetting, and re-verification are governed by verification outcomes. Upon failure, the system revises the candidate or verification flow until the same candidate passes both directions. We also introduce shared mathematical tools that separate logical reasoning from precise computation. We systematically evaluate BiVerify on five challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks using multiple mainstream DeepSeek, GPT, and Gemini models. BiVerify exceeds the strongest representative public baseline evaluated in this work by 13.5 percentage points in average accuracy, with the margin reaching 31.2 percentage points on GPT. Further analysis shows that BiVerify's overall performance exceeds that of either verification direction alone.

</details>


### [469] [RealEmbedBench: Benchmarking LLMs on Real-World Application-Layer Embedded Software Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11469)
*Yujun Huang,Yuwei Zhang,Yi Zhou,Shanshan Wu,Xiang Chen,Lina Gong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RealEmbedBench 是一个涵盖 5142 个样本的基准，涉及嵌入式软件开发中的代码生成和补全、状态机建模和实现以及跨操作系统代码翻译三大任务。研究显示，不同语言模型在任务上的表现差异显著，并指出了模型在状态机翻译到可执行代码上的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究表明，大型语言模型（LLMs）在通用编码任务上表现出色，但在应用层嵌入式软件开发中的应用仍被广泛忽视。鉴于嵌入式软件开发的实际需求和挑战，研究人员提出了一套名为 RealEmbedBench 的基准测试，旨在评估 LLMs 针对嵌入式开发任务的表现。

Method: 研究人员针对嵌入式开发的实际需求，构建了一个名为 RealEmbedBench 的基准包含 5142 个样本数据，涉及三大任务。通过这三大任务对 6 个代表性 LLMs 进行了系统的测试。

Result: 研究结果展示了这些 LLMs 在各个任务上的实际表现，发现模型在任务上的表现差异显著，尤其是在状态机模型转译到可执行代码方面，表现尤为突出。特别是在跨操作系统翻译方向方面，Harmony 到 RT-Thread 的平均通过率为 0.1667，表现较差。

Conclusion: 研究建议开发者在使用 LLMs 进行代码生成和补全时应考虑局部代码上下文条件，并根据翻译方向选择合适的模型。此外，通过引入更多实际的嵌入式软件开发数据参与 LLM 的训练，可以缓解模型在状态机建模与生成可执行代码之间的差距。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform well on general coding tasks, but their capabilities in application-layer embedded software development remain underexplored. Existing embedded benchmarks primarily focus on hardware-in-the-loop validation in simulated environments. We introduce RealEmbedBench, a benchmark of 5,142 samples covering three application-layer tasks: code generation and completion, state machine modeling and implementation, and cross-OS code translation. We evaluate six representative LLMs and find substantial performance differences across tasks and models. Project context, especially the local code window, significantly affects code generation and completion. Models perform reasonably well at state machine modeling but struggle to translate these models into executable code. Cross-OS translation performance varies substantially by direction. Translation from Harmony to RT-Thread is particularly challenging, with an average pass rate of 0.1667. These findings suggest that developers should consider local code context when using LLMs for code generation and completion and select models according to the translation direction. They also motivate the use of more real-world state machine implementation data in LLM training to narrow the gap between modeling and executable code.

</details>


### [470] [GOPR-CAD: Graph-of-Operations Progressive Reasoning for CAD Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11470)
*Yitian Pang,Yifan Li,Xiaowei Yue,Li Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GOPR-CAD 提出了一种基于 Graph-of-Operations 进进步进推理的 Text-to-CAD 管道，通过分离语言模型和编译器，解决了现有 LLM 方法在生成长代码时协调几何、拓扑和尺寸约束的可靠性问题，显著提升了结构正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于语言模型的 Text-to-CAD 方法往往直接生成 CAD 程序，但在生成长代码并协调几何、拓扑和尺寸约束时，语言模型的表现不稳定。GOPR-CAD 旨在通过新的管道设计提高 CAD 构建的可靠性。

Method: GOPR-CAD 使用一个基于 Graph-of-Operations 的渐进步进推理框架，其中语言模型作为决策代理，逐步构建可执行的操作图，然后通过确定性的编译器将其转换为最终的 CAD 模型。

Result: GOPR-CAD 在 MHCAD 基准测试中达到了 82.7% 的结构正确性，并在外部分数的 CADPrompt 中达到了 87.2% 的结构正确性。

Conclusion: GOPR-CAD 在 Text-to-CAD 生成过程中引入了新的框架设计，能够更有效地处理关联的几何、拓扑和尺寸约束，提高了 CAD 模型的结构正确性。

Abstract: Generating accurate CAD models requires substantial engineering expertise and careful control of geometry, topology, and mechanical constraints. Text-to-CAD aims to simplify this process, but current LLM-based methods often generate CAD programs directly. Language models remain unreliable when producing long code while coordinating coupled geometric, topological, and dimensional constraints. Consequently, executable programs may still produce structurally incorrect models, which execution rate and rendered appearance may fail to reveal. To address these limitations, we propose GOPR-CAD, an agentic Text-to-CAD pipeline based on Graph-of-Operations Progressive Reasoning. A language model acts as a decision agent over encapsulated CAD operations and progressively constructs an executable operation graph, which a deterministic compiler converts into the final CAD model. This separation requires no additional training and supports different language models. To evaluate structural fidelity, we construct MHCAD, a benchmark of 300 standard mechanical part requirements derived from Machinery's Handbook. Their explicit structures enable reference-free STEP/B-rep evaluation. GOPR-CAD achieves 82.7% Structural Yield on MHCAD, and 87.2% Structural Yield on an external CADPrompt subset.

</details>


### [471] [DriveFoundry: Co-Evolving Data and Model for Efficient Closed-Loop Iteration in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11532)
*Ziyang Yao,Yuncheng Jiang,Fang Li,Haochen Liu,Shaoqing Xu,Wen Zhang,Xiangyang Chu,Zibin Guo,Jiale Hou,Chuang Wan,Jia Hua,Gengzhao Xiang,Xiaoran Luo,Chong He,Yuechen Luo,Junzhe Wang,Zhiyu Sun,Jun Zhang,Wei Li,Lei Li,Hongwei Xie,Bing Wang,Yuannan Shen,Jianwei Cui,Guang Chen,Hangjun Ye,Jingwei Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DriveFoundry 利用 Closed-loop 结构，通过因果数据精炼结合自适应推理，优化模型在严格运行时约束下的学习能力，特别是在处理稀有关键事件时，显著减少了模型迭代时间和标注错误，成功实现在多种模拟环境中的高性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自动驾驶决策模型在处理罕见的关键事件时，学习效率较低且稳定性差。因此，DriveFoundry 旨在通过更高效的数据和计算预算使用，提升迭代效率，并开发一种能够在严格运行时约束下运行的自适应推理框架。

Method: DriveFoundry 通过构建数据引擎和模型发动机，将因果数据优化和自适应推理相结合。数据引擎构建可追溯的场景候选记录，连接证据与决策要素以及候选轨迹与结果评估。模型引擎则使用共享的视觉语言骨干网络统一感知、因果、行动、世界和价值任务。
此外，DriveFoundry 还引入了块状隐状态重填机制，以任务块内证据和预测视觉结果连接起场景理解、规划和评估。通过学习计算价值头部，模型能够选择任务并根据预期收益和成本分配隐状态 token。

Result: 在测试中，驱动者基金会在物理AI上的9B模型取得了所有评估切分和时间范围中最低的ADE@1。在AlpaSim中，它不仅优于Alpamayo 1.5，而且实现了比34B Alpamayo 2 Super更低的近距离接触率和非道路行驶率，而进步和AlpaSim指标略有下降。对于0.8B变体，联合训练减少了约54%的最小ADE@6，而无需改变推理路径或token预算。自适应推理仅使用28%的token便达到了完整的推理性能。

Conclusion: DriveFoundry 通过综合因果数据优化和自适应推理，显著提升了模型处理稀有关键事件的能力，同时保持了高效的计算预算和严格运行时约束下的运行可行性。这一框架在多种评估环境中的表现优于现有模型，展示了其作为自动驾驶域学习和计算资源动态分配的有效性。

Abstract: A driving foundation model must learn reusable decision knowledge from rare critical events and apply it under strict runtime constraints. We introduce DriveFoundry, a closed-loop framework improving iteration efficiency under data and computation budgets by coupling structured causal data refinement with adaptive inference. The Data Engine builds traceable scene-candidate records linking scene evidence and factor-decision relations to candidate trajectories and outcome assessments. Candidate comparisons and counterfactual annotations clarify how scene factors affect behavioral feasibility and preference. Verified model failures guide VLM-assisted annotation and expert correction, refining training data and annotation systems. The model engine, Xiaomi-Drive-o1, unifies Perception, Causation, Action, World, and Value within a shared vision-language backbone to enable cross-task knowledge transfer. Block-wise latent refill passes candidate-specific evidence and predicted visual consequences between task blocks, connecting scene understanding, planning, and evaluation. A learned value-of-computation head selects tasks and allocates latent tokens based on expected benefit and cost, adapting inference to each decision. On PhysicalAI, the 9B model achieves the lowest ADE@1 across evaluated splits and horizons among tested models. In AlpaSim, it outperforms Alpamayo 1.5 across all metrics and achieves lower close-encounter and off-road rates than the 34B Alpamayo 2 Super, while trailing in progress and AlpaSim scores. For the 0.8B variant, joint training reduces 5 s minADE@6 by about 54% without altering the inference path or token budget. Adaptive inference matches full reasoning performance using only 28% of tokens. Real-vehicle tests confirm runtime feasibility, supporting a unified paradigm for learning from critical experience and dynamically allocating computation.

</details>


### [472] [Safeguarding Agentic AI in Radiology Workflows: A Multimodel Evaluation of Rule-based and Large Language Model-based Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11541)
*Semil Eminovic,Robin Schmidt,Bogdan Levita,Maximilian Lindholz,Tobias Penzkofer,Jawed Nawabi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究在四十八个放射学文档模拟场景中测试了六个大型语言模型代理，发现未经安全措施时错误发生率为7.3%-27.1%，实施规则后降至16.7%，加装本地运行的LLM检查器后进一步降至13.2%，但并未完全消除严重错误。对于含有误导信息的场景，几乎所有代理都会打开经过篡改的文档，且大部分阻止的操作未引发违规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在评估工具使用的大规模语言模型代理在模拟放射学记录中记录临床相关虚假或不支持信息的频率，并探讨不同的安全措施如何降低这些问题。

Method: 研究采用了一个仿真研究设计，包括48个由放射科医生审查的合成基准场景和43个误导性信息变体。六种不同模型的代理（Claude Sonnet 5.5、GPT-6.1-Sol、GLM-5.3、MiniMax M3、Gemma-4-31B、Qwen3.8-27B）分别在仅有权限、包含规则和规则加本地运行的LLM检查器的三种情况下完成了所有变体的任务。

Result: 结果显示，不采取任何安全措施，代理行为中有19.4%的高严重性违反。加入规则后这一比例降低至16.7%，而规则加上本地检查器的策略则降至13.2%。未发现不同模型之间存在显著差异。研究还发现，不论是否出现错误，几乎所有代理都会查看更改后的文档，大多数阻止的操作并未造成违规。

Conclusion: 研究结论指出分层的安全措施能够有效减少但无法完全防止严重错误的发生。对于包含误导信息的场景，代理行为更多反映的是对信息的误判而非未识别的问题。

Abstract: Purpose: To estimate how often tool-using large language model (LLM) agents record clinically relevant false or unsupported information in simulated radiology documentation and how much safeguards applied before each action reduce these errors.
  Materials and Methods: In this simulation study (October 2026), 48 synthetic, radiologist-reviewed base scenarios covered finding communication, tumor board preparation and follow-up management. Forty-three also had a misleading-information variant (91 variants). Six LLM agents (Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1-Sol, GLM-5.3, MiniMax M3, Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3.8-27B) completed each variant with permissions only, deterministic rules, and rules plus a locally run LLM checker (1638 episodes). The primary outcome was at least one executed high-severity violation per episode. Risk differences were estimated per agent at base-scenario level and, exploratorily, pooled across agents, with analyses of document access and blocks.
  Results: With permissions only, 7.3%-27.1% of episodes had a high-severity violation (pooled across agents, 19.4%). Pooled, it was 16.7% with rules (-2.8 percentage points; 95% CI: -6.1, 0.5) and 13.2% with rules plus the LLM checker (-6.2; 95% CI: -9.5, -3.0). Adding the LLM checker to rules changed it by -3.5 (95% CI: -6.3, -0.7). No difference between agents was detected (P = .43), and task success did not decrease detectably. In misleading variants, agents opened the altered document in 83% of episodes regardless of error, and 58% of erroneous statements cited it. Most blocked actions (64%-68%) would not have caused a violation and were returned for revision.
  Conclusion: Layered safeguards reduced but did not prevent high-severity errors. Errors after misleading information reflected misjudged rather than missed information.

</details>


### [473] [InfraRSI: Harnessing Recursive Self-Improvement for Training Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11558)
*InfraRSI Team,Yuchuan Tian,Haocheng Mei,Ye Yuan,Chao Xu,Boxun Li,Guohao Dai,Kai Han,Allen Chen,Yunhe Wang,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: InfraRSI 提供了一种新的框架，用于优化分布式大规模语言模型（LLM）的训练，通过五阶段流程确保优化的可靠性，实现了高达 2.75 倍的速度提升和模型 FLOPs 利用率从 17.4% 提升至 30.0%，超越了现有的调优和编码代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的分布式 LLM 训练依赖于紧密耦合的启动设置、操作内核和通信调度，容易遇到内存超限、编译器冲突、测量抖动或静默数值漂移等问题。InfraRSI 旨在通过验证训练优化来解决这些问题。

Method: InfraRSI 采用了五阶段的工作流程：初始化锁定可编辑范围和固定任务合同，预防奖励作弊；医生阶段调整基线阶段并校准集群噪声；运行阶段协同优化启动旋钮和代码补丁，并重新验证顶级候选者，记录结果到跨硬件经验库；报告和应用审计源路径，跟踪失败试次的成本，并提交已推广的更改。

Result: InfraRSI 在四种单节点和多节点密集型和混合专家（MoE）LLM 工作量中实现了 2.75 倍的速度提升，并将模型 FLOPs 利用率从 17.4% 提升至 30.0%，并且能够跨 GPU 转移经验，提升了基础设施效率。

Conclusion: InfraRSI 形成了一个两层的递归自我改进循环，即在运行中在线修订先验并在集群之间提经验，从而促进基础模型的扩展。

Abstract: While Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) accelerates isolated algorithm and kernel synthesis, distributed LLM training depends on tightly coupled launch settings, operator kernels, and communication schedules, where single edits often hit out-of-memory (OOM) boundaries, compiler conflicts, measurement jitter, or silent numerical drift. We present InfraRSI, the agentic harness that turns open-ended human commands into verified training optimizations via a five-stage workflow: init locks editable scope and a fixed task contract over workload, loss, and timing invariants to prevent reward hacking, doctor profiles baseline phases and calibrates cluster noise, run co-optimizes launch knobs and code patches before re-verifying top candidates against the baseline and logging findings to a cross-hardware experience bank, and report and apply audit source paths, track failed-trial costs, and commit promoted changes. Rather than stepping greedily from a single incumbent, InfraRSI initializes from diverse experience-seeded configurations and fits global execution-time and censored peak-memory models across all trials, including OOMs. Using these models, it prices per-setting memory costs, revises miscalibrated LLM priors from live runs, and pairs memory-hungry optimizations with memory savers and verified code patches. Across four single- and multi-node dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM workloads, InfraRSI achieves a speedup of up to $2.75\times$ and lifts mean Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) from $17.4\%$ to $30.0\%$, outperforming existing tuners and coding agents while transferring experience across GPUs. As it improves training infrastructure efficiency, InfraRSI forms a two-level Recursive Self-Improvement loop---revising priors online within runs and distilling experience across clusters---to push foundation model scaling.

</details>


### [474] [LiveAsset: Learning Intent Assets from Corrective Interactions for Agent Runtime Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11560)
*Guanming Liu,Weihang Wang,Peng Zhang,Meng Wu,Kainan Tu,Jiahao Liu,Yu Zhang,Liuxin Zhang,Qianying Wang,Ning Gu,Tun Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LiveAsset 是一种可以从纠正性交互中学习可重用意图资产的工具，它可以实时控制代理执行，通过联合解析每个修正与其原始和修订结果来推断用户意图。LiveAsset 在这些基准测试中表现出色，优于基于记忆、技能和规则的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大型语言模型（LLM）代理针对用户未具体指定的目标和偏好进行多轮修正时，需要推断用户意图。然而，这些意图往往依赖于特定的上下文，这就带来了确定何时适用以及如何确保代理在此上下文中执行用户预期动作的挑战。LiveAsset 能够通过联合解析每次修正与其原始和修订结果来推断用户意图，学习并更新意图资产，确保代理在执行任务和评估回复可适用性时始终参考用户需求。

Method: LiveAsset 方法包括学习阶段和执行阶段。在学习阶段，模拟用户通过多轮纠正逐步揭示需求，从而获得可重用的意图资产；在执行阶段，LiveAsset 与代理的原始和修订结果进行联合解析，以推断用户意图，实时更新意图资产并进行任务执行。此外，LiveAsset 还提供了解释和评估机制，用于评估每个回复的适用性和代理在执行过程中是否满足未满足的需求。

Result: 通过在 π-Bench、PERMA、Vita 以及 PAST-Bench 和 SkillEvolBench 上进行的实验，LiveAsset 在满足通过纠正性交互学习到的需求方面表现优异，相较于基于记忆、技能和规则的基线方法，其性能有所提升。

Conclusion: LiveAsset 提供了一种有效的方法来实现代理执行的实时控制，并能够学习从纠正性互动中获得的可重用意图资产，从而更好地满足用户需求并在基准测试中取得良好表现。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents acting across web applications and online services often need multi-turn corrections to align their work with users' underspecified goals and preferences. In practice, users may identify problems in the current outcome without specifying the desired result, so learning user intentions requires interpreting each correction against the agent's preceding and revised outcomes. These expectations are often connected to a particular context, making it hard to know when they apply and how to ensure the agent later acts as the user expects. To this end, we propose LiveAsset, an intent harness that learns reusable intent assets from corrective interactions and uses them for runtime control of agent execution. LiveAsset jointly interprets each correction with the agent's original and revised results to infer user intent, incrementally updating the assets while preserving earlier requirements that remain applicable. The learned requirements guide agent execution from task entry and provide criteria for runtime verification, which uses the explanations to assess applicability before each reply is delivered and directs the agent to revise the result to address unmet requirements while preserving those already satisfied. Following a learning phase in which simulated users progressively reveal requirements through multi-turn corrections, we evaluate LiveAsset using same-task replay of the original requests on π-Bench, PERMA, and Vita and cross-task transfer on PAST-Bench and SkillEvolBench. Experiments show that LiveAsset better fulfills requirements learned from corrective interactions and improves performance on these benchmarks compared with memory, skill, and rule-based harness baselines. Code is available at github.com/landian60/LiveAsset.

</details>


### [475] [FinCutBench: A Continually Updated Benchmark for Measuring the Temporal Boundaries of LLM Financial Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11588)
*Siyuan Li,Ke Wan,Boyong Hou,Yujie Deng,Zixuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 引入了一个名为FinCutBench的持续更新的月度金融知识基准，用来测量固定模型的金融知识随日历时间的扩展情况。分析结果显示，在边界日期之后，某些模型在美资资产排名和收益回忆方面的相对下降幅度明显，而中国市场上的排名估计则在不同模型间有所差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为解决由于模型参数利用了披露时间晚于回测日期的金融事实而引入的参数前瞻偏差问题，提出了FinCutBench基准。

Method: 构造了一个包含9,000多个中英文四选一选择题的月度金融知识基准，覆盖中国和美国市场以及四种金融信息类别。通过公开披露月份来构建月度知识配置文件，并通过衰退测试和节检查后定义FinCut边界。

Result: 发现某些模型在美国资产排名和收益回忆方面存在明显相对下降；中国市场的排名估计在不同模型间差异较大，且所有八项披露期配对预测误差比较的未调整p值均超过0.10。

Conclusion: FinCut边界为点时金融评估中的参数知识的时间范围提供了实证参考，支持评估窗口的选择与结果解释。

Abstract: In financial backtesting and other point-in-time tasks, external inputs can be restricted by date, but model parameters may retain financial facts disclosed later, introducing parametric look-ahead bias. We introduce FinCutBench, a continually updated monthly financial knowledge benchmark for measuring how far a fixed model's financial knowledge extends over calendar time. The current dataset contains 9,000 Chinese and English four-option multiple-choice questions from January 2023 to September 2026, covering Chinese and U.S. markets and four categories of financial information. We construct monthly knowledge profiles using the approximate months in which the tested facts became public. After a profile passes the decline test and knot checks, we define the FinCut Boundary as the first month when the fitted profile reaches its lower level, and report the stability of the estimated date under resampling. Boundary dates and localization precision vary across models. Using the independently measured Transition Start and Boundary as fixed references for downstream sample grouping, we find clear relative declines after the Boundary in U.S. asset ranking and earnings recall for some models, while Chinese-market ranking estimates vary across models and all eight disclosure-period-paired forecast-error comparisons have unadjusted $p$ values above 0.10. The FinCut Boundary thus provides an empirical reference for the temporal scope of parametric knowledge in point-in-time financial evaluation, supporting evaluation-window selection and result interpretation.

</details>


### [476] [Weight-Space Programming of Policies and Their Verification via Model Checking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11604)
*Dennis Gross*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究结合了权重空间编程与概率模型检查，通过大型语言模型（LLMs）直接写出小神经网络的权重，并利用模型检查确保其满足指定要求。结果显示，此方法能够直接获得最优策略，即使从未见过的任务也能实现跨任务推广。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的权重学习方法通常需要通过梯度下降迭代进行优化，但可能存在最终性能未达预期的风险。通过LLM直接编程权重并结合模型检查，可以在无需迭代的过程中确保策略满足特定要求，还能实现泛化。

Method: 该研究采用了大型语言模型生成神经网络权重、概率模型检查验证权重满足特定逻辑要求的策略，并通过优化修改权重直至满足要求。这种方法特别地将语言生成与形式验证相结合。

Result: 实验表明，利用这种方法，研究人员能在多任务环境中直接产生满足要求的最优策略，无需使用数据集训练或仅需少量训练。此外，部分策略即使从未见过也能够推广至新任务，并且在某些场景下，即使模型检查发现错误，通过一次验证反馈也能修复问题。

Conclusion: 该研究展示了一种新的机器学习方法，通过结合大型语言模型和概率模型检查，在序列决策任务中生成和验证符合特定要求的策略，展现了显著的泛化能力和高的执行质量。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can write the weights of small neural networks directly, without gradient descent. This weight-space programming creates policies for sequential decision-making from a task description alone, but nothing guarantees that a written policy behaves as intended. We combine weight-space programming with probabilistic model checking. Given an environment modeled as a Markov decision process and a requirement in probabilistic computation tree logic (PCTL), an LLM writes all weights of a policy network, optionally repairs them on a dataset of optimal actions, and receives model-checking feedback until the requirement holds or a round limit is reached. The model checker Storm computes, rather than estimates from simulations, the probability that the policy satisfies the requirement, so every returned policy is verified. With two LLMs on three environments, the created policy of each of the 18 runs attains the optimal probability, before any dataset or model-checking feedback. Four of six policies programmed for two transporter jobs also complete three jobs with probability 1, so they generalize to a task that the LLM never saw. The pipeline also programs a policy that satisfies a complex safety requirement expressed with the PCTL until operator in all six runs. In one of them, dataset repair raised the accuracy to 98.4\% but broke the requirement, and one round of model-checking feedback restored it.

</details>


### [477] [ODSA: Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11621)
*Macardle Meng,Haomin Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ODSA 提高了语言模型回答的准确性，特别是在没有测试时缩放的情况下，通过一个 orchestrator LLM 指导无状态工人执行不同的操作，实现了显著的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时缩放方法要么按顺序处理，要么并行生成多个解决方案并选择最优。ODSA 架构旨在提高这种处理的效率和灵活性。

Method: ODSA 使用一个 orchestrator LLM 提供不同的操作，包括发现新解、比较现有解以构建更好的解，以及接受或验证解。它不直接解决给定的问题，而是分配计算资源，从先前的结果中进行学习，并做出基于所有尝试决策。

Result: 在 Humanity's Last Exam 数据集上，使用 ODSA 后，三个模型的准确率均提升了 4.7 至 18.0 个百分点。在 LiveCodeBench 数据集上，准确率虽然提升幅度较小，但也分别提升了 0.6 至 14.0 个百分点。

Conclusion: ODSA 提供了一种新的测试时缩放方法，能够有效提升语言模型的性能，特别是在复杂任务处理中表现出色。

Abstract: Test-time scaling improves the accuracy of a language model's answers by spending more computation at inference time. Established methods do so either sequentially, revising a single solution over several passes, or in parallel, generating several independent solutions and selecting among them. We present ODSA (Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation), an LLM-directed scaling framework in which an orchestrator LLM is given existing test-time scaling methods as actions --- discovery of a new independent solution, comparison of existing solutions to build a better one, and acceptance of a proposed answer, which triggers its verification --- and directs stateless workers to carry them out. The orchestrator does not solve the problem itself: it allocates computation, feeds the results of earlier actions into later ones, and takes every action from a single context, so that each decision is informed by everything tried before. On Humanity's Last Exam, ODSA improves accuracy by 4.7 to 18.0 points across three models over a single direct call to the model with no test-time scaling. On LiveCodeBench, where a single direct call already solves most problems, it improves accuracy by 0.6 to 14.0 points.

</details>


### [478] [Perturbation Profiles of Scanpath Classifiers: What Reading, Code-Comprehension and Video Decoders Are Sensitive To](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11632)
*Saleh Mozaffari,Abolfazl Nadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种用于评估眼动跟踪描述符的关键性分析框架，通过一系列转换分析影响描述符性能的关键因素，并揭示不同任务中描述符对特定属性的依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对眼动跟踪描述符在任务中的有效性评估时，往往不清楚具体是哪些因素导致了性能的差异。该研究旨在通过基于扰动的分析方法来提高对这些描述符的理解，并揭示描述符对数据特性变化的敏感性。

Method: 研究通过设计五种转换来破坏描述符的特定属性，观察这些转换对描述符分类性能的影响，并根据分类性能的变化来量化不同属性对描述符的重要性。同时，研究还通过参与者重采样的方式来保证分析的可靠性。

Result: 通过对阅读、程序理解以及视频/游戏观看等任务中的七个描述符进行评估，研究发现了不同任务中描述符对特定属性的依赖性。研究结果表明，扰乱注视顺序可以显著提高基于平均眼跳幅度的描述符的表现，而某些描述符对眼动的顺序和局部抖动具有更高的敏感性。

Conclusion: 研究提出的分析框架可以帮助发现描述符对不同属性的敏感性，从而提高眼动跟踪技术在不同任务中的应用效果。未来工作可以进一步探索更多类型的转换以及它们对描述符性能的影响，以期更好地理解描述符的性质及其适用性。

Abstract: When a scanpath descriptor discriminates a task, it is rarely clear what the discrimination rests on. We propose a perturbation profile for trial-level descriptors. Five transformations each destroy one stated property while preserving a listed set of invariants: fixation order, duration-position coupling, the duration distribution, orientation and handedness, and fine spatial structure. The classifier is refit, and the drop in participant-held-out AUC is the pipeline's sensitivity to that property. Because refitting lets the learner use redundant information, this describes the refitted pipeline, not what a fitted classifier used. Intervals come from a participant bootstrap that refits; in simulations at the sample sizes analysed, where the target was zero they excluded zero at a pooled rate of at most 2.5%, and they covered the target in 99.6% of 2720 cases. We profiled seven descriptors on twelve binary problems from three public datasets: reading (SB-SAT, 95 participants), program comprehension (EMIP, up to 159) and video and game viewing (GazeBase, 60). Permuting fixation order raised the AUC of a descriptor built on mean saccade amplitude on three problems (by up to 0.23), because permutation turns amplitude into a measure of spatial spread. A "comprehension" contrast that pooled two programs reached AUC 0.70 with a spread-only baseline and fell to 0.47 within one program: the profile located the confound in stimulus layout. On native versus non-native readers, recurrence was sensitive to order and to jitter at the scale of text lines but not of characters, while a two-feature duration and amplitude descriptor reached the same AUC (0.65). A graph descriptor built on the code's tokens was the strongest non-baseline descriptor on the program contrast (0.78; 0.87 with boosted trees). The interpreted results held under longer runs and three seeds; under a second learner 15 of 16 kept t

</details>


### [479] [An Interpretable Fuzzy Tree for Turbofan Remaining Useful Life with an Auditable Per-Component Diagnostic Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11633)
*Hugo Henry,Bharadwaj Dogga,Scott Philips,Kelly Cohen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种可解释的遗传模糊树模型，用于从涡扇发动机巡航条件的传感器平均值预测剩余使用寿命(RUL)，并暴露了一个按组件划分的诊断层，每一层都可以逐规则检查。模型采用13个巡航条件下的传感器平均值作为输入，训练分为几个阶段，首先是健康层拟合到物理目标并冻结，然后是在各组件上施加一种基于机队参考的模糊损伤映射，最后只优化融合层以最小化RUL的误差。该模型在测试数据上的性能表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于数据的RUL估计器虽然准确但不透明，其内部特征通常编码剩余寿命而非特定组件的状态。因此，本文试图提出一个可解释的遗传模糊树模型，不仅能够准确预测RUL，而且还能够提供对每个组件健康状态的清晰诊断。

Method: 本文提出的方法包括以下几个步骤：首先，通过对传感器平均值进行分层处理，模型将传感器测量值转化为对组件健康状况的评估；其次，模型将健康状况转化为一个受限的组件损伤模型；再次，它确定了不同组件的损伤关系以预测RUL；最后，通过分阶段训练，确保健康层保持不变，而RUL层进行优化。

Result: 该模型在未加序列模型的情况下达到了良好的性能，具体而言，在具有多种故障模式的子集测试中达到了8.44个循环周期的RMSE，并且在整个模式测试中达到了11.51的测试集误差，参数较少，且具有可验证的规则基础。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了一种新颖的方法，通过层次化的模型结构和分阶段训练来实现RUL的准确预测和组件诊断。该模型不仅能够有效预测涡扇发动机的RUL，还能够提供清晰的组件诊断结果，有助于实现对发动机状况的更精确和透明的监测。

Abstract: Data-driven remaining useful life (RUL) estimators for turbofan engines are accurate but opaque, and their internal features typically encode remaining life rather than any specific component's state. This paper presents an interpretable genetic fuzzy tree that predicts RUL from cruise-condition sensor means on N-CMAPSS while exposing a per-component diagnostic layer inspectable rule by rule. The tree follows the engine hierarchy: sensors to component health, then to bounded component damage, spool damage, and RUL, so each level answers a different maintenance question. Training is staged so the prognostic objective cannot reshape the diagnostic layers: health leaves are fitted to physical targets and frozen, a deterministic fuzzy damage map with fleet-referenced thresholds is imposed on each component, and only the aggregation is optimized for RUL. It consumes 13 cruise-mean scalars per cycle rather than a trajectory, which removes any sequence model. On the native split it reaches 8.44 cycles RMSE on the multi-fault subset and 11.51 across all modes with 333 free parameters, 411 total rules, 32 to 12,000 times fewer than compiled baselines. An exhaustive sensor search bounds which components are diagnosable under the tested cruise-mean design, and the rule base is structured to admit formal verification, which this study does not discharge.

</details>


### [480] [Optimizing Multi-Tier Intermediation in Programmatic Advertising: A DAG-Based Mechanism for Supply Path Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11651)
*Amelia Bădică,Costin Bădică*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究利用有向无环图（DAG）模型和混合整数线性规划（MILP），通过考虑可替代路径和基于百分比的费用结构，优化可追踪的程序化广告供应链，以实现纳什社会福利的最大化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前程序化广告供应链的不透明性导致效率损失，现有 heuristic 优化方法仅针对单条路径，未能优化整个网络的均衡。

Method: 采用 DAG 以及 MILP 方法，结合 OpenRTB SupplyChain 对象，定义多属性效用函数来优化广告生态系统。

Result: 提出了一种计算方法和实验框架来比较最优纳什社会福利与当前市场的非协调结果。

Conclusion: 研究改进了现有 SPO 方法，通过优化整个网络，提高了广告投放的效率和透明度。

Abstract: Digital programmatic advertising operates through complex, multi-hop supply chains. The opacity of these intermediary networks leads to significant efficiency losses, often referred to as the ``ad-tech tax.'' While current industry practices utilize heuristic Supply Path Optimization (SPO) to trim inefficient routes, they fail to optimize the equilibrium of the entire network. This paper extends previous work on Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) intermediation models by applying them to traceable programmatic supply chains mapped via the OpenRTB SupplyChain object. We introduce multi-attribute utility functions and Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) to account for substitutable routing (OR nodes) and percentage-based fee structures. Furthermore, we outline a computational methodology and experimental framework using public \texttt{schain} and \texttt{sellers.json} data to benchmark optimal Nash social welfare against current uncoordinated market outcomes.

</details>


### [481] [Inside the Trading Loop: Markets, Models, and Moves with LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11657)
*Renee Jia,Di Mu,Yao Yu,Tianrui Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该系统结合了大型语言模型分析师与动量驱动的投资组合构建和基于规则的执行，通过对冲基金的回报优于SPY和QQQ基准，但伴随着更大的最大回撤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建一个综合了自然语言理解和规则驱动的交易系统，旨在提高投资组合的回报率，克服单一方法的局限性。

Method: 系统利用自然语言模型生成结构化的公司新闻和宏观经济报告，这些报告由协调器用于设置股票权重和现金储备，通过与交易记录器的回放进行评估。

Result: 该系统的投资组合在指定日期内取得了34.5%的回报，高于同期的S&P 500 ETF SPY的14.4%，但最大回撤较大。在使用相同的评估或延迟到下一个评估时，重建的策略也超过了SPY和QQQ的基准。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，现金授权、选择性调用和响应合约的设计对投资组合的影响较为复杂，需要进一步优化，以实现更好的交易表现。

Abstract: We built a hybrid multi-agent trading system that combines large language model (LLM) analysts with momentum-based portfolio construction and rule-based execution. Company-news and macroeconomic agents return structured reports to a coordinator that sets stock weights and cash reserves. We evaluate the portfolio engine using its broker-recorded paper account, which operated with deterministic fallbacks, and compare LLM-enabled configurations through retrospective replays. From March 11 to August 28, 2026, the account returned 34.5%, compared with 14.4% for the S&P 500 fund SPY over the same dates. This raw return advantage came with a larger maximum drawdown. Reconstructed policies also finish above matched SPY and QQQ references when assessments are used in the same session or deferred to the next. Design comparisons examine cash authority, selective invocation, and response contracts. A constant-cash control gives a return estimate close to stance-based sizing, and shorter report contracts improve observed parsing but can change recommendations.

</details>


### [482] [Measuring Generative AI Content in Political Campaigns: Evidence of Rising Adoption and Non-Disclosure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11658)
*Anna-Maria Gueorguieva,Nic Weber*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过开发衡量标准，量化了竞选活动中生成式AI内容的使用情况，发现这类内容在模态上有所增加且未被披露，同时指出现任候选人产生的生成式AI内容少于挑战者，而受生成式AI披露或禁止法律影响的候选人在此类内容的产生上并没有显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为回应公众对生成式AI在政治竞选中的使用所引发的信任问题，研究了其使用情况及其影响。

Method: 研究开发了用于估计政治竞选使用生成式AI进行宣传的广度和形式的指标，并运用这些指标分析了2023至2025年间12,977位美国政治竞选候选人的网站、推特账户和邮件数据。

Result: 研究发现生成式AI内容的使用有所增加，但通常未被报告；现任候选人产生的生成式AI内容比挑战者少；不受AI内容披露或禁止法律影响的地区的候选人生成式AI内容的使用量并无显著差异。

Conclusion: 当前各州主要针对“实质性欺骗性”内容采用了政策工具，但在生成式AI更普遍的情况下，还需额外的政策机制来提升选举透明度，增强信任。

Abstract: The use of generative AI in political campaigns has drawn public concern and policy attention. Public concerns range from distrust of candidates to skepticism about the authenticity and accuracy of political advertising, including AI-generated images and video. Nearly half of U.S. states have enacted laws that prohibit, or require disclosure of, "materially deceptive" AI-generated content (AIGC) in elections to guard against these concerns. This study measures how candidates and their campaigns produce and circulate AIGC during an election cycle. We develop two measures that estimate not only wether campaigns use AIGC, but how much they produce (magnitude) and in what forms (modality). We apply these measures to a novel dataset of text and images from the campaign websites, X accounts, and emails of 12,977 candidates for U.S. political office from 2023 to 2025. We report three findings. First, detectable AIGC from campaigns increased significantly across modalities over the observation window, and campaigns that use AIGC frequently do not disclose it. Second, incumbents' campaigns produced significantly less AIGC than challengers' campaigns. Third, candidates in states with AIGC disclosure or prohibition laws do not produce measurably less AIGC than candidates in other states. Our method and findings have implications for transparency and trust in elections, and on state laws that regulate AI use in campaigns. Because current state laws largely target mainly "materially deceptive" content, we identify additional policy mechanisms that could increase electoral transparency and improve trust as AIGC becomes more prevalent.

</details>
