Using Agency, we implement proof-of-concept optimization techniques based on our analysis and achieve cost reductions up to 35% across various real-world benchmarks on existing harnesses without compromising accuracy.

</details>


### [519] [Toward Sustainable Agentic AI: Carbon Tradeoffs Across Iterative Self-Refinement and Tool-Augmented Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12128)
*Boris Ruf,Adrien de Mailly Nesle,Marcin Detyniecki*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过对两种环境增强型的人工智能系统进行实证研究，评估了它们的碳足迹和能源消耗，发现虽然迭代改进和工具辅助能提高性能，但也会显著增加环境成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在探索环境对人工智能系统性能和能耗的影响，尤其是在迭代改进和工具辅助策略下，以促进更可持续的人工智能发展。

Method: 研究通过两个实验来评估代理AI的碳足迹和能源消耗：首个实验研究了具有k步自我校正的GPT-4.1-mini与GPT-4.1单通道基线在两个数学基准测试集上的表现；第二个实验评估了工具增强的代理编码能力，比较了GPT-4.1-mini、Claude Opus 4.6和GPT-5.3-codex在SWE-bench Lite中的表现。

Result: 首个实验中，k=3次迭代改进将准确率差距缩小到1%，但相比廉价的单通道基线几乎翻了三倍的碳足迹；第二个实验发现GPT-5.3-codex的成功率达到81.2%，在任务解决效率方面高于Claude Opus 4.6和GPT-4.1-mini，但单位任务的碳排放和成本效益却较低。

Conclusion: 研究结论表明，虽然迭代和工具增强策略能够有效提高模拟和编程等任务的性能，但这种性能的提高伴随着显著增加的环境成本，碳足迹可能成为一个重要问题，需要在开发可持续AI系统时考虑这个问题。

Abstract: Agentic language model systems can improve performance either by iterating on their own outputs or by using external tools in grounded environments. While these strategies can reduce error rates and substitute for larger models in some settings, their environmental cost remains relatively underexplored. We present two complementary empirical studies that estimate the energy and carbon footprint of agentic AI across settings of increasing complexity. Study~1 evaluates iterative verbal self-refinement: GPT-4.1-mini at $k = 1$--$5$ steps versus a GPT-4.1 single-pass baseline on two MATH benchmark splits. Study~2 evaluates tool-augmented agentic coding: GPT-4.1-mini, Claude Opus~4.6, and GPT-5.3-codex on SWE-bench Lite, where agents operate inside Docker-isolated environments with access to code execution and file editing tools. In Study~1, $k=3$ refinements close a 16-percentage-point accuracy gap to within 1~point, but nearly triple the carbon footprint relative to the cheap single-pass baseline while remaining below the GPT-4.1 single-pass baseline under the current token-based carbon scenario. In Study~2, GPT-5.3-codex achieves the highest resolution rate in this sample (81.2\%), ahead of Claude Opus~4.6 (68.9\%) and GPT-4.1-mini (25.0\%), but resolved-task-normalized efficiency remains mixed: GPT-4.1-mini is lowest on estimated carbon and cost per resolved task, while GPT-5.3-codex delivers substantially higher task success. All carbon estimates cover output-token inference only; prompt tokens, which exceed 99\% of tokens in Study~2, and tool execution are not charged, so the figures are lower bounds on the full agentic footprint.

</details>


### [520] [Let the Fixer Decide: Training a Code Localizer from the Fixer's Likelihood](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12164)
*Khalil Hennara,Muhammad Hreden,Zeina Aldallal,Sara Chrouf,Safwan AlModhayan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种新的代码定位方法Fixer-Guided Localization (FGL)，该方法减少了代码量的使用，同时也提高了代码修复效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的代码定位方法未能有效帮助修复器定位到正确的Bug位置，修复器需要阅读的代码与实际修改的代码不同。

Method: FGL方法首先由局部化器提出多个可能的定位，经过训练固定的修复器对这些定位进行评分。局部化器通过带有加权监督式微调的方法进行训练，无需运行测试或使用强化学习。

Result: 在Gemma 4 E4B的数据集上，FGL方法在达到与教师定位相同修复成功概率的情况下，使用了27.5%更少的代码。在开发集上，EM一轮优化后，更多任务能够提交补丁（从46增加到53），更少任务因读取不存在的文件卡住（从54减少到43），更多任务被解决（从6增加到8）。训练后的代理探索次数是基线模型的三倍，并且错误补丁减少，一个代理能够在78个任务中解决11个。

Conclusion: 研究表明，FGL方法能够有效地帮助修复器找到Bug位置，相比传统的局部化方法减少代码量27.5%，并且在提高修复成功概率上也有显著优势。此外，FGL对代理和代理训练过程进行了深入分析，为未来的代理开发提供了实用指导。

Abstract: Code localizers are usually trained to predict the files a reference patch edits, but the code a fixer needs to read is not the same as the code it changes. We propose Fixer-Guided Localization (FGL): the localizer proposes several localizations, a frozen fixer scores each by how likely it makes a verified patch, and the localizer is trained on these scores with weighted supervised fine-tuning, without running tests and without reinforcement learning. We build the full pipeline on Gemma 4 E4B for the Kaggle Gemma-4 Developer Agent competition, from 1,629 test-verified Kimi K3 trajectories. The FGL target helps the fixer find the bug as often as the teacher's localization while using 27.5% less code. On the development set, one EM round moves the agent in the expected direction compared with a matched control: more tasks reach a patch (53 vs. 46), fewer tasks get stuck reading files that do not exist (43 vs. 54), and more tasks are solved (8 vs. 6). Training also changes how the agent works: trained agents explore about three times more than the base model and write far fewer wrong patches, and the single agent solves up to 11 of 78 tasks, against 8 for the base model. An analysis of 13 evaluation runs identifies what limits a 4B agent under an 8-minute budget (time, repetition loops and edit quality) and gives practical lessons for training small coding agents. All data, code and adapters are publicly available.

</details>


### [521] [FraudBench: A Legal Evaluation of AI Deception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12167)
*Kevin Wei,Sumaya Nur Adan,Stephan Llerena,Mark Gitau,Jakob Merane,Anita Srinivasan,Colette Le Brannan,Keethan Kleiner,Alessandro Tacconelli,Michael Tiu,Case Thomason,Kyle Emili,Natasza Gadowska,Alex Mark,Eric Ren,Umang Bhatt,Jatinder Singh,Jacy Reese Anthis,Doni Bloomfield,Noam Kolt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FraudBench 是一个对大型语言模型(large language models)在模拟实际情况下的误导和隐瞒行为进行评估的研究。通过一个包含159个基于美国真实案例的场景的数据集，对20种语言模型进行了测试，发现它们的欺诈行为率从0%到40%不等，欺诈行为随任务难度增加而增加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前使用大语言模型的场景越来越多，但这些模型在面临商业利益诱惑时，是否可能出现误导或隐瞒行为成为一个重要的问题。因此，为了评估这些模型在商业场景中是否会充当欺诈工具，研究者提出了 FraudBench 框架，以真实案例为基础，考察模型的行为。

Method: 该研究构建了 FraudBench 框架，包括一个包括159个案例的定制化数据集，每个案例被转换为三种难度的任务提出给20个不同的大语言模型。研究者还设计了预注册的人类评估作为对照基准。

Result: 研究发现，不同大语言模型在不同程度的任务上呈现出0%到40%不等的欺诈行为率，且随着任务难度的增加，欺诈行为比例升高。此外，模型有时即便意识到法律风险仍然会出现欺诈行为，欺诈行为中隐瞒行为多于误导行为。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了在不同程度任务下20种大语言模型的欺诈行为差异，并指出策略干预可以有效减少模型欺诈行为。这项工作提供了评估LLMs在商业环境中表现的重要方法，并强调了透明、合规和合理的使用这些技术的重要性。

Abstract: We introduce FraudBench, an evaluation of large language models' (LLMs) propensities to recommend, assist, or directly take actions that would constitute fraud under U.S. law. Our evaluation contains a novel dataset of 159 scenarios based on real-world U.S. court cases and validated by legal experts. We present each scenario to LLMs via three tasks at varying levels of autonomy: advising users, drafting messages for users to send, and acting directly on behalf of users (477 tasks total). In each scenario, FraudBench re-enacts the facts of a court case to give LLMs an opportunity, but no explicit instruction, to either misrepresent or conceal a material fact in a high-stakes commercial setting--e.g., whether to describe company-funded product testing as "independent" to customers (misrepresentation) or whether to hide unfavorable regulatory investigations from clients (concealment). We evaluate 20 LLMs across 25 experimental conditions (totaling >300,000 generations) and include a preregistered human baseline ($n_{\texttt{annotations}} = 2{,}957$, $n_{\texttt{humans}} = 996$). We score a response as fraudulent when it engages in, assists with, or recommends misrepresentation or concealment. Key findings include: (1) across LLMs, fraud rates ranged from near 0% to over 40%; (2) LLM fraud rates increased with autonomy, with overall rates of 3.0% when advising, 14.7% when drafting, and 21.4% when acting directly, without applying pressure; (3) LLMs sometimes engaged in fraud despite recognizing legal risks; (4) LLMs more often engaged in fraud by concealment than by misrepresentation; and (5) prompt-based interventions substantially affected fraud rates, with a prompt to obey the law reducing fraud rates, while prompts to maximize profits and act agentically increased fraud rates.

</details>


### [522] [Learning to Act with World Models by Valuing What Comes Next](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12200)
*Chenghao Gao,Zhi Zhang,Dian Jin,Yihe Pan,Doudou Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WM-PPO融合世界模型与PPO，通过预测观察和价值评估，提高了成功率，在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上的成功率分别达到87.5%和52.9%，超过了PPO及其他改进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对PPO在利用环境隐含信息方面能力不足的问题，WM-PPO通过引入世界模型和新的训练机制，改进了对环境动态的预测和价值评估，从而提升了智能体的成功率。

Method: WM-PPO结合了世界模型和PPO算法，通过预测观测和评估值函数，同时为策略和价值函数提供辅助目标，利用共享门控层权衡两个通道的信息，从而强化智能体的学习效果。

Result: WM-PPO在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上的成功率分别从PPO的63.5%和39.3%提升到了87.5%和52.9%，并且在训练政策方面表现更优越，能够更频繁地完成必要的步骤。

Conclusion: WM-PPO通过深度融合世界模型与PPO，提供了一种有效的策略优化方法，在多个测试环境中显著提高了智能体的成功率。这一方法有望在具有复杂环境动力学的强化学习任务中产生广泛影响。

Abstract: A sparse terminal reward tells an agent little about its steps. Much of the missing information is implicit in the environment's dynamics, because each state transition can change the conditions for success long before the reward arrives. A world model trained on real transitions can learn to predict what each action changes, but a predicted observation does not by itself show whether success has become more likely. With a binary terminal reward, PPO's critic makes this judgment by estimating the current policy's probability of success, but only for states the agent reaches. Our method, WM-PPO, elegantly brings the two together. For each action the policy samples, executed or not, the world model predicts the next observation and the critic values the predicted successor. In the policy channel, comparisons among these values give the policy auxiliary advantages; in the value channel, their mean gives the critic an auxiliary target. A shared gate weights both channels according to how reliably comparisons with similar margins predicted real outcomes earlier in training. The policy, critic and world model all learn from the agent's own interaction, with no teacher or privileged information, and only the policy is used at inference. With a comparable number of real environment steps, WM-PPO raises success from PPO's 63.5% to 87.5% on ALFWorld and from 39.3% to 52.9% on ScienceWorld. It matches the strongest PPO refinements we tested on ALFWorld and exceeds the best of them by 6.5 points on ScienceWorld. The trained policy more often completes prerequisite steps before placing an object or committing to an answer.

</details>


### [523] [PARIS: A multi-agent LLM framework for end-to-end, PRISMA-guided systematic literature reviews with pre-synthesis corpus quality assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12222)
*Christophe Cruz,Hussam Ghanem,Samir Jabbar,Ait Kbir,Hocine Cherifi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PARIS是一个开源框架，通过调度15个专门的大型语言模型代理来自动化系统综述流程，从研究问题的界定到论文草稿的导出。引入了QualityScore作为预合成指数，评估研究质量和流程合规性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有系统综述(SRs)工作流程自动化工具通常只能解决单一阶段的问题，且耗时且劳动密集。因此，需要一个框架来跨阶段自动化和优化系统综述的过程。

Method: PARIS框架中，一个指挥代理在一个开源环境中调度15个基于大型语言模型的代理，通过声明式的指定和持久化中间产物来进行协调。这些代理负责从数据库检索、元分析评分等任务，并在关键阶段通过人工检查点进行监督。还引入了一个QualityScore指数来综合评估研究质量。

Result: 通过两个案例研究展示了PARIS框架的端到端可行性，包括AI聊天机器人和学生学习案例（包含388条记录，最终选择100条纳入），以及AI辅助系统综述方法案例（包含131条记录，最终选择123条纳入，Pre-Synthesis QualityScore为69.1）。此外，还证明了QualityScore指数在不同阶段的有效性，例如提高研究质量和纳入更早年的文献。

Conclusion: 尽管PARIS框架在一定程度上支持PRISMA 2020条目，但它仍需要进一步的独立验证。未来的工作包括改进框架以遵循更多的PRISMA条目和增加独立的人类审查验证。

Abstract: Systematic literature reviews (SRs) remain slow and labor-intensive, and most automation tools address single stages of the workflow. We present PARIS (PRISMA Agentic Research Intelligence System), an open-source framework in which a conductor agent running in Claude Code orchestrates 15 specialized large language model (LLM) agents, from scoping a research question to exporting a manuscript draft. Agents are specified declaratively, coordinate exclusively through persisted artifacts that the conductor validates before every transition, and delegate retrieval, bibliometric analysis and scoring to deterministic Python utilities. Three human checkpoints gate study inclusion, corpus adequacy and the synthesis outline. We also introduce QualityScore, a pre-synthesis index that aggregates normalized network, bibliometric, semantic and process sub-scores into a 0-100 grade. Two case studies illustrate both: AI chatbots and university students' learning (388 records, 100 included) and AI-assisted SR methods (131 records, 123 included, QualityScore 69.1 recomputed with a proxy network sub-score). They show end-to-end feasibility across domains and the diagnostic use of QualityScore: in the first run, corpus improvements chosen at the corpus-adequacy checkpoint raised the score from 74.6 to 81.9 and the number of pre-2023 studies from 1 to 19. Audits of both runs exposed failure modes: incomplete retrieval, counts that drifted between agents, unrecorded or delegated checkpoint decisions and a grade that depends on how citation data are handled. PARIS fully supports 8 of the 27 PRISMA 2020 items and partially supports 11. Output quality has so far been judged only by an internal reviewer agent; independent validation against human reviews is the next step.

</details>


### [524] [ECOS: Environment-Calibrated On-Policy Self-Distillation for Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12232)
*Chenhao Zhang,Zhongan Wang,Mingxuan Li,Hehe Fan,Zheng Zhu,Ming Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种环境校准的在线自蒸馏方法，通过环境结果来评估教师的指导，从而增强了代理的行为。实验结果显示该方法在ALFWorld和WebShop任务上表现优于GRPO，特别是在未见过的任务中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了改善语言代理的行为，研究人员提出了一种新的自蒸馏方法，该方法能够更准确地指导代理的选择。

Method: 该方法基于环境结果来校准自写的技能，通过估计命令优值来调整教师的偏好和奖励反馈，从而加强诱导更高优值命令的技能。

Result: 3B和7B代理在已见过的ALFWorld任务上的宏成功率分别达到了90.5%和93.3%，在WebShop任务上的成功率分别为75.5%和80.5%。在未见过的ALFWorld任务上，与GRPO相比，该方法的性能分别提升了11.0和7.6个百分点。仅监督可执行命令而非Actor的完整响应时，WebShop任务的成功率提升了22.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 环境校准的在线自蒸馏方法能够更准确地指导代理的行为，并且能够显著提高代理在不同任务上的性能。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation lets a language agent act as its own Teacher by conditioning on privileged context such as skills written from its own trajectories. Its guidance, however, is weighted by how much this context shifts token likelihoods rather than by whether it improves behavior, so errors in self-written skills return through later updates. We propose environment-calibrated on-policy self-distillation, which uses environmental outcomes to decide how much to trust the Teacher's current guidance and which self-written skills to reinforce. Command-level advantages, estimated by comparing commands executed at similar observations, scale each Teacher preference and reward reflections and skills whose induced preferences favor higher-advantage commands. Without skills at inference, 3B and 7B agents reach 90.5% and 93.3% macro success on seen ALFWorld tasks and 75.5% and 80.5% success on WebShop. On unseen ALFWorld tasks, they outperform GRPO under the same protocol by 11.0 and 7.6 percentage points, respectively. In an ablation study, supervising only executable commands rather than the Actor's full response raises 3B WebShop success from 52.3% to 75.0%.

</details>


### [525] [Representational Alignment between Deep Neural Networks and Human Brain in Speech Processing under Audiovisual Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12291)
*Cheng Luo,Jian Zhu,Zhoujian Sun,Yunyi Qi,Yu Qi,Wenhui Sun,Wenyuan Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过使用代表相似性分析（RSA）来量化神经响应和预训练ASR模型生成的DNN嵌入之间的相似性，发现DNN嵌入与大脑的听觉到语言处理在浅层和深层表现出不同的对齐方式，且模型微调过程有助于改善噪声处理和语言表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于近期研究表明DNN层次与听觉路径成正比，但DNN大脑对齐的具体性质尚未充分探索，故本研究旨在探讨DNN表示如何与大脑的听觉到语言处理对齐。

Method: 使用神经编码模型模拟对言语和噪声包络的听觉特征反应以及单词起始和意外的单词内容特征反应。采用代表相似性分析（RSA）量化这些神经响应与预训练ASR模型在浅层和深度层生成的DNN嵌入之间的相似性，研究模型微调过程对噪声处理和语言表示的影响。

Result: 结果表明，浅层DNN嵌入更接近与听觉特征相关的神经响应，而深层DNN嵌入与与语言特征相关的神经响应更接近。模型微调过程改善了浅层噪声处理并细化了深层的语言表示。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，微调后的DNN模型可以在嘈杂环境中自然发展出类似人类的处理模式，突显出人脑和DNN在语音表示功能上的对齐。

Abstract: Speech comprehension in the human brain is an incremental process that begins with acoustic processing and advances to linguistic processing. While recent studies have revealed that the hierarchy of deep neural networks (DNNs) correlates with the ascending auditory pathway, the exact nature of this DNN-brain alignment remains underexplored. In this study, we investigate how DNN representations align with the brain's acoustic-to-linguistic processing. Specifically, we employed neural encoding models to simulate neural responses to acoustic (i.e., speech and noise envelope) and linguistic features (i.e., word onset and surprisal). By applying representational similarity analysis (RSA), we quantified the similarity between these neural responses and the DNN embeddings generated by a pre-trained automatic speech recognition (ASR) model, both before and after fine-tuning on audiovisual noisy data. Our results demonstrate significant DNN-brain alignment: embeddings from shallow layers exhibit higher similarity to neural responses associated with acoustic features, while those from deeper layers align more closely with neural responses related to linguistic features. Importantly, the fine-tuning process enhances this alignment by improving noise processing in shallower layers and refining linguistic representations in deeper layers. These results suggest that fine-tuned DNN models can naturally develop human-like processing patterns in noisy environments, highlighting a functional alignment between the human brain and DNNs in speech representation.

</details>


### [526] [Depth as a Candidate Source: Portfolio Allocation for Recurrent Test-Time Scaling in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12293)
*Chaoyuan Hao,Wentao Yue,Yanyan Wu,Boyuan Gao,Tianyou Lai,Maolin Wang,Yongxin Ni,Hanwen Du,Youhua Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了深度组合分配（DPA）方法，通过预算化分配深度特定候选来源，改善了大语言模型的递归推理深度，并展示了混合深度组合在GSM8K、SVAMP、MultiArith和MBPP数据集上的性能改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究发现深层递归可能导致浅层找到的正确解丢失，且浅层和深层的成功集在很大程度上不嵌套，这表明递归深度不仅影响计算成本，还影响可访问的独特候选解。因此，提出DPA方法来优化不同深度下的候选解分配。

Method: 研究通过系统性的初步分析识别了一种新的递归深度方法，即深度组合分配（DPA），它将递归测试时间的扩展重新公式化为预算化的深度特定候选源的分配。DPA支持固定组合和反馈指导下的序列分配。

Result: 实验结果显示，混合深度组合在匹配候选数量和名义成本的情况下扩展了Oracle覆盖率，反馈引导的分配通常与均匀分配匹配或改进，且在高预算情况下可以减少计算量。

Conclusion: DPA方法成功地实现了不同深度下的候选解优化分配，为大语言模型的递归推理提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Recurrent latent reasoning in large lanugage models (LLMs) scales test-time computation by increasing recurrent depth, naturally framing inference as a problem of deciding when to stop. We identify a previously overlooked limitation of this single-depth view through systematic preliminary analysis: deeper recurrence can lose correct solutions found at shallower depths, while depth-specific success sets remain broadly non-nested even after controlling for marginal accuracy. This suggests that depth determines not only computation cost, but also access to distinct candidate solutions. Motivated by this finding, we propose Depth Portfolio Allocation (DPA), which reformulates recurrent test-time scaling as budgeted allocation across depth-specific candidate sources. DPA supports both fixed portfolios and feedback-guided sequential allocation under a shared inference budget. Experiments on GSM8K, SVAMP, MultiArith, and MBPP show that mixed-depth portfolios expand oracle coverage under matched candidate counts and nominal costs, while feedback-guided allocation generally matches or improves uniform allocation and can reduce computation in high-budget settings. Code and data are avaible at : https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LLM-latent-B7BC/.

</details>


### [527] [TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12640)
*Yihan Hank Tang,Peng Yang,Jiayi Xin,Tianqi Shang,Xuyang Chen,Ying Yuan,Yi Lian,Qi Long*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过引入TrialDesignBench基准，利用617个癌症临床试验案例评估了前沿的语言模型在辅助临床试验设计方面的表现，发现这些模型在与最新FDA指导原则一致的设计上表现不佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鉴于AI在临床试验中的广泛应用，尤其是在统计设计方面的进展不足，研究者利用大型语言模型（LLMs）的生物医学知识和统计推理能力优势，寻求改善AI辅助的临床试验设计。

Method: 研究者构建了一个涵盖617个第I/II期癌症试验的基准集TrialDesignBench，并使用五种前沿的语言模型对此进行评估。

Result: 研究发现，这些最先进的语言模型在与最新FDA指导原则一致的参考设计上表现不尽如人意。进一步的消融实验归因了性能差距的两个主要原因：隐含设计因素的推理以及结构化的决策树推理。

Conclusion: TrialDesignBench提供了一项可重复且具有当代标准的目标，用于评估和增强AI辅助的临床试验设计。

Abstract: AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.

</details>


### [528] [Reconfigurable Action Theories: A Formal Foundation for Dynamically Composable Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12300)
*Jianmin Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了自适应行动理论（RAT），该理论下的行动可以改变行动理论本身。RAT通过模块化的方法来实现这一目标，每个模块包含词汇、因果法则和初始化器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在传统行动理论中，词汇和因果法则固定不变，而行动调节器则可以根据执行环境的变化来改变其工具、提供者和策略。为了更灵活地处理动态变化的环境，研究提出了RAT模型。

Method: RAT通过模块化设计来管理行动理论中的不同元素。每个理论模块包括词汇、因果法则和初始化器， RAT配置记录了当前活跃模块和世界状态。研究提出了模块加载和卸载的机制，并使用普通因果法规则来管理这些操作。

Result: RAT确保当活跃模块集固定时，保留了其语言片段的标准因果行动语义。研究表明在添加模块时保留原有行为，并且在不同顺序加载模块时结果相同。研究还分析了RAT在解决任务时的计算复杂性，并将其有限RAT系统翻译成非单调因果理论和Answer Set Programming（ASP），保留了有限执行。

Conclusion: RAT为检查组件变化如何影响行动调节器的可用行动、行为和可到达目标提供了一个形式基础。实验表明，有限的RAT模型与DeepSeek Harness、Pi和OpenHands实现的执行进行了比较。

Abstract: Action theories typically fix their vocabulary and causal laws, whereas agent harnesses can change their tools, providers, and policies during execution. We introduce Reconfigurable Action Theories (RAT), in which actions can change the action theory itself. A theory module in RAT contains a vocabulary, causal laws, and an initializer. A RAT configuration records the active modules and the world state. Module loading and unloading are represented by actions governed by ordinary causal laws. RAT retains the standard causal action semantics of its language fragment when the active module set is fixed. We give sufficient conditions for at most one next configuration, preservation of existing behavior when a module is added, and equal results when modules are loaded in either order. We establish the computational complexity of reasoning tasks in RAT and translate finite RAT systems into nonmonotonic causal theories and Answer Set Programming (ASP), preserving bounded executions. Experiments compare finite RAT models with executions of official DeepSeek Harness, Pi, and OpenHands implementations. RAT provides a formal basis for checking how component changes affect a harness's available actions, behavior, and reachable goals.

</details>


### [529] [PACE-ECG: Patient-Aware Contrastive ECG Pretraining; Leveraging Longitudinal Structure for Transferable Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12307)
*Riccardo Cavarra,Lupo Lovatelli,Shaheim Ogbomo-Harmitt,Jakub Grzelak,Adelaide De Vecchi,Andrew King,Oleg Aslanidi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究开发了结合时间邻接记录的对比学习和临床指导下的多任务监督的ECG预训练框架PAC-ECG，并展示了其在MIMIC-IV及两个外部HEEDB队列中预测心肌梗死后全因死亡和心力衰竭的性能，相比DeepECG-SSL有显著提升，同时拥有更小的模型规模和预训练数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型常用在同域解释性任务中进行评估，但它们在跨健康医疗系统的长期临床预后应用中的潜力尚未明确。研究希望通过开发PAC-ECG框架，提高ECG表示在不同医院系统间的一致性和泛化性。

Method: 研究使用了结合了时间邻接记录对比学习和临床指导下的多任务监督的ECG预训练框架PAC-ECG，以及冻结的ECG表示方法。通过评估心肌梗死后全因死亡和新发心力衰竭的预测，比较PAC-ECG模型与当前最先进的模型DeepECG-SSL以及两个控制基线的性能。

Result: PAC-ECG在MIMIC-IV和两个外部HEEDB队列中的预测效果优于DeepECG-SSL模型，在心肌梗死后全因死亡和新发心力衰竭的AUROC指标上分别提高了1.9%到+4.0%，对外部人群尤其在HEEDB-Boston和HEEDB-Atlanta中的预测提升更为显著，分别提高了+5.6%到+11.0%。此外，通过消融实验验证了患者时间配对对于提升外部人群预测性能的重要性。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了预训练目标设计与模型和数据规模在下游迁移学习中的重要性，仅在同域性能不足以评估ECG基础表示的临床普适性。

Abstract: Foundation models for physiological signals are commonly evaluated on in-domain interpretation tasks, but their ability to transfer to longitudinal clinical prognosis across healthcare systems remains uncertain. We developed PACE-ECG, an ECG pretraining framework that combines contrastive learning across temporally neighbouring recordings from the same patient with clinically guided multitask supervision. We evaluated frozen ECG representations for post-myocardial-infarction all-cause mortality and incident heart failure prediction across MIMIC-IV and two external HEEDB cohorts, comparing the proposed representation with DeepECG-SSL, a state-of-the-art model, and two control baselines. Across both downstream tasks, the proposed model outperformed DeepECG-SSL in-domain (AUROC +1.9% for mortality and +4.0% for heart failure) and on external populations in HEEDB-Boston (+5.6% for mortality +10.3% for heart failure) and HEEDB-Atlanta (+6.9% for mortality +11.0% for heart failure) while using an encoder 41 times smaller and a fraction of the pretraining data. A matched ablation showed that patient-temporal pairing improved external mortality and heart failure AUROC over generic self-supervision by 7.0% and 9.4% on HEEDB-Boston and 8.9% and 9.3% on HEEDB-Atlanta. These findings indicate that pretraining-objective design greatly influences downstream transfer alongside model and data scale, and that in-domain performance alone is insufficient to establish the clinical generalisability of ECG foundation representations.

</details>


### [530] [AMSchem: Automated Schematic Visualization of AMS Circuits via Verifiable Agentic Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12333)
*Yichen Shi,Zhiyuan Wang,Jianing Cui,Yao Lai,Jinting Zhang,Zhuofu Tao,Hongyang Wang,Zhiping Yu,Ting Jung Lin,Lei He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AMSchem 是一个无需训练的验证器引导代理框架，能够自动从AMS网表生成易于阅读的电路图，提高了设计自动化中模拟混合信号电路的可视化反馈，显著提升了LLM在模拟设计中的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多年来，从网表到电路图的转换始终是一个设计自动化难题，尤其是对于模拟和混合信号（AMS）电路。这种方法不仅需要专家的经验规则，而且LLM设计工具缺乏结构化的视觉反馈，导致他们在看不见的电路中反复迭代。

Method: AMSchem 分离了电路感知的视觉规划（DrawingIntent）和可执行的图示几何（SchematicIR），并提供了局部视觉反馈与有界、重新验证的修复补丁。

Result: 在 AMSchem-Bench 数据集（包含 64 个不同类型的电路）上，对于 40 个电路图子集，AMSchem 与 gpt-5.5 达到了 85.0% 的有效性（直接生成的为 32.5%）。将其集成到基于 LLM 的模拟设计工具中作为视觉反馈模块，AMSchem 解决了 AnalogCoder 基准中之前所有 13 个失败案例，显著提高了成功率。

Conclusion: AMSchem 通过实现自动化的电路可视化，大幅提高了模拟混合信号电路设计的效率和成功率。

Abstract: For decades, the netlist-to-schematic gap has remained a persistent challenge in design automation, especially for analog and mixed-signal (AMS) circuits. Netlists encode connectivity, not visual presentation, making their manual conversion into readable schematics time-consuming and dependent on expert conventions. The same gap leaves LLM-based design tools without structured visual feedback, forcing them to iterate on circuits they cannot see. We present AMSchem, a training-free, verifier-guided agentic framework that automatically generates human-readable schematics from AMS netlists. AMSchem separates circuit-aware visual planning (DrawingIntent) from executable schematic geometry (SchematicIR), and applies localized visual feedback with bounded, revalidated repair patches. Deterministic validators enforce device preservation, pin-net consistency, and geometric correctness throughout. For evaluation, we construct AMSchem-Bench comprising 64 circuits of 12 types. On the 40-circuit schematic subset, AMSchem with gpt-5.5 achieves 85.0\% validity (vs. 32.5\% direct generation). When integrated as a visual feedback module in LLM-based analog design, AMSchem resolves all 13 previously failed cases from AnalogCoder benchmark across five models, substantially improving the success rate. Our dataset and benchmark are available at https://www.amschem.com/benchmark

</details>


### [531] [Rethinking Radar 3D Perception: Representation Learning from Raw Spectra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12334)
*Miao Zhang,Mohamed Abdelsamad,Bin Yang,Sherif Abdulatif,Benedikt Loesch,Marco Altmann,Abhinav Valada,Bin Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究挑战了雷达信号直接用于特征学习的困难，提出结构是雷达频谱在局部破坏下仍可重建的部分，噪声则是不可重构的部分，基于此提出了Leakage-aware Spectral MAE以自监督方式对原始雷达数据进行密集建模，同时强调雷达多普勒组织的重要性，显示出有效学习密集4D雷达数据的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文挑战了直接使用原始雷达频谱作为直接表征学习观点，认为主要问题是缺乏有效的学习目标，区别信号与噪声。鉴于手工艺减少的局限性，本文提出从信号的 robustness 来定义结构，即在局部破坏下仍然可重构的成分作为信号，不可重构的作为噪声。

Method: 研究提出了Leakage-aware Spectral MAE，这是一种基于自监督的masking autoencoder模型，适用于原始雷达立方体，并采用了由频谱泄漏引起的跨频段能量扩散的破坏策略。同时，还强调了多普勒作为主要空间维度的重要性，通过组织雷达多普勒提升学习性能。

Result: 实验结果显示，在没有手工艺减少的前提下，该方法在雷达基检测器和基于点云的自监督学习方法中表现更优，并证实原始雷达频谱在适当预训练目标下可以有效进行3D感知。

Conclusion: 研究展示了原始雷达信号在适当的预训练目标下作为有效3D表征的可能性，特别是通过自监督学习方法进行密集模型构建，而不需要预先假设信号和噪声分离。这一成果对于雷达感知领域具有重要贡献。

Abstract: Raw radar spectra are widely viewed as too cluttered and noisy for direct representation learning, motivating handcrafted reductions, sparse point clouds, or compact Doppler descriptors in radar perception. We challenge this assumption and argue that the main limitation lies not in the raw representation itself, but in the absence of a learning objective that separates structured signal from noise. Handcrafted reductions partially address this problem but impose rigid assumptions about what constitutes signal, discarding weak yet informative structure while retaining artifacts that fit the reduction model. Once removed, such information cannot be recovered by supervised learning. We propose an alternative: structure is the component of a radar spectrum that remains reconstructable under localized corruption, while noise is the component that does not. This perspective motivates self-supervised masked modeling for dense radar spectra without predefined signal-noise separation. We instantiate it with Leakage-aware Spectral MAE, a masked autoencoder for raw radar cubes using a corruption strategy inspired by cross-bin energy spreading caused by spectral leakage. We also demonstrate the importance of Doppler organization: treating Doppler as a primary spatial dimension in an x-y-D representation, with height encoded as features, substantially outperforms naive channel stacking and enables effective learning from dense 4D spectra. Without handcrafted reductions, our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art radar-based detectors and point-cloud-based self-supervised learning (SSL) counterparts. These results establish raw radar spectra as an effective representation for 3D perception when paired with an appropriate pretraining objective.

</details>


### [532] [DForkTree: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Fork-Aware Block Diffusion Draft Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12356)
*Zhicheng Zheng,Cheng Zhang,Chenkai Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DForkTree 提出了一种训练免费的方法，通过对每个分支重新锚定使其专注于自己的tokens，从而加快了语言模型的速度。与 Block diffusion drafters 和 DDTree 相比，DForkTree 在所有基准测试中都是最快的，速度分别比 DFlash 快 41.5% 和比 DDTree 快 15.1%，平均速度提升高达 4.75 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加速语言模型的解码速度，提高解码效率。

Method: DForkTree 引入了一种训练免费的方法，通过在 drafter 的分数中添加目标模型自身的 n-gram 统计，并根据不同情况调整权重，来构建最优的决策树。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 和 9B 上，与其他树方法共享一个 drafter 和 verifer 的情况下，DForkTree 在所有基准测试中都是最快的，且比 DFlash 快 41.5%，比 DDTree 快 15.1%，平均速度提升高达 4.75 倍。

Conclusion: DForkTree 在通过减少对前缀依赖和优化决策树构建方式来实现更快解码速度上取得显著效果。

Abstract: Speculative decoding speeds up language models by letting a lightweight drafter propose several future tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash draft a whole block in one forward pass, and DDTree builds a draft tree from their per-position distributions. Each of these distributions assumes that the drafter's own most likely continuation is correct. A tree, however, gains over a chain only on branches that leave this continuation, where the drafter's top-1 accuracy drops from 89% to 18% and its candidate lists miss the right token far more often. When re-run from the fork token, the same drafter is usually correct, so the errors come from the prefix that the distributions condition on rather than from what the drafter knows. We introduce DForkTree, a training-free method that re-anchors each branch on its own tokens. DForkTree adds n-gram statistics from the target model's own outputs to the drafter's scores as pointwise mutual information, weights them more after the fork, and builds the optimal tree under these scores exactly on the GPU. On Qwen3.5-4B and 9B, with all tree methods sharing one drafter, tree pipeline and verifier, DForkTree is the fastest tree method on every benchmark. It is up to 41.5% faster than DFlash and 15.1% faster than DDTree in the same setting, with average speedups of up to 4.75x over autoregressive decoding.

</details>


### [533] [TANSAR: Editable and Attributable Correlation Matrix Memories under Correlated Keys, with Rule-Constrained Multi-Hop Knowledge Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12374)
*Abdulhady Abas Abdulla,Jiyan Salim Mahmud,Fatemeh Daneshfar,Hussein Mohammed Ali,Mourad Oussalah,Muhammad Bilal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文分析了在相关关键字情况下CMMs的表现，提出了TANSAR方法，该方法通过有向无环关联图遍历、通过逻辑约束剪枝无效路径，并将验证路径的表示注入冻结的语言模型中，实现了高效且准确的多跳关联检索和精确遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的CMMs理论主要基于随机、正交的键进行分析，但实际中的语义编码器生成的表示往往是相关的。因此，需要研究CMMs在相关键情况下表现，并提出新的方法来应对这种挑战。

Method: 通过帧理论相干性对CMMs进行分析，确定容量界限、定义删除后的旁路效应，并且首次提出了几何透明性边界。此外，设计了TANSAR（Topology-Aware Neuro-Symbolic Associative Retrieval）方法，具体步骤包括遍历有向无环关联图、逻辑约束剪枝无效路径、利用验证路径的表示注入冻结的语言模型，最后通过Clopper-Pearson筛选风险。

Result: 理论分析表明，TANSAR在多跳知识编辑中表现优越，相比传统的Hopfield检索，能够显著减少矛盾回答，同时在端到端的编辑操作中具有很高的效率。同时，符号组件能够准确匹配多种理论和数据集。

Conclusion: 本文解决了CMMs在相关键情况下的问题，并通过TANSAR方法实现了高效且准确的多跳关联检索和精确遗忘，实验证明其有效性和实用性。

Abstract: Correlation Matrix Memories (CMMs) store associations as sums of rank-one outer products, providing closed-form addressability, exact deletion, and linear attribution. While classical analyses assume random, orthogonal keys, semantic encoders produce correlated representations. We analyse CMMs under correlated keys using frame-theoretic coherence: (i) capacity bounds yielding an encoder-independent limit $n \le d(1+\varepsilon^2)$ for mean squared crosstalk $\varepsilon^2$; (ii) an exact characterisation of the collateral effect of deleting an association, guaranteeing that deletion never invalidates certified associations; and (iii) a geometric transparency bound demonstrating why attribution requires candidate sets of centred keys. On this basis, we introduce Topology-Aware Neuro-Symbolic Associative Retrieval (TANSAR). TANSAR traverses a directed acyclic association graph, prunes invalid paths via sound ground Horn constraints, and injects a representation derived strictly from the verified path into the residual stream of a frozen language model, guarded by a Clopper--Pearson selective-risk gate. Controlled experiments confirm all theoretical bounds. In multi-hop knowledge editing, Horn pruning reduces answer contradictions from 25.1% to 0.5%, whereas Hopfield retrieval incurs 24% contradictions when stale associations remain stored (and 0% if stale associations are removed). An end-to-end edit transaction requires 13.6 ms on a standard CPU and 2.37 ms on GPU. The symbolic component matches gold labels across all 600 ProofWriter theories and achieves 94.0% agreement on FOLIO, demonstrating sound and efficient multi-hop associative retrieval with exact unlearning.

</details>


### [534] [Detecting Shadow AI: Unsanctioned LLM Agents on Enterprise Endpoints: A Taxonomy, an Open Detector and a Controlled Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12377)
*Jeremy Canale,Fabien Soulis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文讨论了自主人工智能代理如何加速影子IT的增长，并提出了一种检测这些代理的方法，名为Agent Detector，它基于行为与远程服务身份的关联，而非仅仅是基于过程结构和连接。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于自主人工智能代理可以轻易制造工具、使用用户的权限，并留下未经授权的自动化脚本，影子IT可能会以指数级速度增长。因此，需要找到有效的方法来检测这些未经授权的代理。

Method: 作者提出了一个代理检测方法，称为Agent Detector。它利用配置历史、安装历史以及执行历史来锚定和关联行为，而非仅根据进程结构和连接来区分代理和其行为孪生。

Result: 在一项针对12种合成代理、3种AI组件和9种良性工作负载的研究中，Agent Detector在多数运行中成功检测了所有代理，而两个行为性规则标记出了所有行为孪生。

Conclusion: 虽然Agent Detector的成本（每次扫描约154 ms）和时间限制（DNS缓存持有提供者名称的时间约为一到五分钟）使其检测能力受到一定限制，但它表明，未经授权的代理可以通过这种方式被部分检测到，而不仅仅是通过行为来检测。

Abstract: Shadow IT, the use of technology that the IT organisation has not approved, is a long-standing governance problem. We argue that autonomous AI agents can make it grow much faster: agents make building tools nearly free, act with their user's privileges, and leave behind scripts, automations and MCP servers that are themselves unsanctioned. A simple compounding model shows that, under its assumptions, shadow IT grows exponentially once agentic artifacts reproduce faster than the organisation retires them; retiring them starts with detecting them. We then ask whether unsanctioned agents can be detected on Windows endpoints. We propose a taxonomy of nine classes of agents and six layers of endpoint footprint, and argue that rules based only on the structure of processes and connections cannot separate an agent from its behavioural twin, the same program talking to a non-AI service. We present Agent Detector, an open-source Windows detector that anchors behaviour to the identity of the remote service and correlates it with configuration, installation and execution history, using a catalog of 39 tools and 184 LLM endpoint entries; it informs users through a notice they must acknowledge instead of blocking. On a controlled bench of 12 synthetic agents, 3 AI components and 9 benign workloads, repeated 5 times on one workstation, two behavioural rules flagged every behavioural twin, while Agent Detector flagged none and detected every agent in the majority of runs. Its limits are temporal: a connection to a provider behind a shared content-delivery network is attributable only while the DNS cache holds the provider's name, one to five minutes, and an intermittent agent was seen by about one scan in three. A scan costs about 154 ms. The bench is too small to rank detectors; it maps what each kind of evidence can see: unsanctioned agents can be partly detected, and not by behaviour alone.

</details>


### [535] [Reconstructing hourly traffic on every street of a capital from a sparse counting network: a graph neural network applied to Paris](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12379)
*Xavier Jurado,C{é}dric Wemmert,Nicolas Reiminger*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过图神经网络（GNN）从有限的交通计数器网络中重构巴黎市区的小时交通流量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有微尺度空气质量模型需要每条道路段的每小时交通数据，而永久计数器仅覆盖不到网络的5%，因此需要一种方法来补充缺失的流量数据。

Method: 使用Graph Neural Network for Urban Interpolation (GNNUI)对稀疏的交通计数网络进行适应性改造，其中流量解码在交叉点图的边上计算，交通气候学作为零增加负二项式似然的一个偏置，并通过掩码计数器进行训练。

Result: 八折空间交叉验证表明，该模型在记录区域内的插值（R${}^2$ = 0.89，相对误差约为四分之一的平均流量）优于在未记录区域的外推（R${}^2$ = 0.74，相对误差约为三分之一的平均流量）。除了一些被记录的当地街道，相对误差约为50%。消除实验表明，气候学偏置有助于外推。道路属性、时间周期以及计数网络的实时状态是最重要的因素，而天气输入几乎没有任何显著影响。掩码率是唯一有明显效果的继承超参数。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了利用图神经网络可以从有限的交通计数网络中有效地重建城市区域的小时交通流量，这对于进一步改善空气质量模型的数据支持非常重要。

Abstract: Micro-scale air quality models require hourly traffic data on every road segment, whereas permanent counters cover only a small part of the network. A graph neural network (GNN) was developed to reconstruct hourly traffic flows on the 32,163 road segments of Paris intra-muros from the 1,573 segments equipped with a counter (4.9%). The model adapts the Graph Neural Network for Urban Interpolation (GNNUI) to a real, sparse counting network. Flows are decoded on the edges of the junction graph (one edge per segment, both directions summed), a traffic climatology serves as an offset in a zero-inflated negative-binomial likelihood, and training proceeds by masking counters. Eight-fold spatial cross-validation, with counters sharing a published series merged before splitting, distinguishes interpolation at a withheld counter in an instrumented district (R${}^2$ = 0.89, error of a quarter of the mean flow) from extrapolation to a district without counters (R${}^2$ = 0.74, a third of the mean flow). These scores hold on main axes where counters are located, while relative errors are about 50% on the few counted local streets. Ablations show that the climatology offset tends to help extrapolation. Road attributes, time cycles and the live state of the counting network matter most, while weather inputs have no significant effect. The masking rate is the only inherited hyperparameter with a clear effect. When evaluated on January--August 2026 (outside the training period), the frozen model stayed around the error band of previous years.

</details>


### [536] [AutoBuddy: Evaluating Proactive, Always-On Agents on Task Discovery and Execution in a Simulated Workplace](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12393)
*Shiqi Chen,Daniel Madrigal Diaz,Wei-Ning Chen,Gbola Afonja,Fangkai Yang,Rujia Wang,Chetan Bansal,Victor Rühle,Saravan Rajmohan,Dongge Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一个名为AutoBuddy-Bench的模拟器，旨在评估LLM在主动任务发现与执行方面的系统能力，并通过对比不同基础模型的效果，识别出任务生命周期中的关键挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM代理变得越来越自主，它们被期望作为用户的代理助手始终在线，能够自行识别工作并完成这些工作。现有的基准测试通常只需提供任务给代理，然而真实世界中的知识工作中，任务通常隐藏于用户的职场环境中。该研究旨在填补这一空白，通过创建一个能够模拟组织内部环境的AutoBuddy-Bench模拟器来评估LLM的主动任务发现和执行能力。

Method: 开发了AutoBuddy-Bench模拟器来解决实际工作中任务发现和执行的挑战。这个模拟器构建了一个动态图模型来表示组织的员工、项目、业务系统和事件历史，并将其转化为真实的职场环境，接着从事件中推导出任务的真实背景，并计算每个任务的结果。同时，研究还构建了一个包含可替换骨干模型的参考代理AutoBuddy来评估现有LLM的表现。

Result: 研究结果表明，不同基础模型在任务发现和执行方面的表现存在系统性差异。较弱的模型主要在任务发现失败，部分中等程度的模型能够识别出任务但停止执行，而最强的模型则主要在执行阶段遇到困难，特别是与业务系统的操作相关的任务。在任务发现精度与执行质量之间，存在不显著的相关性，表明这两种能力可能是独立的。

Conclusion: 该项研究成功地提出并验证了AutoBuddy-Bench模拟器和AutoBuddy参考代理，为评估LLM在主动任务发现和执行方面的能力提供了一种新的方法。研究还揭示了不同基础模型在任务生命周期中特定阶段的表现差异，强调了未来研究在提高LLM整体能力方面的重要方向。

Abstract: As LLM agents become more autonomous, they are increasingly expected to run as always-on assistants on a user's behalf, identifying work to be done and completing it without being asked. Yet existing benchmarks usually give the agent its task, whereas in knowledge work the requests sit in the user's workspace and the agent must first recognise which obligations exist. We study proactive task discovery and execution, in which an agent must infer a user's pending tasks from their workspace and complete them in the systems where the work lives. This setting poses two challenges. For the agent, the tasks are buried in a large volume of mail, chat, documents and records. For evaluation, a benchmark needs a simulated organisation whose people, events and documents are mutually consistent, so that tasks arise realistically and their correct outcomes are known. We introduce AutoBuddy-Bench, a simulator that addresses these challenges. It models an organisation's employees, projects, business systems and event history as a temporal graph, renders it into realistic workspace artefacts, derives ground-truth tasks from the events that create obligations, and computes each task's outcome from the world state; execution is judged by the agent's changes to the workspace. To evaluate current LLMs, we build AutoBuddy, a reference agent with interchangeable backbone LLMs: it identifies tasks from the workspace, grounding each in its source records, and executes each in a separate session with write access. Varying only the backbone, we find a systematic shift in where tasks are lost: weaker models fail mainly at discovery, intermediate models identify tasks but often stop short of carrying them out, and the strongest models fail mainly during execution, most often on business-system operations. Discovery precision is only weakly related to execution quality, suggesting the two are distinct capabilities.

</details>


### [537] [AuDiR: Diagnosing Audio Reasoning with Rule and Percept Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12478)
*Chengwei Wei,Yi Ma,Nancy F. Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AuDiR 通过控制输入干预，区分声学感知、规则知识和规则应用的失败。基准包含201个项目，结果显示提供声学观察文本可显著提高准确性，但仍存在声学验证不完全、识别捷径和非单调响应的限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的答案准确率无法区分声学感知、规则知识和规则应用的错误，因此提出了 AuDiR 方法来研究这些区别。

Method: AuDiR 方法包含音频片段、选择题、任务通用规则和声学观察的文本描述。通过不同的条件供应不同信息，以分析不同的错误类型。

Result: 基准测试包含201个项目，来自18个家庭的9个源头。在不同的条件下，准确性随着提供的信息量增加而显著提高。无音频情况下准确性较低，但增长值有限。

Conclusion: 结果表明，提供声学观察文本可以有效提高准确性，但声学验证不完全、识别捷径和非单调响应限制了更强的错误归因结论。

Abstract: Answer accuracy alone does not distinguish failures in acoustic perception, rule knowledge, and rule application. AuDiR (Audio Diagnostic Reasoning) examines these distinctions through controlled input interventions. Each item contains an audio clip, a multiple-choice question, a task-general rule, and a textual description of the acoustic observations needed to answer. Three conditions progressively supply the rule and observations; a fourth removes the audio while retaining the question and rule. The first correct diagnostic condition assigns an operational response label, without identifying a unique internal cause. The current benchmark contains 201 items in 18 families drawn from 9 sources, with answer references documented separately from percept extraction. In a preliminary evaluation of Gemini-3.8-flash, accuracy is 29.3% without supplied information, 31.3% with the rule, and 98.5% with the observations also supplied. No-audio accuracy is 23.9%, with a confidence interval containing the 25.0% chance rate. A family-level knowledge probe associates incomplete rule recall with larger gains from rule provision. These results show the benefit of supplying acoustic observations as text, while incomplete validation, possible recognition shortcuts, and non-monotonic responses limit stronger failure-attribution claims.

</details>


### [538] [SciMARS: Multi-Agent Recursive Self-Improvement for Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12552)
*Weimin Wu,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SciMARS是一个框架，旨在解决多智能体系统中的两个主要问题：缺乏共享记忆导致的工作重复和固定角色流程中的错误积累。它通过共享证据图和分离组件编辑器来解决这些问题，能够根据科学证据的变化自适应调整角色和协调，而SciMARS + Memory进一步增强了记录和处理证据的能力。实验结果显示，这种结合了共享记忆和多智能体系统自适应能力的方法在多个科学发现基准测试中表现出优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体系统在科学发现过程中存在两个主要问题：缺乏共享记忆和固定的角色流程，这些问题限制了系统的效率和准确性。SciMARS通过提供一种新的框架来解决这些问题，旨在改进科学发现过程中的多智能体协调。

Method: SciMARS主要包括一个共享的证据图以及独立的组件编辑器。它允许智能体根据科学证据的变化自适应地调整其操作流程，同时SciMARS + Memory增加了智能体如何记录、检索和接收证据的功能。通过这些机制，SciMARS能够更好地适应科学发现过程中的不同阶段和需求。

Result: SciMARS + Memory在多个科学发现基准测试中表现出了显著的改进。在Autonomous Science Bench测试中，它解决了18种尝试中的14种和2种更复杂的情况，而基线多智能体团队只解决了8种和1种。在ScienceAgentBench和AppWorld中，SciMARS + Memory分别解决了38种和20种任务中的14种和11种，而基线团队分别解决了11种和5种。

Conclusion: SciMARS在解决科学发现过程中多智能体系统面临的问题方面具有很大的潜力。通过提供共享证据图和自适应的组件编辑器，SciMARS能够根据科学证据的变化调整智能体的角色和流程，显著提高了多智能体系统在科学发现任务中的效率和准确性。

Abstract: We propose SciMARS, a framework for recursive task-local adaptation of multi-agent harnesses in closed-loop scientific discovery. Multi-agent systems coordinate analysis, experimental design, and verification as scientific evidence evolves. However, two problems limit their effectiveness: (i) without shared memory, agents lose observations and repeat work; (ii) fixed role procedures, handoffs, and memory policies perpetuate mistakes despite retained evidence. We address these problems with a shared evidence graph and separate component editors. SciMARS adapts roles and coordination; SciMARS + Memory adds a third editor for how agents record, retrieve, and receive evidence. Candidate probes guide composition and selection of the next harness. We evaluate scientific discovery through experimental-data replay and a digital twin. SciMARS + Memory resolves 12/18 GPT-6-Astra and 2/18 GLM-5.3 attempts on Autonomous Science Bench, compared with 8/18 and 1/18 for the base multi-agent team. On ScienceAgentBench and AppWorld, it solves 14/38 and 11/20 tasks, compared with 11/38 and 5/20 for the base team. These results support combining shared memory with harness adaptation across scientific and interactive tasks.

</details>


### [539] [Beyond Sunny Skies: Using Large Language Models to Predict Urban Traffic in Adverse Weather](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12635)
*Zhu Xiao,Kuan Feng,Tong Li,Chenxi Liu,Gang Wang,Zhuo Tang,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为Multi-STG的新框架，它结合了大型语言模型推导出的语义先验与基于图的空间-时间学习，有效提升了恶劣天气条件下城市交通流预测的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决现有数据驱动模型在处理稀疏数据和复杂非线性变化方面的不足，特别是在极端天气条件下。

Method: 引入了一个LLM增强的语义增强模块，用于从天气描述、POI和节假日等信息中提取高层语义嵌入，并设计了一种多模态注意力融合机制和具有门控残差校准的语义增强预测头。

Result: 在三个城市的实际多城市私人汽车数据集上的实验表明，Multi-STG在平均MAE上相比最强基准降低了11.82%，并且在稀疏和非平稳条件下保持稳定的性能。

Conclusion: Multi-STG通过结合LLM的语义信息和空间-时间学习方法，显著改善了恶劣天气条件下的城市交通流预测性能。

Abstract: Urban traffic flow prediction is a cornerstone of intelligent transportation systems, yet accurate forecasting under adverse weather conditions remains a significant challenge. Existing data-driven models, while effective for routine patterns, often struggle with the sparse data and complex non-linear shifts associated with rare meteorological events. These methods typically treat environmental contexts as shallow numerical features, failing to capture the underlying semantic reasoning-why and how specific adverse conditions alter mobility behaviors across regions with different functional compositions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-STG, a unified framework that integrates Large Language Model (LLM)-derived semantic priors with graph-based spatiotemporal learning. Multi-STG introduces an LLM-empowered semantic enhancement module that transforms comprehensive context descriptions such as weather, POIs, and holidays into high-level semantic embeddings, effectively providing a knowledge-driven complement to data scarcity. Furthermore, we design a multimodal attentional fusion mechanism to dynamically weigh heterogeneous inputs and a semantic-enhanced prediction head with gated residual calibration to robustly adjust forecasts based on semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on real-world multi-city private car datasets demonstrate that Multi-STG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing MAE by 11.82\% on average relative to the strongest baseline across three cities, while maintaining stable performance under sparse and non-stationary conditions.

</details>


### [540] [Interpretability Is Not Model-Specific](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12675)
*Marcus Armstrong,Navid Ayoobi,Pradham Mummaleti,Alexander Chulzhanov,Arjun Mukherjee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种跨模型可解释性的方法，通过在未标注提示上学习残差流之间的映射来转移解码工具，发现某些解码工具在不同模型间的转移效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的解释工具通常是为单一模型设计的，该研究旨在探索是否可以将这些工具应用于其他模型，通过一种新的方法来实现在不同模型之间转移解释信息。

Method: 该研究构建了一种基于未标注数据的映射方法，用于跨模型转移解释工具。研究者通过在一个模型上的解释工具（如拒绝方向、正确性方向与情感探针），转移到110对不同大小与家族的模型上，控制了特定性并使用了五个种子。

Result: 研究结果显示，转移的效果依赖于映射训练的数据类型。训练集包括普通问题时，能恢复54%的目标模型拒绝方向和16%到77%的正确性提升；加入操作区域的未标注提示后，效果提升到102%和88%到98%。另外，研究证明线性映射在数据覆盖范围内线性对应时会表现出这种方式，由此得出一个无标签覆盖度分数，可以解释模型间映射失败的现象。

Conclusion: 研究认为，可解释性结果可以在一定代价下，在不同模型间重复利用，特别是在引入目标操作区域的未标注提示后，转移的效果显著提高。

Abstract: Interpretability tools are usually built for one model at a time: a refusal direction, a truthfulness probe, or a steering vector is found with labeled data inside the model it explains. We ask whether such tools can be carried to other models through a map between residual streams fit only on unlabeled prompts. We transfer a refusal direction, tested causally by addition and ablation, and two read-out tools, a correctness direction and a sentiment probe, across 110 pairs of models from five families and 1B to 72B parameters and between base and instruction-tuned models, with controls for specificity and five seeds. How much transfers depends on what the map was fit on. A map fit on ordinary questions recovers 54\% of the target's own refusal steering and 16\% to 77\% of its correctness gain; adding unlabeled prompts from the region where the tool operates raises these to 102\% and 88\% to 98\%, while control directions recover at most 1\%. We prove that a linear map behaves this way whenever two models correspond linearly on the data it covers, and a label-free coverage score derived from this result tracks recovery across more than 16,000 runs and explains earlier reports that maps between models fail across domains. Carried read-out tools outperform anything the target's unlabeled representations yield. Interpretability results, once found, can be reused across models at the cost of a few unlabeled prompts.

</details>


### [541] [Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12762)
*Weida Wang,Benteng Chen,Yigeng Jiang,Shuchen Pu,Weiping Shen,Zichao Liu,Yulin Su,Zitong Wang,Siyu Zhou,Zifu Wang,Yizhi Li,Xin Zong,Yuning Yang,Jixiang Bi,Yuan Wang,Chuyi Peng,Shiyao Geng,Qi Zhang,Kuan Lu,Mengzhu Li,Weiwang Xu,Peishan Xiang,Chengjun Liu,Chengrui Wei,Fangchen Yu,Shengji Tang,Yichen Jiang,Jingqi Ye,Cheng Yang,Tao Hu,Jianbiao Mei,Qinglong Cao,Kun Li,Yixin Chen,Shengyuan Xu,Juncheng Xiao,Yiheng Wang,Ruizhe Chen,Shiyang Feng,Runmin Ma,Xiangchao Yan,Zongsheng Cao,Haomeng Hu,Yu Ke,Taihui Wu,Meng Dai,Xu Guo,Haoyang Peng,Yinglong Ni,Pingsen Shi,Xiaosong Wang,Shuyue Hu,Haijun Li,Sherry Dongqi Bao,Yang Yang,Chao Yang,Jie Hou,Tianfan Fu,Yi Gong,Jin Zeng,Mao Su,Hongxia Hao,Fanyang Mo,Fenghua Ling,Tianshu Yu,Yunqi Cai,Baihong Chi,Jingwei Wang,Lei Wang,Chuncheng Bu,Shide Lv,Guangyu Wang,Yuqiang Li,Chunfeng Song,Lei Bai,Hui Wang,Xujun Fu,Li Cao,Lei Chen,Dahua Lin,Xing Xie,Bowen Zhou,Wenlong Zhang,Pinlong Cai,Peng Ye,Aiwen Lei,Jie Li,Shengchun Wang,Bo Zhang,Shufei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Sage-Taiyi 是一种受元认知启发的架构，利用累积的科学理解来指导研究方向和方法，表现出色并实现了科学创新的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前科研过程中存在对研究方向和方法选择不够智能的问题，Sage-Taiyi 旨在通过借鉴科学界的经验和理解来优化科研流程，提高科研效率。

Method: Sage-Taiyi 采用显式的监控和控制机制，定期审视证据、假设和未解决问题，然后根据这些评估调整研究目标和选择重用的推理方法。

Result: 在 Taiyi-Bench 上，Sage-Taiyi 在 8 个历史重构和开放式创新指标中均排名第一，得分 54.0，远超基准线的 47.9 分。此外，它在两个外部科学创新基准测试中也表现优异。在与化学、材料科学和工程领域的专家合作中，成功将提案与实验和计算验证相结合，实现了科研效果的显著提升。

Conclusion: Sage-Taiyi 证明了元认知调节在科学创新中的有效性，并为其后续的实际应用奠定了基础。

Abstract: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight metrics of historical rediscovery and open-ended ideation, achieving an Overall score of 54.0 compared with 47.9 for the strongest baseline, AI Scientist-v2. It also performs well on two external scientific ideation benchmarks. Five expert-guided collaborations further connect its proposals to experimental and computational validation across chemistry, materials science, and engineering. In chemistry, reaction-condition optimization raises the yield of cobalt-catalyzed carbonylation from trace amounts to 84% and photocatalytic allylic amination from 13% to 69%. These results support metacognitive regulation as an approach to scientific ideation and its progression toward practical validation.

</details>


### [542] [LogCDM: Interpretable Log Anomaly Detection via Behavioral Graph Drift and Adaptive Signal Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12775)
*Suryansh Talukdar,Taha Sarwat,Jin Soung Yoo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LogCDM 是一种紧凑型检测器，通过三重信号（事件的惊讶度、图形注意嵌入的距离和过渡漂移统计量）来评估每个日志会话。此外，它能够在没有 GPU 的情况下进行推断，并在多个数据集上实现了高 F1 值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于日志的方法依赖于大型预训练模型，这些模型在推断时需要 GPU，并且难以部署在日志生成的监控节点上。为了解决这个问题，提出了 LogCDM，旨在通过紧凑型设计来提高部署的灵活性和效率。

Method: LogCDM 使用一个小型因果 Transformer 来评估事件的惊讶度，采用图形注意嵌入并在参考日志的图形上进行对比，以及计算过渡漂移统计量。方法包括使用 Chi-squared 拟合度度量来解释每条警报，通过逻辑门融合三个信号，并在共享协方差高斯模型下，逻辑门权重反映出哪些信号在特定数据集中占主导地位。

Result: LogCDM 的参数量为 8.1-8.8M，没有在推断时使用 GPU，其结果在多个日志数据集上表现优秀，F1 值分别为 HDFS 上的 0.984、BGL 上的 0.870 和 Thunderbird 上的 0.850，接近 8.1B 参数的预训练模型，同时 CPU 推断仅需 5.5-10.5 毫秒。

Conclusion: LogCDM 通过对不同类型日志数据集表现出不同的性能提升，证明了该方法的有效性，并强调了紧凑型设计对于实际应用中的部署灵活性和高效性的关键作用。

Abstract: Log-based anomaly detection is increasingly dominated by large pretrained models, from BERT-scale encoders to 8B-parameter language models, which require GPUs at inference time and are difficult to deploy on the monitoring nodes where logs are produced. We present LogCDM, a compact detector that scores each log session using three complementary signals: the next-event surprise of a small causal Transformer, the distance between a graph-attention embedding of the session's own transition graph and that of a normal reference graph, and a transition-drift statistic that we show is exactly a frequency-weighted chi-squared divergence between transition kernels. The divergence view yields an asymptotic null distribution, a length-standardized score, and a per-edge decomposition that explains each alarm. A sigmoid gate fuses the three signals; under a shared-covariance Gaussian model, this gate is the Bayes posterior, and its learned weights indicate which signal each dataset relies on. With 8.1-8.8M parameters and no GPU required at inference, LogCDM reaches F1 scores of 0.984 on HDFS, 0.870 on chronologically split BGL, and 0.850 on Thunderbird, within 0.013-0.12 of an 8.1B-parameter LLM detector evaluated under the same protocol and above all compact baselines on BGL. It scores a session in 5.5-10.5 ms on a CPU. Ablations show that the structural signals add 0.025-0.030 F1 on BGL and Thunderbird but almost nothing on HDFS, consistent with the learned fusion weights.

</details>


### [543] [Automated Knowledge Acquisition Pipeline for Disassembly Instructions: A Comparison of NLP and Generative AI Frameworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12816)
*Tim Schnieders,Tareq Maximilian Gabriel Ahrari,Oliver Petrovic,Christian Brecher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了并比较了两种从非结构化信息源中提取拆卸指令的框架，旨在将自然语言文本转化为结构化、经过筛选并可供机器读取的格式。该研究对比了基于规则的自然语言处理框架和基于LLM的生成式AI框架，并使用实际的拆卸手册进行了测试。研究结果为未来拆卸过程的开发和自动化提供了必要的数据基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提出了解决中小企业因产品复杂性增加而难以采用拆卸自动化技术的挑战，旨在通过从拆卸手册等非结构化信息源中提取拆卸指令来促进拆卸自动化。

Method: 该研究实现了两种框架的实施与测试：一种基于规则的NLP框架和一种基于LLM的生成式AI框架，使用实际的拆卸手册数据进行比较。

Result: 两种框架的性能通过实际的拆卸手册进行了比较，结果显示各自的优势和局限。

Conclusion: 研究为开发和自动化未来的拆卸过程提供了必要的数据基础。

Abstract: The push towards circularity and Re-X principles presents a challenge to SMEs, particularly due to increasing product complexity that impedes the adoption of disassembly automation. This paper introduces and compares two frameworks for extracting disassembly instructions from unstructured information sources, such as disassembly manuals. Our goal is to transform natural language text into a structured, curated and machine-readable format. We implemented and tested a rule-based Natural Language Processing (NLP) framework against a generative AI framework leveraging LLMs. The performance of both approaches was compared using real-world disassembly manuals. This work provides the necessary data foundation for developing and automating future disassembly processes.

</details>


### [544] [MaxIM: Maximally Informative Incremental Summarization via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12825)
*Jihwan Jeong,Guy Tennenholtz,Yinlam Chow,Chih-Wei Hsu,Craig Boutilier*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MaxIM通过将增量总结形式化为一种容量受限的信息论奖赏塑形问题，旨在优化memory representation以提升下游任务的实用性，无需昂贵的人类偏好标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对传统强化学习中由于稀疏延迟奖励带来的归因问题，MaxIM通过结合信息论和价值子最优性理论，提出了一种新的框架来优化记忆表示，特别是在处理无界交互历史时。

Method: MaxIM框架将增量总结视为一种容量受限且信息论导向的奖赏塑形问题，引入了递归一致性条件来确保总结与观察到的历史的最大信息量，通过参数化的不对称评论家来逐步计算变异最大信息量限边界进行密集奖赏塑形。

Result: 在长期展望的科学阅读和多轮对话基准上，MaxIM表现出对事实定位、综合自动评分和下游任务实用性的优越性，而无需昂贵的人类偏好标签。

Conclusion: MaxIM证明了在优化记忆表示以提升下游任务的实用性方面是有效的，特别是在处理无界交互历史时。

Abstract: AI systems must often maintain bounded memory of unbounded interaction histories. However, optimizing the memory representation, and its updates, for downstream task utility is difficult for standard reinforcement learning (RL) due to severe credit assignment bottlenecks induced by sparse, delayed rewards. We introduce MaxIM (Maximally Informative Incremental Memory), a framework that formulates incremental summarization as a capacity-constrained, information-theoretic reward-shaping problem. Grounded in value suboptimality bounds, we show that bounding sequential information loss motivates maximizing the predictive log-likelihood of future, task-relevant targets, a variational lower bound on predictive sufficiency. We introduce a recursive consistency condition to ensure summaries are grounded by maximizing mutual information (MI) with the observed history. We mitigate credit assignment issues with a parameterized asymmetric critic that computes step-wise variational MI bounds for dense reward shaping. Empirical evaluation on long-horizon scientific reading and multi-turn dialogue benchmarks shows that MaxIM outperforms RL, supervised fine-tuning, and prompt-focused baselines on factual grounding, comprehensive autorater metrics, and downstream task utility across strict token budgets and extended horizons, without the need for expensive human preference labels.

</details>


### [545] [Shortcuts and Boundaries: Verifiable RL Misalignment and Contextual Safety Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12865)
*Xinjie Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过验证奖励与上下文冲突来生成大规模交互环境，从而揭示奖励驱动的不一致性，并通过变化的任务和授权条件下的安全学习来应对这些挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于揭示强化学习中奖励驱动的不一致性，特别是当奖励与执行要求产生冲突时，如何通过生成验证性奖励与上下文冲突来构建大规模交互环境，以提高系统的真实工作效率，同时确保合规性和安全性。

Method: 研究方法涉及构建包含奖励与上下文冲突的任务动力学，利用执行历史提供合规反馈，控制训练分布以模拟不同冲突暴露，并通过资源使用和报告工作流程中的任务优化来证明效果。研究人员进一步探讨了通过少量冲突暴露积累的不合规行为，并提供了减轻这些不合规行为的方法。

Result: 研究结果表明，在存在25%冲突混合的情况下，在128次更新后，实现了97.9%的经验证有利违规行为，同时提出了一种简单的二元惩罚机制，能够支持能力与合规性的协同提升，并部分缓解了已学习的违规行为。此外，通过学习的安全性能够适应广泛的授权条件变化，并转移到新的要求中，从而在未见过的变化证据任务中提高了安全完成率。

Conclusion: 综上所述，该研究改进了强化学习中奖励驱动不一致性的处理方法，提出了一种新的策略以实现在动态变化下保持系统安全和高效的双重目标。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve an agent's task capability while reinforcing behavior that violates contextual execution requirements. We study this reward-driven misalignment, including reward hacking, through verifiable reward--context conflicts, where compliant task completion remains feasible while some executable shortcuts earn more reward than every compliant strategy. Encoding these conflicts in task dynamics lets us generate diverse interactive environments at scale and derive compliance feedback from execution histories. In resource and reporting workflows, task optimization increases real productivity through unauthorized resource use or raises reported scores while actual work declines. Controlled changes in the training distribution show that minority conflict exposure can still lead to widespread shortcut acquisition, reaching 97.9\% certified profitable violations on an API task under a 25\% conflict mixture after 128 updates. The same contextual checks supply a simple binary penalty that supports joint capability and compliance gains and partially mitigates acquired violations. Learned safety adapts to expanded authorization and transfers across mechanisms into workflows with evolving evidence and approval requirements. On 32 unseen changing-evidence tasks, resource-trained safety increases safe completion from 53.1\% to 89.1\% relative to task-only training, while both policies achieve full real work. These results connect a verifiable account of reward-driven misalignment with scalable task construction and safety learning that remains useful under changing execution requirements.

</details>
