# cs.PF [[Back]](#toc)

### [546] [Sparse Predict and Demote: Optimal Scheduling with Minimal Size Advice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10293)
*Chengyi Liu,Thodoris Lykouris,Junxuan Shen,Adam Wierman*

Main category: cs.PF

TL;DR: 介绍了一种名为Sparse Predict and Demote (SPD)的新政策，该政策在大量流量情况下实现了响应时间的按比例最优性，仅需少量一比特的作业大小预测，即使预测不准确且成本高昂（服务器被用于计算预测时无法处理作业），SPD仍能保持近最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的作业大小预测通常不够准确且获取成本高昂，论文旨在探讨在预测不准确且成本高昂的情况下，是否仍可能实现响应时间的按比例最优性。

Method: 提出了名为Sparse Predict and Demote (SPD)的新型策略，并通过理论证明和数值实验验证策略的有效性。

Result: SPD策略在大量流量情况下实现了响应时间的按比例最优性，仅需要少量一比特的作业大小预测，即使预测不准确或计算成本高时仍能保持最优性能。

Conclusion: 研究证明，在预测存在误差且计算预测需占用服务器资源的情况下，SPD策略仍能实现最优性响应时间，扩展了单服务器调度中响应时间优化的条件。

Abstract: Knowledge of job sizes is crucial for optimizing the mean response time in single-server scheduling. However, predictions of job sizes are typically inexact and may be costly to obtain. Thus, a long-standing research question is: what is the minimal information about job sizes required to obtain near-optimal mean response time? We introduce a novel policy, \emph{Sparse Predict and Demote (SPD)}, and prove that it achieves order-optimal mean response time in heavy traffic while requiring only one-bit job-size predictions for a vanishing fraction of arrivals. SPD achieves heavy-traffic order-optimality even in situations when predictions are (i) inexact up to any fixed multiplicative error bound, and (ii) costly, i.e., the server is used to compute predictions and is thus unavailable to serve jobs while processing prediction queries. Finally, we use numerical experiments to illustrate that SPD maintains near-optimal performance beyond the heavy-traffic regime.

</details>


### [547] [Repeating Work Can Lower Energy per Successful Goal in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10315)
*Deepak Panigrahy,Stephen Abkin,Aakash Tyagi,David Kebo Houngninou,Rabi Mahapatra*

Main category: cs.PF

TL;DR: 研究了不同类型恢复机制对具有临时中断的工具使用LLM代理的影响，重点是能量效率，并提出了一种优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM代理在复杂任务中的应用，探索如何高效地恢复中断变得至关重要。研究提出了一个评价框架，以能量效率为核心指标，评估不同的恢复策略。

Method: 通过设计控制实验，在单节点环境下测试了八种恢复机制在特定模型上的表现。实验分组关注恢复时机（早中断或晚中断）和是否保留前缀缓存对能量效率的影响。

Result: 实验结果表明，重复中断的部分工作或从头开始恢复可以减少能量效率（EpG），具体取决于中断时间和前缀缓存的状态。对于试验模型，仅中断的工作重复具有最低EpG。

Conclusion: 研究表明，恢复策略的选择应考虑任务中断点和前缀缓存状态，以优化能量效率。框架开发者可以根据模型和任务特点灵活选择恢复方式，提高执行效率。

Abstract: When a temporary call failure interrupts a tool-using LLM agent, the framework must choose how much completed work to repeat. Repeating less completed work intuitively saves computation, but recovery mechanisms also change subsequent execution and the chance of success. We compare recovery mechanisms by energy per successful goal (EpG), which divides the energy of all task runs (including failed runs) by the number that finish correctly. In controlled vLLM experiments on one node, we measure board energy above idle for eight recovery options on reliably solved multi-turn tasks, with selected comparisons across three model families. For the model tested across all eight options, with the prefix cache retained, starting over has 22 percent lower EpG than continuing after early failures. Under the same cache condition, continuing has 24 percent lower EpG than starting over after late failures. Among all eight recovery options, repeating only the interrupted turn has the lowest observed EpG after early and late tool failures on this model. Holding recovery fixed, retaining the prefix cache reduces prompt tokens needing fresh computation by 86 percent but reduces recovery energy by only 8 percent at contexts up to 7,333 tokens. These measurements and a condition relating recovery energy and success show when repeating work lowers EpG, helping framework developers choose how their agents recover on their intended models and tasks.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [548] [The World Model Planning Accelerator (WMPA): Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design for Embedded AI in Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10316)
*Prerana Ramkumar,Suhas Suresh Bharadwaj,Fazal Hameed*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文推导了潜在状态转换的算术运算和CMOS动态能量的下限，分析了DreamerV3风格的递归状态空间模型（RSSM）中的能耗瓶颈，并提出了一个加速嵌入式世界模型规划的芯片架构World Model Planning Accelerator (WMPA)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然机器人使用了世界模型预测候选动作的结果，但预测步骤的能耗和硬件与理想状态的差距尚未被详细研究。通过对潜在状态转换的算术运算和CMOS动态能量进行理论分析，以及通过实验观测验证能耗瓶颈。

Method: 通过信息理论和布尔电路复杂性推导出潜在状态转换的算术运算和CMOS动态能量的下限，并通过解析DreamerV3风格的递归状态空间模型（RSSM）以确定能耗瓶颈。接着，进行暂态3D热模拟，最后设计了World Model Planning Accelerator (WMPA)芯片架构，以解决能耗及热量问题。

Result: 实验证明，每一次展开操作都受到内存带宽的限制，并表明GPU消耗的CMOS能量至少是地板能量的5.9x10^10倍。热模拟显示，这种低效率也是热效率问题，导致毫米级的硅片在理想散热装置保护下仍然达到556 K。WMPA芯片设计的目标为40倍的低功耗，使得相同硅片在仿真中维持在接近环境温度306 K，为热限制的机器人提供可行的规划思路。

Conclusion: 提出的设计在能耗和热管理方面提供了显著提升，为机器人嵌入式世界模型规划提供了实际可行性。

Abstract: Embedded AI is moving from perception to prediction. Robots now use world models$\unicode{x2014}$learned simulators that predict the outcome of candidate actions in a compressed latent space before any is executed. Every predicted step must be computed on board within a tight power and thermal budget, yet the energy these steps fundamentally require, and how far real hardware sits from it, have not been characterized. We derive lower bounds on the arithmetic operations and the CMOS dynamic energy of a latent state transition from information theory and Boolean circuit complexity. Profiling a DreamerV3-style Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) shows that every rollout operation is memory-bandwidth bound and that a GPU consumes at least $5.9\times10^{10}$ times the CMOS energy floor. Transient 3D thermal simulations show that this inefficiency is also a thermal one, since sustained back-to-back planning heats a millimeter-scale silicon tile to 556 K even behind an ideal copper heat spreader. Guided by this chain from bound to bottleneck, we propose the World Model Planning Accelerator (WMPA), a chip architecture for embedded world model planning that combines near-memory computation, real-time entropy estimation, variable-precision rollout units, and copy-on-write latent scratchpads. With a design target of 40x lower power, the same tile stays near ambient at 306 K in simulation, pointing toward practical planning on thermally constrained robots.

</details>


### [549] [PENSA: A Spatial Accelerator for BitNet b1.58 Inference on an HBM-equipped AMD Alveo FPGA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10648)
*Karthikeyan B. Kalyanasundara,Ivan S. Maksymo,Philip H. W. Leong*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: PENSA 是一个针对 BitNet b1.58 2B4T 模型优化的 FPGA 加速器，实现了每秒 58.09 万种 token 的吞吐量（上下文长度为 128），并能够处理 2048 的上下文长度，达到每秒 24.60 万种 token，表明了 FPGA 在处理大型语言模型中的应用潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主要的大型语言模型使用常规的乘法操作，而 PENSA 通过使用 sign-controlled 聚集替换普通乘法操作，减轻了硬件瓶颈，使其更适合高带宽内存访问和高效的算子占位。PENSA 的设计旨在优化运行硬件资源有限的 FPGA 平台，同时保持模型结构的原样。

Method: PENSA 通过使用分行的 ternary 矩阵引擎，从八个独立的高带宽内存通道中读取打包的 TQ1_0 权重，并通过选择符号和整数缩放执行逐周期处理。序列器、注意机制和词汇投影单元保留在 FPGA 中，通过交错调度循环管道单元，实现了连续序列的处理。

Result: PENSA 在 104.1 MHz 时的性能为：在 context 128 下达到 58.09 tok/s，而在 context 2048 下达到 24.60 tok/s，显示了其在处理大型语言模型时的高吞吐量。

Conclusion: PENSA 实现了在未修改模型结构的情况下，使用 FPGA 执行 2B 级别的 BitNet 拓扑，展示了 FPGA 在处理大型语言模型中的潜力。

Abstract: Ternary large language models (tLLMs) replace general multiplication in dominant linear layers with sign-controlled accumulation, shifting hardware bottlenecks toward packed-weight delivery, reduction, and operator occupancy. PENSA is an end-to-end FPGA accelerator for the BitNet b1.58 2B4T model on an AMD Alveo U50. Two row-partitioned ternary matrix engines consume packed TQ1_0 weights from eight independent high-bandwidth memory (HBM) pseudo-channels, each processing 1,280 ternary weights per cycle through sign selection and integer reduction. The sequencer, attention, and vocabulary-projection units remain resident on the FPGA, while two-stream interleaved scheduling overlaps sequences across the persistent pipeline to form the Penta-Unit. At 104.1~MHz, PENSA achieves 58.09 tok/s at context 128 and 24.60 tok/s at context 2048, corresponding to 2.14-3.14$\times$ the throughput of a same-model Xeon E-2356G baseline. The resulting system demonstrates end-to-end FPGA execution of 2B-scale BitNet topology without modifying its model structure.

</details>


### [550] [RTLREX: LLM-Guided Framework for Exact High-Level RTL Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10798)
*Wuqian Tang,Fangzhou Liu,Ruijie Wang,TingTing Hwang,Bei Yu,Chun-Yao Wang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: RTLREX 是一种结合大型语言模型和专用工具的框架，能够在无法访问 RTL 设计时从低级表示中恢复高度相关的 RTL 代码，并提升可读性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有硬件设计可能仅存在于门级网络列表或输入输出描述中，没有原始的寄存器传输级（RTL）设计和文档文件。通过从这些低级描述恢复高一级的RTL设计，工程师能够更直观地理解电路功能，并对RTL代码进行修改和重新合成，因此对于理解和优化硬件设计具有重要意义。

Method: RTLREX框架采用了大型语言模型（LLM）来指导具体的任务，包括函数恢复、RTL生成、独立验证以及成本导向的重写。模型会根据工具的反馈选择进一步分析，修正候选RTL代码的语法，并提出降低语法成本的建议。

Result: 在30个来自 ICCAD 2022 CAD Contest Problem A 的基准测试中，RTLREX 的恢复覆盖率超越了最先进的方法 WolFEx。与 WofFEx 相比，RTLREX 将平均语法成本降低了20.5%。在来自 IWLS 2026 Contest 的全真值表基准测试中，我们的框架在两条方法都验证的基准测试上将平均语法成本降低了95.7%。

Conclusion: RTLREX 框架通过结合大型语言模型和专用工具，成功地从低级表示中恢复出等效的高一级的RTL代码，显著提高了恢复的全面性和效率。

Abstract: Hardware designs may be available only as gate-level netlists or input-output descriptions when the original register-transfer-level (RTL) design and documentation are not accessible. Low-level representations obscure word-level computation and its finite-width behavior. Recovering high-level RTL from such representations therefore helps engineers understand a circuit's functionality and enables RTL rewriting and resynthesis. A plausible function model is also insufficient unless the generated RTL is equivalent to the original circuit for all input combinations. In this paper, we present RTLREX, a large language model (LLM)-guided framework that coordinates domain-specific tools for function recovery, RTL generation, independent verification, and cost-guided rewriting. Independent verification establishes equivalence between the recovered RTL and the original circuit. The LLM uses tool feedback to select further analyses, revise candidate RTL, and propose syntax-cost reductions. Experiments on 30 benchmarks from Problem A of the ICCAD 2022 CAD Contest show that RTLREX recovers equivalent high-level RTL for all benchmarks, surpassing the state-of-the-art method WolFEx in recovery coverage. On benchmarks recovered by both methods, RTLREX reduces mean syntax cost by 20.5% relative to WolFEx. On complete truth-table benchmarks from the IWLS 2026 Contest, our framework reduces mean syntax cost by 95.7% relative to an LLM agent baseline on the benchmarks validated by both methods.

</details>


### [551] [AutoC2V: Synthesis-Guided LLM Training for QoR-Optimized C++-to-Verilog Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10824)
*Guanqi Lyu,Fei Zhao,Zhaojun Lu,Jiaji He,Yongqiang Lyu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该研究提出了AutoC2V框架，通过使用真实综合反馈来优化基于C++的RTL生成，实现了更好的功能性通过率和时延与资源优化，优于其他方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手动调优和多次综合评估限制了高效率硬件的生成，因此需要一个能够直接从可综合C++内核生成高质量RTL的框架。

Method: 该研究利用真实综合结果来构建训练数据集，包括可综合C++源代码、相应的Verilog RTL、QoR指标和优化目标。通过监督微调（SFT）和组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行模型训练，并设计了一种QoR预测回报模型（QoR RM），以预测RTL的时延和资源指标，为策略优化提供低成本的连续QoR奖励信号。

Result: 实验结果表明AutoC2V在功能通过率、时延和资源优化方面均优于未微调的基础模型和其他方法。这表明结合真实综合数据和高效的QoR奖励建模可以进一步提高LLMs生成高质量RTL的能力。

Conclusion: AutoC2V框架通过利用真实综合结果和高效的QoR奖励建模，显著提高了从C++内核生成高质量RTL的能力，展示了其在硬件综合领域的有效性和潜力。

Abstract: High-level synthesis (HLS) can translate C/C++ kernels into register-transfer level (RTL) designs, yet generating high-quality hardware still relies heavily on manual pragma tuning and repeated synthesis evaluation. We propose AutoC2V, a C++-to-Verilog generation framework driven by real synthesis feedback that enables large language models (LLMs) to directly generate RTL with improved quality of results (QoR) from synthesizable C++ kernels. We construct training data from real synthesis results, including synthesizable C++ source code, the corresponding Verilog RTL, QoR metrics, and optimization objectives. Using this dataset, we align the model toward synthesis-aware RTL generation through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). To reduce the high cost of repeatedly invoking real synthesis during GRPO, we design the QoR Prediction Reward Model (QoR RM), which predicts latency and resource metrics by encoding RTL into long-context semantic representations, thereby providing low-cost and continuous QoR reward signals for policy optimization. Experimental results demonstrate that AutoC2V not only substantially improves RTL functional pass rates, but also achieves superior latency and resource optimization compared to the unfine-tuned base model, representative HLS optimization approaches (HLSPilot, LLM-DSE, and AutoDSE), and advanced general-purpose commercial models (Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek v4 Pro, and GLM-5.2). These results indicate that combining real synthesis data with efficient QoR reward modeling can further improve the ability of LLMs to generate high-quality RTL.

</details>


### [552] [Bit-level Perceptron Prediction for Indirect Branches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10913)
*Elba Garza,Samira Mirbagher-Ajorpaz,Tahsin Ahmad Khan,Daniel A. Jiménez*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种新的间接分支预测方案，通过位级预测分支目标地址，实现在与现有最先进的预测器相同硬件预算下具有竞争力的预测准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 间接分支因无法在执行前确定目标地址，是处理器控制流预测的一大挑战。针对此问题，该论文提出了一种基于感知机模型的新型位级间接分支预测方法。

Method: 该方法基于感知机模型进行分支历史相关性分析，通过预测分支目标地址的每一位实现精准控制流预测。

Result: 实验结果表明，该新型预测器在一系列工作负载下，比如SPEC和移动应用中，表现出了与最先进的预测器相当的预测准确率，例如在每1000个指令中仅误预测0.183次，对比于ITTAGE预测器的0.193次误预测率，以及基于VPC的间接预测器的0.29次误预测率。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了基于感知机模型的位级间接分支预测方法的有效性和实用性，在现代高性能处理器的设计中具有重要的应用前景。

Abstract: Modern software uses indirect branches for various purposes including, but not limited to, virtual method dispatch and implementation of switch statements. Because an indirect branch's target address cannot be determined prior to execution, high-performance processors depend on highly-accurate indirect branch prediction techniques to mitigate control hazards. This paper proposes a new indirect branch prediction scheme that predicts target addresses at the bit level. Using a series of perceptron-based predictors, our predictor predicts individual branch target address bits based on correlations within branch history. Our evaluations show this new branch target predictor is competitive with state-of-the-art branch target predictors at an equivalent hardware budget. For instance, over a set of workloads including SPEC and mobile applications, our predictor achieves a misprediction rate of 0.183 mispredictions per 1000 instructions, compared with 0.193 for the state-of-the-art ITTAGE predictor and 0.29 for a VPC-based indirect predictor.

</details>


### [553] [Augur: An Online Learning-based Hardware Data Prefetcher using Reservoir Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10929)
*Satvik Maurya,David Trilla,Swamit Tannu,Alper Buyuktosunoglu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Augur 是一种基于下一代蓄水库计算（NGRC）的硬件差值预测器，它通过在线更新、单一内积预测方式和避免浮点运算来实现在保持固定硬件成本的同时实现高效预测，从而显著提升了性能和准确度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着硬件技术和机器学习的不断发展，如何在保持低硬件成本的同时实现高效的预取是本文探讨的关键问题。当前的机器学习预取器虽然能够学习复杂的访存模式，但却在在线适应性、低延迟推理和适度硬件成本方面存在不足。

Method: Augur 将差值预测概念化为基于历史的回归问题，通过建立固定大小的蓄水库来自计算哈希化差值特征，并使用单一内积预测下一个差值。通过使用位与操作替代传统的整数乘法生成非线性蓄水库特征，保证了联合上下文编码在哈希特征中得以保留。此外，Augur 还结合了基于马尔可夫的简单差值预测器，用于处理简单的差值模式，并采用多层过滤和自适应预取窗口控制来减少不必要的预取。

Result: Augur 在169条不同的工作负载痕迹上，包括GAP、Ligra、PARSEC、SPEC CPU 2006、SPEC CPU 2017以及人工智能负载，超越了最先进的机器学习基差值预取器，分别在单核、四核和八核系统中的平均速度提升为2.9%、4.5%和5.3%。而且，Augur 可以实现约2倍的预取准确性以及37.8%更少的错误预取。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种实用的硬件差值预取器 Augur，它能够在保持低硬件成本的同时，不仅具备高效地预测任意差值的能力，还能够在各种工作负载中表现出色。这一策略为未来的硬件预取器设计提供了新的参考。

Abstract: Machine-learning-based hardware prefetchers can learn complex access patterns, but practical deployment demands online adaptation, low-latency inference, and modest hardware cost. We present Augur, a hardware delta prefetcher based on next-generation reservoir computing (NGRC) that meets all three requirements. Augur formulates delta prediction as a history-based regression problem. It constructs a fixed-size reservoir from hashed delta features over a short context window and predicts the next delta using a single dot product. The model is updated online via one-step SGD and requires no offline pre-training, no workload-specific tuning, and no floating-point arithmetic. A key technical insight makes this practical: replacing the integer multiplications traditionally used to generate nonlinear reservoir features with bitwise AND operations removes all feature-generation multipliers while preserving the joint context encoded in hash-derived features. Because Augur regresses a continuous delta rather than classifying into a fixed action set, it can predict any delta in [-64, 63]. Augur pairs the reservoir with a simple Markov-based delta predictor for simple delta patterns and employs multi-layered filtering and adaptive lookahead to suppress wasteful prefetches. Evaluated on 169 traces spanning GAP, Ligra, PARSEC, SPEC CPU 2006, SPEC CPU 2017, and AI workloads, Augur outperforms the state-of-the-art ML-based delta prefetcher by 2.9%, 4.5%, and 5.3% in geomean speedup on 1-, 4-, and 8-core systems, respectively, while achieving ~2x higher prefetch accuracy and 37.8% fewer overpredictions. Augur is practical to implement at 35 KB storage, 0.32 sq. mm area, and 32.7 mW in 12 nm.

</details>


### [554] [Beyond Host-Side Control: HBM Controller Partitioning Across Host and HBM Base Dies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10930)
*Tharunya Yogananda,Wantong Li*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文对主机和HBM4基片控制器在硅中介层上的功能级放置进行了第一项系统性定量研究，评估了从完全主机控制器到完全基片控制器的四种放置方式，并通过引入die-to-die (D2D) 链路和改进的Ramulator模型，探讨了其对面积、能耗和温度的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着高带宽内存HBM（如HBM4）的发展，基片 die 可以集成更复杂的控制器功能，研究者旨在探索在硅中介层上优化控制器放置的不同策略。

Method: 研究者将控制器分为几个主要功能，并设计了四种放置方案进行评估。他们使用扩展的 Ramulator 2 模型来模拟 HBM4 调度和维护机制，同时考虑了存储区和接口的能耗，并对数据进行了合成建模。

Result: 通过D2D链路连接解决了堆栈延迟问题，并提供了高达1.72倍的吞吐量，同时减少了主机岸线61%，节省了16.85 mm²的主机面积。此外，D2D链路导致了基片上的更大面积和功率需求，但在流式传输时，接口能效较低。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，将控制器功能放置在基片 die 上可以显著减少主机面积和能耗，同时提高系统性能，但在某些情况下也会增加基片 die 的发热程度。

Abstract: Recent generations of high bandwidth memory (HBM), such as HBM4, allow the base die of the memory stack to be manufactured using a logic process that can accommodate more complex controller functions next to the DRAM. We present the first systematic quantitative study of function-level controller placement between the host and the HBM4 base die on a silicon interposer. We divide the controller into its main functions and evaluate four placements, from a complete host controller to a complete base die controller, with intermediate placements that move maintenance or scheduling to the base die. We extend Ramulator 2 with HBM4 timing and maintenance, model a die-to-die (D2D) link with timing checks at the DRAM interface, and compose area, energy, and temperature from synthesized controller blocks, modeled storage, and interface data. A provisioned D2D link preserves per-stack bandwidth and adds about twice its one-way delay to unloaded latency. Maintenance moves to the base die with no bandwidth cost and frees host command slots, and the freed share grows with stack height. Replacing the wide interface with a D2D link saves 61% of host shoreline and 16.85 mm2 of host area per stack. The D2D link dominates the added base die area and power, and the base die runs cooler under streaming with link energy below 0.4 pJ/bit. Shared control delivers up to 1.72x the throughput of static partitioning between two requestors.

</details>


### [555] [When Is High-Bandwidth Flash Cost-Effective for LLM Inference?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11036)
*Zhiyu An,Yiping Li,Wan Du*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 通过在GPU附近存储权重，高带宽闪存（HBF）能够在某些场景下减少GPU的需求，从而降低大型语言模型（LLM）推理的成本。研究通过模拟各种模型和工作负载情况，发现HBF在不同需求下显示出节约成本和提高吞吐量的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索高带宽闪存（HBF）在取代部分GPU角色以降低大型语言模型（LLM）推理成本方面的潜力。

Method: 研究通过模拟九种密集和混合专家（MoE）模型，五种工作负载，两种GPU平台，以及1到100个GPU的比例，评估HBF的实际应用效果。

Result: 在固定需求下，HBF能够在98/468次比较中减少最少GPU的数量，特别是在暂停和短会话中。对于单个短聊天用户，HBF使得大型MoE模型如DeepSeek V3和Kimi K2能够在单个RTX 4090 GPU上满足新的服务目标，而在同样的GPU数量下，HBF能提高48%的匹配比较中的吞吐量，特别是在GPU数量不超过16个时。即使在100个RTX 4090规模的GPU情况下，层次化HBF也能将三个大型MoE模型的脱机吞吐量提高16.4到26.5倍。

Conclusion: 虽然高带宽闪存（HBF）在降低成本方面并不总能取代GPU，但在特定场景下，它确实能够在减少GPU使用的同时提高性能并降低总体成本。

Abstract: Can high-bandwidth flash (HBF) make LLM inference cheaper than adding GPUs? By storing weights closer to the GPU than SSD, HBF may reduce the number of GPUs needed for model capacity. However, this integration is only justified if it meets service targets and its cost is recovered. We simulate this integration using public component data across nine dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, five workloads, two GPU platforms, and 1--100 GPUs. At fixed demand, HBF reduces the minimum GPU count to meet a service target in 98 of 468 comparisons; majority of them are paused and short sessions, 63 remain cost-effective at half a GPU price per HBF stack. For single short-chat users, HBF enables large MoEs, e.g. DeepSeek V3 and Kimi K2, to meet a relaxed service target on one RTX~4090 GPU, where conventional serving fails. At fixed GPU count, HBF improves throughput in 48\% of matched comparisons below 16 GPUs and 13\% at larger counts. Even at 100 RTX~4090-scale GPUs, cascaded HBF raises offline throughput by 16.4--26.5$\times$ for three large MoEs. We found savings and throughput gains arise in different scenarios.

</details>


### [556] [PRISM: Preference-based Reward and Uncertainty-Integrated Synthesis Minimization for RTL PPA Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11051)
*Armin Abdollahi,Negin Ashrafi,Mehdi Kamal,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: PRISM是一种预算意识强的多目标框架，旨在优化RTL代码，同时减少昂贵的商业综合工具调用次数。它通过迭代LLM驱动的重写生成、快速编译/模拟等价性过滤、低成本特征提取和具有选择性的商业工具评估来改进功率、性能和面积。PRISM通过维护一个非劣解集来避免早期偏见和重复操作，从而实现稳健的逐步改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标是通过优化RTL代码，平衡固定预算下的功率、性能和面积，降低对昂贵商业工具的依赖。

Method: PRISM的方法包括基于LLM的重写生成、快速编译/模拟等价性过滤、低成本特征提取以及选择性商业综合工具评估，同时还训练了一个基于偏好奖励模型，使用对商业综合结果的成对排名监督进行优化。

Result: PRISM在不同工艺节点（7nm、15nm和45nm）的RTLLM v2.0模块中保持了一致的合成后收益，且消融实验表明奖励导向的选择和候选体舍弃对于样本高效进展至关重要。

Conclusion: PRISM能够实现稳健的逐步改进，同时在相同的综合管道中不需要重新训练，也能够满足在固定预算下的多目标优化需求。

Abstract: This paper introduces a budget-aware, multi-objective framework (called PRISM) for RTL optimization that improves power, performance, and area (PPA) while sharply limiting expensive commercial synthesis tool calls. Starting from a synthesizable baseline and functional testbench, the method iterates through LLM-driven rewrite generation, fast compile/simulation equivalence filtering, low-cost proxy feature extraction, and selective commercial synthesis tool (Synopsys Design Compiler (DC)) evaluation. To prioritize which candidates deserve high-quality synthesis, we train a preference-based reward model using pairwise ranking supervision derived from commercial synthesis tool outcomes, and combine ensemble uncertainty with a diversity-aware acquisition rule to avoid early bias and redundant evaluations. A key advantage is that PRISM maintains a best-tradeoff set G of non-dominated designs throughout the run: G preserves the best solutions found so far, is fed back into generation and refinement, and enables consistent, cumulative improvements rather than repeatedly restarting from the baseline. Across RTLLM v2.0 modules, the approach consistently yields post-synthesis gains under fixed commercial synthesis tool call budgets, and ablations confirm that reward-guided selection and candidate dropping are central to sample-efficient progress. PRISM efficacy is evaluated across multiple technology nodes (7 nm, 15 nm, and 45 nm) using identical pipelines without retraining.

</details>


### [557] [Efficient VLA Inference via Retrieval-Based Speculation and Hardware Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11098)
*Zhengyang Cheng,He Zhu,Zeyu Guo,Zihan Liu,Anbang Wu,Yiming Gan,Jingwen Leng,Yu Feng,Minyi Guo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Zora框架通过引入轻量级的RAG基草图模型、优化批验证过程以及设计专用硬件Zora核心来加速基于AR的VLA推理，使其在软件和硬件优化下分别比GPU快3.4倍和7.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了在资源受限的机器人平台上加速基于AR的VLA推理，解决现有推测解码方法依赖昂贵的草图模型带来的效率问题。

Method: Zora提出了一个新的硬件和软件协同设计框架：引入轻量级的RAG基草图模型，优化批验证策略，利用专用硬件（Zora核心）解决内存不规则性问题。

Result: Zora在软件优化下实现了最多3.4倍的速度提升，在结合硬件支持时速度提升至最多7.6倍，同时保留了与原始模型相当的准确性。

Conclusion: Zora框架通过软硬结合的方法有效提升了基于AR的VLA推理效率，使其更适用于实际的机器人系统中。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to understand and execute complex instructions, but their autoregressive (AR) action generation introduces significant latency on resource-constrained robotic platforms. Speculative decoding can accelerate AR-based inference by parallelizing action generation and verification; however, existing approaches rely on costly draft models, which are inefficient on edge platforms.
  In this paper, we propose Zora, a hardware-software co-design framework for accelerating AR-based VLA inference. Specifically, Zora introduces a lightweight retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-based draft model that exploits robotic dynamics without additional neural draft models. We further reduce batch verification overhead through a kinematics-guided action-acceptance strategy and a KV-cache-sharing attention mechanism. To address the retrieval overhead introduced by RAG-based drafting, we co-design dedicated hardware support, Zora core, to address the memory irregularity in RAG-based drafting. We evaluate Zora on four VLA models with the LIBERO benchmark. Zora retains comparable accuracy while achieving up to 3.4$\times$ speedup with software-only optimization and up to 7.6$\times$ speedup with hardware support over GPUs.

</details>


### [558] [A Per-Step Load-Balancing Engine for Expert-Parallel MoE Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11402)
*Jingyuan Li,Maolin Wang,Hayden So*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 通过引入Relief算法，实现了在专家并行Mixture-of-Experts服务中更高效的计算资源利用。Relief算法通过双向逐对松弛解决了线性规划问题，确保了在每一层的每一个解码步长中，计算资源的高效利用，使得计算资源利用率接近最优点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在专家并行Mixture-of-Experts服务中，由于GPU负载不均导致的资源浪费问题，传统的线性规划方法在处理大规模部署时无法有效解决。为此，文章旨在通过提出Relief算法来改善这一问题。

Method: Relief算法是一种双向逐对松弛的方法，通过对每个解码步长中复制专家的令牌分配进行整数减半处理，达到了在不使用精确线性规划解决器的情况下，逼近每步最优解的效果。

Result: 通过实验证明，Relief算法在不同专家组的拆分下，能够保持与最优利用率的接近平衡状态，相比传统的部署方案，能够使计算资源利用率提升高达37.3%，而仅增加0.02%的当前加速器的晶体管数量。

Conclusion: Relief算法在多层及不同粒度的解码步骤中实现了计算资源利用率的提升，特别是对于小型专家组的拆分，能够显著提高资源利用效率，对于计算资源有限的场景具有重要意义和价值。

Abstract: In expert-parallel Mixture-of-Experts serving, a layer finishes only when the most loaded GPU of its group does. Token routing shifts at every decode step and concentrates on a few experts, so most of the group's reserved GPU time waits on stragglers. Recovering that time means re-deciding, at every layer of every decode step, how each replicated expert's tokens divide between its copies. The exact linear-program solvers that make this decision optimally take longer than many of the layers they serve, and their working set outgrows GPU shared memory at deployment scale. We introduce Relief, a bidirectional pairwise relaxation that makes the linear program unnecessary, coming within a fraction of a point of the per-step optimum in a few passes of integer halving over the token counts. We build and measure three deployments, CUDA kernels on the serving GPU, the same verified engine on an FPGA over PCIe, and a fixed-function block beside the accelerator. On decode routing from three open MoE families, Relief holds the balance near the per-step optimum at every group size and layer time measured. Scored as effective utilization relative to that optimum, the kernel alone matches or exceeds every deployable scheme at every group size, from the hundred-microsecond layer on. The on-die engine widens that lead at every point, recovering up to 37.3 percentage points over the deployed static placement, while adding 0.02% of a current accelerator's transistors.

</details>


### [559] [CU-3D: A Scalable Legality-Aware RTL-to-GDS Flow for 3D-IC Physical Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11475)
*Mingjun Wang,Guanqi Li,Yihan Wen,Lancheng Zou,Mingjun Li,Feng Gu,Fengrui Liu,Jianan Mu,Yuxuan Zhao,Tsung-Yi Ho,Huawei Li,Sung Kyu Lim,Bei Yu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: CU-3D是一种基于商业EDA工具的RTL-to-GDS物理设计流程，综合考虑了多种连接类型，优化了硬件和电源分配，实现了多个高性能设计的零后端DRC违规和良好的信号连通性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计高效的3D封装实现需要同时优化数据、时钟和电源连接，以减少互连延迟并提高系统性能和能效。

Method: CU-3D流程从技术模型、HB足迹和PG几何中推导出角色兼容的HB站点，通过多种优化策略协调分区和布局，包括同时优化数据和时钟HB分配，并在3D时钟树合成、电源感知单元插入和布线过程中保留所选的HB站点和堆栈。

Result: 在11个设计中，流使得所有设计满足零后端DRC违规和信号连通性检查。在九个配对设计中，实现了更低尺寸和更节能的实现；在四个设计中，提高了设置WNS。在JPEG测试中，早期联合规划获得了87 ps的收益，而移动感知分区获得了346 ps的收益。

Conclusion: CU-3D流程成功地将数据、时钟和电源网格连接优化组合，实现了多个高性能设计的高效3D封装实现。

Abstract: Face-to-face (F2F) hybrid bonds shorten interdie connections, but data, clock, and power-grid (PG) connections must be realized together. CU-3D is a RTL-to-GDS physical design flow based on commercial EDA tools. It derives role-compatible hybrid-bond (HB) sites from a 17-metal ASAP7-based technology model, complete HB footprints, and constructed PG geometry. To coordinate partitioning with placement flexibility, Scaled refines an inherited 2D placement, whereas Fresh places the receiving die first and uses its pin locations and clock loads to guide placement of the other die. Data and clock HB assignments are jointly optimized while retaining alternative data sites and reserving capacity for subsequent PG assignment. The selected HB sites and stacks are preserved during 3D clock-tree synthesis, supply-aware cell insertion, and routing. Across eleven designs, including a 133-macro processor, the flow achieves zero backend DRC violations and passes signal-connectivity checks. Nine paired designs admit lower-footprint, lower-power implementations; four improve setup WNS. On JPEG, early joint planning gains 87 ps and mobility-aware partitioning gains 346 ps. Path analysis explains why cell-delay savings can outweigh net-delay increases.

</details>


### [560] [Practical Deep Learning-Based Block Demapping for mmWave MIMO Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11629)
*Syed Asrar ul haq,Jesus O. Lacruz,Joerg Widmer,Sumit J. Darak*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于深度学习的软译码器，采用块级处理而非符号级检测，通过一维卷积神经网络学习实际传播和硬件效应引起的时间结构，并产生与软决策解码阶段兼容的软位输出。实验结果表明，该方法在实际60GHz宽频段毫米波MIMO系统中表现优越，特别是适用于16QAM和64QAM，且在资源受限的边缘硬件上具有高效的部署性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鉴于残留信道失真、干扰和硬件非理想性等问题，传统的分析模型难以捕捉毫米波MIMO系统的实际情况，而深度学习有望通过数据驱动的方法，提供更灵活和适应性的物理层设计。

Method: 该方法通过一维卷积神经网络处理接收到的符号块，以学习实际传播和硬件效应引起的时间结构，并生成与软决策解码阶段兼容的软位输出。该网络在60 GHz的4x4宽频段毫米波MIMO系统上进行了训练和评估。

Result: 实验结果表明，与传统软决策译码器相比，该方法在实际毫米波MIMO条件下的比特误码率显著降低，尤其在16QAM和64QAM中的效果显著。

Conclusion: 基于深度学习的软译码器显示出在资源受限的边缘硬件上高效部署的潜力，为6G系统的设计提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Deep learning is expected to play a central role in 6G systems, by enabling data-driven physical layer designs that can adapt to practical wireless impairments. This is particularly important for millimetre-wave (mmWave) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, which are strongly affected by residual channel distortions, interference, and hardware non-idealities that are difficult to capture with analytical models. In this paper, we propose a deep learning-based soft demapper that performs block-wise processing of received symbols instead of conventional symbol-wise detection. The demapper employs a one-dimensional convolutional neural network to learn temporal structure induced by practical propagation and hardware effects, while producing soft bit outputs compatible with soft-decision decoding stages. The proposed approach is trained and evaluated for a 4$\times$4 wideband mmWave MIMO system at 60~GHz, using an over-the-air dataset collected across multiple days and settings. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements over a conventional soft-decision demapper, including up to a 2.6$\times$ reduction in bit error rate for 16QAM and up to a 17.6$\times$ reduction for 64QAM under real over-the-air mmWave MIMO conditions. The proposed demapper is further implemented on a Zynq RFSoC platform using a reconfigurable convolution engine and fixed-point arithmetic, achieving an approximately 34.3$\times$ speedup compared to a processor-based implementation, and demonstrating that learning-based demapping can be deployed efficiently on resource-constrained edge hardware.

</details>


### [561] [AscSpMM: Efficient SpMM on Ascend NPUs via Pipelined Vector-Cube Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11823)
*Fei Li,Haoxin Li,Kehong Liu,Yanzi Zhou,Weiguo Wu,Shiqiang Nie,Jinyu Wang,Song Liu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: AscSpMM通过改进的参数化向量-CSR表示和分离了不规则的操作准备与规则的矩阵计算，实现了显著的速度提升和内存消耗减少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NPUs的主要库主要针对密集计算，而稀疏矩阵-密集矩阵乘法（SpMM）由于其特殊的操作需求与NPUs的硬件设计相冲突，因此需要一种新的方法来优化。

Method: AscSpMM通过使用参数化向量-CSR表示来分离不规则的操作准备与规则的矩阵计算。它使用向量引擎解码索引并将密集操作重组，而Cube引擎执行矩阵相乘累加操作。通过引入双插槽环形缓冲区实现依赖感知的异步流水线，并通过操作再利用和运行时自适应分块减少跨引擎停滞。

Result: AscSpMM在Ascend 910B3上的速度是GEMM的2.36倍，是现有SpMM实现的19.92倍，是cuSPARSE的5.82倍。与特定的GPU Tensor Core SpMM内核相比，它在平均存储量和峰值HBM占用率上分别减少了48.24%和22.98%。

Conclusion: AscSpMM通过优化不规则数据的操作准备，提高了稀疏矩阵-密集矩阵乘法的性能，并且能够在保持高效率的同时减少内存消耗。

Abstract: Neural processing units (NPUs) provide high compute density and energy efficiency through specialized matrix engines and software-managed on-chip memory. However, their libraries primarily target dense computation. Sparse matrix-dense matrix multiplication (SpMM), a key kernel in graph analytics, sparse neural networks, and scientific computing, requires index-driven operand selection, indirect addressing, scattered memory accesses, and load balancing. These requirements conflict with the fixed shapes and contiguous layouts preferred by NPU matrix engines. GPU Tensor Core SpMM methods cannot be directly transferred to NPUs with decoupled vector and matrix engines. We present AscSpMM, which separates irregular operand preparation from regular matrix computation through a parameterized Vector-CSR representation. The vector engine decodes indices and gathers and reorganizes dense operands, while the Cube engine performs matrix multiply-accumulate operations. A double-slot ring buffer enables dependency-aware asynchronous pipelining, while operand reuse and runtime-adaptive tiling reduce cross-engine stalls. On an Ascend 910B3, AscSpMM achieves geometric-mean speedups of 2.36x over GEMM, 19.92x over an existing SpMM implementation, and 5.82x over cuSPARSE on an A100. It reduces matrix-input storage and peak HBM footprint by 48.24% and 22.98% on average, while remaining competitive with specialized GPU Tensor Core SpMM kernels. The code is available at https://github.com/LfLab-AI/Ascend-NPU-SpMM.

</details>


### [562] [To SIMD or Not to SIMD: Comparing RVV vs. CGRA SoCs for Non-Linear Functions in AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12435)
*Sameer Deshmukh,Naoya Mizuki,Takumi Honda*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文构建了使用RVV向量处理器和弹性CGRAs的SoCs，分析了两者在非线性函数上的性能表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前芯片厂商依赖于传统向量或标量处理单元进行非线性函数运算，这些单元的性能落后于矩阵乘法单元，本文研究旨在弥补这一差距。

Method: 构建了两个SoC系统，分别采用RVV向量处理器和弹性CGRAs，并比较了它们在常见前馈网络上的速度。

Result: 弹性CGRAs在简单点乘非线性函数（如SiLU）的激活阶段达到7.12倍的时钟周期加速，而在复杂非线性函数（如softmax）上，RVV达到9.8倍的加速；整体前馈块上，最大加速分别为3.16倍和4.24倍。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，不同的非线性函数适合不同的处理单元，弹性CGRAs在简单非线性函数上有优势，而RVV在复杂非线性函数上表现出色。

Abstract: Non-linear functions are an important class of operations in modern large language models. However, chip vendors building for AI have so far relied on traditional vector or scalar processing units for non-linear functions. The performance of these units has not kept pace with matrix multiplication units (MMUs), which can be found in both high-performance and edge-computing devices from almost every vendor. Reconfigurable units such as FPGAs and CGRAs have been proposed in the literature, but have not been systematically compared with traditional units backed by MMUs. In this paper, we build two SoCs: one using an RVV vector processor and the other using a latency-insensitive (\emph{elastic}) CGRA, both coupled with an MMU and driven by a single-core CPU. We then propose mappings for common feed-forward networks on our SoCs and find that the CGRA reaches a maximum speedup in clock cycles of 7.12x over RVV on the activation stage of simple point-wise non-linear functions like SiLU, whereas the RVV reaches a maximum speedup of \textbf{9.8x} over the CGRA on complex non-linear functions such as $\mathrm{softmax}$. Over the enclosing feed-forward block the corresponding maxima are 3.16x and 4.24x.

</details>


### [563] [Hidden in Plain Sight: Privacy-Enhanced Computing Through Register Renaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12570)
*Ahmed Nematallah,Stefanos Kaxiras*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: HPS-PEC通过利用CPU现有基础设施，在少量架构修改下实现了隐私增强计算（PEC），在执行保护代码时仅增加轻微的延迟成本，相比专用加密单元，性能提升了超过1.26倍，同时使用较少的硬件资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的硬件机制虽然能够实现PEC，但需要专用的处理器保护区，限制了计算资源的利用和并行执行能力。HPS-PEC旨在利用CPU现有硬件资源，减少对专用处理器保护区的需求，提高PEC应用的性能。

Method: HPS-PEC通过引入数据盲存（Data-oblivious）编码格式，加密数据在CPU内部透明处理，使得每条指令都无法触及明文数据。这种方法依赖于CPU现有的重命名单元和寄存器文件，从而避免了构建额外保护区域的复杂性。

Result: HPS-PEC在25个VIP-Bench基准测试下实现了加密代码执行时间仅有原生代码的3.41倍，其中1.03倍归因于数据盲存代码的固有限制。相较于专门的加密单元Sequestered Encryption (SE)，HPS-PEC的性能提升了1.26倍，同时占用不到其1/3的专用面积。

Conclusion: HPS-PEC展示了通过少量架构改动利用现有CPU硬件资源实现PEC的可行性，为提高隐私计算性能和效率提供了新途径。

Abstract: Privacy-Enhanced Computing (PEC) is a mechanism to hide program secrets from the outside world without paying the cost of fully-homomorphic encryption. Previous work has developed hardware mechanisms to achieve this goal but they require a dedicated processor enclave where all computations are done, requiring duplicate ALU resources and limiting the performance of PEC-utilizing applications due to not being able to access the full compute resources of the processor (e.g., multiple execution units and vector units), or not being able to execute PEC instructions in parallel and out-of-order.
  In this work, we introduce HPS-PEC (Hidden in Plain Sight PEC), a novel method of utilizing existing infrastructure in the CPU to achieve PEC with minor modifications to the architecture. We show that, across 25 VIP-Bench benchmarks and with a 7-cycle QARMA-64 cipher, HPS-PEC runs encrypted code at 3.41x the execution time of unprotected native code (geometric mean), of which 1.03x is the cost of data-oblivious code itself, and is 1.26x faster than a Sequestered Encryption (SE) unit while utilizing under a third of its dedicated area. Our method keeps plaintext out of reach of every instruction, as an enclave does given a correctly functioning renamer and register file, which every program already depends on.

</details>
